000801: export class AdminController {
000802:   /**
000803:    * Bootstrap initial system admin account (creates Firebase user + Firestore profile)
000804:    * This should be called manually or via a secure admin script
000805:    * Only use this for the first admin setup
000806:    */
000807:   static async bootstrapAdmin(req, res, next) {
000808:     try {
000809:       const { email, password, fullName } = req.body;
000810:       await ensureBootstrapAuthorized(req);
000811: 
000812:       if (!email || !password) {
000813:         return res.status(400).json({ error: 'Email and password are required' });
000814:       }
000815: 
000816:       // Note: We allow creating multiple system admins for flexibility
000817:       // The first admin can promote others later
000818: 
000819:       // Create Firebase Auth user
000820:       let firebaseUser;
000821:       try {
000822:         firebaseUser = await admin.auth().createUser({
000823:           email,
000824:           password,
000825:           displayName: fullName || 'System Administrator',
000826:           emailVerified: true, // Auto-verify admin email
000827:         });
000828:       } catch (error) {
000829:         if (error.code === 'auth/email-already-exists') {
000830:           // User exists in Firebase, try to get their UID
000831:           const existingUser = await admin.auth().getUserByEmail(email);
000832:           firebaseUser = existingUser;
000833:           logger.info(`Firebase user already exists for ${email}, using existing UID`);
000834:         } else {
000835:           throw error;
000836:         }
000837:       }
000838: 
000839:       const uid = firebaseUser.uid;
000840: 
000841:       // Check if user already exists in Firestore
000842:       let user = await userStore.getByUid(uid);
000843: 
000844:       if (user) {
000845:         if (user.accountType === 'SYSTEM_ADMIN') {
000846:           await ensureRealtimeAdmin({
000847:             uid,
000848:             email: user.email || email,
000849:             fullName: user.fullName || fullName,
000850:           });
000851:           return res.json({
000852:             success: true,
000853:             message: 'System admin already exists',
000854:             user: sanitizeUser(user),
000855:           });
000856:         }
000857: 
000858:         // Update existing user to system admin
000859:         user = await userStore.update(uid, {
000860:           accountType: 'SYSTEM_ADMIN',
000861:         });
000862:       } else {
000863:         // Create new system admin user in Firestore
000864:         user = await userStore.create(uid, {
000865:           email,
000866:           accountType: 'SYSTEM_ADMIN',
000867:           fullName: fullName || 'System Administrator',
000868:         });
000869:       }
000870: 
000871:       await ensureRealtimeAdmin({
000872:         uid,
000873:         email,
000874:         fullName: user?.fullName || fullName,
000875:       });
000876: 
000877:       // Initialize system settings if not exist
000878:       await systemSettingsStore.initialize(uid);
000879: 
000880:       // Log the action
000881:       await platformAuditLogStore.record({
000882:         actorId: uid,
000883:         actorType: 'SYSTEM_ADMIN',
000884:         action: 'ADMIN_BOOTSTRAPPED',
000885:         targetType: 'USER',
000886:         targetId: uid,
000887:         metadata: { email },
000888:       });
000889: 
000890:       logger.info(`System admin bootstrapped: ${email} (${uid})`);
000891: 
000892:       res.status(201).json({
000893:         success: true,
000894:         message: 'System admin created successfully',
000895:         user: sanitizeUser(user),
000896:         credentials: {
000897:           email,
000898:           uid,
000899:           note: 'You can now log in with this email and password',
000900:         },
000901:       });
000902:     } catch (error) {
000903:       logger.error('Bootstrap admin error:', error);
000904:       next(error);
000905:     }
000906:   }
000907: 
000908:   /**
000909:    * Seed initial system admin account (one-time operation)
000910:    * This should be called manually or via a secure admin script
000911:    * Requires user to already exist in Firebase Auth
000912:    */
000913:   static async seedAdmin(req, res, next) {
000914:     try {
000915:       const { email, uid } = req.body;
000916:       const normalizedEmail = (email || '').toString().trim().toLowerCase();
000917: 
000918:       if (!normalizedEmail || !uid) {
000919:         return res.status(400).json({ error: 'Email and UID are required' });
000920:       }
000921: 
000922:       // Check if user already exists
000923:       let user = await userStore.getByUid(uid);
000924: 
000925:       if (user) {
000926:         if (user.accountType === 'SYSTEM_ADMIN') {
000927:           await ensureRealtimeAdmin({
000928:             uid: user.id || uid,
000929:             email: user.email || normalizedEmail,
000930:             fullName: user.fullName || req.body.fullName,
000931:           });
000932:           return res.json({
000933:             success: true,
000934:             message: 'System admin already exists',
000935:             user: sanitizeUser(user),
000936:           });
000937:         }
000938:       } else {
000939:         // Safe idempotent retry path: if the email already belongs to a system admin,
000940:         // treat this request as already satisfied even if the caller supplied a stale UID.
000941:         const existingByEmail = await userStore.getByEmail(normalizedEmail);
000942:         if (existingByEmail?.accountType === 'SYSTEM_ADMIN') {
000943:           await ensureRealtimeAdmin({
000944:             uid: existingByEmail.id,
000945:             email: existingByEmail.email || normalizedEmail,
000946:             fullName: existingByEmail.fullName || req.body.fullName,
000947:           });
000948:           return res.json({
000949:             success: true,
000950:             message: existingByEmail.id === uid
000951:               ? 'System admin already exists'
000952:               : 'System admin already exists for this email',
000953:             user: sanitizeUser(existingByEmail),
000954:             ...(existingByEmail.id !== uid
000955:               ? {
000956:                 requestedUid: uid,
000957:                 resolvedUid: existingByEmail.id,
000958:               }
000959:               : {}),
000960:           });
000961:         }
000962:       }
000963: 
000964:       // If a system admin already exists, only authenticated system admins can
000965:       // promote additional users. The idempotent "already exists" success path
000966:       // above remains available for safe retries.
000967:       await ensureBootstrapAuthorized(req);
000968: 
000969:       if (user) {
000970:         // Update existing user to system admin
000971:         user = await userStore.update(uid, {
000972:           accountType: 'SYSTEM_ADMIN',
000973:         });
000974:       } else {
000975:         // Create new system admin user
000976:         user = await userStore.create(uid, {
000977:           email: normalizedEmail,
000978:           accountType: 'SYSTEM_ADMIN',
000979:           fullName: req.body.fullName || 'System Administrator',
000980:         });
000981:       }
000982: 
000983:       await ensureRealtimeAdmin({
000984:         uid: user?.id || uid,
000985:         email: user?.email || normalizedEmail,
000986:         fullName: user?.fullName || req.body.fullName,
000987:       });
000988: 
000989:       // Initialize system settings if not exist
000990:       await systemSettingsStore.initialize(uid);
000991: 
000992:       // Log the action
000993:       await platformAuditLogStore.record({
000994:         actorId: uid,
000995:         actorType: 'SYSTEM_ADMIN',
000996:         action: 'ADMIN_SEEDED',
000997:         targetType: 'USER',
000998:         targetId: uid,
000999:         metadata: { email: normalizedEmail },
001000:       });
001001: 
001002:       logger.info(`System admin seeded: ${normalizedEmail}`);
001003: 
001004:       res.status(201).json({
001005:         success: true,
001006:         message: 'System admin created successfully',
001007:         user: sanitizeUser(user),
001008:       });
001009:     } catch (error) {
001010:       logger.error('Seed admin error:', error);
001011:       next(error);
001012:     }
001013:   }

001015:   /**
001016:    * List all organizations with optional status filter
001017:    */
001018:   static async listOrganizations(req, res, next) {
001019:     try {
001020:       const { status, limit = 100, offset = 0 } = req.query;
001021: 
001022:       let organizations;
001023:       if (status) {
001024:         organizations = await organizationStore.listByStatus(status, parseInt(limit));
001025:       } else {
001026:         organizations = await organizationStore.listAll(parseInt(limit), parseInt(offset));
001027:       }
001028: 
001029:       // Enrich with owner information
001030:       const ownerIds = organizations.map((org) => org.ownerId).filter(Boolean);
001031:       const owners = await userStore.getSummaries(ownerIds);
001032: 
001033:       const enriched = organizations.map((org) => ({
001034:         ...sanitizeOrganization(org),
001035:         owner: owners.get(org.ownerId) || null,
001036:       }));
001037: 
001038:       res.json({
001039:         success: true,
001040:         organizations: enriched,
001041:         total: enriched.length,
001042:       });
001043:     } catch (error) {
001044:       logger.error('List organizations error:', error);
001045:       next(error);
001046:     }
001047:   }

001049:   /**
001050:    * Get pending organizations (awaiting approval)
001051:    */
001052:   static async listPendingOrganizations(req, res, next) {
001053:     try {
001054:       const { limit = 50 } = req.query;
001055: 
001056:       const organizations = await organizationStore.listByStatus('PENDING', parseInt(limit));
001057: 
001058:       // Enrich with owner information
001059:       const ownerIds = organizations.map((org) => org.ownerId).filter(Boolean);
001060:       const owners = await userStore.getSummaries(ownerIds);
001061: 
001062:       // Get member counts
001063:       const enriched = await Promise.all(
001064:         organizations.map(async (org) => {
001065:           const members = await organizationMemberStore.listByOrganization(org.id);
001066:           return {
001067:             ...sanitizeOrganization(org),
001068:             owner: owners.get(org.ownerId) || null,
001069:             memberCount: members.length,
001070:           };
001071:         }),
001072:       );
001073: 
001074:       res.json({
001075:         success: true,
001076:         organizations: enriched,

001210:   /**
001211:    * Reject organization
001212:    */
001213:   static async rejectOrganization(req, res, next) {
001214:     try {
001215:       const { id } = req.params;
001216:       const { reason, reasonCode, reasonTags, reasonTagOther } = req.body;
001217:       const adminId = req.user.id;
001218: 
001219:       const organization = await organizationStore.getById(id);
001220:       if (!organization) {
001221:         return res.status(404).json({ error: 'Organization not found' });
001222:       }
001223: 
001224:       if (organization.status === 'REJECTED') {
001225:         return res.json({
001226:           success: true,
001227:           message: 'Organization is already rejected',
001228:           organization: sanitizeOrganization(organization),
001229:         });
001230:       }
001231: 
001232:       if (organization.status !== 'PENDING') {
001233:         return res.status(409).json({
001234:           success: false,
001235:           error: `Only pending organizations can be rejected. Current status: ${organization.status}.`,
001236:           code: 'INVALID_ORG_STATUS',
001237:         });
001238:       }
001239: 
001240:       const normalizedReasonCode = normalizeRejectionCode(reasonCode);
001241:       const normalizedReasonTags = normalizeRejectionTags(reasonTags, normalizedReasonCode);
001242:       const normalizedReasonTagOther = normalizedReasonTags.includes('OTHER') && reasonTagOther
001243:         ? String(reasonTagOther).trim()
001244:         : null;
001245:       const rejected = await organizationStore.reject(id, {
001246:         reason,
001247:         rejectedBy: adminId,
001248:         reasonCode: normalizedReasonCode,
001249:         reasonTags: normalizedReasonTags,
001250:         reasonTagOther: normalizedReasonTagOther,
001251:       });
001252: 
001253:       // Log the action
001254:       await platformAuditLogStore.record({
001255:         actorId: adminId,
001256:         actorType: 'SYSTEM_ADMIN',
001257:         action: 'ORG_REJECTED',
001258:         targetType: 'ORGANIZATION',
001259:         targetId: id,
001260:         metadata: {
001261:           organizationName: organization.name,
001262:           ownerId: organization.ownerId,
001263:           reason,
001264:           reasonCode: normalizedReasonCode,
001265:           reasonTags: normalizedReasonTags,
001266:           reasonTagOther: normalizedReasonTagOther,
001267:         },
001268:       });
001269: 
001270:       // Send rejection email in background.
001271:       const owner = await userStore.getByUid(organization.ownerId).catch(() => null);
001272:       if (!owner) {
001273:         logger.warn(`Owner not found for organization ${id}, ownerId: ${organization.ownerId}`);
001274:       } else if (!owner.email) {
001275:         logger.warn(`Owner ${organization.ownerId} does not have an email address`);
001276:       } else {
001277:         queueEmailJob({
001278:           type: 'ORG_REJECTED_EMAIL',
001279:           payload: {
001280:             organizationId: rejected.id,
001281:             ownerId: owner.id,
001282:             recipient: owner.email,
001283:           },
001284:           handler: async () => {
001285:             logger.info(`Attempting to send rejection email to ${owner.email} for organization ${organization.name}`);
001286:             await emailNotifications.sendOrganizationRejected(rejected, owner, reason);
001287:             logger.info(`Rejection email sent successfully to ${owner.email}`);
001288:           },
001289:         });
001290:       }
001291: 
001292:       logger.info(`Organization rejected: ${id} by admin ${adminId}, reason: ${reason}`);
001293: 
001294:       await publishAdminRealtimeUpdate('organization-status-updated', {
001295:         organizationId: id,
001296:         status: rejected?.status || 'REJECTED',
001297:       });
001298: 
001299:       res.json({
001300:         success: true,
001301:         message: 'Organization rejected',
001302:         organization: sanitizeOrganization(rejected),
001303:       });
001304:     } catch (error) {
001305:       logger.error('Reject organization error:', error);
001306:       next(error);
001307:     }
001308:   }

001571:   /**
001572:    * Get platform audit logs
001573:    */
001574:   static async getAuditLogs(req, res, next) {
001575:     try {
001576:       const { limit = 100, offset = 0, cursor = null } = req.query;
001577:       const parsedLimit = Number.parseInt(limit, 10);
001578:       const parsedOffset = Number.parseInt(offset, 10);
001579:       const normalizedCursor = typeof cursor === 'string' ? cursor.trim() : null;
001580: 
001581:       const page = normalizedCursor
001582:         ? await platformAuditLogStore.listPage({
001583:           limit: parsedLimit,
001584:           cursor: normalizedCursor,
001585:         })
001586:         : await platformAuditLogStore.listPageFromOffset({
001587:           limit: parsedLimit,
001588:           offset: parsedOffset,
001589:         });
001590:       const logs = page.items;
001591: 
001592:       // Enrich with actor information
001593:       const actorIds = logs.map((log) => log.actorId).filter(Boolean);
001594:       const actors = await userStore.getSummaries(actorIds);
001595: 
001596:       const enriched = logs.map((log) => ({
001597:         ...log,
001598:         actor: actors.get(log.actorId) || null,
001599:       }));
001600: 
001601:       res.json({
001602:         success: true,
001603:         logs: enriched,
001604:         total: enriched.length,
001605:         hasMore: page.hasMore,
001606:         nextCursor: page.nextCursor,
001607:       });
001608:     } catch (error) {
001609:       logger.error('Get audit logs error:', error);
001610:       next(error);
001611:     }
001612:   }

001614:   /**
001615:    * Get platform statistics
001616:    */
001617:   static async getStats(req, res, next) {
001618:     try {
001619:       const [allOrgs, usersSnapshot, subscriptionsSnapshot] = await Promise.all([
001620:         organizationStore.listAll(1000, 0),
001621:         firestore.collection('users').get(),
001622:         firestore.collection('subscriptions').get(),
001623:       ]);
001624:       const pendingOrgs = allOrgs.filter((o) => o.status === 'PENDING');
001625:       const approvedOrgs = allOrgs.filter((o) => o.status === 'APPROVED');
001626:       const rejectedOrgs = allOrgs.filter((o) => o.status === 'REJECTED');
001627:       const suspendedOrgs = allOrgs.filter((o) => o.status === 'SUSPENDED');
001628: 
001629:       const users = usersSnapshot.docs.map((doc) => doc.data() || {});
001630:       const usersByType = users.reduce(
001631:         (acc, user) => {
001632:           const type = (user.accountType || 'UNKNOWN').toString().toUpperCase();
001633:           if (type === 'CANDIDATE') acc.candidates += 1;
001634:           else if (type === 'COMPANY') acc.companyUsers += 1;
001635:           else if (type === 'SYSTEM_ADMIN') acc.systemAdmins += 1;
001636:           else acc.other += 1;
001637:           return acc;
001638:         },
001639:         {
001640:           candidates: 0,
001641:           companyUsers: 0,
001642:           systemAdmins: 0,
001643:           other: 0,
001644:         },
001645:       );
001646:       const suspendedUsers = users.filter(
001647:         (user) => normalizeUserAccountStatus(user.accountStatus) === 'SUSPENDED',
001648:       ).length;
001649: 
001650:       const subscriptions = subscriptionsSnapshot.docs.map((doc) => doc.data() || {});
001651:       const activeSubscriptions = subscriptions.filter(
001652:         (subscription) => (subscription.status || '').toString().toLowerCase() === 'active',
001653:       ).length;
001654:       
001655:       // Get recent activity
001656:       const recentLogsPage = await platformAuditLogStore.listPage({ limit: 10 });
001657:       const recentLogs = recentLogsPage.items;
001658:       
001659:       // Enrich with actor information
001660:       const actorIds = recentLogs.map((log) => log.actorId).filter(Boolean);
001661:       const actors = actorIds.length > 0 ? await userStore.getSummaries(actorIds) : new Map();
001662:       
001663:       const enrichedLogs = recentLogs.map((log) => ({
001664:         ...log,
001665:         actor: actors.get(log.actorId) || null,
001666:         timestamp: log.createdAt, // Add timestamp alias for compatibility
001667:       }));
001668: 
001669:       res.json({
001670:         success: true,
001671:         stats: {
001672:           organizations: {
001673:             total: allOrgs.length,
001674:             pending: pendingOrgs.length,
001675:             approved: approvedOrgs.length,
001676:             rejected: rejectedOrgs.length,
001677:             suspended: suspendedOrgs.length,
001678:           },
001679:           users: {
001680:             total: users.length,
001681:             suspended: suspendedUsers,
001682:             ...usersByType,
001683:           },
001684:           billing: {
001685:             totalSubscriptions: subscriptions.length,
001686:             activeSubscriptions,
001687:           },
001688:           recentActivity: enrichedLogs,
001689:         },
001690:       });
001691:     } catch (error) {
001692:       logger.error('Get stats error:', error);
001693:       next(error);
001694:     }
001695:   }
001696: 
001697:   /**
001698:    * Get fairness and calibration metrics (FR10).
001699:    * Aggregates score distribution and AI vs SME calibration from recent interviews and reviews.
001700:    */
001701:   static async getFairnessCalibration(req, res, next) {
001702:     try {
001703:       const limit = Math.min(parseInt(req.query.limit, 10) || 500, 1000);
001704:       const [interviews, reviews] = await Promise.all([
001705:         interviewStore.listRecent(limit),
001706:         reviewStore.listRecent(limit),
001707:       ]);
001708: 
001709:       const completed = interviews.filter((i) => i.status === 'COMPLETED');
001710:       const withScore = completed.filter((i) => i.overallScore != null && !Number.isNaN(Number(i.overallScore)));
001711: 
001712:       const scoreBuckets = { '0-20': 0, '21-40': 0, '41-60': 0, '61-80': 0, '81-100': 0 };
001713:       withScore.forEach((i) => {
001714:         const s = Number(i.overallScore);
001715:         if (s <= 20) scoreBuckets['0-20'] += 1;
001716:         else if (s <= 40) scoreBuckets['21-40'] += 1;
001717:         else if (s <= 60) scoreBuckets['41-60'] += 1;
001718:         else if (s <= 80) scoreBuckets['61-80'] += 1;
001719:         else scoreBuckets['81-100'] += 1;
001720:       });
001721: 
001722:       const withFinalScore = completed.filter((i) => i.finalOverallScore != null || i.overallScore != null);
001723:       const finalScoreBuckets = { '0-20': 0, '21-40': 0, '41-60': 0, '61-80': 0, '81-100': 0 };
001724:       withFinalScore.forEach((i) => {
001725:         const s = Number(i.finalOverallScore ?? i.overallScore);
001726:         if (s <= 20) finalScoreBuckets['0-20'] += 1;
001727:         else if (s <= 40) finalScoreBuckets['21-40'] += 1;
001728:         else if (s <= 60) finalScoreBuckets['41-60'] += 1;
001729:         else if (s <= 80) finalScoreBuckets['61-80'] += 1;
001730:         else finalScoreBuckets['81-100'] += 1;
001731:       });
001732: 
001733:       const calibrationPairs = reviews.filter(
001734:         (r) =>
001735:           r.aiOverallScoreAtReview != null &&
001736:           !Number.isNaN(Number(r.aiOverallScoreAtReview)) &&
001737:           r.smeOverallScore != null &&
001738:           !Number.isNaN(Number(r.smeOverallScore))
001739:       );
001740:       const overrideCount = reviews.filter((r) => r.overrideOverall === true).length;
001741:       const meanAbsDiff =
001742:         calibrationPairs.length > 0
001743:           ? calibrationPairs.reduce((sum, r) => sum + Math.abs(Number(r.aiOverallScoreAtReview) - Number(r.smeOverallScore)), 0) /
001744:             calibrationPairs.length
001745:           : null;
001746:       const agreementWithin10 =
001747:         calibrationPairs.length > 0
001748:           ? calibrationPairs.filter((r) => Math.abs(Number(r.aiOverallScoreAtReview) - Number(r.smeOverallScore)) <= 10).length
001749:           : 0;
001750: 
001751:       // Inter-rater reliability: ICC(2,1) for AI vs SME (continuous scores, two-way random single measure)
001752:       let icc = null;
001753:       if (calibrationPairs.length >= 2) {
001754:         const n = calibrationPairs.length;
001755:         const aiScores = calibrationPairs.map((r) => Number(r.aiOverallScoreAtReview));
001756:         const smeScores = calibrationPairs.map((r) => Number(r.smeOverallScore));
001757:         const grandMean = (aiScores.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) + smeScores.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0)) / (2 * n);
001758:         const subjectMeans = aiScores.map((ai, i) => (ai + smeScores[i]) / 2);
001759:         const ssSubjects = 2 * subjectMeans.reduce((sum, m) => sum + (m - grandMean) ** 2, 0);
001760:         const ssTotal =
001761:           aiScores.reduce((sum, x) => sum + (x - grandMean) ** 2, 0) +
001762:           smeScores.reduce((sum, x) => sum + (x - grandMean) ** 2, 0);
001763:         const ssError = ssTotal - ssSubjects;
001764:         const msSubjects = ssSubjects / (n - 1);
001765:         const msError = ssError / n;
001766:         const rawIcc = (msSubjects - msError) / (msSubjects + msError);
001767:         icc = Number.isFinite(rawIcc) ? Math.round(Math.max(0, Math.min(1, rawIcc)) * 1000) / 1000 : null;
001768:       }
001769: 
001770:       res.json({
001771:         success: true,
001772:         fairness: {
001773:           completedInterviews: completed.length,
001774:           withScore: withScore.length,
001775:           scoreDistribution: scoreBuckets,
001776:           finalScoreDistribution: finalScoreBuckets,
001777:           smeOverrideCount: completed.filter((i) => i.finalScoreSource === 'SME').length,
001778:         },
001779:         calibration: {
001780:           reviewsWithBothScores: calibrationPairs.length,
001781:           meanAbsoluteDifference: meanAbsDiff != null ? Math.round(meanAbsDiff * 10) / 10 : null,
001782:           agreementWithin10Points: agreementWithin10,
001783:           agreementWithin10Percent:
001784:             calibrationPairs.length > 0
001785:               ? Math.round((agreementWithin10 / calibrationPairs.length) * 100)
001786:               : null,
001787:           interRaterReliabilityIcc: icc,
001788:           overrideCount,
001789:           totalReviews: reviews.length,
001790:         },
001791:         sampleSize: { interviews: interviews.length, reviews: reviews.length },
001792:       });
001793:     } catch (error) {
001794:       logger.error('Get fairness calibration error:', error);
001795:       next(error);
001796:     }
001797:   }

001883:   static async updateUserStatus(req, res, next) {
001884:     try {
001885:       const { id } = req.params;
001886:       const adminId = req.user.id;
001887:       const status = normalizeUserAccountStatus(req.body?.status);
001888:       const reason = req.body?.reason ? String(req.body.reason).trim() : null;
001889: 
001890:       const targetUser = await userStore.getByUid(id);
001891:       if (!targetUser) {
001892:         return res.status(404).json({ success: false, error: 'User not found' });
001893:       }
001894: 
001895:       if (id === adminId && status === 'SUSPENDED') {
001896:         return res.status(409).json({
001897:           success: false,
001898:           error: 'You cannot suspend your own account.',
001899:           code: 'SELF_SUSPEND_FORBIDDEN',
001900:         });
001901:       }
001902: 
001903:       if ((targetUser.accountType || '').toUpperCase() === 'SYSTEM_ADMIN' && status === 'SUSPENDED') {
001904:         return res.status(409).json({
001905:           success: false,
001906:           error: 'System admin accounts cannot be suspended from this panel.',
001907:           code: 'SYSTEM_ADMIN_SUSPEND_FORBIDDEN',
001908:         });
001909:       }
001910: 
001911:       const currentStatus = normalizeUserAccountStatus(targetUser.accountStatus);
001912:       if (currentStatus === status) {
001913:         return res.json({
001914:           success: true,
001915:           message: `User is already ${status}`,
001916:           user: sanitizeUser(targetUser),
001917:         });
001918:       }
001919: 
001920:       const updates = status === 'SUSPENDED'
001921:         ? {
001922:             accountStatus: 'SUSPENDED',
001923:             suspendedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
001924:             suspendedBy: adminId,
001925:             suspensionReason: reason || null,
001926:           }
001927:         : {
001928:             accountStatus: 'ACTIVE',
001929:             suspendedAt: null,
001930:             suspendedBy: null,
001931:             suspensionReason: null,
001932:           };
001933: 
001934:       const updatedUser = await userStore.update(id, updates);
001935:       try {
001936:         await admin.auth().updateUser(id, {
001937:           disabled: status === 'SUSPENDED',
001938:         });
001939:       } catch (firebaseError) {
001940:         logger.error(`Failed to update Firebase auth status for user ${id}:`, firebaseError);
001941:       }
001942: 
001943:       const action = status === 'SUSPENDED' ? 'USER_SUSPENDED' : 'USER_ACTIVATED';
001944:       await platformAuditLogStore.record({
001945:         actorId: adminId,
001946:         actorType: 'SYSTEM_ADMIN',
001947:         action,
001948:         targetType: 'USER',
001949:         targetId: id,
001950:         metadata: {
001951:           targetAccountType: updatedUser.accountType || null,
001952:           reason: reason || null,
001953:           previousStatus: currentStatus,
001954:           nextStatus: status,
001955:         },
001956:       });
001957: 
001958:       await publishAdminRealtimeUpdate('user-status-updated', {
001959:         userId: id,
001960:         status,
001961:       });
001962: 
001963:       return res.json({
001964:         success: true,
001965:         message: status === 'SUSPENDED' ? 'User suspended successfully' : 'User activated successfully',
001966:         user: sanitizeUser(updatedUser),
001967:       });
001968:     } catch (error) {
001969:       logger.error('Update user status error:', error);
001970:       next(error);
001971:     }
001972:   }

002184:   static async runDataRetentionCleanup(req, res, next) {
002185:     try {
002186:       const adminId = req.user.id;
002187:       const dryRun = req.body?.dryRun === true || req.body?.dryRun === 'true';
002188:       const requestedMax = Number.parseInt(req.body?.maxDocuments, 10);
002189:       const maxDocuments = Number.isInteger(requestedMax)
002190:         ? Math.min(Math.max(requestedMax, 1), 1000)
002191:         : 250;
002192: 
002193:       const settings = await systemSettingsStore.get();
002194:       const retentionPolicy = getRetentionPolicy(settings);
002195:       const interviewCutoffIso = getCutoffIsoFromDays(retentionPolicy.interviewDataDays);
002196:       const activityCutoffIso = getCutoffIsoFromDays(retentionPolicy.activityLogDays);
002197: 
002198:       const interviewDocsRaw = await queryCollectionBeforeDate({
002199:         collection: firestore.collection('interviews'),
002200:         dateField: 'endedAt',
002201:         cutoffIso: interviewCutoffIso,
002202:         limit: maxDocuments,
002203:         additionalWhere: { field: 'status', value: 'COMPLETED' },
002204:       });
002205:       const interviewDocs = interviewDocsRaw
002206:         .filter((doc) => !(doc.data() || {}).retentionPurgedAt)
002207:         .slice(0, maxDocuments);
002208: 
002209:       const platformAuditDocs = await queryCollectionBeforeDate({
002210:         collection: firestore.collection('platformAuditLogs'),
002211:         dateField: 'createdAt',
002212:         cutoffIso: activityCutoffIso,
002213:         limit: maxDocuments,
002214:       });
002215: 
002216:       const activityLogDocs = await queryCollectionBeforeDate({
002217:         collection: firestore.collection('activityLogs'),
002218:         dateField: 'createdAt',
002219:         cutoffIso: activityCutoffIso,
002220:         limit: maxDocuments,
002221:       });
002222: 
002223:       const summary = {
002224:         dryRun,
002225:         maxDocuments,
002226:         policy: retentionPolicy,
002227:         cutoff: {
002228:           interviews: interviewCutoffIso,
002229:           activityLogs: activityCutoffIso,
002230:         },
002231:         candidates: {
002232:           interviews: interviewDocs.length,
002233:           platformAuditLogs: platformAuditDocs.length,
002234:           activityLogs: activityLogDocs.length,
002235:         },
002236:         processed: {
002237:           interviews: 0,
002238:           redactedQuestions: 0,
002239:           deletedPoseDataPoints: 0,
002240:           platformAuditLogs: 0,
002241:           activityLogs: 0,
002242:         },
002243:         failedInterviews: [],
002244:         hasMore: {
002245:           interviews: interviewDocsRaw.length >= maxDocuments,
002246:           platformAuditLogs: platformAuditDocs.length >= maxDocuments,
002247:           activityLogs: activityLogDocs.length >= maxDocuments,
002248:         },
002249:       };
002250: 
002251:       if (!dryRun) {
002252:         for (const doc of interviewDocs) {
002253:           const interviewData = { id: doc.id, ...(doc.data() || {}) };
002254:           try {
002255:             const redaction = await redactInterviewForRetention({
002256:               interviewRef: doc.ref,
002257:               interviewData,
002258:               retentionDays: retentionPolicy.interviewDataDays,
002259:             });
002260:             summary.processed.interviews += 1;
002261:             summary.processed.redactedQuestions += redaction.redactedQuestions;
002262:             summary.processed.deletedPoseDataPoints += redaction.deletedPoseDataPoints;
002263:           } catch (retentionError) {
002264:             summary.failedInterviews.push({
002265:               interviewId: interviewData.id,
002266:               error: retentionError?.message || 'Unknown error',
002267:             });
002268:           }
002269:         }
002270: 
002271:         summary.processed.platformAuditLogs = await deleteDocsByRef(platformAuditDocs);
002272:         summary.processed.activityLogs = await deleteDocsByRef(activityLogDocs);
002273: 
002274:         await platformAuditLogStore.record({
002275:           actorId: adminId,
002276:           actorType: 'SYSTEM_ADMIN',
002277:           action: 'DATA_RETENTION_CLEANUP_RUN',
002278:           targetType: 'SETTINGS',
002279:           targetId: 'global',
002280:           metadata: {
002281:             maxDocuments,
002282:             policy: retentionPolicy,
002283:             processed: summary.processed,
002284:             failedInterviews: summary.failedInterviews.length,
002285:           },
002286:         });
002287: 
002288:         await publishAdminRealtimeUpdate('data-retention-cleanup-run', {
002289:           adminId,
002290:           processed: summary.processed,
002291:           failedInterviews: summary.failedInterviews.length,
002292:         });
002293:       }
002294: 
002295:       return res.json({
002296:         success: true,
002297:         retention: summary,
002298:       });
002299:     } catch (error) {
002300:       logger.error('Run data retention cleanup error:', error);
002301:       next(error);
002302:     }
002303:   }
002304: }

000223:

000826:           });
000827:           continue;
000828:         }
000829: 
000830:         const previousStatus = normalizeApplicationStatus(application.status);
000831:         if (!canTransitionApplicationStatus(previousStatus, targetStatus, { allowNoop: true })) {
000832:           results.push({
000833:             applicationId,
000834:             updated: false,

000836:             message: `Cannot transition from ${previousStatus} to ${targetStatus}.`,

000841:

000850:           status: targetStatus,
000851:           changedAt: statusChangedAt,
000852:           changedBy: userId,
000853:           source: 'RECRUITER_BULK',
000854:           note: disposition.notes || disposition.reason || null,
000855:           dispositionCode: disposition.code,

000858: 
000859:         const updated = await jobApplicationStore.update(applicationId, {

000865:           ...(isFinalDecision
000866:             ? {

000869:               dispositionReason: disposition.reason,
000870:               dispositionNotes: disposition.notes,

000884:           statusHistory: appendStatusHistory(application.statusHistory, statusHistoryEntry),

000896:           jobId: updated.jobId || null,

000900:         await publishCandidateRealtimeUpdate(updated.candidateId, 'application-status-updated', {

000137: const EMAIL_VERIFICATION_CODE_LENGTH = 8;
000138: const EMAIL_VERIFICATION_EXPIRY_MINUTES = 10;
000139: const EMAIL_VERIFICATION_RESEND_COOLDOWN_MS = 60 * 1000;
000140: const EMAIL_VERIFICATION_WINDOW_MS = 60 * 60 * 1000;
000141: const EMAIL_VERIFICATION_MAX_PER_HOUR = 5;
000142: const EMAIL_VERIFICATION_MAX_ATTEMPTS = 5;

000144: const toMillisSafe = (value) => {
000145:   if (!value) return 0;
000146:   if (typeof value === 'number') return value;
000147:   const parsed = Date.parse(value);
000148:   return Number.isNaN(parsed) ? 0 : parsed;
000149: };
000150: 
000151: /**
000152:  * Get verification code secret for HMAC signing
000153:  * SECURITY: In production, this should always be a strong, unique secret
000154:  * The default value is only for development - it will log a warning
000155:  */
000156: const getVerificationSecret = () => {
000157:   const secret = process.env.EMAIL_VERIFICATION_CODE_SECRET || process.env.JWT_SECRET;
000158:   
000159:   if (!secret) {
000160:     if (process.env.NODE_ENV === 'production') {
000161:       throw new Error('EMAIL_VERIFICATION_CODE_SECRET or JWT_SECRET must be set in production');
000162:     }
000163:     // Only use default in development, and log a warning
000164:     logger.warn('⚠️  Using default verification secret - this is insecure for production!');
000165:     return 'dev-only-verification-secret-change-in-production';
000166:   }
000167:   
000168:   return secret;
000169: };
000170: 
000171: const hashVerificationCode = (code) =>
000172:   createHmac('sha256', getVerificationSecret()).update(code).digest('hex');
000173: 
000174: const generateVerificationCode = () =>
000175:   randomInt(0, 10 ** EMAIL_VERIFICATION_CODE_LENGTH)
000176:     .toString()
000177:     .padStart(EMAIL_VERIFICATION_CODE_LENGTH, '0');
000178: 
000179: const safeHashEquals = (a, b) => {
000180:   if (!a || !b) return false;
000181:   const bufferA = Buffer.from(a, 'hex');
000182:   const bufferB = Buffer.from(b, 'hex');
000183:   if (bufferA.length !== bufferB.length) return false;
000184:   return timingSafeEqual(bufferA, bufferB);
000185: };

000187: const buildUploadUrl = (basePath, filename) => (filename ? `${basePath}/${filename}` : null);
000188: 
000189: const cleanupUploadedFiles = async (filePaths = []) => {
000190:   const uniquePaths = Array.from(new Set(filePaths.filter(Boolean)));
000191:   await Promise.all(
000192:     uniquePaths.map(async (filePath) => {
000193:       if (!filePath) return;
000194:       try {
000195:         await unlink(filePath);
000196:       } catch (cleanupError) {
000197:         logger.warn('Failed to clean up uploaded file', {
000198:           filePath,
000199:           error: cleanupError.message,
000200:         });
000201:       }
000202:     })
000203:   );
000204: };
000205: 
000206: const normalizeListField = (value) => {
000207:   if (Array.isArray(value)) {
000208:     return value
000209:       .map((item) => (typeof item === 'string' ? item.trim() : String(item)))
000210:       .filter(Boolean);
000211:   }
000212: 
000213:   if (typeof value === 'string') {
000214:     const trimmed = value.trim();
000215:     if (!trimmed) return [];
000216:     if (trimmed.startsWith('[') && trimmed.endsWith(']')) {
000217:       try {
000218:         const parsed = JSON.parse(trimmed);
000219:         if (Array.isArray(parsed)) {
000220:           return parsed
000221:             .map((item) => (typeof item === 'string' ? item.trim() : String(item)))
000222:             .filter(Boolean);
000223:         }
000224:       } catch (parseError) {
000225:         // Fall through to simple parsing.
000226:       }
000227:     }
000228:     if (trimmed.includes(',')) {
000229:       return trimmed
000230:         .split(',')
000231:         .map((item) => item.trim())
000232:         .filter(Boolean);
000233:     }
000234:     return [trimmed];
000235:   }
000236: 
000237:   if (value === undefined || value === null) return [];
000238:   return [String(value)];
000239: };

001019:     try {

001021:       const tokenEmail = (req.user.email || '').trim().toLowerCase();
001022: 
001023:       if (!requestedEmail) {
001024:         return res.status(400).json({ success: false, error: 'Email is required.' });
001025:       }
001026: 
001027:       if (tokenEmail && requestedEmail !== tokenEmail) {
001028:         return res.status(400).json({
001029:           success: false,
001030:           error: 'Email does not match the signed-in account.',
001031:         });
001032:       }
001033: 
001034:       const userRecord = await admin.auth().getUser(req.user.uid);
001035:       const firebaseEmail = (userRecord?.email || '').toLowerCase();
001036: 
001037:       if (firebaseEmail && firebaseEmail !== requestedEmail) {
001038:         return res.status(400).json({
001039:           success: false,
001040:           error: 'Email does not match the Firebase account.',
001041:         });
001042:       }
001043: 
001044:       if (userRecord?.emailVerified) {
001045:         return res.json({
001046:           success: true,
001047:           verified: true,
001048:           message: 'Email is already verified.',
001049:         });
001050:       }
001051: 
001052:       const existing = await emailVerificationStore.getByUid(req.user.uid);
001053:       const nowMs = Date.now();
001054:       const lastSentMs = toMillisSafe(existing?.lastSentAt);
001055: 
001056:       if (lastSentMs && nowMs - lastSentMs < EMAIL_VERIFICATION_RESEND_COOLDOWN_MS) {
001057:         const waitSeconds = Math.ceil(
001058:           (EMAIL_VERIFICATION_RESEND_COOLDOWN_MS - (nowMs - lastSentMs)) / 1000
001059:         );
001060:         return res.status(429).json({
001061:           success: false,
001062:           error: `Please wait ${waitSeconds} seconds before requesting another verification email.`,
001063:         });
001064:       }
001065: 
001066:       let sendCount = existing?.sendCount || 0;
001067:       let windowStartedAt = existing?.windowStartedAt || new Date(nowMs).toISOString();
001068:       const windowStartMs = toMillisSafe(windowStartedAt);
001069: 
001070:       if (!windowStartMs || nowMs - windowStartMs >= EMAIL_VERIFICATION_WINDOW_MS) {
001071:         sendCount = 0;
001072:         windowStartedAt = new Date(nowMs).toISOString();
001073:       }
001074: 
001075:       if (sendCount >= EMAIL_VERIFICATION_MAX_PER_HOUR) {
001076:         return res.status(429).json({
001077:           success: false,
001078:           error: 'You have reached the maximum number of verification emails. Please wait an hour and try again.',
001079:         });
001080:       }
001081: 
001082:       const verificationCode = generateVerificationCode();
001083: 
001084:       await emailService.sendEmailVerification({
001085:         email: requestedEmail,
001086:         fullName: req.body.fullName || userRecord?.displayName || req.user.metadata?.fullName || null,
001087:         verificationCode,
001088:         expiresInMinutes: EMAIL_VERIFICATION_EXPIRY_MINUTES,
001089:       });
001090: 
001091:       await emailVerificationStore.upsert(req.user.uid, {
001092:         email: requestedEmail,
001093:         codeHash: hashVerificationCode(verificationCode),
001094:         codeLastFour: verificationCode.slice(-4),
001095:         expiresAt: new Date(nowMs + EMAIL_VERIFICATION_EXPIRY_MINUTES * 60 * 1000).toISOString(),
001096:         lastSentAt: new Date(nowMs).toISOString(),
001097:         sendCount: sendCount + 1,
001098:         windowStartedAt,
001099:         attempts: 0,
001100:         usedAt: null,
001101:       });
001102: 
001103:       return res.json({
001104:         success: true,
001105:         verified: false,
001106:         email: requestedEmail,
001107:         expiresInMinutes: EMAIL_VERIFICATION_EXPIRY_MINUTES,
001108:         message: `Verification code sent to ${requestedEmail}.`,

001116:   static async verifyEmailCode(req, res, next) {
001117:     try {
001118:       const code = (req.body.code || '').trim();
001119: 
001120:       if (!code) {
001121:         return res.status(400).json({ success: false, error: 'Verification code is required.' });
001122:       }
001123: 
001124:       if (!/^\d{8}$/.test(code)) {
001125:         return res.status(400).json({
001126:           success: false,
001127:           error: 'Verification code must be 8 digits.',
001128:         });
001129:       }
001130: 
001131:       const userRecord = await admin.auth().getUser(req.user.uid);
001132:       const firebaseEmail = (userRecord?.email || req.user.email || '').toLowerCase();
001133: 
001134:       if (!firebaseEmail) {
001135:         return res.status(400).json({
001136:           success: false,
001137:           error: 'Email is missing from the Firebase account.',
001138:         });
001139:       }
001140: 
001141:       if (userRecord?.emailVerified) {
001142:         await emailVerificationStore.delete(req.user.uid);
001143:         return res.json({
001144:           success: true,
001145:           verified: true,
001146:           message: 'Email is already verified.',
001147:         });
001148:       }
001149: 
001150:       const record = await emailVerificationStore.getByUid(req.user.uid);
001151: 
001152:       if (!record || !record.codeHash) {
001153:         return res.status(400).json({
001154:           success: false,
001155:           error: 'No active verification request found. Please request a new code.',
001156:         });
001157:       }
001158: 
001159:       if (record.email && record.email.toLowerCase() !== firebaseEmail) {
001160:         return res.status(400).json({
001161:           success: false,
001162:           error: 'Email mismatch. Please request a new verification code.',
001163:         });
001164:       }
001165: 
001166:       const expiresAtMs = toMillisSafe(record.expiresAt);
001167:       if (expiresAtMs && Date.now() > expiresAtMs) {
001168:         return res.status(400).json({
001169:           success: false,
001170:           error: 'Verification code has expired. Please request a new code.',
001171:         });
001172:       }
001173: 
001174:       const attempts = record.attempts || 0;
001175:       if (attempts >= EMAIL_VERIFICATION_MAX_ATTEMPTS) {
001176:         return res.status(429).json({
001177:           success: false,
001178:           error: 'Too many incorrect attempts. Please request a new verification code.',
001179:         });
001180:       }
001181: 
001182:       const candidateHash = hashVerificationCode(code);
001183:       if (!safeHashEquals(candidateHash, record.codeHash)) {
001184:         await emailVerificationStore.upsert(req.user.uid, {
001185:           attempts: attempts + 1,
001186:           lastAttemptAt: now(),
001187:         });
001188:         return res.status(400).json({
001189:           success: false,
001190:           error: 'Invalid verification code. Please try again.',
001191:         });
001192:       }
001193: 
001194:       await admin.auth().updateUser(req.user.uid, { emailVerified: true });
001195:       await emailVerificationStore.delete(req.user.uid);
001196: 
001197:       return res.json({
001198:         success: true,
001199:         verified: true,
001200:         message: 'Email verified successfully.',
001201:       });
001202:     } catch (error) {
001203:       logger.error('Verify email code error:', error);
001204:       next(error);
001205:     }

000110:       const plan = PLANS[subscription.planId.toUpperCase()];

000114:       for (const [feature, limit] of Object.entries(plan.features)) {
000115:         if (typeof limit === 'number') {

000117:           usageStats[feature] = {
000118:             limit: limit === -1 ? 'unlimited' : limit,
000119:             current,
000120:             remaining: limit === -1 ? 'unlimited' : Math.max(0, limit - current),
000121:             percentage: limit === -1 ? 0 : Math.min(100, (current / limit) * 100),

000001: import logger from '../utils/logger.js';

000003: 
000004: const escapeHtml = (value) => String(value)
000005:   .replace(/&/g, '&amp;')
000006:   .replace(/</g, '&lt;')
000007:   .replace(/>/g, '&gt;')
000008:   .replace(/"/g, '&quot;')
000009:   .replace(/'/g, '&#39;');
000010: 
000011: const formatHtmlMessage = (value) => escapeHtml(value).replace(/\r?\n/g, '<br />');

000013: export class ContactController {
000014:   static async submit(req, res, next) {
000015:     try {
000016:       const { name, email, subject, message } = req.body;
000017:       const contactName = (name || '').trim();
000018:       const contactEmail = (email || '').trim().toLowerCase();
000019:       const contactSubject = (subject || '').trim();
000020:       const contactMessage = (message || '').trim();
000021:       const contactInbox = process.env.CONTACT_INBOX_EMAIL || process.env.FROM_EMAIL;
000022: 
000023:       if (!contactInbox) {
000024:         return res.status(500).json({ error: 'Contact inbox is not configured.' });
000025:       }
000026: 
000027:       const submittedAtText = new Date().toISOString();
000028:       const safeMessageHtml = formatHtmlMessage(contactMessage);
000029:       const safeNameHtml = escapeHtml(contactName);
000030:       const safeEmailHtml = escapeHtml(contactEmail);
000031:       const safeSubjectHtml = escapeHtml(contactSubject);
000032:       await emailService.sendTemplatedEmail('CONTACT_RECEIVED', {
000033:         to: contactInbox,
000034:         name: contactName,
000035:         email: contactEmail,
000036:         subject: contactSubject,
000037:         message: contactMessage,
000038:         submittedAtText,
000039:         safeName: safeNameHtml,
000040:         safeEmail: safeEmailHtml,
000041:         safeSubject: safeSubjectHtml,
000042:         safeMessageHtml,
000043:         replyTo: contactEmail,
000044:       });
000045:       await emailService.sendTemplatedEmail('CONTACT_CONFIRMATION', {
000046:         email: contactEmail,
000047:         name: contactName,
000048:         subject: contactSubject,
000049:         message: contactMessage,
000050:         safeName: safeNameHtml,
000051:         safeSubject: safeSubjectHtml,
000052:         safeMessageHtml,
000053:         replyTo: contactInbox,
000054:       });
000055: 
000056:       return res.status(200).json({
000057:         success: true,
000058:         message: 'Message sent successfully. A confirmation email has been sent to you.',
000059:       });
000060:     } catch (error) {
000061:       logger.error('Contact form submission error:', error);
000062:       next(error);
000063:     }
000064:   }
000065: }

000500: /**
000501:  * Helper: Calculate quality score for interview data
000502:  */
000503: function calculateQualityScore(questionAnswerPairs) {
000504:   if (!questionAnswerPairs || questionAnswerPairs.length === 0) return 0;
000505: 
000506:   const scores = questionAnswerPairs.map(qa => qa.evaluation?.score || 0);
000507:   const avgScore = scores.reduce((sum, s) => sum + s, 0) / scores.length;
000508:   
000509:   // Quality score based on average evaluation score and data completeness
000510:   const completenessBonus = questionAnswerPairs.every(qa => 
000511:     qa.question?.text && qa.answer?.text
000512:   ) ? 10 : 0;
000513: 
000514:   return Math.round(Math.min(100, avgScore * 10 + completenessBonus));
000515: }
000516: 
000517: /**
000518:  * Helper: Calculate reference comparison for analytics data
000519:  */
000520: function calculateReferenceComparison(dataPoints) {
000521:   if (!dataPoints || dataPoints.length === 0) {
000522:     return { averages: {}, deviations: {} };
000523:   }
000524: 
000525:   let postureSum = 0;
000526:   let attentionSum = 0;
000527:   let bodyLanguageSum = 0;
000528:   let overallSum = 0;
000529: 
000530:   dataPoints.forEach(point => {
000531:     postureSum += point.scores?.posture || 0;
000532:     attentionSum += point.scores?.attention || 0;
000533:     bodyLanguageSum += point.scores?.bodyLanguage || 0;
000534:     overallSum += point.scores?.overall || 0;
000535:   });
000536: 
000537:   const count = dataPoints.length;
000538: 
000539:   return {
000540:     averages: {
000541:       posture: Math.round(postureSum / count),
000542:       attention: Math.round(attentionSum / count),
000543:       bodyLanguage: Math.round(bodyLanguageSum / count),
000544:       overall: Math.round(overallSum / count),
000545:     },
000546:     deviations: {
000547:       // Could calculate standard deviations here if needed
000548:     },
000549:     sampleCount: count,
000550:   };
000551: }

000563:     }, { merge: true });
000564:   } catch (error) {

000566:   }
000567: }

000591:   static async deleteJob(req, res, next) {
000592:     try {
000593:       const organizationId = req.user.organizationContext?.organization?.id;
000594:       const jobId = req.params.id;
000595:       const resolveActiveApplications = req.body?.resolveActiveApplications === true;
000596:       const notifyCandidates = req.body?.notifyCandidates !== false;
000597:       const resolutionMessage = typeof req.body?.resolutionMessage === 'string'
000598:         ? req.body.resolutionMessage.trim()
000599:         : '';
000600: 
000601:       const existing = await jobStore.getById(jobId);
000602:       if (!existing || existing.organizationId !== organizationId) {
000603:         return res.status(404).json({ error: 'Job not found' });
000604:       }
000605: 
000606:       const jobStatus = (existing.status || '').toString().toUpperCase();
000607:       if (jobStatus !== 'ARCHIVED' && jobStatus !== 'DRAFT') {
000608:         return res.status(409).json({
000609:           error: 'Archive this job before deleting it.',
000610:           code: ARCHIVE_REQUIRED_CODE,
000611:           details: {
000612:             currentStatus: jobStatus || 'UNKNOWN',
000613:             requiredAction: 'Set job status to ARCHIVED before deleting.',
000614:           },
000615:         });
000616:       }
000617: 
000618:       const [applications, organization] = await Promise.all([
000619:         jobApplicationStore.listByJob(jobId),
000620:         organizationStore.getById(organizationId).catch((organizationError) => {
000621:           logger.warn(`Unable to fetch organization ${organizationId} for delete snapshot:`, organizationError);
000622:           return null;
000623:         }),
000624:       ]);
000625:       const activeApplications = applications.filter(isApplicationActive);
000626: 
000627:       if (activeApplications.length > 0 && !resolveActiveApplications) {
000628:         return res.status(409).json({
000629:           error: 'This job has active applications. Resolve them before deleting.',
000630:           code: RESOLUTION_REQUIRED_CODE,
000631:           details: {
000632:             totalApplications: applications.length,
000633:             activeApplications: activeApplications.length,
000634:             requiredAction: 'Set resolveActiveApplications=true to auto-reject active applications before deletion.',
000635:           },
000636:         });
000637:       }
000638: 
000639:       let resolvedApplicationsCount = 0;
000640:       let notifiedCandidatesCount = 0;
000641:       let notificationFailures = 0;
000642:       const deletedAt = new Date().toISOString();
000643:       const fallbackJobSnapshot = buildJobSnapshot(existing);
000644:       const fallbackOrganizationSnapshot = buildOrganizationSnapshot(organization, organizationId);
000645:       const candidateIds = [...new Set(activeApplications.map((application) => application.candidateId).filter(Boolean))];
000646:       const candidateMap = candidateIds.length > 0 ? await userStore.getSummaries(candidateIds) : new Map();
000647:       const closureMessage = buildJobClosureMessage(resolutionMessage);
000648:       const closureDisposition = normalizeDisposition({
000649:         dispositionCode: 'JOB_CLOSED',
000650:         dispositionReason: 'This role was closed before the application process was completed.',
000651:         dispositionNotes: resolutionMessage || null,
000652:       }, {
000653:         status: 'REJECTED',
000654:         jobDeletedAt: deletedAt,
000655:         fallbackCode: 'JOB_CLOSED',
000656:       });
000657: 
000658:       if (applications.length > 0) {
000659:         for (const application of applications) {
000660:           const currentJobSnapshot = application?.jobSnapshot && typeof application.jobSnapshot === 'object'
000661:             ? application.jobSnapshot
000662:             : null;
000663:           const currentOrganizationSnapshot = application?.organizationSnapshot && typeof application.organizationSnapshot === 'object'
000664:             ? application.organizationSnapshot
000665:             : null;
000666:           const shouldResolveStatus = resolveActiveApplications && isApplicationActive(application);
000667:           const nextStatus = shouldResolveStatus ? 'REJECTED' : application.status;
000668:           const statusHistoryEntry = shouldResolveStatus
000669:             ? buildStatusHistoryEntry({
000670:               previousStatus: application.status,
000671:               status: nextStatus,
000672:               changedAt: deletedAt,
000673:               changedBy: req.user.id,
000674:               source: 'JOB_CLOSURE_AUTOMATION',
000675:               note: closureDisposition.notes || closureDisposition.reason || null,
000676:               dispositionCode: closureDisposition.code,
000677:               dispositionCategory: closureDisposition.category,
000678:             })
000679:             : null;
000680: 
000681:           const updatedApplication = await jobApplicationStore.update(application.id, {
000682:             jobSnapshot: currentJobSnapshot || fallbackJobSnapshot,
000683:             organizationSnapshot: currentOrganizationSnapshot || fallbackOrganizationSnapshot,
000684:             jobDeletedAt: deletedAt,
000685:             ...(shouldResolveStatus
000686:               ? {
000687:                 status: nextStatus,
000688:                 reviewedAt: deletedAt,
000689:                 reviewedBy: req.user.id,
000690:                 statusSource: 'JOB_CLOSURE_AUTOMATION',
000691:                 statusChangedAt: deletedAt,
000692:                 dispositionCode: closureDisposition.code,
000693:                 dispositionCategory: closureDisposition.category,
000694:                 dispositionReason: closureDisposition.reason,
000695:                 dispositionNotes: closureDisposition.notes,
000696:                 dispositionTags: closureDisposition.tags,
000697:                 dispositionAt: deletedAt,
000698:                 dispositionBy: req.user.id,
000699:                 statusHistory: appendStatusHistory(application.statusHistory, statusHistoryEntry),
000700:               }
000701:               : {}),
000702:           });
000703: 
000704:           if (!shouldResolveStatus) {
000705:             continue;
000706:           }
000707: 
000708:           resolvedApplicationsCount++;
000709: 
000710:           await publishOrganizationRealtimeUpdate(organizationId, 'application-status-updated', {
000711:             applicationId: updatedApplication.id,
000712:             jobId: updatedApplication.jobId || jobId,
000713:             candidateId: updatedApplication.candidateId || null,
000714:             status: nextStatus,
000715:           });
000716:           await publishCandidateRealtimeUpdate(updatedApplication.candidateId, 'application-status-updated', {
000717:             applicationId: updatedApplication.id,
000718:             jobId: updatedApplication.jobId || jobId,
000719:             organizationId,
000720:             status: nextStatus,
000721:           });
000722: 
000723:           if (!notifyCandidates) {
000724:             continue;
000725:           }
000726: 
000727:           const candidate = candidateMap.get(updatedApplication.candidateId);
000728:           if (!candidate?.email) {
000729:             continue;
000730:           }
000731: 
000732:           const queuedJobId = queueEmailJob({
000733:             type: 'JOB_CLOSED_CANDIDATE_NOTIFICATION',
000734:             payload: {
000735:               applicationId: updatedApplication.id,

000737:               candidateId: updatedApplication.candidateId,
000738:               recipient: candidate.email,

000740:             handler: async () => {

000742:                 updatedApplication,
000743:                 candidate,
000744:                 existing,
000745:                 organization || { id: organizationId, name: 'Company' },
000746:                 closureMessage,

000748:             },
000749:           });
000750:           if (queuedJobId) {

000753:             notificationFailures++;

000755:           }
000756:         }
000757:       }
000758: 
000759:       for (const imageUrl of normalizeAdvertImageUrls(existing)) {

000763:       const deletedJob = await jobStore.delete(jobId, {

000767:       });
000768:       await activityLogStore.record({
000769:         organizationId,
000770:         actorId: req.user.id,
000771:         actorRole: req.user.organizationContext?.membership?.role,
000772:         action: 'JOB_DELETED',
000773:         targetType: 'JOB',
000774:         targetId: jobId,
000775:         metadata: {
000776:           title: existing.title,
000777:           deletionMode: deletedJob?.deletionMode || 'SOFT',
000778:           resolvedApplicationsCount,
000779:           notifiedCandidatesCount,
000780:           notificationFailures,
000781:         },
000782:       });
000783: 
000784:       await publishOrganizationRealtimeUpdate(organizationId, 'job-deleted', {
000785:         jobId,
000786:       });
000787:       await publishPublicRealtimeUpdate('jobs', 'job-deleted', {
000788:         jobId,
000789:         organizationId,
000790:       });
000791: 
000792:       res.json({

000796:         resolvedApplicationsCount,
000797:         notifiedCandidatesCount,

000799:       });
000800:     } catch (error) {

000001: import fs from 'fs/promises';

000007:   verifySignedDownloadQuery,
000008: } from '../services/localObjectStorage.service.js';
000009:

000011:   const origin = `${req.protocol}://${req.get('host')}`;
000012:   return `${origin}${relativePath}`;
000013: };
000014: 
000015: export class ObjectStorageController {
000016:   static async getSignedDownloadUrl(req, res, next) {
000017:     try {
000018:       const normalizedPath = normalizeUploadsPublicPath(req.query.path);
000019:       if (!normalizedPath) {
000020:         return res.status(400).json({
000021:           error: 'A valid uploads path is required.',
000022:         });
000023:       }
000024: 
000025:       const absolutePath = resolveUploadsAbsolutePath(normalizedPath);
000026:       if (!absolutePath) {
000027:         return res.status(400).json({
000028:           error: 'Invalid uploads path.',
000029:         });
000030:       }
000031: 
000032:       try {
000033:         await fs.access(absolutePath);
000034:       } catch {
000035:         return res.status(404).json({
000036:           error: 'File not found.',
000037:         });
000038:       }
000039: 
000040:       const expiresInSeconds = toSafeTtlSeconds(req.query.expiresInSeconds);
000041:       const signedRelativeUrl = createSignedDownloadPath({
000042:         publicPath: normalizedPath,
000043:         expiresInSeconds,
000044:       });
000045:       if (!signedRelativeUrl) {
000046:         return res.status(400).json({
000047:           error: 'Unable to sign this uploads path.',
000048:         });
000049:       }
000050: 
000051:       return res.json({
000052:         success: true,
000053:         path: normalizedPath,
000054:         expiresInSeconds,
000055:         relativeDownloadUrl: signedRelativeUrl,
000056:         downloadUrl: toAbsoluteApiUrl(req, signedRelativeUrl),
000057:       });
000058:     } catch (error) {
000059:       return next(error);
000060:     }
000061:   }
000062: 
000063:   static async download(req, res, next) {
000064:     try {
000065:       const verification = verifySignedDownloadQuery({
000066:         publicPath: req.query.path,
000067:         expiresAt: req.query.expiresAt,
000068:         signature: req.query.signature,
000069:       });
000070: 
000071:       if (!verification.valid) {
000072:         if (verification.code === 'EXPIRED') {
000073:           return res.status(410).json({
000074:             error: 'Signed file URL has expired.',
000075:             code: verification.code,
000076:           });
000077:         }
000078:         return res.status(403).json({
000079:           error: 'Invalid signed file URL.',
000080:           code: verification.code,
000081:         });
000082:       }
000083: 
000084:       const absolutePath = resolveUploadsAbsolutePath(verification.path);
000085:       if (!absolutePath) {
000086:         return res.status(400).json({
000087:           error: 'Invalid uploads path.',
000088:         });
000089:       }
000090: 
000091:       try {
000092:         await fs.access(absolutePath);
000093:       } catch {
000094:         return res.status(404).json({
000095:           error: 'File not found.',
000096:         });
000097:       }
000098: 
000099:       const maxAge = Math.max(0, verification.expiresAt - Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000));
000100:       res.setHeader('Cache-Control', `private, max-age=${maxAge}`);
000101:       return res.sendFile(absolutePath);
000102:     } catch (error) {
000103:       return next(error);
000104:     }
000105:   }

000050:   const problemSolving = body.problemSolvingScore != null ? Number(body.problemSolvingScore) : null;

000052:   const scores = [technical, communication, problemSolving, culturalFit].filter(

000055:   if (scores.length === 0) return null;

000011: /**
000012:  * Middleware to verify Firebase authentication token
000013:  */
000014: export async function verifyFirebaseAuth(req, res, next) {
000015:   try {
000016:     const authHeader = req.headers.authorization;
000017:     
000018:     if (!authHeader || !authHeader.startsWith('Bearer ')) {
000019:       return res.status(401).json({ error: 'No token provided' });
000020:     }
000021: 
000022:     const token = authHeader.split('Bearer ')[1];
000023:     
000024:     const userData = await verifyFirebaseToken(token);
000025:     
000026:     if (!userData) {
000027:       return res.status(401).json({ error: 'Invalid or expired token' });
000028:     }
000029: 
000030:     req.user = {
000031:       uid: userData.uid,
000032:       email: userData.email,
000033:       emailVerified: userData.emailVerified,
000034:       metadata: userData.metadata,
000035:     };
000036: 
000037:     next();
000038:   } catch (error) {
000039:     logger.error('Auth middleware error:', error);
000040:     return res.status(500).json({ error: 'Authentication error' });
000041:   }
000042: }

000045: /**
000046:  * Middleware to load user from database after token verification
000047:  */
000048: export async function loadUser(req, res, next) {
000049:   try {
000050:     if (!req.user) {
000051:       return res.status(401).json({ error: 'User not authenticated' });
000052:     }
000053: 
000054:     const user = await userStore.getByUid(req.user.uid);
000055: 
000056:     if (!user) {
000057:       return res.status(404).json({ error: 'User not found in database' });
000058:     }
000059: 
000060:     const accountStatus = (user.accountStatus || 'ACTIVE').toString().toUpperCase();
000061:     if (accountStatus === 'SUSPENDED') {
000062:       return res.status(403).json({
000063:         error: 'Your account has been suspended. Please contact support.',
000064:         code: 'ACCOUNT_SUSPENDED',
000065:       });
000066:     }
000067: 
000068:     req.user = {
000069:       ...req.user,
000070:       id: user.id,
000071:       accountType: user.accountType,
000072:       accountStatus,
000073:       fullName: user.fullName,
000074:       profile: user,
000075:     };
000076: 
000077:     next();
000078:   } catch (error) {
000079:     logger.error('Load user error:', error);
000080:     return res.status(500).json({ error: 'Failed to load user' });
000081:   }
000082: }
000083: 
000084: /**
000085:  * Middleware to attach organization context when available
000086:  */
000087: export async function loadOrganizationContext(req, res, next) {
000088:   try {
000089:     if (!req.user || !req.user.profile) {
000090:       return res.status(401).json({ error: 'User not authenticated' });
000091:     }
000092: 
000093:     const primaryOrganizationId = req.user.profile.primaryOrganizationId;
000094:     if (!primaryOrganizationId) {
000095:       req.user.organizationContext = null;
000096:       return next();
000097:     }
000098: 
000099:     const [organization, membership] = await Promise.all([
000100:       organizationStore.getById(primaryOrganizationId),
000101:       organizationMemberStore.getMember(primaryOrganizationId, req.user.id),
000102:     ]);
000103: 
000104:     req.user.organizationContext =
000105:       organization && membership
000106:         ? {
000107:             organization,
000108:             membership,
000109:           }
000110:         : null;
000111:

000118:         });
000119:       } catch (membershipSyncError) {

000121:       }

000128:   }

000164: export function requireOrgRole(roles = []) {

000001: import multer from 'multer';
000002: import logger from '../utils/logger.js';
000003: 
000004: const { MulterError } = multer;
000005: 
000006: export function setupErrorHandling(app) {
000007:   // 404 handler
000008:   app.use((req, res) => {
000009:     res.status(404).json({
000010:       error: 'Not Found',
000011:       message: `Cannot ${req.method} ${req.path}`,
000012:     });
000013:   });
000014: 
000015:   // Global error handler
000016:   app.use((err, req, res, next) => {
000017:     logger.error('Error:', {
000018:       error: err.message,
000019:       stack: err.stack,
000020:       path: req.path,
000021:       method: req.method,
000022:     });
000023: 
000024:     // Prisma errors
000025:     if (err.code === 'P2002') {
000026:       return res.status(409).json({
000027:         error: 'Conflict',
000028:         message: 'A record with this information already exists',
000029:       });
000030:     }
000031: 
000032:     if (err.code === 'P2025') {
000033:       return res.status(404).json({
000034:         error: 'Not Found',
000035:         message: 'The requested record was not found',
000036:       });
000037:     }
000038: 
000039:     // Validation errors
000040:     if (err.name === 'ValidationError') {
000041:       return res.status(400).json({
000042:         error: 'Validation Error',
000043:         message: err.message,
000044:       });
000045:     }
000046: 
000047:     if (err instanceof MulterError) {
000048:       let message = 'File upload failed.';
000049:       if (err.code === 'LIMIT_FILE_SIZE') {
000050:         message = 'Uploaded file exceeds the 10 MB size limit.';
000051:       } else if (err.code === 'LIMIT_UNEXPECTED_FILE' && err.message) {
000052:         message = err.message;
000053:       } else if (err.code === 'LIMIT_UNEXPECTED_FILE') {
000054:         message = 'Unexpected upload field detected.';
000055:       }
000056: 
000057:       return res.status(400).json({
000058:         error: message,
000059:       });
000060:     }
000061: 
000062:     // Default error
000063:     res.status(err.status || 500).json({
000064:       error: err.message || 'Internal Server Error',
000065:       ...(process.env.NODE_ENV === 'development' && { stack: err.stack }),
000066:     });
000067:   });
000068: }

000001: /**
000002:  * Comprehensive Input Validation and Sanitization Middleware
000003:  * 
000004:  * Implements OWASP best practices for input validation:
000005:  * - Schema-based validation with type checking
000006:  * - Length limits on all string inputs
000007:  * - Sanitization to prevent XSS and injection attacks
000008:  * - Rejection of unexpected fields
000009:  * - Whitelist approach for allowed values

000011:  * @see https://cheatsheetseries.owasp.org/cheatsheets/Input_Validation_Cheat_Sheet.html
000012:  */
000013: 
000014: import { body, param, query, validationResult, matchedData } from 'express-validator';
000015: import logger from '../utils/logger.js';
000016: 
000017: /**
000018:  * HTML escape function to prevent XSS attacks
000019:  * Escapes: & < > " ' / ` =
000020:  * 
000021:  * @param {string} str - Input string to escape
000022:  * @returns {string} Escaped string safe for HTML output
000023:  */
000024: const escapeHtml = (str) => {
000025:   if (typeof str !== 'string') return str;
000026:   
000027:   const htmlEscapes = {
000028:     '&': '&amp;',
000029:     '<': '&lt;',
000030:     '>': '&gt;',
000031:     '"': '&quot;',
000032:     "'": '&#39;',
000033:     '/': '&#x2F;',
000034:     '`': '&#x60;',
000035:     '=': '&#x3D;',
000036:   };
000037:   
000038:   return str.replace(/[&<>"'`=/]/g, char => htmlEscapes[char]);
000039: };
000040: 
000041: // =============================================================================
000042: // CONFIGURATION CONSTANTS
000043: // =============================================================================
000044: 
000045: /**
000046:  * Maximum length limits for different field types
000047:  * Based on practical usage and security considerations
000048:  */
000049: const LENGTH_LIMITS = {
000050:   // Personal information
000051:   NAME: 100,
000052:   EMAIL: 254, // RFC 5321 maximum
000053:   PHONE: 20,
000054:   SHORT_TEXT: 100,
000055:   MEDIUM_TEXT: 500,
000056:   LONG_TEXT: 2000,
000057:   VERY_LONG_TEXT: 5000,
000058:   
000059:   // URLs
000060:   URL: 2083, // IE limit, commonly used as standard
000061:   
000062:   // IDs and tokens
000063:   ID: 128,
000064:   TOKEN: 512,
000065:   UUID: 36,
000066:   
000067:   // Code and verification
000068:   VERIFICATION_CODE: 8,
000069:   PASSWORD: 128,
000070:   
000071:   // Arrays
000072:   ARRAY_MAX_ITEMS: 100,
000073:   
000074:   // File names
000075:   FILENAME: 255,
000076: };
000077: 
000078: /**
000079:  * Regular expression patterns for validation
000080:  */
000081: const PATTERNS = {
000082:   // UUID v4 format
000083:   UUID: /^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-4[0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i,
000084:   
000085:   // Firebase UID format (alphanumeric, 28 chars typically)
000086:   FIREBASE_UID: /^[a-zA-Z0-9]{20,128}$/,
000087:   
000088:   // Simple alphanumeric ID
000089:   ALPHANUMERIC_ID: /^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]{1,128}$/,
000090:   
000091:   // Verification code (8 digits)
000092:   VERIFICATION_CODE: /^\d{8}$/,
000093:   
000094:   // Phone number (international format)
000095:   PHONE: /^[+]?[0-9\s\-().]{7,20}$/,
000096:   
000097:   // Safe string (no script tags or HTML)
000098:   SAFE_STRING: /^[^<>]*$/,
000099:   
000100:   // Slug format
000101:   SLUG: /^[a-z0-9]+(?:-[a-z0-9]+)*$/,
000102:   
000103:   // Year format (4 digits)
000104:   YEAR: /^(19|20)\d{2}$/,
000105: };
000106: 
000107: /**
000108:  * Allowed values for enumerated fields
000109:  */
000110: const ALLOWED_VALUES = {
000111:   ACCOUNT_TYPE: ['CANDIDATE', 'COMPANY'],
000112:   ORGANIZATION_ROLE: ['ADMIN', 'RECRUITER', 'REVIEWER'],
000113:   ORGANIZATION_STATUS: ['PENDING', 'APPROVED', 'REJECTED', 'SUSPENDED'],
000114:   REJECTION_REASON_CODE: [
000115:     'DOCUMENT_MISSING',
000116:     'DOCUMENT_MISMATCH',
000117:     'IDENTITY_MISMATCH',
000118:     'DOMAIN_MISMATCH',
000119:     'PUBLIC_EMAIL_DOMAIN',
000120:     'INSUFFICIENT_PUBLIC_PRESENCE',
000121:     'HIGH_RISK_SIGNALS',
000122:     'INCOMPLETE_REGISTRATION',
000123:     'OTHER',
000124:   ],
000125:   APPLICATION_STATUS: ['SUBMITTED', 'SCREENING', 'INTERVIEWING', 'SHORTLISTED', 'REJECTED', 'HIRED'],
000126:   JOB_STATUS: ['DRAFT', 'PUBLISHED', 'ARCHIVED'],
000127:   INTERVIEW_MODE: ['PRACTICE', 'HIRING'],
000128:   INTERVIEW_STATUS: ['SCHEDULED', 'IN_PROGRESS', 'COMPLETED', 'PAUSED', 'CANCELLED'],
000129:   PIPELINE_STATUS: ['SCREENING', 'INTERVIEW', 'FINAL', 'HIRED', 'REJECTED'],
000130:   MEMBER_STATUS: ['ACTIVE', 'INACTIVE'],
000131:   USER_ACCOUNT_STATUS: ['ACTIVE', 'SUSPENDED'],
000132:   PLAN_ID: ['free', 'starter', 'professional', 'enterprise'],
000133:   EMPLOYMENT_TYPE: ['FULL_TIME', 'PART_TIME', 'CONTRACT', 'INTERNSHIP', 'TEMPORARY'],
000134:   WORK_TYPE: ['REMOTE', 'ONSITE', 'HYBRID'],
000135:   EXPERIENCE_LEVEL: ['ENTRY', 'JUNIOR', 'MID', 'SENIOR', 'LEAD', 'EXECUTIVE'],
000136:   GENDER: ['MALE', 'FEMALE', 'OTHER', 'PREFER_NOT_TO_SAY'],
