```text
000138: 
000139: // =============================================================================
000140: // SANITIZATION FUNCTIONS
000141: // =============================================================================
000142: 
000143: /**
000144:  * Sanitize a string to prevent XSS attacks
000145:  * Escapes HTML special characters
000146:  * 
000147:  * @param {string} value - Input string
000148:  * @returns {string} Sanitized string
000149:  */
000150: const sanitizeString = (value) => {
000151:   if (typeof value !== 'string') return value;
000152:   return escapeHtml(value.trim());
000153: };
000154: 
000155: /**
000156:  * Sanitize an object by removing unexpected fields
000157:  * Uses whitelist approach for security
000158:  * 
000159:  * @param {Object} obj - Input object
000160:  * @param {Array<string>} allowedFields - Whitelist of allowed field names
000161:  * @returns {Object} Sanitized object with only allowed fields
000162:  */
000163: const sanitizeObject = (obj, allowedFields) => {
000164:   if (!obj || typeof obj !== 'object') return {};
000165:   
000166:   const sanitized = {};
000167:   allowedFields.forEach(field => {
000168:     if (Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(obj, field) && obj[field] !== undefined) {
000169:       sanitized[field] = obj[field];
000170:     }
000171:   });
000172:   
000173:   return sanitized;
000174: };
000175: 
000176: /**
000177:  * Sanitize an array of strings
000178:  * 
000179:  * @param {Array} arr - Input array
000180:  * @param {number} maxItems - Maximum allowed items
000181:  * @returns {Array} Sanitized array
000182:  */
000183: const sanitizeStringArray = (arr, maxItems = LENGTH_LIMITS.ARRAY_MAX_ITEMS) => {
000184:   if (!Array.isArray(arr)) return [];
000185:   
000186:   return arr
000187:     .slice(0, maxItems)
000188:     .filter(item => typeof item === 'string')
000189:     .map(item => sanitizeString(item))
000190:     .filter(item => item.length > 0);
000191: };
000192: 
000193: /**
000194:  * Normalize and sanitize email address
000195:  * 
000196:  * @param {string} email - Input email
000197:  * @returns {string} Normalized email
000198:  */
000199: const normalizeEmail = (email) => {
000200:   if (typeof email !== 'string') return '';
000201:   return email.trim().toLowerCase();
000202: };
000203: 
000204: // =============================================================================
000205: // VALIDATION MIDDLEWARE
000206: // =============================================================================
000207: 
000208: /**
000209:  * Middleware to validate request and return errors
000210:  * Should be called after all validation rules
000211:  */
000212: export const validateRequest = (req, res, next) => {
000213:   const errors = validationResult(req);
000214:   
000215:   if (!errors.isEmpty()) {
000216:     const errorDetails = errors.array().map(err => ({
000217:       field: err.path || err.param,
000218:       message: err.msg,
000219:       value: err.value !== undefined ? '[REDACTED]' : undefined, // Don't expose values
000220:     }));
000221:     
000222:     // Log validation failure for security monitoring
000223:     logger.warn('Validation failed', {
000224:       path: req.path,
000225:       method: req.method,
000226:       ip: req.ip,
000227:       errors: errorDetails.map(e => e.field),
000228:     });
000229:     
000230:     return res.status(400).json({
000231:       success: false,
000232:       error: 'Validation failed',
000233:       code: 'VALIDATION_ERROR',
000234:       errors: errorDetails,
000235:     });
000236:   }
000237:   
000238:   next();
000239: };
000240: 
000241: /**
000242:  * Middleware to strip unexpected fields from request body
000243:  * Uses whitelist approach - only allows specified fields
000244:  * 
000245:  * @param {Array<string>} allowedFields - Whitelist of allowed field names
000246:  * @returns {Function} Express middleware
000247:  */
000248: export const stripUnexpectedFields = (allowedFields) => (req, res, next) => {
000249:   if (req.body && typeof req.body === 'object') {
000250:     const unexpectedFields = Object.keys(req.body).filter(
000251:       field => !allowedFields.includes(field)
000252:     );
000253:     
000254:     if (unexpectedFields.length > 0) {
000255:       logger.warn('Unexpected fields stripped from request', {
000256:         path: req.path,
000257:         method: req.method,
000258:         ip: req.ip,
000259:         unexpectedFields,
000260:       });
000261:     }
000262:     
000263:     req.body = sanitizeObject(req.body, allowedFields);
000264:   }
000265:   
000266:   next();
000267: };
000268: 
000269: // =============================================================================
000270: // COMMON VALIDATION RULES
000271: // =============================================================================
000272: 
000273: /**
000274:  * Common validation rules for reuse across routes
000275:  */
000276: export const commonValidators = {
000277:   // ID validation
000278:   id: () => param('id')
000279:     .trim()
000280:     .notEmpty()
000281:     .withMessage('ID is required')
000282:     .isLength({ max: LENGTH_LIMITS.ID })
000283:     .withMessage(`ID must be ${LENGTH_LIMITS.ID} characters or less`)
000284:     .matches(PATTERNS.ALPHANUMERIC_ID)
000285:     .withMessage('Invalid ID format'),
000286: 
000287:   // Firebase UID validation
000288:   firebaseUid: (field = 'uid') => body(field)
000289:     .trim()
000290:     .notEmpty()
000291:     .withMessage('User ID is required')
000292:     .matches(PATTERNS.FIREBASE_UID)
000293:     .withMessage('Invalid user ID format'),
000294: 
000295:   // Email validation
000296:   email: (field = 'email', required = true) => {
000297:     let validator = body(field)
000298:       .trim()
000299:       .normalizeEmail();
000300:     
000301:     if (required) {
000302:       validator = validator
000303:         .notEmpty()
000304:         .withMessage('Email is required');
000305:     } else {
000306:       validator = validator.optional({ nullable: true, checkFalsy: true });
000307:     }
000308:     
000309:     return validator
000310:       .isEmail()
000311:       .withMessage('Valid email address is required')
000312:       .isLength({ max: LENGTH_LIMITS.EMAIL })
000313:       .withMessage(`Email must be ${LENGTH_LIMITS.EMAIL} characters or less`);
000314:   },
000315: 
000316:   // Name validation
000317:   name: (field = 'name', required = true) => {
000318:     let validator = body(field)
000319:       .trim()
000320:       .customSanitizer(sanitizeString);
000321:     
000322:     if (required) {
000323:       validator = validator
000324:         .notEmpty()
000325:         .withMessage('Name is required');
000326:     } else {
000327:       validator = validator.optional({ nullable: true, checkFalsy: true });
000328:     }
000329:     
000330:     return validator
000331:       .isLength({ max: LENGTH_LIMITS.NAME })
000332:       .withMessage(`Name must be ${LENGTH_LIMITS.NAME} characters or less`)
000333:       .matches(PATTERNS.SAFE_STRING)
000334:       .withMessage('Name contains invalid characters');
000335:   },
000336: 
000337:   // Short text validation
000338:   shortText: (field, required = false) => {
000339:     let validator = body(field)
000340:       .trim()
000341:       .customSanitizer(sanitizeString);
000342:     
000343:     if (required) {
000344:       validator = validator
000345:         .notEmpty()
000346:         .withMessage(`${field} is required`);
000347:     } else {
000348:       validator = validator.optional({ nullable: true, checkFalsy: true });
000349:     }
000350:     
000351:     return validator
000352:       .isLength({ max: LENGTH_LIMITS.SHORT_TEXT })
000353:       .withMessage(`${field} must be ${LENGTH_LIMITS.SHORT_TEXT} characters or less`);
000354:   },
000355: 
000356:   // Medium text validation
000357:   mediumText: (field, required = false) => {
000358:     let validator = body(field)
000359:       .trim()
000360:       .customSanitizer(sanitizeString);
000361:     
000362:     if (required) {
000363:       validator = validator
000364:         .notEmpty()
000365:         .withMessage(`${field} is required`);
000366:     } else {
000367:       validator = validator.optional({ nullable: true, checkFalsy: true });
000368:     }
000369:     
000370:     return validator
000371:       .isLength({ max: LENGTH_LIMITS.MEDIUM_TEXT })
000372:       .withMessage(`${field} must be ${LENGTH_LIMITS.MEDIUM_TEXT} characters or less`);
000373:   },
000374: 
000375:   // Long text validation (for descriptions, messages)
000376:   longText: (field, required = false) => {
000377:     let validator = body(field)
000378:       .trim()
000379:       .customSanitizer(sanitizeString);
000380:     
000381:     if (required) {
000382:       validator = validator
000383:         .notEmpty()
000384:         .withMessage(`${field} is required`);
000385:     } else {
000386:       validator = validator.optional({ nullable: true, checkFalsy: true });
000387:     }
000388:     
000389:     return validator
000390:       .isLength({ max: LENGTH_LIMITS.LONG_TEXT })
000391:       .withMessage(`${field} must be ${LENGTH_LIMITS.LONG_TEXT} characters or less`);
000392:   },
000393: 
000394:   // Very long text validation (for very long content)
000395:   veryLongText: (field, required = false) => {
000396:     let validator = body(field)
000397:       .trim()
000398:       .customSanitizer(sanitizeString);
000399:     
000400:     if (required) {
000401:       validator = validator
000402:         .notEmpty()
000403:         .withMessage(`${field} is required`);
000404:     } else {
000405:       validator = validator.optional({ nullable: true, checkFalsy: true });
000406:     }
000407:     
000408:     return validator
000409:       .isLength({ max: LENGTH_LIMITS.VERY_LONG_TEXT })
000410:       .withMessage(`${field} must be ${LENGTH_LIMITS.VERY_LONG_TEXT} characters or less`);
000411:   },
000412: 
000413:   // URL validation
000414:   url: (field, required = false) => {
000415:     let validator = body(field)
000416:       .trim();
000417:     
000418:     if (required) {
000419:       validator = validator
000420:         .notEmpty()
000421:         .withMessage(`${field} is required`);
000422:     } else {
000423:       validator = validator.optional({ nullable: true, checkFalsy: true });
000424:     }
000425:     
000426:     return validator
000427:       .isURL({ protocols: ['http', 'https'], require_protocol: true })
000428:       .withMessage(`${field} must be a valid URL`)
000429:       .isLength({ max: LENGTH_LIMITS.URL })
000430:       .withMessage(`${field} must be ${LENGTH_LIMITS.URL} characters or less`);
000431:   },
000432: 
000433:   // Phone validation
000434:   phone: (field = 'phoneNumber', required = false) => {
000435:     let validator = body(field)
000436:       .trim();
000437:     
000438:     if (required) {
000439:       validator = validator
000440:         .notEmpty()
000441:         .withMessage('Phone number is required');
000442:     } else {
000443:       validator = validator.optional({ nullable: true, checkFalsy: true });
000444:     }
000445:     
000446:     return validator
000447:       .isLength({ max: LENGTH_LIMITS.PHONE })
000448:       .withMessage(`Phone number must be ${LENGTH_LIMITS.PHONE} characters or less`)
000449:       .matches(PATTERNS.PHONE)
000450:       .withMessage('Invalid phone number format');
000451:   },
000452: 
000453:   // Token validation
000454:   token: (field = 'token') => body(field)
000455:     .trim()
000456:     .notEmpty()
000457:     .withMessage('Token is required')
000458:     .isLength({ max: LENGTH_LIMITS.TOKEN })
000459:     .withMessage('Invalid token format'),
000460: 
000461:   // Verification code validation
000462:   verificationCode: () => body('code')
000463:     .trim()
000464:     .notEmpty()
000465:     .withMessage('Verification code is required')
000466:     .matches(PATTERNS.VERIFICATION_CODE)
000467:     .withMessage('Verification code must be 8 digits'),
000468: 
000469:   // Enum validation
000470:   enum: (field, allowedValues, required = false) => {
000471:     let validator = body(field)
000472:       .trim()
000473:       .customSanitizer(v => v?.toUpperCase?.() || v);
000474:     
000475:     if (required) {
000476:       validator = validator
000477:         .notEmpty()
000478:         .withMessage(`${field} is required`);
000479:     } else {
000480:       validator = validator.optional({ nullable: true, checkFalsy: true });
000481:     }
000482:     
000483:     return validator
000484:       .isIn(allowedValues)
000485:       .withMessage(`${field} must be one of: ${allowedValues.join(', ')}`);
000486:   },
000487: 
000488:   // Array of strings validation
000489:   stringArray: (field, required = false, maxItems = LENGTH_LIMITS.ARRAY_MAX_ITEMS) => {
000490:     let validator = body(field)
000491:       .customSanitizer(value => {
000492:         if (Array.isArray(value)) return sanitizeStringArray(value, maxItems);
000493:         if (typeof value === 'string') {
000494:           // Handle comma-separated string
000495:           return sanitizeStringArray(value.split(','), maxItems);
000496:         }
000497:         return [];
000498:       });
000499:     
000500:     if (required) {
000501:       validator = validator
000502:         .isArray({ min: 1 })
000503:         .withMessage(`${field} must have at least one item`);
000504:     } else {
000505:       validator = validator.optional({ nullable: true });
000506:     }
000507:     
000508:     return validator
000509:       .isArray({ max: maxItems })
000510:       .withMessage(`${field} must have at most ${maxItems} items`);
000511:   },
000512: 
000513:   // Integer validation
000514:   integer: (field, { min, max, required = false } = {}) => {
000515:     let validator = body(field)
000516:       .toInt();
000517:     
000518:     if (required) {
000519:       validator = validator
000520:         .notEmpty()
000521:         .withMessage(`${field} is required`);
000522:     } else {
000523:       validator = validator.optional({ nullable: true, checkFalsy: true });
000524:     }
000525:     
000526:     validator = validator.isInt();
000527:     
000528:     if (min !== undefined) {
000529:       validator = validator.isInt({ min }).withMessage(`${field} must be at least ${min}`);
000530:     }
000531:     if (max !== undefined) {
000532:       validator = validator.isInt({ max }).withMessage(`${field} must be at most ${max}`);
000533:     }
000534:     
000535:     return validator;
000536:   },
000537: 
000538:   // Boolean validation
000539:   boolean: (field, required = false) => {
000540:     let validator = body(field)
000541:       .toBoolean();
000542:     
000543:     if (required) {
000544:       validator = validator
000545:         .notEmpty()
000546:         .withMessage(`${field} is required`);
000547:     } else {
000548:       validator = validator.optional({ nullable: true });
000549:     }
000550:     
000551:     return validator.isBoolean().withMessage(`${field} must be a boolean`);
000552:   },
000553: 
000554:   // Date/ISO8601 validation
000555:   isoDate: (field, required = false) => {
000556:     let validator = body(field)
000557:       .trim();
000558:     
000559:     if (required) {
000560:       validator = validator
000561:         .notEmpty()
000562:         .withMessage(`${field} is required`);
000563:     } else {
000564:       validator = validator.optional({ nullable: true, checkFalsy: true });
000565:     }
000566:     
000567:     return validator
000568:       .isISO8601()
000569:       .withMessage(`${field} must be a valid ISO 8601 date`);
000570:   },
000571: 
000572:   // Year validation
000573:   year: (field = 'year', required = false) => {
000574:     let validator = body(field)
000575:       .trim();
000576:     
000577:     if (required) {
000578:       validator = validator
000579:         .notEmpty()
000580:         .withMessage('Year is required');
000581:     } else {
000582:       validator = validator.optional({ nullable: true, checkFalsy: true });
000583:     }
000584:     
000585:     return validator
000586:       .matches(PATTERNS.YEAR)
000587:       .withMessage('Year must be a valid 4-digit year');
000588:   },
000589: 
000590:   // Query parameter validation
000591:   queryParam: {
000592:     limit: (defaultVal = 50, maxVal = 500) => query('limit')
000593:       .optional()
000594:       .toInt()
000595:       .isInt({ min: 1, max: maxVal })
000596:       .withMessage(`Limit must be between 1 and ${maxVal}`)
000597:       .default(defaultVal),
000598:     
000599:     offset: () => query('offset')
000600:       .optional()
000601:       .toInt()
000602:       .isInt({ min: 0 })
000603:       .withMessage('Offset must be 0 or greater')
000604:       .default(0),
000605:     
000606:     status: (allowedValues) => query('status')
000607:       .optional()
000608:       .trim()
000609:       .isIn(allowedValues)
000610:       .withMessage(`Status must be one of: ${allowedValues.join(', ')}`),
000611:   },
000612: };
```

### 13.2.93 `server/src/middleware/maintenance.middleware.js`
- Metadata: bytes=2475, lines=59, sha256=`a4cc58e07655935e27b0e0db20e4442438e66b15e466da20ebc3376c1d4e88fc`
```text
000001: import { systemSettingsStore } from '../services/firebaseData.service.js';
000002: import logger from '../utils/logger.js';
000003: 
000004: /**
000005:  * Middleware to check maintenance mode
000006:  * System admins can bypass maintenance mode
000007:  * Non-admin users are blocked from write operations when maintenance mode is enabled
000008:  * Read operations are allowed but maintenance flag is added to response
000009:  * 
000010:  * NOTE: This middleware should run AFTER authentication middleware
000011:  * so that req.user is available to check if user is system admin
000012:  */
000013: export async function checkMaintenanceMode(req, res, next) {
000014:   try {
000015:     // Allow system admins to bypass maintenance mode completely
000016:     if (req.user?.accountType === 'SYSTEM_ADMIN') {
000017:       return next();
000018:     }
000019: 
000020:     // Get system settings
000021:     const settings = await systemSettingsStore.get();
000022:     
000023:     // If maintenance mode is not enabled, proceed normally
000024:     if (!settings?.maintenanceMode) {
000025:       return next();
000026:     }
000027: 
000028:     // Maintenance mode is enabled - check if this is a write operation
000029:     const writeMethods = ['POST', 'PUT', 'PATCH', 'DELETE'];
000030:     const isWriteOperation = writeMethods.includes(req.method);
000031: 
000032:     if (isWriteOperation) {
000033:       // Block write operations for non-admin users (both authenticated and unauthenticated)
000034:       const userId = req.user?.id || req.user?.uid || 'unauthenticated';
000035:       logger.warn(`Maintenance mode: Blocked ${req.method} ${req.path} for user ${userId}`);
000036:       return res.status(503).json({
000037:         error: 'The platform is currently under maintenance. Please try again later.',
000038:         code: 'MAINTENANCE_MODE',
000039:         maintenanceMode: true,
000040:       });
000041:     }
000042: 
000043:     // Allow read operations but add maintenance flag to response
000044:     // This allows frontend to show maintenance banner
000045:     res.locals.maintenanceMode = true;
000046:     res.setHeader('X-Maintenance-Mode', 'true');
000047:     return next();
000048:   } catch (error) {
000049:     logger.error('Maintenance mode check error:', error);
000050:     // On error, allow request to proceed (fail open)
000051:     // This prevents maintenance mode from breaking the system if settings can't be loaded
000052:     return next();
000053:   }
000054: }
000055: 
000056: /**
000057:  * Middleware to add maintenance mode status to response headers
000058:  * This allows frontend to detect maintenance mode even on successful requests
000059:  */
000060: export function addMaintenanceHeader(req, res, next) {
000061:   if (res.locals.maintenanceMode) {
000062:     res.setHeader('X-Maintenance-Mode', 'true');
000063:   }
000064:   next();
000065: }
000066: 
000067: 
```

```text
000001: /**
000002:  * Enhanced Rate Limiting Middleware
000003:  * 
000004:  * Implements OWASP best practices for rate limiting:
000005:  * - IP-based rate limiting for unauthenticated requests
000006:  * - User-based rate limiting for authenticated requests
000007:  * - Endpoint-specific limits based on sensitivity
000008:  * - Graceful 429 responses with retry information
000009:  * - Sliding window algorithm for accurate rate limiting
000010:  * 
000011:  * @see https://cheatsheetseries.owasp.org/cheatsheets/Denial_of_Service_Cheat_Sheet.html
000012:  */
000013: 
000014: import rateLimit from 'express-rate-limit';
000015: import logger from '../utils/logger.js';
000016: 
000017: // =============================================================================
000018: // CONFIGURATION CONSTANTS
000019: // =============================================================================
000020: 
000021: /**
000022:  * Rate limit configurations by endpoint type
000023:  * Values are based on OWASP recommendations and practical usage patterns
000024:  */
000025: const RATE_LIMIT_CONFIG = {
000026:   // General API endpoints - moderate limits
000027:   API_GENERAL: {
000028:     windowMs: 15 * 60 * 1000, // 15 minutes
000029:     max: 100, // 100 requests per window
000030:     message: 'Too many requests. Please try again in a few minutes.',
000031:   },
000032: 
000033:   // Authentication endpoints - stricter limits to prevent brute force
000034:   AUTH_LOGIN: {
000035:     windowMs: 15 * 60 * 1000, // 15 minutes
000036:     max: 10, // 10 attempts per window
000037:     message: 'Too many login attempts. Please wait 15 minutes before trying again.',
000038:     skipSuccessfulRequests: true, // Only count failed attempts
000039:   },
000040: 
000041:   AUTH_REGISTER: {
000042:     windowMs: 60 * 60 * 1000, // 1 hour
000043:     max: 5, // 5 registrations per hour per IP
000044:     message: 'Too many registration attempts. Please try again later.',
000045:   },
000046: 
000047:   AUTH_EMAIL_CHECK: {
000048:     windowMs: 60 * 1000, // 1 minute
000049:     max: 10, // 10 checks per minute
000050:     message: 'Too many email checks. Please slow down.',
000051:   },
000052: 
000053:   // Email verification - prevent abuse
000054:   EMAIL_VERIFICATION: {
000055:     windowMs: 60 * 60 * 1000, // 1 hour
000056:     max: 5, // 5 verification emails per hour
000057:     message: 'Too many verification requests. Please wait before requesting another code.',
```

```text
000023:   profilePhotosDir,
000024:   resumesDir,
000025:   companyLogosDir,
000026:   companyProofsDir,
000027:   jobAdvertImagesDir,
000028:   jobAdvertVideosDir,
000029: ].forEach(ensureDir);
000030: 
000031: const fileDestinationMap = {
000032:   profilePhoto: profilePhotosDir,
000033:   resumeFile: resumesDir,
000034:   companyLogo: companyLogosDir,
000035:   companyProof: companyProofsDir,
000036:   jobAdvertImage: jobAdvertImagesDir,
000037:   jobAdvertVideo: jobAdvertVideosDir,
000038: };
000039: 
000040: const storage = multer.diskStorage({
000041:   destination: (req, file, cb) => {
000042:     const destination = fileDestinationMap[file.fieldname] || uploadsRoot;
000043:     cb(null, destination);
000044:   },
000045:   filename: (req, file, cb) => {
000046:     const extension = path.extname(file.originalname || '').toLowerCase();
000047:     const uniqueName = `${Date.now()}-${randomUUID()}${extension}`;
000048:     cb(null, uniqueName);
000049:   },
000050: });
000051: 
000052: const allowedMimeTypes = {
000053:   profilePhoto: ['image/jpeg', 'image/png', 'image/webp'],
000054:   companyLogo: ['image/jpeg', 'image/png', 'image/webp', 'image/svg+xml'],
000055:   file: ['image/jpeg', 'image/png', 'image/webp', 'image/svg+xml'],
000056:   jobAdvertImage: ['image/jpeg', 'image/png', 'image/webp', 'image/gif'],
000057:   jobAdvertVideo: ['video/mp4', 'video/webm', 'video/quicktime', 'video/x-matroska', 'video/ogg'],
000058:   resumeFile: [
000059:     'application/pdf',
000060:     'application/msword',
000061:     'application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document',
000062:   ],
000063:   companyProof: [
000064:     'application/pdf',
000065:     'application/msword',
000066:     'application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document',
000067:   ],
000068: };
000069: 
000070: const errorMessages = {
000071:   profilePhoto: 'Profile photo must be a JPG, PNG, or WEBP image.',
000072:   companyLogo: 'Company logo must be a JPG, PNG, WEBP, or SVG image.',
000073:   file: 'Image must be JPG, PNG, WEBP, or SVG.',
000074:   jobAdvertImage: 'Job advert image must be JPG, PNG, WEBP, or GIF.',
000075:   jobAdvertVideo: 'Job advert video must be MP4, WEBM, MOV, MKV, or OGG.',
000076:   resumeFile: 'Résumé must be a PDF or Word document.',
000077:   companyProof: 'Verification document must be a PDF or Word document.',
000078: };
000079: 
000080: const { MulterError } = multer;
000081: 
000082: const fileFilter = (req, file, cb) => {
000083:   const allowed = allowedMimeTypes[file.fieldname];
000084:   if (!allowed) {
000085:     return cb(new MulterError('LIMIT_UNEXPECTED_FILE', file.fieldname));
000086:   }
000087: 
000088:   if (!allowed.includes(file.mimetype)) {
000089:     const error = new MulterError('LIMIT_UNEXPECTED_FILE', file.fieldname);
000090:     error.message = errorMessages[file.fieldname] || 'Unsupported file type.';
000091:     return cb(error);
000092:   }
000093: 
000094:   cb(null, true);
000095: };
000096: 
000097: export const registrationUpload = multer({
000098:   storage,
000099:   fileFilter,
000100:   limits: {
000101:     fileSize: 15 * 1024 * 1024, // Max 15 MB for larger verification docs
000102:     files: 4,
000103:   },
000104: });
000105: 
000106: export const jobAdvertUpload = multer({
000107:   storage,
000108:   fileFilter,
000109:   limits: {
000110:     fileSize: 50 * 1024 * 1024, // Max 50 MB for short advert videos
000111:     files: 1,
000112:   },
000113: });
000114: 
000115: export const uploadsPaths = {
000116:   root: uploadsRoot,
000117:   profilePhotosDir,
000118:   resumesDir,
000119:   companyLogosDir,
000120:   companyProofsDir,
000121:   jobAdvertImagesDir,
000122:   jobAdvertVideosDir,
000123: };

000125:
```

```text
000001: /**
```

```text
000006:  * - Input sanitization
000007:  * - Field whitelisting
000008:  * - Rate limiting (applied in security middleware)

000011:  */

000013: import express from 'express';
000014: import { authenticate, requireCandidate, requireCompany, verifyFirebaseAuth } from '../middleware/auth.middleware.js';

000016:   validateRequest,

000021: import { registrationUpload } from '../middleware/upload.middleware.js';
000022: 
000023: const router = express.Router();
000024: 
000025: // File upload handler for registration
000026: const registrationUploadHandler = registrationUpload.fields([

000044:  */
000045: router.post(

000051:   validateRequest,
000052:   AuthController.register
000053: );
000054: 
000055: /**
000056:  * POST /api/auth/check-email
000057:  * Check email availability before registration
000058:  * 
000059:  * Rate limited: 10 checks per minute per IP
000060:  * Prevents email enumeration through rate limiting
000061:  */
000062: router.post(
000063:   '/check-email',
000064:   stripUnexpectedFields(validationSchemas.auth.checkEmail.allowedFields),
000065:   validationSchemas.auth.checkEmail.validators,
000066:   validateRequest,

000069:

000080:  */
000081: router.post(

000088: );
000089:

000095:  * Controller has additional attempt limiting
000096:  */
000097: router.post(
```

```text
000001: /**

000007:  *

000012:  * GET    /api/datasets/statistics    - Get dataset statistics
000013:  * GET    /api/datasets/export/:type  - Export datasets in training format

000015:  */
000016:

000027: import { requireSystemAdmin } from '../middleware/admin.middleware.js';

000030: 
000031: /**

000035:  */
000036: router.post('/interview', optionalAuth, saveInterviewDataset);
000037: 
000038: /**

000044:

000047:  * @desc    List all datasets

000053: router.get('/', authenticate, requireSystemAdmin, listDatasets);

000060: router.get('/statistics', authenticate, requireSystemAdmin, getDatasetStatistics);

000070: router.get('/export/:type', authenticate, requireSystemAdmin, exportDatasets);
```

```text
000001: /**
000002:  * Server Entry Point
000003:  * 
000004:  * Initializes the Express application with:
000005:  * - Secure configuration validation
000006:  * - Security middleware (Helmet, CORS, rate limiting)
000007:  * - Route handling with input validation
000008:  * - Error handling
000009:  * - WebSocket support
000010:  */
000011: 
000012: // Load environment variables FIRST (this file loads .env)
000013: import './config/env.js';
000014: 
000015: // Validate environment configuration
000016: import { initializeSecureConfig } from './config/secureConfig.js';
000017: initializeSecureConfig();
000018: 
000019: import express from 'express';
000020: import { createServer } from 'http';
000021: import { Server } from 'socket.io';
000022: import cors from 'cors';
000023: import helmet from 'helmet';
000024: import cookieParser from 'cookie-parser';
000025: import fs from 'fs';
000026: import path from 'path';
000027: import { fileURLToPath } from 'url';
000028: import { setupRoutes } from './routes/index.js';
000029: import { setupSocketIO } from './socket/interview.socket.js';
000030: import { setupSecurity } from './middleware/security.middleware.js';
000031: import { setupErrorHandling } from './middleware/error.middleware.js';
000032: import logger from './utils/logger.js';
000033: 
000034: const app = express();
000035: const httpServer = createServer(app);
000036: const io = new Server(httpServer, {
000037:   cors: {
000038:     origin: process.env.FRONTEND_URL || "http://localhost:4028",
000039:     credentials: true
000040:   }
000041: });
000042: 
000043: export { io };
000044: 
000045: // Security middleware
000046: setupSecurity(app);
000047: 
000048: // Body parsing middleware
000049: app.use(express.json({ limit: '10mb' }));
000050: app.use(express.urlencoded({ extended: true, limit: '10mb' }));
000051: app.use(cookieParser());
000052: 
000053: const uploadsPath = path.resolve(path.dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)), '..', 'uploads');
000054: if (!fs.existsSync(uploadsPath)) {
000055:   fs.mkdirSync(uploadsPath, { recursive: true });
000056: }
000057: const uploadsAccessMode = String(process.env.UPLOADS_ACCESS_MODE || 'PUBLIC').trim().toUpperCase();
000058: if (uploadsAccessMode === 'PUBLIC') {
000059:   app.use('/uploads', express.static(uploadsPath));
000060: } else {
000061:   logger.info(`Uploads static route disabled (UPLOADS_ACCESS_MODE=${uploadsAccessMode}). Use signed object-storage URLs.`);
000062: }
000063: 
000064: // Routes
000065: setupRoutes(app);
000066: 
000067: // Socket.IO setup
000068: setupSocketIO(io);
000069: 
000070: // Error handling (must be last)
000071: setupErrorHandling(app);
000072: 
000073: const PORT = process.env.PORT || 3000;
000074: 
000075: // Graceful shutdown
000076: process.on('SIGINT', async () => {
000077:   logger.info('Shutting down gracefully...');
000078:   httpServer.close(() => {
000079:     logger.info('Server closed');
000080:     process.exit(0);
000081:   });
000082: });
000083: 
000084: httpServer.listen(PORT, () => {
000085:   logger.info(`🚀 Server running on port ${PORT}`);
000086:   logger.info(`📡 Socket.IO server ready`);
000087: });
000088: 
```

```text
000001: import { randomUUID } from 'crypto';
000002: import logger from '../utils/logger.js';
000003: 
000004: const QUEUE_MODES = new Set(['ASYNC', 'INLINE']);
000005: 
000006: const normalizeQueueMode = (value) => {
000007:   const normalized = String(value || 'ASYNC').trim().toUpperCase();
000008:   return QUEUE_MODES.has(normalized) ? normalized : 'ASYNC';
000009: };
000010: 
000011: const calculateRetryDelayMs = (attempt) => {
000012:   const baseDelay = 250;
000013:   const cappedAttempt = Math.min(Math.max(attempt, 1), 6);
000014:   return baseDelay * (2 ** (cappedAttempt - 1));
000015: };
000016: 
000017: class InMemoryBackgroundQueue {
000018:   constructor(name, { concurrency = 1 } = {}) {
000019:     this.name = name;
000020:     this.concurrency = Math.max(1, Number.parseInt(concurrency, 10) || 1);
000021:     this.mode = normalizeQueueMode(process.env.JOB_QUEUE_MODE);
000022:     this.pending = [];
000023:     this.runningCount = 0;
000024:     this.totalProcessed = 0;
000025:     this.totalFailed = 0;
000026:   }
000027: 
000028:   enqueue({
000029:     type,
000030:     handler,
000031:     payload = {},
000032:     maxAttempts = 3,
000033:   }) {
000034:     if (typeof handler !== 'function') {
000035:       throw new Error(`[${this.name}] Queue handler must be a function.`);
000036:     }
000037: 
000038:     const job = {
000039:       id: randomUUID(),
000040:       queue: this.name,
000041:       type: type || 'UNKNOWN',
000042:       payload,
000043:       handler,
000044:       attempts: 0,
000045:       maxAttempts: Math.max(1, Number.parseInt(maxAttempts, 10) || 3),
000046:       enqueuedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
000047:     };
000048: 
000049:     if (this.mode === 'INLINE') {
000050:       // Inline mode is used by tests for deterministic execution.
000051:       void this.#runJob(job);
000052:       return job.id;
000053:     }
000054: 
000055:     this.pending.push(job);
000056:     this.#drain();
000057:     return job.id;
000058:   }
000059: 
000060:   getStats() {
000061:     return {
000062:       name: this.name,
000063:       mode: this.mode,
000064:       concurrency: this.concurrency,
000065:       pending: this.pending.length,
000066:       running: this.runningCount,
000067:       totalProcessed: this.totalProcessed,
000068:       totalFailed: this.totalFailed,
000069:     };
000070:   }
000071: 
000072:   async waitForIdle(timeoutMs = 5000) {
000073:     const start = Date.now();
000074:     while (this.pending.length > 0 || this.runningCount > 0) {
000075:       if (Date.now() - start > timeoutMs) {
000076:         throw new Error(`[${this.name}] Timed out waiting for queue to become idle.`);
000077:       }
000078:       // eslint-disable-next-line no-await-in-loop
000079:       await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 20));
000080:     }
000081:   }
000082: 
000083:   #drain() {
000084:     while (this.runningCount < this.concurrency && this.pending.length > 0) {
000085:       const job = this.pending.shift();
000086:       if (!job) break;
000087:       void this.#runJob(job);
000088:     }
000089:   }
000090: 
000091:   async #runJob(job) {
000092:     this.runningCount += 1;
000093:     job.attempts += 1;
000094: 
000095:     try {
000096:       await job.handler(job.payload);
000097:       this.totalProcessed += 1;
000098:     } catch (error) {
000099:       const shouldRetry = job.attempts < job.maxAttempts;
000100:       if (shouldRetry) {
000101:         const retryDelayMs = calculateRetryDelayMs(job.attempts);
000102:         logger.warn(
000103:           `[${this.name}] Job ${job.type} (${job.id}) failed attempt ${job.attempts}/${job.maxAttempts}; retrying in ${retryDelayMs}ms.`,
000104:           error,
000105:         );
000106:         setTimeout(() => {
000107:           this.pending.push(job);
000108:           this.#drain();
000109:         }, retryDelayMs);
000110:       } else {
000111:         this.totalFailed += 1;
000112:         logger.error(
000113:           `[${this.name}] Job ${job.type} (${job.id}) failed permanently after ${job.attempts} attempts.`,
000114:           error,
000115:         );
000116:       }
000117:     } finally {
000118:       this.runningCount -= 1;
000119:       this.#drain();
000120:     }
000121:   }
000122: }
000123: 
000124: const emailQueue = new InMemoryBackgroundQueue('email', { concurrency: 2 });
000125: const analyticsQueue = new InMemoryBackgroundQueue('analytics', { concurrency: 1 });
000126: 
000127: export const queueEmailJob = ({ type, handler, payload, maxAttempts = 3 }) => {
000128:   try {
000129:     return emailQueue.enqueue({ type, handler, payload, maxAttempts });
000130:   } catch (error) {
000131:     logger.error(`[email] Failed to enqueue ${type || 'UNKNOWN'} job.`, error);
000132:     return null;
000133:   }
000134: };
000135: 
000136: export const queueAnalyticsJob = ({ type, handler, payload, maxAttempts = 2 }) => {
000137:   try {
000138:     return analyticsQueue.enqueue({ type, handler, payload, maxAttempts });
000139:   } catch (error) {
000140:     logger.error(`[analytics] Failed to enqueue ${type || 'UNKNOWN'} job.`, error);
000141:     return null;
000142:   }
000143: };
000144: 
000145: export const backgroundJobQueueStats = () => ({
000146:   email: emailQueue.getStats(),
000147:   analytics: analyticsQueue.getStats(),
000148: });
000149: 
000150: export const waitForBackgroundJobs = async (timeoutMs = 5000) => {
000151:   await Promise.all([
000152:     emailQueue.waitForIdle(timeoutMs),
000153:     analyticsQueue.waitForIdle(timeoutMs),
000154:   ]);
000155: };
```

```text
000220: /**

000222:  */
000223: export async function checkLimit(organizationId, feature) {
000224:   try {
000225:     const subscription = await getSubscription(organizationId);
000226:     const plan = PLANS[subscription.planId.toUpperCase()];
000227:     
000228:     if (!plan || !plan.features[feature]) {
000229:       return { allowed: true }; // Default to allow if feature not defined
000230:     }
000231:     
000232:     const limit = plan.features[feature];
000233:     
000234:     // -1 means unlimited
000235:     if (limit === -1) {
000236:       return { allowed: true, unlimited: true };
000237:     }
000238:     
000239:     const currentUsage = subscription.usage[feature] || 0;
000240:     
000241:     return {
000242:       allowed: currentUsage < limit,
000243:       limit,
000244:       current: currentUsage,
000245:       remaining: Math.max(0, limit - currentUsage),
000246:     };
000247:   } catch (error) {
000248:     logger.error('Check limit error:', error);
000249:     // Default to allow on error
```

```text
000038: const MAX_REGISTERED_REG_NUMBERS = 5;
000039: 
000040: const BUSINESS_SECTION_KEYWORDS = [
000041:   ['business', 'company', 'organization', 'organisation', 'enterprise'],
000042:   ['registration', 'incorporation', 'certificate', 'licence', 'license', 'permit'],
000043:   ['tax', 'gst', 'vat', 'ein', 'tin', 'pan', 'uen', 'cin', 'uen'],
000044:   ['authority', 'government', 'ministry', 'department', 'commission', 'municipal'],
000045:   ['address', 'headquarters', 'office', 'location', 'contact'],
000046: ];

000048: const RESUME_MIN_SIZE_BYTES = 10 * 1024;
000049: const RESUME_MAX_SIZE_BYTES = 50 * 1024 * 1024;

000055:   ['education', 'academic', 'university'],

000062:   ['volunteer', 'community'],

000078:   'registration',
000079:   'reg.',

000081:   'business number',

000083:   'license',
000084:   'licence',
000085:   'permit',

000095:   'inc',

000099:   'l.l.c',
000100:   'ltd',
000101:   'ltd.',
000102:   'limited',

000104:   'pte',
000105:   'plc',
000106:   'corp',
000107:   'corp.',

000117: const REGISTRATION_NUMBER_REGEX = /\b([A-Z]{1,4}\d[\dA-Z\-\/]{3,}|[A-Z0-9]{6,})\b/g;
000118: const ADDRESS_REGEX = /\b\d{1,5}\s+[A-Za-z0-9.,\-/\s]+(street|st\.|road|rd\.|avenue|ave\.|boulevard|blvd\.|suite|ste\.|floor|fl\.|building|lane|ln\.|drive|dr\.|block|tower)\b/i;
000119: const POSTAL_CODE_REGEX = /\b\d{4,6}(?:-\d{2,4})?\b/;
000120: const GOVERNMENT_KEYWORDS = ['government', 'ministry', 'department', 'authority', 'commission', 'secretary', 'republic', 'federal', 'state'];
000121: const MONTH_NAMES = [
000122:   'january', 'february', 'march', 'april', 'may', 'june',
000123:   'july', 'august', 'september', 'october', 'november', 'december',
000124: ];

000126: const sanitizeCountryLabel = (value = '') =>
000127:   value
000128:     .toLowerCase()
000129:     .replace(/[^a-z\s]/g, ' ')
000130:     .replace(/\s+/g, ' ')
000131:     .trim();
000132: 
000133: const COUNTRY_VARIANTS = Object.values(COUNTRIES).flatMap((country) => {
000134:   const variants = new Set();
000135:   [country.name, country.native, country.capital]
000136:     .filter(Boolean)
000137:     .forEach((label) => {
000138:       const normalized = sanitizeCountryLabel(label);
000139:       if (normalized.length >= 4) {
000140:         variants.add(normalized);
000141:       }
000142:     });
000143:   return Array.from(variants).map((keyword) => ({
000144:     country: country.name,
000145:     keyword,
000146:   }));
000147: });
000148: 
000149: const ensureFileExists = async (filePath) => {
000150:   if (!filePath) {
000151:     throw new Error('No file provided for verification.');
000152:   }
000153:   const resolved = path.resolve(filePath);
000154:   try {
000155:     await fs.access(resolved);
000156:   } catch {
000157:     throw new Error('Uploaded document is not available for verification.');
000158:   }
000159:   return resolved;
000160: };
000161: 
000162: const normalizeText = (text = '') =>
000163:   text
000164:     .replace(/\u0000/g, ' ')
000165:     .replace(/\s+/g, ' ')
000166:     .trim();
000167: 
000168: const parsePdfText = async (buffer) => {
000169:   try {
000170:     const parser = new PDFParse({ data: buffer });
000171:     const result = await parser.getText();
000172:     await parser.destroy();
000173:     const text = normalizeText(result?.text || '');
000174:     if (!text) {
000175:       throw new Error('We could not read any text from the PDF. Please upload a searchable document (not a scanned image).');
000176:     }
000177:     return text;
000178:   } catch (error) {
000179:     logger.warn('PDF parsing failed during moderation', { error: error.message });
000180:     throw new Error('We could not open your PDF. Please upload a standard PDF document.');
000181:   }
000182: };
000183: 
000184: const parseDocxText = async (resolvedPath) => {
000185:   try {
000186:     const result = await mammoth.extractRawText({ path: resolvedPath });
000187:     const text = normalizeText(result?.value || '');
000188:     if (!text) {
000189:       throw new Error('We could not read any text from the document. Please upload an editable DOCX or PDF file.');
000190:     }
000191:     return text;
000192:   } catch (error) {
000193:     logger.warn('DOCX parsing failed during moderation', { error: error.message });
000194:     throw new Error('We could not open your DOCX document. Please upload a valid DOCX or PDF file.');
000195:   }
000196: };
000197: 
000198: const parseDocText = async (resolvedPath) => {
000199:   try {
000200:     const extractor = new WordExtractor();
000201:     const doc = await extractor.extract(resolvedPath);
000202:     const text = normalizeText(doc?.getBody?.() || '');
000203:     if (!text) {
000204:       throw new Error('We could not read any text from the document. Please upload an editable Word or PDF file.');
000205:     }
000206:     return text;
000207:   } catch (error) {
000208:     logger.warn('DOC parsing failed during moderation', { error: error.message });
000209:     throw new Error('We could not open your .doc document. Please re-export it as DOCX or PDF and try again.');
000210:   }
000211: };
000212: 
000213: const detectDocumentType = (originalName = '', mimeType = '') => {
000214:   const normalizedName = originalName.toLowerCase();
000215:   const normalizedMime = mimeType.toLowerCase();
000216: 
000217:   if (normalizedMime === 'application/pdf' || normalizedName.endsWith('.pdf')) {
000218:     return 'pdf';
000219:   }
000220:   if (
000221:     normalizedMime === 'application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document'
000222:     || normalizedName.endsWith('.docx')
000223:   ) {
000224:     return 'docx';
000225:   }
000226:   if (normalizedMime === 'application/msword' || normalizedName.endsWith('.doc')) {
000227:     return 'doc';
000228:   }
000229:   return null;
000230: };
000231: 
000232: const extractDocumentText = async (resolvedPath, docType, buffer) => {
000233:   if (docType === 'pdf') {
000234:     return parsePdfText(buffer);
000235:   }
000236:   if (docType === 'docx') {
000237:     return parseDocxText(resolvedPath);
000238:   }
000239:   return parseDocText(resolvedPath);
000240: };
000241: 
000242: const ensureSupportedDocument = async (filePath, fileMeta = {}, unsupportedMessage) => {
000243:   const resolvedPath = await ensureFileExists(filePath);
000244:   const buffer = await fs.readFile(resolvedPath);
000245:   const hash = createHash('sha256').update(buffer).digest('hex');
000246:   const docType = detectDocumentType(fileMeta?.originalname || path.basename(resolvedPath), fileMeta?.mimetype || '');
000247: 
000248:   if (!docType) {
000249:     throw new Error(unsupportedMessage || 'Unsupported document format. Please upload a PDF or Word document.');
000250:   }
000251: 
000252:   const text = await extractDocumentText(resolvedPath, docType, buffer);
000253:   return { text, docType, hash, buffer };
000254: };
000255: 
000256: const analyzeResumeText = (text, context = {}) => {
000257:   const normalized = normalizeText(text);
000258:   if (!normalized) {
000259:     throw new Error('We could not extract readable text from your document. Please upload a searchable CV or resume.');
000260:   }
000261: 
000262:   const words = normalized.split(/\s+/);
000263:   const uniqueWords = new Set(words.map((word) => word.toLowerCase()));
000264: 
000265:   if (normalized.length < MIN_CHAR_COUNT || words.length < MIN_WORD_COUNT || uniqueWords.size < MIN_UNIQUE_WORDS) {
000266:     throw new Error('Document appears too short to be a complete CV or résumé. Please upload the full document.');
000267:   }
000268: 
000269:   const estimatedPages = Math.max(1, Math.round(words.length / WORDS_PER_PAGE_ESTIMATE) || 1);
000270:   if (estimatedPages < RESUME_MIN_ESTIMATED_PAGES || estimatedPages > RESUME_MAX_ESTIMATED_PAGES) {
000271:     throw new Error('CV must be between 1 and 6 pages. Please upload a standard résumé.');
000272:   }
000273: 
000274:   const lower = normalized.toLowerCase();
000275:   const matchedSections = SECTION_KEYWORDS.reduce(
000276:     (count, group) => (group.some((keyword) => lower.includes(keyword)) ? count + 1 : count),
000277:     0
000278:   );
000279: 
000280:   if (matchedSections < MIN_SECTION_MATCHES) {
000281:     throw new Error('We could not detect typical résumé sections. Please upload a complete CV or résumé.');
000282:   }
000283: 
000284:   const hasCoreSection = CORE_RESUME_SECTIONS.some((group) => group.some((keyword) => lower.includes(keyword)));
000285:   const hasSupportingSection = SUPPORTING_RESUME_SECTIONS.some((group) => group.some((keyword) => lower.includes(keyword)));
000286:   if (!hasCoreSection || !hasSupportingSection) {
000287:     throw new Error('Résumé must include a core section (Experience/Education) and a supporting section (Skills/Projects/etc.).');
000288:   }
000289: 
000290:   const hasContactInfo = EMAIL_REGEX.test(normalized) || PHONE_REGEX.test(normalized);
000291:   if (!hasContactInfo) {
000292:     throw new Error('Resume appears to be missing contact information (email or phone). Please double-check your document.');
000293:   }
000294: 
000295:   if (PLACEHOLDER_PATTERNS.some((pattern) => lower.includes(pattern))) {
000296:     throw new Error('Resume appears to contain placeholder text. Please upload the finalized document.');
000297:   }
000298: 
000299:   const nameMatch = calculateEntityNameMatch(lower, context.expectedFullName);
000300:   if (nameMatch.status === 'mismatch') {
000301:     throw new Error('We could not find your name inside the résumé. Please upload the correct document.');
000302:   }
000303: 
000304:   const emailCheck = ensureEmailConsistency(text, context.expectedEmail);
000305:   if (!emailCheck.isSatisfied) {
000306:     throw new Error(emailCheck.message);
000307:   }
000308: 
000309:   const languageResult = detectLanguageConfidence(normalized);
000310:   if (!languageResult.isValid) {
000311:     throw new Error(languageResult.message);
000312:   }
000313: 
000314:   return {
000315:     wordCount: words.length,
000316:     uniqueWordCount: uniqueWords.size,
000317:     matchedSections,
000318:     hasContactInfo,
000319:     estimatedPages,
000320:     nameMatchScore: nameMatch.score,
000321:     matchedNameTokens: nameMatch.matches,
000322:     detectedEmails: emailCheck.detectedEmails,
000323:     language: languageResult.language,
000324:     languageConfidence: languageResult.confidence,
000325:   };
000326: };
000327: 
000328: const analyzeBusinessDocumentText = (text, context = {}) => {
000329:   const normalized = normalizeText(text);
000330:   if (!normalized) {
000331:     throw new Error('We could not read any text from your document. Please upload the original PDF or Word file.');
000332:   }
000333: 
000334:   const words = normalized.split(/\s+/);
000335:   const uniqueWords = new Set(words.map((word) => word.toLowerCase()));
000336: 
000337:   if (
000338:     normalized.length < BUSINESS_MIN_CHAR_COUNT
000339:     || words.length < BUSINESS_MIN_WORD_COUNT
000340:     || uniqueWords.size < BUSINESS_MIN_UNIQUE_WORDS
000341:   ) {
000342:     throw new Error('Please upload the complete certificate or letter.');
000343:   }
000344: 
000345:   const lower = normalized.toLowerCase();
000346:   const matchedSections = BUSINESS_SECTION_KEYWORDS.reduce(
000347:     (count, group) => (group.some((keyword) => lower.includes(keyword)) ? count + 1 : count),
000348:     0
000349:   );
000350: 
000351:   if (matchedSections < BUSINESS_MIN_SECTION_MATCHES) {
000352:     throw new Error('We could not find typical business verification details (registration, tax, or authority references). Please upload an official document.');
000353:   }
000354: 
000355:   const authorityMentions = extractAuthorityMentions(text);
000356:   const registrationMentions = extractRegistrationMentions(text);
000357:   if (!authorityMentions.length && !registrationMentions.length) {
000358:     throw new Error('Document is missing an authority reference or registration number. Please upload an official certificate or license.');
000359:   }
000360: 
000361:   const addressMentions = extractAddressMentions(text);
000362:   const detectedCountries = detectCountriesInDocument(lower);
000363:   const expectedCountry = context.expectedCountry || null;
000364:   let countryMatchStatus = 'not_provided';
000365:   if (expectedCountry) {
000366:     if (detectedCountries.length === 0) {
000367:       countryMatchStatus = 'missing_in_document';
000368:     } else {
000369:       countryMatchStatus = detectedCountries.includes(expectedCountry) ? 'match' : 'mismatch';
000370:     }
000371:   }
000372: 
000373:   const mostRecentDate = determineMostRecentDate(text);
000374: 
000375:   const nameMatch = calculateEntityNameMatch(lower, context.expectedCompanyName);
000376: 
000377:   const limitedRegistrationMentions = registrationMentions.slice(0, MAX_REGISTERED_REG_NUMBERS);
000378:   const recencyStatus = !mostRecentDate
000379:     ? 'unknown'
000380:     : isOlderThanYears(mostRecentDate, MAX_DOC_AGE_YEARS)
000381:       ? 'stale'
000382:       : 'recent';
000383: 
000384:   return {
000385:     wordCount: words.length,
000386:     uniqueWordCount: uniqueWords.size,
000387:     matchedSections,
000388:     authorityMentions: authorityMentions.slice(0, 5),
000389:     registrationNumbers: limitedRegistrationMentions,
000390:     addressMentions: addressMentions.slice(0, 5),
000391:     detectedCountries,
000392:     expectedCountry,
000393:     countryMatchStatus,
000394:     companyNameScore: nameMatch.score,
000395:     companyNameMatches: nameMatch.matches,
000396:     mostRecentDate: mostRecentDate ? mostRecentDate.toISOString() : null,
000397:     recencyStatus,
000398:     expectedCompanyName: context.expectedCompanyName || null,
000399:   };
000400: };
000401: 
000402: export const validateResumeDocument = async (filePath, fileMeta = {}, context = {}) => {
000403:   const { text, docType, hash, buffer } = await ensureSupportedDocument(
000404:     filePath,
000405:     fileMeta,
000406:     'Unsupported resume format. Please upload a PDF or Word document.'
000407:   );
000408: 
000409:   const fileSizeBytes = fileMeta?.size ?? buffer?.length ?? 0;
000410:   if (fileSizeBytes && fileSizeBytes < RESUME_MIN_SIZE_BYTES) {
000411:     throw new Error('Résumé file appears empty. Please upload the complete document.');
000412:   }
000413:   if (fileSizeBytes && fileSizeBytes > RESUME_MAX_SIZE_BYTES) {
000414:     throw new Error('Résumé file is too large. Please keep it under 50 MB.');
000415:   }
000416: 
000417:   const resolvedContext = {
000418:     expectedFullName: context.expectedFullName?.trim() || null,
000419:     expectedEmail: context.expectedEmail?.trim() || null,
000420:   };
000421: 
000422:   const analysis = analyzeResumeText(text, resolvedContext);
000423:   analysis.documentHash = hash;
000424:   analysis.docType = docType;
000425:   analysis.fileSizeBytes = fileSizeBytes;
000426: 
000427:   const llmSummary = buildResumeLLMSummary(analysis, resolvedContext);
000428:   try {
000429:     const llmVerdict = await LLMService.verifyResumeDocument({
000430:       documentText: text.slice(0, 8000),
000431:       summary: llmSummary,
000432:       expectedName: resolvedContext.expectedFullName || 'Candidate',
000433:     });
000434:     if (llmVerdict) {
000435:       analysis.llmVerdict = llmVerdict;
000436:       const confidence = typeof llmVerdict.confidence === 'number' ? llmVerdict.confidence : 0;
000437:       if (!llmVerdict.isOfficial || confidence < 0.65) {
000438:         throw new Error(llmVerdict.message || 'We could not confirm this is a valid résumé. Please upload another file.');
000439:       }
000440:     }
000441:   } catch (error) {
000442:     if (error.message?.includes('valid résumé')) {
000443:       throw error;
000444:     }
000445:     logger.warn('LLM resume verification unavailable, continuing with heuristic result.', { error: error.message });
000446:   }
000447: 
000448:   logger.info('Resume validation succeeded', {
000449:     type: docType,
000450:     wordCount: analysis.wordCount,
000451:     matchedSections: analysis.matchedSections,
000452:   });
000453: 
000454:   return {
000455:     hash,
000456:     docType,
000457:     analysis,
000458:   };
000459: };
000460:

000513: const resolveCountryContext = (countryInput, countryCode) => {
000514:   if (countryCode) {
000515:     const entry = COUNTRIES[countryCode.toUpperCase()];
000516:     if (entry?.name) {
000517:       return entry.name;
000518:     }
000519:   }
000520:   if (!countryInput) return null;
000521:   const normalized = sanitizeCountryLabel(countryInput);
000522:   if (!normalized) return null;
000523:   const directMatch = COUNTRY_VARIANTS.find((variant) => normalized.includes(variant.keyword));
000524:   if (directMatch) return directMatch.country;
000525:   const parts = normalized.split(' ');
000526:   return parts.length ? parts[parts.length - 1].replace(/\b(state|province)\b/g, '').trim() || null : null;
000527: };
000528: 
000529: const detectCountriesInDocument = (textLower) => {
000530:   const matches = new Set();
000531:   for (const variant of COUNTRY_VARIANTS) {
000532:     if (textLower.includes(variant.keyword)) {
000533:       matches.add(variant.country);
000534:     }
000535:   }
000536:   return Array.from(matches);
000537: };
000538: 
000539: const extractAuthorityMentions = (text) => {
000540:   const lines = text.split(/\n+/);
000541:   return lines
000542:     .filter((line) => {
000543:       const lower = line.toLowerCase();
000544:       return GOVERNMENT_KEYWORDS.some((keyword) => lower.includes(keyword));
000545:     })
000546:     .map((line) => line.trim())
000547:     .filter(Boolean);
000548: };
000549: 
000550: const extractAddressMentions = (text) => {
000551:   const matches = [];
000552:   const lines = text.split(/\n+/);
000553:   lines.forEach((line) => {
000554:     if (ADDRESS_REGEX.test(line) || POSTAL_CODE_REGEX.test(line)) {
000555:       matches.push(line.trim());
000556:     }
000557:   });
000558:   return matches;
000559: };
000560: 
000561: const extractRegistrationMentions = (text) => {
000562:   const mentions = [];
000563:   const lines = text.split(/\n+/);
000564:   lines.forEach((line) => {
000565:     const lower = line.toLowerCase();
000566:     if (REGISTRATION_CONTEXT_KEYWORDS.some((keyword) => lower.includes(keyword))) {
000567:       const numbers = Array.from(
000568:         new Set(Array.from(line.matchAll(REGISTRATION_NUMBER_REGEX), (match) => match[1] || match[0]))
000569:       );
000570:       numbers.forEach((number) => {
000571:         mentions.push({
000572:           number,
000573:           context: line.trim().slice(0, 160),
000574:         });
000575:       });
000576:     }
000577:   });
000578:   return mentions;
000579: };
000580: 
000581: const ensureEmailConsistency = (text, expectedEmail) => {
000582:   const detectedEmails = Array.from(text.match(EMAIL_REGEX_GLOBAL) || []).map((email) => email.toLowerCase());
000583:   if (!detectedEmails.length) {
000584:     return {
000585:       isSatisfied: false,
000586:       detectedEmails: [],
000587:       message: 'Résumé must include a contact email address.',
000588:     };
000589:   }
000590: 
000591:   if (!expectedEmail) {
000592:     return { isSatisfied: true, detectedEmails };
000593:   }
000594: 
000595:   const normalizedExpected = expectedEmail.toLowerCase();
000596:   const expectedDomain = normalizedExpected.split('@')[1] || '';
000597:   if (detectedEmails.includes(normalizedExpected)) {
000598:     return { isSatisfied: true, detectedEmails };
000599:   }
000600:   if (expectedDomain && detectedEmails.some((email) => email.endsWith(`@${expectedDomain}`))) {
000601:     return { isSatisfied: true, detectedEmails };
000602:   }
000603: 
000604:   return {
000605:     isSatisfied: false,

000664:

000666:   if (!tokens.length) {

000668:   }
000669:

000671:   const score = matches.length / tokens.length;

000692: const determineMostRecentDate = (text) => {
000693:   const candidates = extractDateCandidates(text);
000694:   if (!candidates.length) return null;
000695:   return candidates.reduce((latest, current) => (current > latest ? current : latest), candidates[0]);

000697: 
000698: const extractDateCandidates = (text) => {
000699:   const normalized = text.replace(/(\d)(st|nd|rd|th)/gi, '$1');
000700:   const dates = [];
000701: 
000702:   const numericMatch = /\b(\d{1,2})[\/\-](\d{1,2})[\/\-](\d{2,4})\b/g;
000703:   let match;
000704:   while ((match = numericMatch.exec(normalized)) !== null) {
000705:     const [month, day, year] = normalizeDateParts(match[1], match[2], match[3]);
000706:     if (year >= 1980) {
000707:       const candidate = new Date(year, month - 1, day);
000708:       if (!Number.isNaN(candidate.getTime())) dates.push(candidate);
000709:     }
000710:   }
000711: 
000712:   const isoMatch = /\b(\d{4})[\/\-](\d{1,2})[\/\-](\d{1,2})\b/g;
000713:   while ((match = isoMatch.exec(normalized)) !== null) {
000714:     const year = Number(match[1]);
000715:     const month = Number(match[2]);
000716:     const day = Number(match[3]);
000717:     if (year >= 1980) {
000718:       const candidate = new Date(year, month - 1, day);
000719:       if (!Number.isNaN(candidate.getTime())) dates.push(candidate);
000720:     }
000721:   }
000722: 
000723:   const monthNameRegex = new RegExp(`\\b(${MONTH_NAMES.join('|')})\\s+\\d{1,2},?\\s+\\d{4}\\b`, 'gi');
000724:   let monthMatch;
000725:   while ((monthMatch = monthNameRegex.exec(normalized)) !== null) {
000726:     const candidate = new Date(monthMatch[0]);
000727:     if (!Number.isNaN(candidate.getTime()) && candidate.getFullYear() >= 1980) {
000728:       dates.push(candidate);
000729:     }
000730:   }
000731: 
000732:   const invertedMonthRegex = new RegExp(`\\b\\d{1,2}\\s+(${MONTH_NAMES.join('|')})\\s+\\d{4}\\b`, 'gi');
000733:   while ((monthMatch = invertedMonthRegex.exec(normalized)) !== null) {
000734:     const candidate = new Date(monthMatch[0]);
000735:     if (!Number.isNaN(candidate.getTime()) && candidate.getFullYear() >= 1980) {
000736:       dates.push(candidate);
000737:     }
000738:   }
000739: 
000740:   return dates;
000741: };
000742: 
000743: const normalizeDateParts = (part1, part2, part3) => {
000744:   const first = Number(part1);
000745:   const second = Number(part2);
000746:   const third = Number(part3);
000747:   if (third < 100) {
000748:     const year = third + 2000;
000749:     return [first, second, year];
000750:   }
000751:   return [first, second, third];
000752: };

000754: const isOlderThanYears = (date, years) => {
000755:   const cutoff = new Date();
000756:   cutoff.setFullYear(cutoff.getFullYear() - years);
000757:   return date < cutoff;
000758: };
```

```text
000375:   }
000376:   @keyframes shimmer {
000377:     0% { background-position: 0% 50%; }
000378:     100% { background-position: 200% 50%; }
000379:   }
000380:   @keyframes popIn {
000381:     0% { opacity: 0; transform: scale(0.94); }
000382:     100% { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1); }
000383:   }
000384:   @media only screen and (max-width: 600px) {
000385:     body { padding: 12px 8px; }
000386:     .header, .content { padding-left: 20px; padding-right: 20px; }
000387:     .footer { padding-left: 20px; padding-right: 20px; }
000388:     .header h1 { font-size: 20px; }
000389:     .detail-item strong { min-width: 100px; }
000390:     .code-box { font-size: 20px; letter-spacing: 4px; }
000391:   }
000392:   @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
000393:     * { animation: none !important; transition: none !important; }
000394:   }
000395: `.trim();

000397: /**
000398:  * Render email HTML layout
000399:  * @param {Object} options
000400:  * @param {string} options.title - Email title
000401:  * @param {string} options.bodyHtml - Main content HTML
000402:  * @param {string} [options.footerHtml] - Footer HTML
000403:  * @param {string} [options.extraCss] - Additional CSS
000404:  * @param {string} [options.logoUrl] - Logo URL (can be cid:logo for inline attachment)
000405:  * @param {boolean} [options.useLogo=true] - Whether to show logo
000406:  */
000407: const renderEmailLayout = ({
000408:   title,
000409:   bodyHtml,
000410:   footerHtml = DEFAULT_FOOTER_HTML,
000411:   extraCss = '',
000412:   logoUrl = null,
000413:   useLogo = true,
000414: } = {}) => {
000415:   const styles = [BASE_EMAIL_STYLES, extraCss].filter(Boolean).join('\n');
000416:   const content = (bodyHtml || '').trim();
000417:   const footer = (footerHtml || DEFAULT_FOOTER_HTML).trim();
000418:   const headerTitle = title || 'InterviewAI Pro';
000419:   const preheaderText = `${headerTitle} | InterviewAI Pro`;
000420:   
000421:   // Determine logo HTML based on what's provided
000422:   let logoHtml;
000423:   if (!useLogo) {
000424:     logoHtml = '';
000425:   } else if (logoUrl) {
000426:     // Use provided logo URL (CID reference or external URL)
000427:     // Logo with text - larger size for better visibility
000428:     logoHtml = `<img src="${logoUrl}" alt="InterviewAI Pro" width="280" height="auto" style="max-width:280px;width:280px;height:auto;margin:24px auto 24px;display:block;object-fit:contain;" />`;
000429:   } else {
000430:     // Fallback to CSS-based logo
000431:     logoHtml = `<div class="logo-icon" style="width:52px;height:52px;margin:0 auto 14px;border-radius:999px;background:linear-gradient(135deg, #2563eb 0%, #7c3aed 100%);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;box-shadow:0 8px 16px rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.25);">
000432:       <span style="color:#ffffff;font-size:20px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:0.5px;">IP</span>
000433:     </div>`;
000434:   }
000435: 
000436:   return `
000437: <!DOCTYPE html>
000438: <html>
000439: <head>
000440:   <meta charset="UTF-8">
000441:   <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
000442:   <style>
000443: ${styles}
000444:   </style>
000445: </head>
000446: <body>
000447:   <span class="preheader">${preheaderText}</span>
000448:   <div class="email-wrapper">
000449:     <div class="container">
000450:       <div class="accent-bar"></div>
000451:       <div class="header">
000452:         ${logoHtml}
000453:         <h1>${headerTitle}</h1>
000454:       </div>
000455:       <div class="content">
000456:         ${content}
000457:       </div>
000458:       <div class="footer">
000459:         ${footer}
000460:       </div>
000461:     </div>
000462:   </div>
000463: </body>
000464: </html>
000465:   `.trim();
000466: };

000891: /**
000892:  * Send email via Gmail SMTP
000893:  * @param {Object} options - Email options
000894:  * @param {string} options.to - Recipient email
000895:  * @param {string} options.subject - Email subject
000896:  * @param {string} options.text - Plain text content (IMPORTANT for deliverability)
000897:  * @param {string} options.html - HTML content
000898:  * @param {string} [options.replyTo] - Reply-to email
000899:  * @param {string} [options.category] - Backward-compatible field (ignored)
000900:  */
000901: async function sendEmail({ to, subject, text, html, replyTo, category }) {
000902:   if (!to || !to.trim()) {
000903:     throw new Error('Email recipient (to) is required');
000904:   }
000905:   if (!subject || !subject.trim()) {
000906:     throw new Error('Email subject is required');
000907:   }
000908:   // Keep category in the signature for backward compatibility with existing callers.
000909:   void category;
000910:   // Warn if no plain text version (critical for deliverability)
000911:   if (!text || !text.trim()) {
000912:     logger.warn('Email missing plain text version. This can hurt deliverability.');
000913:   }
000914:   try {
000915:     logger.info(`Sending email to ${to}: ${subject}`);
000916:     return await sendWithSMTP({ to, subject, text, html, replyTo });
000917:   } catch (error) {
000918:     logger.error('Failed to send email:', error);
000919:     throw error;
000920:   }
000921: }
000922: 
000923: /**
000924:  * Gmail SMTP implementation (Nodemailer)
000925:  *
000926:  * Gmail setup:
000927:  * 1. Enable 2-factor authentication on your Google account.
000928:  * 2. Generate App Password: https://myaccount.google.com/apppasswords
000929:  * 3. Configure SMTP_HOST=smtp.gmail.com, SMTP_PORT=587, SMTP_USER, SMTP_PASS.
000930:  */
000931: async function sendWithSMTP({ to, subject, text, html, replyTo }) {
000932:   const smtpHost = process.env.SMTP_HOST || 'smtp.gmail.com';
000933:   const smtpPort = parseInt(process.env.SMTP_PORT || '587', 10);
000934:   const smtpUser = process.env.SMTP_USER;
000935:   const smtpPass = process.env.SMTP_PASS;
000936:   const smtpSecure = process.env.SMTP_SECURE === 'true';
000937: 
000938:   if (!smtpHost || !smtpUser || !smtpPass) {

000940:   }
000941:   if (!smtpHost.toLowerCase().includes('gmail.com')) {
000942:     throw new Error(`Unsupported SMTP_HOST "${smtpHost}". This system is configured for Gmail SMTP only.`);

000945:   try {
000946:     const transporter = nodemailer.createTransport({
000947:       host: smtpHost,

000950:       auth: {

000953:       },

000960:     // Verify connection

000963:     // Get logo attachment for inline embedding

000966:     // Replace CSS logo placeholder with CID reference if logo is available
000967:     let processedHtml = html;
000968:     if (logoAttachment) {
000969:       // The CID reference format for Nodemailer: cid:contentId
000970:       const cidReference = `cid:${logoAttachment.cid}`;
000971:       
000972:       // Replace the CSS-based logo div with an img tag using CID
000973:       // This regex matches the CSS logo div we generate
000974:       const cssLogoPattern = /<div class="logo-icon"[^>]*>[\s\S]*?<\/div>/gi;
000975:       // Logo with text - larger size for better visibility with spacing above and below
000976:       const imgTag = `<img src="${cidReference}" alt="InterviewAI Pro" width="280" height="auto" style="max-width:280px;width:280px;height:auto;margin:24px auto 24px;display:block;object-fit:contain;" />`;

000978:       const beforeReplace = processedHtml.includes('logo-icon');

000980:       const afterReplace = processedHtml.includes('logo-icon');

000982:       logger.info('📎 Logo attachment prepared for SMTP', {
000983:         cid: logoAttachment.cid,

000986:         contentType: logoAttachment.contentType,
000987:         contentSize: logoAttachment.content.length,
000988:         hadCssLogo: beforeReplace,

000990:       });
000991:     } else {

000993:     }

000995:     const mailOptions = {
000996:       from: {
000997:         name: FROM_NAME,
000998:         address: FROM_EMAIL,
000999:       },
001000:       to,
001001:       subject,
001002:       text,
001003:       html: processedHtml,
001004:     };
001005:     
001006:     if (replyTo) {

001008:     }
001009:     
001010:     // Add logo as inline attachment
001011:     if (logoAttachment) {
001012:       mailOptions.attachments = [logoAttachment];
001013:     }
001014: 
001015:     const result = await transporter.sendMail(mailOptions);
001016:     logger.info(`Email sent via SMTP to ${to}: ${result.messageId}`);
001017:     return { success: true, messageId: result.messageId };
001018:   } catch (error) {
001019:     logger.error('SMTP error:', error);
```

```text
000284:     const map = new Map();
000285:     docs.forEach((doc) => {
000286:       if (doc.exists) {

000288:       }
000289:     });

000293:   async hasAccountType(accountType) {
000294:     if (!accountType) return false;
000295:     const normalizedType = accountType.toString().toUpperCase();
000296:     try {
000297:       const snapshot = await usersCollection
000298:         .where('accountType', '==', normalizedType)
000299:         .limit(1)
000300:         .get();
000301:       return !snapshot.empty;
000302:     } catch (error) {
000303:       if (!isIndexBuildingError(error)) {
000304:         throw error;
000305:       }
000306:       logger.warn('User accountType index still building; falling back to in-memory scan.');
000307:       const snapshot = await usersCollection.get();
000308:       return snapshot.docs.some((doc) => {
000309:         const user = docToData(doc);
000310:         return (user?.accountType || '').toString().toUpperCase() === normalizedType;
000311:       });
000312:     }
000313:   },
000314: 
000315:   async list(options = {}) {
000316:     const {
000317:       accountType = null,
000318:       accountStatus = null,
000319:       query = '',
000320:       limit = 100,
000321:       offset = 0,
000322:     } = options;
000323: 
000324:     const normalizedLimit = Math.max(1, Math.min(Number.parseInt(limit, 10) || 100, 500));
000325:     const normalizedOffset = Math.max(0, Number.parseInt(offset, 10) || 0);
000326:     const normalizedType = accountType ? accountType.toString().toUpperCase() : null;
000327:     const normalizedStatus = accountStatus ? accountStatus.toString().toUpperCase() : null;
000328:     const normalizedQuery = (query || '').toString().trim().toLowerCase();
000329: 
000330:     const applyFilters = (users = []) =>
000331:       users.filter((user) => {
000332:         if (normalizedType && (user.accountType || '').toString().toUpperCase() !== normalizedType) {
000333:           return false;
000334:         }
000335:         if (normalizedStatus) {
000336:           const userStatus = (user.accountStatus || 'ACTIVE').toString().toUpperCase();
000337:           if (userStatus !== normalizedStatus) return false;
000338:         }
000339:         if (!normalizedQuery) return true;
000340:         const email = (user.email || '').toString().toLowerCase();
000341:         const fullName = (user.fullName || '').toString().toLowerCase();
000342:         const companyName = (user.companyName || '').toString().toLowerCase();
000343:         return (
000344:           email.includes(normalizedQuery)
000345:           || fullName.includes(normalizedQuery)
000346:           || companyName.includes(normalizedQuery)
000347:           || (user.id || '').toString().toLowerCase().includes(normalizedQuery)
000348:         );
000349:       });
000350: 
000351:     try {
000352:       let firestoreQuery = usersCollection.orderBy('createdAt', 'desc');
000353:       if (normalizedType) {
000354:         firestoreQuery = firestoreQuery.where('accountType', '==', normalizedType);
000355:       }
000356: 
000357:       // When search/status filters are present we still fetch a bounded window and refine in-memory.
000358:       const fetchLimit = normalizedQuery || normalizedStatus
000359:         ? Math.min(normalizedLimit + normalizedOffset + 300, 500)
000360:         : normalizedLimit;
000361: 
000362:       const snapshot = await firestoreQuery
000363:         .limit(fetchLimit)
000364:         .offset(normalizedQuery || normalizedStatus ? 0 : normalizedOffset)
000365:         .get();
000366: 
000367:       const all = snapshot.docs.map((doc) => docToData(doc));
000368:       const filtered = applyFilters(all);
000369:       const paged = normalizedQuery || normalizedStatus
000370:         ? filtered.slice(normalizedOffset, normalizedOffset + normalizedLimit)
000371:         : filtered;
000372: 
000373:       return {
000374:         users: paged,
000375:         total: filtered.length,
000376:       };
000377:     } catch (error) {
000378:       if (!isIndexBuildingError(error)) {
000379:         throw error;
000380:       }
000381:       logger.warn('User listing index still building; falling back to in-memory sort/filter.');
000382:       const snapshot = await usersCollection.get();
000383:       const allUsers = snapshot.docs
000384:         .map((doc) => docToData(doc))
000385:         .sort((a, b) => toMillis(b?.createdAt) - toMillis(a?.createdAt));
000386:       const filtered = applyFilters(allUsers);
000387:       return {
000388:         users: filtered.slice(normalizedOffset, normalizedOffset + normalizedLimit),
000389:         total: filtered.length,
000390:       };
000391:     }
000392:   },
000393: };

000719: const REALTIME_FEED_EXCLUDED_EVENTS = new Set(['pose-data']);
```
