```text
000721: const getInterviewParticipantIds = (interview = {}) =>
000722:   Array.from(new Set([interview?.candidateId, interview?.companyId].filter(Boolean)));
000723: 
000724: const toParticipantMap = (participantIds = []) =>
000725:   participantIds.reduce((acc, participantId) => {
000726:     acc[participantId] = true;
000727:     return acc;
000728:   }, {});
000729: 
000730: async function resolveRealtimeParticipantIds(interviewId) {
000731:   if (!realtimeDb || !interviewId) return [];
000732: 
000733:   try {
000734:     const participantsSnapshot = await realtimeDb.ref(`sessions/${interviewId}/participants`).once('value');
000735:     const participantMap = participantsSnapshot.val() || {};
000736:     const participantIds = Object.keys(participantMap).filter((participantId) => participantMap[participantId] === true);
000737:     if (participantIds.length > 0) {
000738:       return participantIds;
000739:     }
000740:   } catch (error) {
000741:     logger.warn(`Failed to resolve realtime participants for interview ${interviewId} from RTDB:`, error);
000742:   }
000743: 
000744:   const interview = await interviewStore.getById(interviewId);
000745:   if (!interview) return [];
000746: 
000747:   await syncRealtimeInterviewSession(interview);
000748:   return getInterviewParticipantIds(interview);
000749: }
000750: 
000751: export async function syncRealtimeInterviewSession(interview = {}) {
000752:   if (!realtimeDb || !interview?.id) return;
000753: 
000754:   const participantIds = getInterviewParticipantIds(interview);
000755:   const participantMap = toParticipantMap(participantIds);
000756:   const timestamp = now();
000757:   const syncEventId = randomUUID();
000758:   const sessionRef = realtimeDb.ref(`sessions/${interview.id}`);
000759: 
000760:   try {
000761:     await sessionRef.child('participants').set(participantMap);
000762:     await sessionRef.child('meta').update({
000763:       interviewId: interview.id,
000764:       candidateId: interview.candidateId || null,
000765:       companyId: interview.companyId || null,
000766:       status: interview.status || 'SCHEDULED',
000767:       pipelineStatus: interview.pipelineStatus || null,
000768:       jobStage: interview.jobStage || null,
000769:       overallScore: interview.overallScore ?? null,
000770:       readinessLevel: interview.readinessLevel ?? null,
000771:       updatedAt: timestamp,
000772:     });
000773: 
000774:     if (participantIds.length > 0) {
000775:       const feedUpdates = {};
000776:       participantIds.forEach((participantId) => {
000777:         const feedBasePath = `userInterviewFeeds/${participantId}/${interview.id}`;
000778:         feedUpdates[`${feedBasePath}/interviewId`] = interview.id;
000779:         feedUpdates[`${feedBasePath}/status`] = interview.status || 'SCHEDULED';
000780:         feedUpdates[`${feedBasePath}/pipelineStatus`] = interview.pipelineStatus || null;
000781:         feedUpdates[`${feedBasePath}/jobStage`] = interview.jobStage || null;
000782:         feedUpdates[`${feedBasePath}/overallScore`] = interview.overallScore ?? null;
000783:         feedUpdates[`${feedBasePath}/readinessLevel`] = interview.readinessLevel ?? null;
000784:         feedUpdates[`${feedBasePath}/lastEventId`] = syncEventId;
000785:         feedUpdates[`${feedBasePath}/lastEventType`] = 'session-synced';
000786:         feedUpdates[`${feedBasePath}/lastEventAt`] = interview.updatedAt || interview.createdAt || timestamp;
000787:         feedUpdates[`${feedBasePath}/updatedAt`] = timestamp;
000788:       });
000789: 
000790:       await realtimeDb.ref().update(feedUpdates);
000791:     }
000792:   } catch (error) {
000793:     logger.error(`Failed to sync realtime interview session for interview ${interview.id}:`, error);
000794:   }
000795: }
000796: 
000797: export async function recordRealtimeEvent(interviewId, eventType, payload = {}) {
000798:   if (!realtimeDb || !interviewId) return;
000799: 
000800:   const eventId = randomUUID();
000801:   const timestamp = now();
000802:   const event = {
000803:     eventId,
000804:     eventType,
000805:     payload,
000806:     timestamp,
000807:   };
000808: 
000809:   try {
000810:     const sessionRef = realtimeDb.ref(`sessions/${interviewId}`);
000811:     const eventsRef = sessionRef.child('events').push();
000812:     await eventsRef.set(event);
000813:     await sessionRef.child('lastEvent').set(event);
000814: 
000815:     const metaUpdates = {
000816:       lastEventType: eventType,
000817:       lastEventAt: timestamp,
000818:       updatedAt: timestamp,
000819:     };
000820: 
000821:     if (typeof payload?.status === 'string' && payload.status.trim()) {
000822:       metaUpdates.status = payload.status.trim();
000823:     }
000824:     if (payload?.overallScore !== undefined) {
000825:       metaUpdates.overallScore = payload.overallScore;
000826:     }
000827:     if (payload?.readinessLevel !== undefined) {
000828:       metaUpdates.readinessLevel = payload.readinessLevel;
000829:     }
000830: 
000831:     await sessionRef.child('meta').update(metaUpdates);
000832: 
000833:     if (eventType === 'participant-connected' || eventType === 'participant-disconnected') {
000834:       const actorId = typeof payload?.actor === 'string' ? payload.actor.trim() : '';
000835:       if (actorId) {
000836:         await sessionRef.child(`presence/${actorId}`).update({
000837:           connected: eventType === 'participant-connected',
000838:           role: payload?.role || null,
000839:           socketId: payload?.socketId || null,
000840:           updatedAt: timestamp,
000841:         });
000842:       }
000843:     }
000844: 
000845:     if (!REALTIME_FEED_EXCLUDED_EVENTS.has(eventType)) {
000846:       const participantIds = await resolveRealtimeParticipantIds(interviewId);
000847:       if (participantIds.length > 0) {
000848:         const feedUpdates = {};
000849:         participantIds.forEach((participantId) => {
000850:           const feedBasePath = `userInterviewFeeds/${participantId}/${interviewId}`;
000851:           feedUpdates[`${feedBasePath}/interviewId`] = interviewId;
000852:           feedUpdates[`${feedBasePath}/lastEventId`] = eventId;
000853:           feedUpdates[`${feedBasePath}/lastEventType`] = eventType;
000854:           feedUpdates[`${feedBasePath}/lastEventAt`] = timestamp;
000855:           feedUpdates[`${feedBasePath}/updatedAt`] = timestamp;
000856: 
000857:           if (typeof payload?.status === 'string' && payload.status.trim()) {
000858:             feedUpdates[`${feedBasePath}/status`] = payload.status.trim();
000859:           }
000860:           if (payload?.overallScore !== undefined) {
000861:             feedUpdates[`${feedBasePath}/overallScore`] = payload.overallScore;
000862:           }
000863:           if (payload?.readinessLevel !== undefined) {
000864:             feedUpdates[`${feedBasePath}/readinessLevel`] = payload.readinessLevel;
000865:           }
000866:           if (typeof payload?.questionId === 'string' && payload.questionId.trim()) {
000867:             feedUpdates[`${feedBasePath}/lastQuestionId`] = payload.questionId.trim();
000868:           }
000869:         });
000870: 
000871:         await realtimeDb.ref().update(feedUpdates);
000872:       }
000873:     }
000874:   } catch (error) {
000875:     logger.error('Failed to record realtime event:', error);
000876:   }
000877: }

000897: const buildRealtimeFeedPayload = (eventType, payload = {}, timestamp = now()) => ({
000898:   lastEventId: randomUUID(),
000899:   lastEventType: eventType || 'updated',
000900:   lastEventAt: timestamp,
000901:   updatedAt: timestamp,
000902:   payload: payload && typeof payload === 'object' ? payload : {},
000903: });

000905: const writeRealtimeFeed = async (feedPath, eventType, payload = {}) => {
000906:   if (!realtimeDb || !feedPath) return null;
000907: 
000908:   const timestamp = now();
000909:   const feedPayload = buildRealtimeFeedPayload(eventType, payload, timestamp);
000910: 
000911:   try {
000912:     await realtimeDb.ref(feedPath).update(feedPayload);
000913:     return feedPayload;
000914:   } catch (error) {
000915:     logger.error(`Failed to write realtime feed at "${feedPath}":`, error);
000916:     return null;
000917:   }
000918: };

000963: export async function hydrateInterviewParticipants(interviews = []) {
000964:   if (!interviews.length) return interviews;
000965: 
000966:   const participantIds = new Set();
000967:   interviews.forEach((interview) => {
000968:     if (interview?.candidateId) participantIds.add(interview.candidateId);
000969:     if (interview?.companyId) participantIds.add(interview.companyId);
000970:   });
000971: 
000972:   const summaries = await userStore.getSummaries(Array.from(participantIds));
000973: 
000974:   return interviews.map((interview) => ({
000975:     ...interview,
000976:     candidate: interview.candidateId ? summaries.get(interview.candidateId) || null : null,
000977:     company: interview.companyId ? summaries.get(interview.companyId) || null : null,
000978:   }));
000979: }

000990:     const completed = interviews.filter((i) => i.status === 'COMPLETED');

000999:   async getCompanyMetrics(companyId) {

001001:     const completed = interviews.filter((i) => i.status === 'COMPLETED');
001002:     const averageScore =
001003:       completed.length > 0
001004:         ? completed.reduce((sum, interview) => sum + (interview.overallScore || 0), 0) / completed.length
001005:         : 0;
001006: 
001007:     return {

001015:   /**
001016:    * Get dashboard metrics with historical comparison data (week-over-week)
001017:    * @param {string} organizationId - The organization ID
001018:    * @returns {Object} Metrics with change indicators
001019:    */
001020:   async getDashboardMetricsWithComparison(organizationId) {
001021:     try {
001022:       // Get current metrics
001023:       const currentMetrics = await this.getCurrentOrganizationMetrics(organizationId);
001024:       
001025:       // Get snapshot from 7 days ago for comparison
001026:       const oneWeekAgo = new Date();
001027:       oneWeekAgo.setDate(oneWeekAgo.getDate() - 7);
001028:       const previousMetrics = await this.getSnapshotNearDate(organizationId, oneWeekAgo);
001029: 
001030:       // Calculate changes
001031:       const calculateChange = (current, previous, suffix = '', isInterviews = false) => {
001032:         if (previous === null || previous === undefined) {
001033:           return { value: current, changeText: 'New', changeType: 'neutral' };
001034:         }
001035:         const diff = current - previous;
001036:         if (diff === 0) {
001037:           return { value: current, changeText: 'No change', changeType: 'neutral' };
001038:         }
001039:         if (isInterviews) {
001040:           // For interviews, use "X more than last week" or "X fewer than last week"
001041:           const absDiff = Math.abs(diff);
001042:           const direction = diff > 0 ? 'more' : 'fewer';
001043:           return {
001044:             value: current,
001045:             changeText: `${absDiff} ${direction} than last week`,
001046:             changeType: diff > 0 ? 'positive' : 'negative',
001047:           };
001048:         }
001049:         const sign = diff > 0 ? '+' : '';
001050:         return {
001051:           value: current,
001052:           changeText: `${sign}${diff}${suffix} this week`,
001053:           changeType: diff > 0 ? 'positive' : 'negative',
001054:         };
001055:       };
001056: 
001057:       // Special handling for pending reviews (lower is better)
001058:       const calculatePendingChange = (current, previous) => {
001059:         if (previous === null || previous === undefined) {
001060:           return { 
001061:             value: current, 
001062:             changeText: current > 0 ? `${current} pending` : 'All caught up', 
001063:             changeType: current > 0 ? 'urgent' : 'positive' 
001064:           };
001065:         }
001066:         const diff = current - previous;
001067:         if (diff === 0) {
001068:           return { 
001069:             value: current, 
001070:             changeText: current > 0 ? `${current} pending` : 'All caught up', 
001071:             changeType: current > 0 ? 'urgent' : 'positive' 
001072:           };
001073:         }
001074:         const sign = diff > 0 ? '+' : '';
001075:         return {
001076:           value: current,
001077:           changeText: `${sign}${diff} pending`,
001078:           changeType: diff > 0 ? 'urgent' : 'positive', // More pending = urgent, less = positive
001079:         };
001080:       };
001081: 
001082:       return {
001083:         activeJobPostings: calculateChange(
001084:           currentMetrics.activeJobPostings,
001085:           previousMetrics?.activeJobPostings
001086:         ),
001087:         pendingReviews: calculatePendingChange(
001088:           currentMetrics.pendingReviews,
001089:           previousMetrics?.pendingReviews
001090:         ),
001091:         upcomingInterviews: calculateChange(
001092:           currentMetrics.upcomingInterviews,
001093:           previousMetrics?.upcomingInterviews,
001094:           '',
001095:           true // Mark as interviews to use "more/fewer than last week" format
001096:         ),
001097:         // Additional metrics
001098:         totalInterviews: currentMetrics.totalInterviews,
001099:         completedInterviews: currentMetrics.completedInterviews,
001100:         averageScore: currentMetrics.averageScore,
001101:         totalCandidates: currentMetrics.totalCandidates,
001102:         hiredCount: currentMetrics.hiredCount,
001103:         snapshotDate: currentMetrics.snapshotDate,
001104:       };
001105:     } catch (error) {
001106:       logger.error('getDashboardMetricsWithComparison error:', error);
001107:       // Return basic metrics without comparison on error
001108:       const current = await this.getCurrentOrganizationMetrics(organizationId);
001109:       return {
001110:         activeJobPostings: { value: current.activeJobPostings, changeText: '', changeType: 'neutral' },
001111:         pendingReviews: { value: current.pendingReviews, changeText: current.pendingReviews > 0 ? `${current.pendingReviews} pending` : 'All caught up', changeType: current.pendingReviews > 0 ? 'urgent' : 'positive' },
001112:         upcomingInterviews: { value: current.upcomingInterviews, changeText: '', changeType: 'neutral' },
001113:         totalInterviews: current.totalInterviews,
001114:         completedInterviews: current.completedInterviews,
001115:         averageScore: current.averageScore,
001116:         totalCandidates: current.totalCandidates,
001117:         hiredCount: current.hiredCount,
001118:         snapshotDate: current.snapshotDate,
001119:       };
001120:     }
001121:   },
001122: 
001123:   /**
001124:    * Get current organization metrics (live data)
001125:    * @param {string} organizationId - The organization ID
001126:    * @returns {Object} Current metrics
001127:    */
001128:   async getCurrentOrganizationMetrics(organizationId) {
001129:     // Get all jobs for the organization
001130:     const jobsSnapshot = await jobsCollection
001131:       .where('organizationId', '==', organizationId)
001132:       .get();
001133:     const jobs = jobsSnapshot.docs.map(docToData);
001134:     const activeJobPostings = jobs.filter((job) => isJobCurrentlyPublic(job)).length;
001135: 
001136:     // Get all interviews for the organization
001137:     const interviewsSnapshot = await interviewsCollection
001138:       .where('organizationId', '==', organizationId)
001139:       .get();
001140:     const interviews = interviewsSnapshot.docs.map(docToData);
001141:     
001142:     // Calculate metrics
001143:     const completedInterviews = interviews.filter(i => i?.status === 'COMPLETED');
001144:     const pendingReviews = completedInterviews.filter(i => !i?.evaluation).length;
001145:     const scheduledInterviews = interviews.filter(i => i?.status === 'SCHEDULED');
001146:     
001147:     // Get upcoming interviews (scheduled for today or future)
001148:     const today = new Date();
001149:     today.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
001150:     const upcomingInterviews = scheduledInterviews.filter(i => {
001151:       const scheduledDate = i?.scheduledFor ? new Date(i.scheduledFor) : null;
001152:       return scheduledDate && scheduledDate >= today;
001153:     }).length;
001154: 
001155:     // Get pipeline data for hired count
001156:     const hiredCount = interviews.filter(i => i?.pipelineStatus === 'HIRED').length;
001157: 
001158:     // Calculate average score
001159:     const scoredInterviews = completedInterviews.filter(i => i?.overallScore != null);
001160:     const averageScore = scoredInterviews.length > 0
001161:       ? scoredInterviews.reduce((sum, i) => sum + (i.overallScore || 0), 0) / scoredInterviews.length
001162:       : 0;
001163: 
001164:     // Get application count (total unique candidates)
001165:     const applicationsSnapshot = await jobApplicationsCollection
001166:       .where('organizationId', '==', organizationId)
001167:       .get();
001168:     const totalCandidates = applicationsSnapshot.size;
001169: 
001170:     return {
001171:       activeJobPostings,
001172:       pendingReviews,
001173:       upcomingInterviews,
001174:       totalInterviews: interviews.length,
001175:       completedInterviews: completedInterviews.length,
001176:       averageScore: Math.round(averageScore * 100) / 100,
001177:       totalCandidates,
001178:       hiredCount,
001179:       snapshotDate: now(),
001180:     };
001181:   },
001182: 
001183:   /**
001184:    * Create a daily snapshot of organization metrics for historical tracking
001185:    * @param {string} organizationId - The organization ID
001186:    * @returns {Object} The created snapshot
001187:    */
001188:   async createDailySnapshot(organizationId) {
001189:     try {
001190:       const today = new Date();
001191:       const dateKey = today.toISOString().split('T')[0]; // YYYY-MM-DD format
001192: 
001193:       // Check if a snapshot already exists for today
001194:       const existingSnapshot = await analyticsSnapshotsCollection
001195:         .where('organizationId', '==', organizationId)
001196:         .where('dateKey', '==', dateKey)
001197:         .limit(1)
001198:         .get();
001199: 
001200:       if (!existingSnapshot.empty) {
001201:         // Update existing snapshot
001202:         const existingDoc = existingSnapshot.docs[0];
001203:         const metrics = await this.getCurrentOrganizationMetrics(organizationId);
001204:         await existingDoc.ref.update({
001205:           ...metrics,
001206:           updatedAt: now(),
001207:         });
001208:         return { id: existingDoc.id, ...existingDoc.data(), ...metrics };
001209:       }
001210: 
001211:       // Create new snapshot
001212:       const metrics = await this.getCurrentOrganizationMetrics(organizationId);
001213:       const docRef = analyticsSnapshotsCollection.doc();
001214:       const snapshot = {
001215:         id: docRef.id,
001216:         organizationId,
001217:         dateKey,
001218:         ...metrics,
001219:         createdAt: now(),
001220:         updatedAt: now(),
001221:       };
001222: 
001223:       await docRef.set(snapshot);
001224:       logger.info(`Created daily analytics snapshot for org ${organizationId}: ${dateKey}`);
001225:       return snapshot;
001226:     } catch (error) {
001227:       logger.error('createDailySnapshot error:', error);
001228:       throw error;
001229:     }
001230:   },
001231: 
001232:   /**
001233:    * Get the snapshot nearest to a specific date
001234:    * @param {string} organizationId - The organization ID
001235:    * @param {Date} targetDate - The target date to find snapshot for
001236:    * @returns {Object|null} The snapshot or null if not found
001237:    */
001238:   async getSnapshotNearDate(organizationId, targetDate) {
001239:     try {
001240:       const dateKey = targetDate.toISOString().split('T')[0];
001241:       
001242:       // Try to find exact date match first
001243:       let snapshot = await analyticsSnapshotsCollection
001244:         .where('organizationId', '==', organizationId)
001245:         .where('dateKey', '==', dateKey)
001246:         .limit(1)
001247:         .get();
001248: 
001249:       if (!snapshot.empty) {
001250:         return docToData(snapshot.docs[0]);
001251:       }
001252: 
001253:       // If no exact match, find the nearest snapshot before the target date
001254:       snapshot = await analyticsSnapshotsCollection
001255:         .where('organizationId', '==', organizationId)
001256:         .where('dateKey', '<=', dateKey)
001257:         .orderBy('dateKey', 'desc')
001258:         .limit(1)
001259:         .get();
001260: 
001261:       if (!snapshot.empty) {
001262:         return docToData(snapshot.docs[0]);
001263:       }
001264: 
001265:       return null;
001266:     } catch (error) {
001267:       // Handle index building error gracefully
001268:       if (isIndexBuildingError(error)) {
001269:         logger.warn('Analytics snapshot index not ready, returning null for comparison');
001270:         console.error('Firestore index error - click the link below to create the index:');
001271:         console.error(error.message || error);
001272:         return null;
001273:       }
001274:       logger.error('getSnapshotNearDate error:', error);
001275:       return null;
001276:     }
001277:   },
001278: 
001279:   /**
001280:    * Get historical snapshots for trend analysis
001281:    * @param {string} organizationId - The organization ID
001282:    * @param {number} days - Number of days of history to retrieve
001283:    * @returns {Array} Array of snapshots
001284:    */
001285:   async getSnapshots(organizationId, days = 7) {
001286:     try {
001287:       const startDate = new Date();
001288:       startDate.setDate(startDate.getDate() - days);
001289:       const startDateKey = startDate.toISOString().split('T')[0];
001290: 
001291:       const snapshot = await analyticsSnapshotsCollection
001292:         .where('organizationId', '==', organizationId)
001293:         .where('dateKey', '>=', startDateKey)
001294:         .orderBy('dateKey', 'desc')
001295:         .get();
001296: 
001297:       return snapshot.docs.map(docToData);
001298:     } catch (error) {
001299:       if (isIndexBuildingError(error)) {
001300:         logger.warn('Analytics snapshot index not ready, returning empty array');
001301:         console.error('Firestore index error - click the link below to create the index:');
001302:         console.error(error.message || error);
001303:         return [];
001304:       }
001305:       logger.error('getSnapshots error:', error);
001306:       return [];
001307:     }
001308:   },
001309: 
001310:   // ============================================
001311:   // CANDIDATE ANALYTICS FUNCTIONS
001312:   // ============================================
001313: 
001314:   /**
001315:    * Get current candidate metrics (live data)
001316:    * @param {string} candidateId - The candidate user ID
001317:    * @returns {Object} Current metrics
001318:    */
001319:   async getCurrentCandidateMetrics(candidateId) {
001320:     const interviews = await interviewStore.listByCandidate(candidateId);
001321:     
001322:     const completedInterviews = interviews.filter(i => i?.status === 'COMPLETED');
001323:     const scheduledInterviews = interviews.filter(i => i?.status === 'SCHEDULED');
001324:     const inProgressInterviews = interviews.filter(i => i?.status === 'IN_PROGRESS');
001325:     
001326:     // Calculate average score from completed interviews
001327:     const scoredInterviews = completedInterviews.filter(i => i?.overallScore != null);
001328:     const averageScore = scoredInterviews.length > 0
001329:       ? scoredInterviews.reduce((sum, i) => sum + (i.overallScore || 0), 0) / scoredInterviews.length
001330:       : 0;
001331: 
001332:     // Calculate grade based on average score
001333:     const getGrade = (score) => {
001334:       if (!score || score === 0) return null;
001335:       if (score >= 90) return 'A+';
001336:       if (score >= 85) return 'A';
001337:       if (score >= 80) return 'B+';
001338:       if (score >= 75) return 'B';
001339:       if (score >= 70) return 'C+';
001340:       if (score >= 65) return 'C';
001341:       return 'D';
001342:     };
001343: 
001344:     return {
001345:       totalInterviews: interviews.length,
001346:       completedInterviews: completedInterviews.length,
001347:       scheduledInterviews: scheduledInterviews.length,
001348:       inProgressInterviews: inProgressInterviews.length,
001349:       averageScore: Math.round(averageScore * 100) / 100,
001350:       currentGrade: getGrade(averageScore),
001351:       snapshotDate: now(),
001352:     };
001353:   },
001354: 
001355:   /**
001356:    * Get candidate dashboard metrics with historical comparison (week-over-week)
001357:    * @param {string} candidateId - The candidate user ID
001358:    * @returns {Object} Metrics with change indicators
001359:    */
001360:   async getCandidateDashboardMetricsWithComparison(candidateId) {
001361:     try {
001362:       // Get current metrics
001363:       const currentMetrics = await this.getCurrentCandidateMetrics(candidateId);
001364:       
001365:       // Get snapshot from 7 days ago for comparison
001366:       const oneWeekAgo = new Date();
001367:       oneWeekAgo.setDate(oneWeekAgo.getDate() - 7);
001368:       const previousMetrics = await this.getCandidateSnapshotNearDate(candidateId, oneWeekAgo);
001369: 
001370:       // Calculate changes
001371:       const calculateChange = (current, previous, suffix = '') => {
001372:         if (previous === null || previous === undefined) {
001373:           return { value: current, changeText: 'New', changeType: 'neutral' };
001374:         }
001375:         const diff = current - previous;
001376:         if (diff === 0) {
001377:           return { value: current, changeText: 'No change', changeType: 'neutral' };
001378:         }
001379:         const sign = diff > 0 ? '+' : '';
001380:         return {
001381:           value: current,
001382:           changeText: `${sign}${diff}${suffix} this week`,
001383:           changeType: diff > 0 ? 'positive' : 'negative',
001384:         };
001385:       };
001386: 
001387:       // Special handling for score (show percentage change)
001388:       const calculateScoreChange = (current, previous) => {
001389:         if (!current || current === 0) {
001390:           return { value: current, changeText: 'No scores yet', changeType: 'neutral' };
001391:         }
001392:         if (previous === null || previous === undefined || previous === 0) {
001393:           return { value: current, changeText: 'First score!', changeType: 'positive' };
001394:         }
001395:         const diff = Math.round(current - previous);
001396:         if (diff === 0) {
001397:           return { value: current, changeText: 'Steady', changeType: 'neutral' };
001398:         }
001399:         const sign = diff > 0 ? '+' : '';
001400:         return {
001401:           value: current,
001402:           changeText: `${sign}${diff}% this week`,
001403:           changeType: diff > 0 ? 'positive' : 'negative',
001404:         };
001405:       };
001406: 
001407:       // Grade change
001408:       const calculateGradeChange = (current, previous) => {
001409:         if (!current) {
001410:           return { value: '—', changeText: 'Complete interviews to get a grade', changeType: 'neutral' };
001411:         }
001412:         if (!previous) {
001413:           return { value: current, changeText: 'First grade!', changeType: 'positive' };
001414:         }
001415:         if (current === previous) {
001416:           return { value: current, changeText: 'Maintained', changeType: 'neutral' };
001417:         }
001418:         // Grade improved (A+ > A > B+ > B > C+ > C > D)
001419:         const gradeOrder = ['D', 'C', 'C+', 'B', 'B+', 'A', 'A+'];
001420:         const currentIdx = gradeOrder.indexOf(current);
001421:         const prevIdx = gradeOrder.indexOf(previous);
001422:         const improved = currentIdx > prevIdx;
001423:         return {
001424:           value: current,
001425:           changeText: improved ? `↑ from ${previous}` : `↓ from ${previous}`,
001426:           changeType: improved ? 'positive' : 'negative',
001427:         };
001428:       };
001429: 
001430:       return {
001431:         completedInterviews: calculateChange(
001432:           currentMetrics.completedInterviews,
001433:           previousMetrics?.completedInterviews
001434:         ),
001435:         scheduledInterviews: calculateChange(
001436:           currentMetrics.scheduledInterviews,
001437:           previousMetrics?.scheduledInterviews
001438:         ),
001439:         averageScore: calculateScoreChange(
001440:           currentMetrics.averageScore,
001441:           previousMetrics?.averageScore
001442:         ),
001443:         currentGrade: calculateGradeChange(
001444:           currentMetrics.currentGrade,
001445:           previousMetrics?.currentGrade
001446:         ),
001447:         // Additional metrics without comparison
001448:         totalInterviews: currentMetrics.totalInterviews,
001449:         inProgressInterviews: currentMetrics.inProgressInterviews,
001450:         snapshotDate: currentMetrics.snapshotDate,
001451:       };
001452:     } catch (error) {
001453:       logger.error('getCandidateDashboardMetricsWithComparison error:', error);
001454:       // Return basic metrics without comparison on error
001455:       const current = await this.getCurrentCandidateMetrics(candidateId);
001456:       return {
001457:         completedInterviews: { value: current.completedInterviews, changeText: '', changeType: 'neutral' },
001458:         scheduledInterviews: { value: current.scheduledInterviews, changeText: '', changeType: 'neutral' },
001459:         averageScore: { value: current.averageScore, changeText: '', changeType: 'neutral' },
001460:         currentGrade: { value: current.currentGrade || '—', changeText: '', changeType: 'neutral' },
001461:         totalInterviews: current.totalInterviews,
001462:         inProgressInterviews: current.inProgressInterviews,
001463:         snapshotDate: current.snapshotDate,
001464:       };
001465:     }
001466:   },
001467: 
001468:   /**
001469:    * Create a daily snapshot of candidate metrics for historical tracking
001470:    * @param {string} candidateId - The candidate user ID
001471:    * @returns {Object} The created snapshot
001472:    */
001473:   async createCandidateDailySnapshot(candidateId) {
001474:     try {
001475:       const today = new Date();
001476:       const dateKey = today.toISOString().split('T')[0]; // YYYY-MM-DD format
001477: 
001478:       // Check if a snapshot already exists for today
001479:       const existingSnapshot = await analyticsSnapshotsCollection
001480:         .where('candidateId', '==', candidateId)
001481:         .where('dateKey', '==', dateKey)
001482:         .limit(1)
001483:         .get();
001484: 
001485:       if (!existingSnapshot.empty) {
001486:         // Update existing snapshot
001487:         const existingDoc = existingSnapshot.docs[0];
001488:         const metrics = await this.getCurrentCandidateMetrics(candidateId);
001489:         await existingDoc.ref.update({
001490:           ...metrics,
001491:           updatedAt: now(),
001492:         });
001493:         return { id: existingDoc.id, ...existingDoc.data(), ...metrics };
001494:       }
001495: 
001496:       // Create new snapshot
001497:       const metrics = await this.getCurrentCandidateMetrics(candidateId);
001498:       const docRef = analyticsSnapshotsCollection.doc();
001499:       const snapshot = {
001500:         id: docRef.id,
001501:         candidateId,
001502:         dateKey,
001503:         type: 'candidate', // Distinguish from organization snapshots
001504:         ...metrics,
001505:         createdAt: now(),
001506:         updatedAt: now(),
001507:       };
001508: 
001509:       await docRef.set(snapshot);
001510:       logger.info(`Created daily candidate analytics snapshot for user ${candidateId}: ${dateKey}`);
001511:       return snapshot;
001512:     } catch (error) {
001513:       logger.error('createCandidateDailySnapshot error:', error);
001514:       throw error;
001515:     }
001516:   },
001517: 
001518:   /**
001519:    * Get the candidate snapshot nearest to a specific date
001520:    * @param {string} candidateId - The candidate user ID
001521:    * @param {Date} targetDate - The target date to find snapshot for
001522:    * @returns {Object|null} The snapshot or null if not found
001523:    */
001524:   async getCandidateSnapshotNearDate(candidateId, targetDate) {
001525:     try {
001526:       const dateKey = targetDate.toISOString().split('T')[0];
001527:       
001528:       // Try to find exact date match first
001529:       let snapshot = await analyticsSnapshotsCollection
001530:         .where('candidateId', '==', candidateId)
001531:         .where('dateKey', '==', dateKey)
001532:         .limit(1)
001533:         .get();
001534: 
001535:       if (!snapshot.empty) {
001536:         return docToData(snapshot.docs[0]);
001537:       }
001538: 
001539:       // If no exact match, find the nearest snapshot before the target date
001540:       snapshot = await analyticsSnapshotsCollection
001541:         .where('candidateId', '==', candidateId)
001542:         .where('dateKey', '<=', dateKey)
001543:         .orderBy('dateKey', 'desc')
001544:         .limit(1)
001545:         .get();
001546: 
001547:       if (!snapshot.empty) {
001548:         return docToData(snapshot.docs[0]);
001549:       }
001550: 
001551:       return null;
001552:     } catch (error) {
001553:       // Handle index building error gracefully
001554:       if (isIndexBuildingError(error)) {
001555:         logger.warn('Candidate analytics snapshot index not ready, returning null for comparison');
001556:         console.error('Firestore index error - click the link below to create the index:');
001557:         console.error(error.message || error);
001558:         return null;
001559:       }
001560:       logger.error('getCandidateSnapshotNearDate error:', error);
001561:       return null;
001562:     }
001563:   },
001564: 
001565:   /**
001566:    * Get candidate historical snapshots for trend analysis
001567:    * @param {string} candidateId - The candidate user ID
001568:    * @param {number} days - Number of days of history to retrieve
001569:    * @returns {Array} Array of snapshots
001570:    */
001571:   async getCandidateSnapshots(candidateId, days = 7) {
001572:     try {
001573:       const startDate = new Date();
001574:       startDate.setDate(startDate.getDate() - days);
001575:       const startDateKey = startDate.toISOString().split('T')[0];
001576: 
001577:       const snapshot = await analyticsSnapshotsCollection
001578:         .where('candidateId', '==', candidateId)
001579:         .where('dateKey', '>=', startDateKey)
001580:         .orderBy('dateKey', 'desc')
001581:         .get();
001582: 
001583:       return snapshot.docs.map(docToData);
001584:     } catch (error) {
001585:       if (isIndexBuildingError(error)) {
001586:         logger.warn('Candidate analytics snapshot index not ready, returning empty array');
001587:         console.error('Firestore index error - click the link below to create the index:');
001588:         console.error(error.message || error);
001589:         return [];
001590:       }
001591:       logger.error('getCandidateSnapshots error:', error);
001592:       return [];
001593:     }
001594:   },
001595: };

001738:   async reject(
001739:     id,
001740:     {
001741:       reason,
001742:       rejectedBy = null,
001743:       reasonCode = 'OTHER',
001744:       reasonTags = [],
001745:       reasonTagOther = null,
001746:     } = {},
001747:   ) {
001748:     if (!id) throw new Error('Organization ID is required');
001749:     if (!reason || !reason.trim()) {
001750:       throw new Error('Rejection reason is required');
001751:     }
001752: 
001753:     const docRef = organizationsCollection.doc(id);
001754:     const currentDoc = await docRef.get();
001755:     const current = organizationDocToData(currentDoc);
001756: 
001757:     if (!current) {
001758:       throw new Error('Organization not found');
001759:     }
001760: 
001761:     const normalizedReason = reason.trim();
001762:     const normalizedReasonCode = (reasonCode || 'OTHER').toString().trim().toUpperCase() || 'OTHER';
001763:     const normalizedReasonTags = Array.isArray(reasonTags)
001764:       ? Array.from(
001765:           new Set(
001766:             reasonTags
001767:               .map((tag) => (tag || '').toString().trim().toUpperCase())
001768:               .filter(Boolean),
001769:           ),
001770:         ).slice(0, 8)
001771:       : [];
001772:     const normalizedReasonTagOther = normalizedReasonTags.includes('OTHER') && reasonTagOther
001773:       ? String(reasonTagOther).trim() || null
001774:       : null;
001775:     const rejectedAt = now();
001776:     const rejectionEntry = {
001777:       rejectedAt,
001778:       rejectedBy: rejectedBy || null,
001779:       reason: normalizedReason,
001780:       reasonCode: normalizedReasonCode,
001781:       reasonTags: normalizedReasonTags,
001782:       reasonTagOther: normalizedReasonTagOther,
001783:     };
001784:     const rejectionHistory = Array.isArray(current.rejectionHistory)
001785:       ? [...current.rejectionHistory, rejectionEntry]
001786:       : [rejectionEntry];
001787: 
001788:     await docRef.set(
001789:       {
001790:         status: 'REJECTED',
001791:         rejectedReason: normalizedReason,
001792:         rejectedReasonCode: normalizedReasonCode,
001793:         rejectedReasonTags: normalizedReasonTags,
001794:         rejectedReasonTagOther: normalizedReasonTagOther,
001795:         rejectedBy: rejectedBy || null,
001796:         rejectedAt,
001797:         rejectionHistory,
001798:         reReviewRequestedAt: null,
001799:         reReviewRequestedBy: null,
001800:         reReviewRequestNote: null,
001801:         updatedAt: now(),
001802:       },
001803:       { merge: true },
001804:     );
001805:     const updated = await docRef.get();
001806:     const organization = organizationDocToData(updated);
001807: 
001808:     // Update Realtime Database for real-time notification to waiting users
001809:     if (organization && realtimeDb) {
001810:       try {
001811:         await realtimeDb.ref(`organizationApprovalStatus/${id}`).update({
001812:           status: 'REJECTED',
001813:           rejectedReason: normalizedReason,
001814:           rejectedReasonCode: normalizedReasonCode,
001815:           rejectedReasonTags: normalizedReasonTags,
001816:           rejectedReasonTagOther: normalizedReasonTagOther,
001817:           rejectedBy: rejectedBy || null,
001818:           rejectedAt,
001819:           reReviewRequestedAt: null,
001820:           reReviewRequestNote: null,
001821:           updatedAt: now(),
001822:         });
001823:         logger.info(`Updated organization approval status in Realtime DB: ${id} - REJECTED`);
001824:       } catch (rtdbError) {
001825:         logger.error('Failed to update organization approval status in Realtime DB:', rtdbError);
001826:         // Don't fail the rejection if RTDB update fails
001827:       }
001828:     }
001829: 
001830:     return organization;
001831:   },

001833:   async requestReReview(id, { requestedBy = null, note } = {}) {
001834:     if (!id) throw new Error('Organization ID is required');
001835:     if (!note || !note.trim()) {
001836:       throw new Error('Re-review note is required');
001837:     }
001838: 
001839:     const docRef = organizationsCollection.doc(id);
001840:     const currentDoc = await docRef.get();
001841:     const current = organizationDocToData(currentDoc);
001842: 
001843:     if (!current) {
001844:       throw new Error('Organization not found');
001845:     }
001846: 
001847:     const normalizedNote = note.trim();
001848:     const requestedAt = now();
001849:     const currentCount = Number.isFinite(current.reReviewRequestCount) ? current.reReviewRequestCount : 0;
001850:     const requestEntry = {
001851:       requestedAt,
001852:       requestedBy: requestedBy || null,
001853:       note: normalizedNote,
001854:       previousRejectedReason: current.rejectedReason || null,
001855:       previousRejectedReasonCode: current.rejectedReasonCode || null,
001856:     };
001857:     const reReviewRequests = Array.isArray(current.reReviewRequests)
001858:       ? [...current.reReviewRequests, requestEntry]
001859:       : [requestEntry];
001860: 
001861:     await docRef.set(
001862:       {
001863:         status: 'PENDING',
001864:         reReviewRequestedAt: requestedAt,
001865:         reReviewRequestedBy: requestedBy || null,
001866:         reReviewRequestNote: normalizedNote,
001867:         reReviewRequestCount: currentCount + 1,
001868:         reReviewRequests,
001869:         updatedAt: now(),
001870:       },
001871:       { merge: true },
001872:     );
001873: 
001874:     const updated = await docRef.get();
001875:     const organization = organizationDocToData(updated);
001876: 
001877:     // Update Realtime Database for real-time notification to waiting users
001878:     if (organization && realtimeDb) {
001879:       try {
001880:         await realtimeDb.ref(`organizationApprovalStatus/${id}`).update({
001881:           status: 'PENDING',
001882:           reReviewRequestedAt: requestedAt,
001883:           reReviewRequestedBy: requestedBy || null,
001884:           reReviewRequestNote: normalizedNote,
001885:           updatedAt: now(),
001886:         });
001887:         logger.info(`Updated organization approval status in Realtime DB: ${id} - PENDING (re-review requested)`);
001888:       } catch (rtdbError) {
001889:         logger.error('Failed to update organization approval status in Realtime DB:', rtdbError);
001890:         // Don't fail the re-review request if RTDB update fails
001891:       }
001892:     }
001893: 
001894:     return organization;
001895:   },

001971:     if (!organizationId || !userId) {
001972:       throw new Error('organizationId and userId are required');
001973:     }
001974: 
001975:     const normalizedRole = sanitizeOrgRole(role) || 'RECRUITER';
001976:     const membershipId = `${organizationId}_${userId}`;
001977:     const docRef = organizationMembersCollection.doc(membershipId);
001978:     const payload = {
001979:       id: membershipId,

001985:       createdAt: now(),

001988: 
001989:     await docRef.set(payload, { merge: true });
001990:     const updated = await docRef.get();
001991:     const membership = organizationDocToData(updated);
001992: 
001993:     await syncUserOrganizationRealtimeMembership({
001994:       userId,
001995:       organizationId,
001996:       active: isMembershipActive(membership?.status || status),
001997:     });
001998: 
001999:     await publishOrganizationRealtimeUpdate(organizationId, 'member-synced', {
002000:       userId,
002001:       role: membership?.role || normalizedRole,
002002:       status: membership?.status || status,
002003:     });
002004:     await publishCandidateRealtimeUpdate(userId, 'organization-membership-updated', {
002005:       organizationId,
002006:       role: membership?.role || normalizedRole,
002007:       status: membership?.status || status,
002008:     });
002009: 
002010:     return membership;
002011:   },

002062:       advertImageUrls: ensureArray(data.advertImageUrls).length > 0
002063:         ? ensureArray(data.advertImageUrls)
002064:         : (data.advertImageUrl ? [data.advertImageUrl] : []),

002066:         || ensureArray(data.advertImageUrls)[0]
002067:         || null,
002068:       advertImageAlt: data.advertImageAlt || null,
002069:       advertVideoUrl: data.advertVideoUrl || null,
002070:       status: sanitizeJobStatus(data.status),
002071:       stages: ensureArray(data.stages),
002072:       templateConfig: data.templateConfig || {

002074:         duration: 30,
002075:         scoringRubric: [],
002076:       },
002077:       reviewerIds: ensureArray(data.reviewerIds),
002078:       hiringManagerId: data.hiringManagerId || null,
002079:       postingDuration: data.postingDuration || 30,
002080:       acceptingApplications: data.acceptingApplications !== false,
002081:       scheduledPublishAt: data.scheduledPublishAt || null,
002082:       publishedAt: null,
002083:       expiresAt: null,
002084:       deletedAt: null,
002085:       deletedBy: null,
002086:       deleteReason: null,
002087:       deletionMode: null,
002088:       createdAt,
002089:       updatedAt: createdAt,
002090:     };
002091:     
002092:     // Handle publishing logic on creation
002093:     if (payload.status === 'PUBLISHED') {
002094:       if (data.scheduledPublishAt) {
002095:         const scheduledDate = new Date(data.scheduledPublishAt);
002096:         const nowDate = new Date();
002097:         if (scheduledDate > nowDate) {
002098:           // Scheduled for future - don't set publishedAt yet, keep status as PUBLISHED
002099:           payload.publishedAt = null;
002100:           payload.expiresAt = null;
002101:         } else {
002102:           // Scheduled time has passed or is now - publish immediately
002103:           payload.publishedAt = data.publishedAt || now();
002104:           const publishDate = new Date(payload.publishedAt);
002105:           publishDate.setDate(publishDate.getDate() + payload.postingDuration);
002106:           payload.expiresAt = publishDate.toISOString();
002107:         }
002108:       } else {
002109:         // Publish immediately
002110:         payload.publishedAt = data.publishedAt || now();
002111:         const publishDate = new Date(payload.publishedAt);
002112:         publishDate.setDate(publishDate.getDate() + payload.postingDuration);
002113:         payload.expiresAt = publishDate.toISOString();
002114:       }
002115:     }
002116: 
002117:     await docRef.set(payload);
002118:     return payload;
002119:   },
002120: 
002121:   async update(id, data = {}) {
002122:     const docRef = jobsCollection.doc(id);
002123:     
002124:     // Get existing job to check current status and postingDuration
002125:     const existing = await this.getById(id, { includeDeleted: true });
002126:     const postingDuration = data.postingDuration || existing?.postingDuration || 30;
002127:     
002128:     const payload = {
002129:       ...data,
002130:       ...(data.status ? { status: sanitizeJobStatus(data.status) } : {}),
002131:       updatedAt: now(),
002132:     };
002133:     
002134:     // Handle publishing logic
002135:     if (data.status === 'PUBLISHED') {
002136:       // If scheduledPublishAt is set and in the future, don't publish yet
002137:       if (data.scheduledPublishAt) {
002138:         const scheduledDate = new Date(data.scheduledPublishAt);
002139:         const nowDate = new Date();
002140:         if (scheduledDate > nowDate) {
002141:           // Scheduled for future - don't set publishedAt yet
002142:           payload.publishedAt = null;
002143:           payload.expiresAt = null;
002144:         } else {
002145:           // Scheduled time has passed - publish now
002146:           payload.publishedAt = data.publishedAt || now();
002147:           const publishDate = new Date(payload.publishedAt);
002148:           publishDate.setDate(publishDate.getDate() + postingDuration);
002149:           payload.expiresAt = publishDate.toISOString();
002150:         }
002151:       } else {
002152:         // Publish immediately
002153:         payload.publishedAt = data.publishedAt || now();
002154:         const publishDate = new Date(payload.publishedAt);
002155:         publishDate.setDate(publishDate.getDate() + postingDuration);
002156:         payload.expiresAt = publishDate.toISOString();
002157:       }
002158:     } else if (existing?.status === 'PUBLISHED' && data.status && data.status !== 'PUBLISHED') {
002159:       // Only clear publish metadata when status is explicitly changed away from PUBLISHED.
002160:       payload.publishedAt = null;
002161:       payload.expiresAt = null;
002162:     } else if (existing?.status === 'PUBLISHED' && !data.status) {
002163:       // Updating published job - recalculate expiresAt if postingDuration changed
002164:       if (data.postingDuration && existing.publishedAt) {
002165:         const publishDate = new Date(existing.publishedAt);
002166:         publishDate.setDate(publishDate.getDate() + postingDuration);
002167:         payload.expiresAt = publishDate.toISOString();
002168:       }
002169:     }
002170:     
002171:     await docRef.set(payload, { merge: true });
002172:     const updated = await docRef.get();
002173:     return docToData(updated);
002174:   },
002175: 
002176:   async getById(id, options = {}) {
002177:     if (!id) return null;

002179:     const doc = await jobsCollection.doc(id).get();

002184: 
002185:   async listByOrganization(organizationId, options = {}) {
002186:     if (!organizationId) return [];

002188:     // Auto-publish any scheduled jobs before listing
002189:     await this.autoPublishScheduledJobs();
002190:     const snapshot = await jobsCollection.where('organizationId', '==', organizationId).orderBy('createdAt', 'desc').get();
002191:     const jobs = snapshot.docs.map((doc) => docToData(doc));

002195: 
002196:   async listPublished(limit = 20) {
002197:     // First, check and auto-publish any scheduled jobs whose time has come
002198:     await this.autoPublishScheduledJobs();
002199: 
002200:     let jobs = [];
002201:     try {
002202:       const snapshot = await jobsCollection
002203:         .where('status', '==', 'PUBLISHED')
002204:         .orderBy('publishedAt', 'desc')
002205:         .limit(limit * 2)
002206:         .get();
002207:       jobs = snapshot.docs.map((doc) => docToData(doc));
002208:     } catch (error) {
002209:       if (!isIndexBuildingError(error)) {
002210:         throw error;
002211:       }
002212: 
002213:       logger.warn('Published jobs index still building; falling back to in-memory sort.');
002214:       console.error('Firestore index error - click the link below to create the index:');
002215:       console.error(error.message || error);
002216: 
002217:       // Fallback query that only relies on single-field index.
002218:       const snapshot = await jobsCollection
002219:         .where('status', '==', 'PUBLISHED')
002220:         .limit(limit * 5)
002221:         .get();
002222:       jobs = snapshot.docs
002223:         .map((doc) => docToData(doc))
002224:         .sort((a, b) => toMillis(b?.publishedAt) - toMillis(a?.publishedAt));
002225:     }
002226: 
002227:     // Keep only currently public jobs (published, live, and not expired).
002228:     const nowDate = new Date();
002229:     const activeJobs = jobs.filter((job) => isJobCurrentlyPublic(job, nowDate));
002230: 
002231:     // Return limited results
002232:     return activeJobs.slice(0, limit);
002233:   },
002234: 
002235:   async autoPublishScheduledJobs() {
002236:     try {
002237:       const nowDate = new Date();
002238:       const nowISO = nowDate.toISOString();
002239:       
002240:       // Query for jobs with scheduledPublishAt <= now (jobs ready to publish)
002241:       // Note: This requires a Firestore index on scheduledPublishAt
002242:       // If index doesn't exist, we'll catch the error and use fallback
002243:       let scheduledJobsSnapshot;
002244:       try {
002245:         scheduledJobsSnapshot = await jobsCollection
002246:           .where('scheduledPublishAt', '<=', nowISO)
002247:           .limit(50)
002248:           .get();
002249:       } catch (indexError) {
002250:         // If index doesn't exist, use fallback: get recent jobs and filter
002251:         if (isIndexBuildingError(indexError)) {
002252:           logger.warn('Scheduled jobs index not available, using fallback method');
002253:           console.error('Firestore index error - click the link below to create the index:');
002254:           console.error(indexError.message || indexError);
002255:         }
002256:         // Get recent jobs and filter in memory
002257:         const allJobsSnapshot = await jobsCollection
002258:           .orderBy('createdAt', 'desc')
002259:           .limit(100)
002260:           .get();
002261:         scheduledJobsSnapshot = {
002262:           docs: allJobsSnapshot.docs.filter((doc) => {
002263:             const job = docToData(doc);
002264:             if ((job?.status || '').toString().toUpperCase() !== 'PUBLISHED') return false;
002265:             if (isJobSoftDeleted(job)) return false;
002266:             if (!job?.scheduledPublishAt || job?.publishedAt) return false;
002267:             const scheduledDate = new Date(job.scheduledPublishAt);
002268:             if (Number.isNaN(scheduledDate.getTime())) return false;
002269:             return scheduledDate <= nowDate;
002270:           }),
002271:         };
002272:       }
002273:       
002274:       // Filter for jobs that haven't been published yet
002275:       const jobsToPublish = scheduledJobsSnapshot.docs
002276:         .map(docToData)
002277:         .filter((job) => {
002278:           if ((job?.status || '').toString().toUpperCase() !== 'PUBLISHED') return false;
002279:           if (isJobSoftDeleted(job)) return false;
002280:           if (!job.scheduledPublishAt) return false;
002281:           const scheduledDate = new Date(job.scheduledPublishAt);
002282:           if (Number.isNaN(scheduledDate.getTime())) return false;
002283:           // Include jobs whose scheduled time has passed and haven't been published yet
002284:           return scheduledDate <= nowDate && !job.publishedAt;
002285:         });
002286: 
002287:       // Auto-publish each scheduled job
002288:       for (const job of jobsToPublish) {
002289:         const postingDuration = job.postingDuration || 30;
002290:         const publishDate = now();
002291:         const publishDateObj = new Date(publishDate);
002292:         publishDateObj.setDate(publishDateObj.getDate() + postingDuration);
002293:         const expiresAt = publishDateObj.toISOString();
002294: 
002295:         await jobsCollection.doc(job.id).set({
002296:           status: 'PUBLISHED', // Ensure status is PUBLISHED
002297:           publishedAt: publishDate,
002298:           expiresAt,
002299:           updatedAt: now(),
002300:         }, { merge: true });
002301: 
002302:         await publishOrganizationRealtimeUpdate(job.organizationId, 'job-published', {
002303:           jobId: job.id,
002304:           status: 'PUBLISHED',
002305:           publishedAt: publishDate,
002306:         });
002307:         await publishPublicRealtimeUpdate('jobs', 'job-published', {
002308:           jobId: job.id,
002309:           organizationId: job.organizationId || null,
002310:           publishedAt: publishDate,
002311:         });
002312:         
002313:         logger.info(`Auto-published scheduled job ${job.id} (${job.title})`);
002314:       }
002315: 
002316:       return jobsToPublish.length;
002317:     } catch (error) {
002318:       logger.error('Error auto-publishing scheduled jobs:', error);
002319:       return 0;
002320:     }
002321:   },
002322: 
002323:   async delete(id, options = {}) {
002324:     if (!id) throw new Error('Job ID is required');
002325:     const docRef = jobsCollection.doc(id);
002326:     const hardDelete = options?.hardDelete === true;
002327:     if (hardDelete) {
002328:       await docRef.delete();
002329:       return { id, deleted: true, hardDeleted: true };
002330:     }
002331: 
002332:     const deletedAt = options?.deletedAt || now();
002333:     await docRef.set({
002334:       status: 'ARCHIVED',
002335:       acceptingApplications: false,
002336:       deletedAt,
002337:       deletedBy: options?.deletedBy || null,
002338:       deleteReason: options?.deleteReason || null,
002339:       deletionMode: 'SOFT',
002340:       updatedAt: deletedAt,
002341:     }, { merge: true });
002342:     const updated = await docRef.get();
002343:     return { ...docToData(updated), deleted: true, hardDeleted: false };
002344:   },
002345: };

002422:         .where('jobId', '==', jobId)
002423:         .where('email', '==', normalizedEmail)

002426:         .get();

002430:         .find((invitation) =>
002431:           invitation?.status === 'PENDING'
002432:           && (!invitation?.expiresAt || new Date(invitation.expiresAt) >= nowDate));
002433:       return active || null;

002439:       console.error('Firestore index error - click the link below to create the index:');

002443:         .where('organizationId', '==', organizationId)
002444:         .where('jobId', '==', jobId)
002445:         .where('email', '==', normalizedEmail)
002446:         .get();
002447:       const nowDate = new Date();
002448:       const active = sortApplicationsByCreatedAtDesc(
002449:         snapshot.docs.map((doc) => docToData(doc)),
002450:       ).find((invitation) =>
002451:         invitation?.status === 'PENDING'
002452:         && (!invitation?.expiresAt || new Date(invitation.expiresAt) >= nowDate));
002453:       return active || null;

002456: 
002457:   async markAccepted(token, userId) {
002458:     const claim = await this.claimForAcceptance(token, userId);
002459:     if (claim.status !== 'CLAIMED' && claim.status !== 'ALREADY_COMPLETED') {
002460:       return null;
002461:     }
002462:     return claim.invitation;
002463:   },
002464: 
002465:   async claimForAcceptance(token, userId) {
002466:     if (!token || !userId) {
002467:       return { status: 'NOT_FOUND', invitation: null };
002468:     }
002469: 
002470:     const invitation = await this.getByToken(token);
002471:     if (!invitation) {
002472:       return { status: 'NOT_FOUND', invitation: null };
002473:     }
002474: 
002475:     const docRef = invitationsCollection.doc(invitation.id);
002476:     return firestore.runTransaction(async (transaction) => {
002477:       const snapshot = await transaction.get(docRef);
002478:       const current = docToData(snapshot);
002479:       if (!current) {
002480:         return { status: 'NOT_FOUND', invitation: null };
002481:       }
002482: 
002483:       const currentTime = now();
002484:       const claimEvaluation = evaluateInvitationAcceptanceClaim(current, userId, currentTime);
002485:       if (claimEvaluation === INVITATION_ACCEPTANCE_CLAIM_STATUS.EXPIRED) {
002486:         const expiredPayload = {
002487:           status: 'EXPIRED',
002488:           acceptanceInProgress: false,
002489:           updatedAt: currentTime,
002490:         };
002491:         transaction.set(docRef, expiredPayload, { merge: true });
002492:         return {
002493:           status: 'EXPIRED',
002494:           invitation: { ...current, ...expiredPayload },
002495:         };
002496:       }
002497: 
002498:       if (claimEvaluation === INVITATION_ACCEPTANCE_CLAIM_STATUS.ALREADY_COMPLETED) {
002499:         return {
002500:           status: 'ALREADY_COMPLETED',
002501:           invitation: current,
002502:         };
002503:       }
002504: 
002505:       if (claimEvaluation === INVITATION_ACCEPTANCE_CLAIM_STATUS.IN_PROGRESS) {
002506:         return {
002507:           status: 'IN_PROGRESS',
002508:           invitation: current,
002509:         };
002510:       }
002511: 
002512:       if (claimEvaluation !== INVITATION_ACCEPTANCE_CLAIM_STATUS.CLAIM_ALLOWED) {
002513:         return {
002514:           status: 'UNAVAILABLE',
002515:           invitation: current,
002516:         };
002517:       }
002518: 
002519:       const acceptedAt = current.acceptedAt || currentTime;
002520:       const acceptedPayload = {
002521:         status: 'ACCEPTED',
002522:         candidateUserId: userId,
002523:         acceptedAt,
002524:         acceptanceInProgress: true,
002525:         acceptanceStartedAt: currentTime,
002526:         updatedAt: currentTime,
002527:       };
002528:       transaction.set(docRef, acceptedPayload, { merge: true });
002529: 
002530:       return {
002531:         status: 'CLAIMED',
002532:         invitation: { ...current, ...acceptedPayload },
002533:       };
002534:     });
002535:   },
002536: 
002537:   async finalizeAcceptance(invitationId, { interviewId = null, applicationId = null } = {}) {
002538:     if (!invitationId) return null;
002539:     await invitationsCollection.doc(invitationId).set(
002540:       {
002541:         status: 'ACCEPTED',
002542:         acceptanceInProgress: false,
002543:         acceptanceStartedAt: null,
002544:         acceptedInterviewId: interviewId || null,
002545:         acceptedApplicationId: applicationId || null,
002546:         updatedAt: now(),
002547:       },
002548:       { merge: true },
002549:     );
002550:     const updated = await invitationsCollection.doc(invitationId).get();
002551:     return docToData(updated);
002552:   },
002553: 
002554:   async releaseAcceptanceLock(invitationId, options = {}) {
002555:     if (!invitationId) return null;
002556:     const revertToPending = options?.revertToPending === true;
002557:     await invitationsCollection.doc(invitationId).set(
002558:       {
002559:         ...(revertToPending
002560:           ? {
002561:             status: 'PENDING',
002562:             candidateUserId: null,
002563:             acceptedAt: null,
002564:           }
002565:           : {}),
002566:         acceptanceInProgress: false,
002567:         acceptanceStartedAt: null,
002568:         ...(revertToPending
002569:           ? {
002570:             acceptedInterviewId: null,
002571:             acceptedApplicationId: null,
002572:           }
002573:           : {}),
002574:         updatedAt: now(),
002575:       },
002576:       { merge: true },
002577:     );
002578:     const updated = await invitationsCollection.doc(invitationId).get();
002579:     return docToData(updated);
002580:   },
002581: };

002692: const normalizeApplicationPageLimit = (value, fallback = 50, max = 200) => {
002693:   const parsed = Number.parseInt(value, 10);
002694:   if (!Number.isInteger(parsed) || parsed <= 0) {
002695:     return fallback;
002696:   }
002697:   return Math.min(parsed, max);
002698: };

002700: const normalizeApplicationCursor = (cursor) => {
002701:   if (!cursor) return null;
002702:   const normalized = String(cursor).trim();
002703:   return normalized || null;
002704: };
002705: 
002706: const sortApplicationsByCreatedAtDesc = (applications = []) =>
002707:   applications
002708:     .filter(Boolean)
002709:     .sort((a, b) => {
002710:       const createdAtDiff = toMillis(b?.createdAt) - toMillis(a?.createdAt);
002711:       if (createdAtDiff !== 0) return createdAtDiff;
002712:       return String(b?.id || '').localeCompare(String(a?.id || ''));
002713:     });
002714: 
002715: const sliceApplicationsPage = (applications = [], limit = 50) => {
002716:   const safeLimit = normalizeApplicationPageLimit(limit, 50, 200);
002717:   const hasMore = applications.length > safeLimit;
002718:   const items = applications.slice(0, safeLimit);
002719:   const nextCursor = hasMore && items.length > 0 ? (items[items.length - 1]?.createdAt || null) : null;
002720:   return {
002721:     items,
002722:     hasMore,
002723:     nextCursor,
002724:   };
002725: };

002994:   async countByJob(jobId) {
002995:     if (!jobId) return 0;
002996:     try {
002997:       const snapshot = await jobApplicationsCollection
002998:         .where('jobId', '==', jobId)
002999:         .get();
003000:       return snapshot.size;

003006: 
003007:   async countByJobIds(jobIds = []) {
003008:     const uniqueJobIds = Array.from(new Set((jobIds || []).filter(Boolean)));
003009:     const counts = new Map(uniqueJobIds.map((jobId) => [jobId, 0]));
003010:     if (uniqueJobIds.length === 0) {
003011:       return counts;
003012:     }
003013: 
003014:     const chunkSize = 10;
003015:     const chunks = [];
003016:     for (let i = 0; i < uniqueJobIds.length; i += chunkSize) {
003017:       chunks.push(uniqueJobIds.slice(i, i + chunkSize));
003018:     }
003019: 
003020:     try {
003021:       const snapshots = await Promise.all(
003022:         chunks.map((chunk) =>
003023:           jobApplicationsCollection
003024:             .where('jobId', 'in', chunk)
003025:             .get()),
003026:       );
003027:       snapshots.forEach((snapshot) => {
003028:         snapshot.docs.forEach((doc) => {
003029:           const jobId = doc.data()?.jobId;
003030:           if (!jobId) return;
003031:           counts.set(jobId, (counts.get(jobId) || 0) + 1);
003032:         });
003033:       });
003034:       return counts;
003035:     } catch (error) {
003036:       logger.warn('Batch job application count query failed; falling back to per-job counts.', error);
003037:       await Promise.all(
003038:         uniqueJobIds.map(async (jobId) => {
003039:           const count = await this.countByJob(jobId);
003040:           counts.set(jobId, count);
003041:         }),
003042:       );
003043:       return counts;
003044:     }
003045:   },
003046: 
003047:   async update(id, updates) {
003048:     if (!id) throw new Error('Application ID is required');
003049:     const updateData = {
003050:       ...updates,
003051:       ...(Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(updates || {}, 'dispositionTags')
003052:         ? { dispositionTags: ensureArray(updates.dispositionTags) }
003053:         : {}),
003054:       ...(Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(updates || {}, 'statusHistory')
003055:         ? { statusHistory: ensureArray(updates.statusHistory) }
003056:         : {}),
003057:       updatedAt: now(),
003058:     };
003059:     await jobApplicationsCollection.doc(id).set(updateData, { merge: true });
003060:     const updated = await jobApplicationsCollection.doc(id).get();
003061:     return docToData(updated);
003062:   },
003063: };

003065: export const platformAuditLogStore = {
003066:   async record({ actorId, actorType, action, targetType, targetId, metadata = {} }) {
003067:     const docRef = platformAuditLogsCollection.doc();
003068:     const payload = {
003069:       id: docRef.id,
003070:       actorId: actorId || null,
003071:       actorType: actorType || null,
003072:       action: action || 'UNKNOWN',
003073:       targetType: targetType || null,
003074:       targetId: targetId || null,
003075:       metadata,
003076:       createdAt: now(),
003077:     };
003078:     await docRef.set(payload);
003079:     return payload;
003080:   },
003081: 
003082:   async listPage(options = {}) {
003083:     const limit = normalizeAuditPageLimit(options?.limit, 100, 500);
003084:     const cursor = decodeAuditCursor(options?.cursor);
003085:     const cursorCreatedAt = cursor?.createdAt || null;
003086: 
003087:     try {
003088:       let query = platformAuditLogsCollection;
003089:       if (cursorCreatedAt) {
003090:         query = query.where('createdAt', '<', cursorCreatedAt);
003091:       }
003092:       const snapshot = await query
003093:         .orderBy('createdAt', 'desc')
003094:         .limit(limit + 1)
003095:         .get();
003096:       return sliceAuditLogsPage(snapshot.docs.map((doc) => docToData(doc)), limit);
003097:     } catch (error) {
003098:       if (!isIndexBuildingError(error)) {
003099:         throw error;
003100:       }
003101:       logger.warn('Platform audit log index still building; falling back to in-memory sort.');
003102:       console.error('Firestore index error - click the link below to create the index:');
003103:       console.error(error.message || error);
003104:       const snapshot = await platformAuditLogsCollection.get();
003105:       let logs = sortAuditLogsByCreatedAtDesc(snapshot.docs.map((doc) => docToData(doc)));
003106:       if (cursorCreatedAt) {
003107:         const cursorMillis = toMillis(cursorCreatedAt);
003108:         logs = logs.filter((log) => toMillis(log?.createdAt) < cursorMillis);
003109:       }
003110:       return sliceAuditLogsPage(logs, limit);
003111:     }
003112:   },
003113: 
003114:   async listPageFromOffset(options = {}) {
003115:     const limit = normalizeAuditPageLimit(options?.limit, 100, 500);
003116:     let remainingOffset = Number.parseInt(options?.offset, 10);
003117:     if (!Number.isInteger(remainingOffset) || remainingOffset <= 0) {
003118:       return this.listPage({ limit });
003119:     }
003120: 
003121:     let cursor = null;
003122:     while (remainingOffset > 0) {
003123:       const skipLimit = Math.min(remainingOffset, 500);
003124:       const skippedPage = await this.listPage({ limit: skipLimit, cursor });
003125:       if (skippedPage.items.length === 0) {
003126:         return { items: [], hasMore: false, nextCursor: null };
003127:       }
003128:       remainingOffset -= skippedPage.items.length;
003129:       cursor = skippedPage.nextCursor;
003130:       if (!cursor && remainingOffset > 0) {
003131:         return { items: [], hasMore: false, nextCursor: null };
003132:       }
003133:     }
003134: 
003135:     return this.listPage({ limit, cursor });
003136:   },
003137: 
003138:   async list(limit = 100, offset = 0) {
003139:     const page = await this.listPageFromOffset({ limit, offset });
003140:     return page.items;
003141:   },
003142: };
```

```text
000001: /**
```

```text
000001: import crypto from 'crypto';
000002: import path from 'path';

000005: const DEFAULT_TTL_SECONDS = 300;
000006: const MAX_TTL_SECONDS = 3600;
000007: 
000008: const getSigningSecret = () => {
000009:   const secret = process.env.LOCAL_STORAGE_SIGNING_SECRET
000010:     || process.env.JWT_SECRET
000011:     || process.env.FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID

000016: export const normalizeUploadsPublicPath = (value) => {
000017:   if (!value || typeof value !== 'string') return null;
000018:   const trimmed = value.trim();
000019:   if (!trimmed) return null;
000020: 
000021:   const normalizedSlashes = trimmed.replaceAll('\\', '/');
000022:   if (normalizedSlashes.includes('..')) return null;
000023: 
000024:   if (normalizedSlashes.startsWith('/uploads/')) {
000025:     return normalizedSlashes;
000026:   }
000027:   if (normalizedSlashes.startsWith('uploads/')) {
000028:     return `/${normalizedSlashes}`;
000029:   }
000030: 
000031:   const knownUploadPrefixes = [
000032:     'profile-photos/',
000033:     'resumes/',
000034:     'company-logos/',
000035:     'company-verifications/',
000036:     'job-advert-images/',
000037:     'job-advert-videos/',
000038:   ];
000039:   const lower = normalizedSlashes.toLowerCase();
000040:   const hasKnownPrefix = knownUploadPrefixes.some((prefix) => lower.startsWith(prefix));
000041:   if (!hasKnownPrefix) return null;
000042: 
000043:   return `/uploads/${normalizedSlashes}`;
000044: };
000045: 
000046: export const resolveUploadsAbsolutePath = (publicPath) => {
000047:   const normalizedPath = normalizeUploadsPublicPath(publicPath);
000048:   if (!normalizedPath) return null;
000049: 
000050:   const uploadsRoot = path.resolve(uploadsPaths.root);
000051:   const relativePath = normalizedPath.replace(/^\/uploads\//, '');
000052:   const absolutePath = path.resolve(uploadsRoot, relativePath);
000053: 
000054:   if (absolutePath === uploadsRoot) return null;
000055:   if (!absolutePath.startsWith(`${uploadsRoot}${path.sep}`)) return null;
000056:   return absolutePath;
000057: };
000058: 
000059: export const toSafeTtlSeconds = (value) => {
000060:   const parsed = Number.parseInt(value, 10);
000061:   if (!Number.isInteger(parsed) || parsed <= 0) return DEFAULT_TTL_SECONDS;
000062:   return Math.min(parsed, MAX_TTL_SECONDS);
000063: };
000064: 
000065: const buildSignature = ({ path: signedPath, expiresAt }) => {
000066:   const payload = `${signedPath}:${expiresAt}`;
000067:   return crypto
000068:     .createHmac('sha256', getSigningSecret())
000069:     .update(payload)
000070:     .digest('hex');
000071: };
000072: 
000073: const safeTimingEqual = (a, b) => {
000074:   if (!a || !b || a.length !== b.length) return false;
000075:   try {
000076:     return crypto.timingSafeEqual(Buffer.from(a), Buffer.from(b));
000077:   } catch {
000078:     return false;
000079:   }
000080: };
000081: 
000082: export const createSignedDownloadPath = ({ publicPath, expiresInSeconds = DEFAULT_TTL_SECONDS }) => {
000083:   const normalizedPath = normalizeUploadsPublicPath(publicPath);
000084:   if (!normalizedPath) return null;
000085: 
000086:   const ttlSeconds = toSafeTtlSeconds(expiresInSeconds);
000087:   const expiresAt = Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000) + ttlSeconds;
000088:   const signature = buildSignature({
000089:     path: normalizedPath,
000090:     expiresAt,
000091:   });
000092:   const query = new URLSearchParams({
000093:     path: normalizedPath,
000094:     expiresAt: String(expiresAt),
000095:     signature,
000096:   });
000097:   return `/api/object-storage/download?${query.toString()}`;
000098: };
000099: 
000100: export const verifySignedDownloadQuery = ({
000101:   publicPath,
000102:   expiresAt,
000103:   signature,
000104:   nowEpochSeconds = Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000),
000105: }) => {
000106:   const normalizedPath = normalizeUploadsPublicPath(publicPath);
000107:   if (!normalizedPath) return { valid: false, code: 'INVALID_PATH' };
000108: 
000109:   const parsedExpiresAt = Number.parseInt(expiresAt, 10);
000110:   if (!Number.isInteger(parsedExpiresAt)) {
000111:     return { valid: false, code: 'INVALID_EXPIRY' };
000112:   }
000113:   if (parsedExpiresAt < nowEpochSeconds) {
000114:     return { valid: false, code: 'EXPIRED' };
000115:   }
000116: 
000117:   const expectedSignature = buildSignature({
000118:     path: normalizedPath,
000119:     expiresAt: parsedExpiresAt,
000120:   });
000121:   if (!safeTimingEqual(expectedSignature, String(signature || ''))) {
000122:     return { valid: false, code: 'INVALID_SIGNATURE' };
000123:   }
000124: 
000125:   return {
000126:     valid: true,
000127:     code: null,
```

### 13.2.134 `server/src/utils/auditLogPagination.util.js`

```text
000001: const toMillis = (value) => {
000002:   if (!value) return 0;
000003:   if (typeof value === 'number') return value;
000004:   if (value instanceof Date) return value.getTime();
000005:   if (typeof value === 'string') {
000006:     const parsed = Date.parse(value);
000007:     return Number.isNaN(parsed) ? 0 : parsed;
000008:   }
000009:   if (typeof value?.toMillis === 'function') return value.toMillis();
000010:   if (typeof value?.toDate === 'function') return value.toDate().getTime();
000011:   return 0;
000012: };
000013: 
000014: export const normalizeAuditPageLimit = (value, fallback = 100, max = 500) => {
000015:   const parsed = Number.parseInt(value, 10);
000016:   if (!Number.isInteger(parsed) || parsed <= 0) {
000017:     return fallback;
000018:   }
000019:   return Math.min(parsed, max);
000020: };
000021: 
000022: export const encodeAuditCursor = (log) => {
000023:   const createdAt = log?.createdAt;
000024:   if (!createdAt) return null;
000025:   const payload = {
000026:     createdAt: String(createdAt),
000027:     id: log?.id ? String(log.id) : null,
000028:   };
000029:   return Buffer.from(JSON.stringify(payload), 'utf8').toString('base64url');
000030: };
000031: 
000032: export const decodeAuditCursor = (cursor) => {
000033:   if (!cursor) return null;
000034:   const raw = String(cursor).trim();
000035:   if (!raw) return null;
000036: 
000037:   try {
000038:     const normalized = raw.replace(/-/g, '+').replace(/_/g, '/');
000039:     const padded = normalized.padEnd(normalized.length + ((4 - (normalized.length % 4)) % 4), '=');
000040:     const parsed = JSON.parse(Buffer.from(padded, 'base64').toString('utf8'));
000041:     if (!parsed || typeof parsed !== 'object') return null;
000042:     if (!parsed.createdAt || typeof parsed.createdAt !== 'string') return null;
000043:     return {
000044:       createdAt: parsed.createdAt,
000045:       id: parsed.id ? String(parsed.id) : null,
000046:     };
000047:   } catch (_error) {
000048:     return null;
000049:   }
000050: };
000051: 
000052: export const sortAuditLogsByCreatedAtDesc = (logs = []) =>
000053:   logs
000054:     .filter(Boolean)
000055:     .sort((a, b) => {
000056:       const createdAtDiff = toMillis(b?.createdAt) - toMillis(a?.createdAt);
000057:       if (createdAtDiff !== 0) return createdAtDiff;
000058:       return String(b?.id || '').localeCompare(String(a?.id || ''));
000059:     });
000060: 
000061: export const sliceAuditLogsPage = (logs = [], limit = 100) => {
000062:   const safeLimit = normalizeAuditPageLimit(limit, 100, 500);
000063:   const hasMore = logs.length > safeLimit;
000064:   const items = logs.slice(0, safeLimit);
000065:   const nextCursor = hasMore && items.length > 0
000066:     ? encodeAuditCursor(items[items.length - 1])
000067:     : null;
000068:   return {
000069:     items,
000070:     hasMore,
000071:     nextCursor,
000072:   };
000073: };
000074: 
```
