000001: const DEFAULT_LOCK_STALE_MS = 2 * 60 * 1000;
000002: 
000003: const toMillis = (value) => {
000004:   if (!value) return 0;
000005:   if (typeof value === 'number') return value;
000006:   if (value instanceof Date) return value.getTime();
000007:   if (typeof value === 'string') {
000008:     const parsed = Date.parse(value);
000009:     return Number.isNaN(parsed) ? 0 : parsed;
000010:   }
000011:   if (typeof value?.toMillis === 'function') return value.toMillis();
000012:   if (typeof value?.toDate === 'function') return value.toDate().getTime();
000013:   return 0;
000014: };
000015: 
000016: export const INVITATION_ACCEPTANCE_CLAIM_STATUS = {
000017:   CLAIM_ALLOWED: 'CLAIM_ALLOWED',
000018:   IN_PROGRESS: 'IN_PROGRESS',
000019:   ALREADY_COMPLETED: 'ALREADY_COMPLETED',
000020:   EXPIRED: 'EXPIRED',
000021:   UNAVAILABLE: 'UNAVAILABLE',
000022: };
000023: 
000024: export const isInvitationAcceptanceLockStale = (
000025:   invitation,
000026:   nowValue = new Date().toISOString(),
000027:   staleAfterMs = DEFAULT_LOCK_STALE_MS,
000028: ) => {
000029:   if (!invitation?.acceptanceInProgress) return false;
000030:   const lockStartedAt = invitation.acceptanceStartedAt || invitation.updatedAt || invitation.acceptedAt;
000031:   const lockStartedAtMs = toMillis(lockStartedAt);
000032:   if (!lockStartedAtMs) return true;
000033:   const nowMs = toMillis(nowValue) || Date.now();
000034:   return nowMs - lockStartedAtMs > staleAfterMs;
000035: };
000036: 
000037: export const evaluateInvitationAcceptanceClaim = (
000038:   invitation,
000039:   userId,
000040:   nowValue = new Date().toISOString(),
000041: ) => {
000042:   if (!invitation) {
000043:     return INVITATION_ACCEPTANCE_CLAIM_STATUS.UNAVAILABLE;
000044:   }
000045: 
000046:   const status = String(invitation.status || '').toUpperCase();
000047:   const isExpired = invitation.expiresAt && new Date(invitation.expiresAt) < new Date(nowValue);
000048: 
000049:   if (status === 'PENDING' && isExpired) {
000050:     return INVITATION_ACCEPTANCE_CLAIM_STATUS.EXPIRED;
000051:   }
000052: 
000053:   const sameCandidate = !invitation.candidateUserId || invitation.candidateUserId === userId;
000054:   const hasAcceptedInterview = Boolean(invitation.acceptedInterviewId || invitation.interviewId);
000055:   const lockStale = isInvitationAcceptanceLockStale(invitation, nowValue);
000056: 
000057:   if (status === 'ACCEPTED') {
000058:     if (!sameCandidate) return INVITATION_ACCEPTANCE_CLAIM_STATUS.UNAVAILABLE;
000059:     if (hasAcceptedInterview) return INVITATION_ACCEPTANCE_CLAIM_STATUS.ALREADY_COMPLETED;
000060:     if (invitation.acceptanceInProgress && !lockStale) return INVITATION_ACCEPTANCE_CLAIM_STATUS.IN_PROGRESS;
000061:     return INVITATION_ACCEPTANCE_CLAIM_STATUS.CLAIM_ALLOWED;
000062:   }
000063: 
000064:   if (status === 'PENDING') {
000065:     if (invitation.acceptanceInProgress && !lockStale) return INVITATION_ACCEPTANCE_CLAIM_STATUS.IN_PROGRESS;
000066:     return INVITATION_ACCEPTANCE_CLAIM_STATUS.CLAIM_ALLOWED;
000067:   }
000068: 
000069:   return INVITATION_ACCEPTANCE_CLAIM_STATUS.UNAVAILABLE;
000070: };
000071:

000001: """

000006: import os

000010: # Add CUDA library paths to system PATH

000016:         nvidia_dirs = [
000017:             os.path.join(sp, 'nvidia', 'cublas', 'bin'),
000018:             os.path.join(sp, 'nvidia', 'cudnn', 'bin'),
000019:             os.path.join(sp, 'nvidia', 'cuda_runtime', 'bin'),
000020:         ]
000021:         for nv_dir in nvidia_dirs:
000022:             if os.path.exists(nv_dir):
000023:                 os.environ['PATH'] = nv_dir + os.pathsep + os.environ.get('PATH', '')
000024:                 print(f"Added to PATH: {nv_dir}")
000025: 
000026: setup_cuda_paths()

000028: from flask import Flask, request, jsonify
000029: from flask_cors import CORS
000030: from faster_whisper import WhisperModel
000031: import tempfile
000032: import logging
000033: 
000034: app = Flask(__name__)
000035: # Enable CORS for all origins (development mode)
000036: CORS(app, resources={
000037:     r"/*": {
000038:         "origins": "*",
000039:         "methods": ["GET", "POST", "OPTIONS"],
000040:         "allow_headers": ["*"]
000041:     }
000042: })
000043: 
000044: # Configure logging
000045: logging.basicConfig(level=logging.INFO)
000046: logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)
000047: 
000048: DEFAULT_MODEL = "large-v3"
000049: env_model = os.getenv("WHISPER_MODEL", "").strip()
000050: MODEL_SIZE = env_model or DEFAULT_MODEL
000051: DEVICE = "cuda"
000052: COMPUTE_TYPE = "float16"
000053: 
000054: if env_model:
000055:     logger.info("Loading Whisper model from WHISPER_MODEL env: %s", MODEL_SIZE)
000056: else:
000057:     logger.warning(
000058:         "WHISPER_MODEL env var is missing; using default model '%s'.",
000059:         DEFAULT_MODEL,
000060:     )
000061:     logger.info("Loading Whisper model: %s", MODEL_SIZE)
000062: try:
000063:     model = WhisperModel(MODEL_SIZE, device=DEVICE, compute_type=COMPUTE_TYPE)
000064:     logger.info(f"✓ Whisper model loaded on {DEVICE}")
000065: except Exception as e:
000066:     logger.error(f"Failed to load model on GPU, falling back to CPU: {e}")
000067:     DEVICE = "cpu"
000068:     COMPUTE_TYPE = "int8"
000069:     model = WhisperModel(MODEL_SIZE, device=DEVICE, compute_type=COMPUTE_TYPE)
000070:     logger.info(f"✓ Whisper model loaded on {DEVICE}")
000071: 
000072: @app.route('/health', methods=['GET', 'OPTIONS'])
000073: def health():
000074:     """Health check endpoint"""
000075:     logger.info("Health check requested")
000076:     response = jsonify({
000077:         'status': 'healthy',
000078:         'model': MODEL_SIZE,
000079:         'device': DEVICE,
000080:         'compute_type': COMPUTE_TYPE
000081:     })
000082:     return response
000083: 
000084: @app.route('/transcribe', methods=['POST'])
000085: def transcribe():
000086:     """
000087:     Transcribe audio file to text
000088:     Expects: multipart/form-data with 'audio' field
000089:     Returns: { text: string, language: string, segments: array }
000090:     """
000091:     try:
000092:         # Check if audio file is present
000093:         if 'audio' not in request.files:
000094:             return jsonify({'error': 'No audio file provided'}), 400
000095:         
000096:         audio_file = request.files['audio']
000097:         filename = audio_file.filename or ''
000098:         _, ext = os.path.splitext(filename)
000099:         suffix = ext if ext else '.webm'
000100:         
000101:         # Save to temporary file
000102:         with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(delete=False, suffix=suffix) as temp_file:
000103:             audio_file.save(temp_file.name)
000104:             temp_path = temp_file.name
000105:         
000106:         logger.info(f"Transcribing audio file: {temp_path}")
000107: 
000108:         language = request.form.get('language', '').strip().lower()
000109:         if not language:
000110:             language = 'en'
000111:         if language == 'auto':
000112:             language = None
000113: 
000114:         task = request.form.get('task', '').strip().lower()
000115:         if task not in ('transcribe', 'translate'):
000116:             task = 'transcribe'
000117:         
000118:         # Transcribe with faster-whisper (optimized for accuracy)
000119:         segments, info = model.transcribe(
000120:             temp_path,
000121:             language=language,  # Default to English unless specified
000122:             task=task,
000123:             beam_size=5,  # Higher beam search for better accuracy
000124:             best_of=5,  # More candidates for better quality
000125:             vad_filter=True,  # Voice Activity Detection (removes silence)
000126:             vad_parameters=dict(min_silence_duration_ms=300),  # More aggressive silence removal
000127:             temperature=0.0,  # Deterministic output
000128:             condition_on_previous_text=True  # Use context for better accuracy
000129:         )
000130:         
000131:         # Collect segments
000132:         transcription_segments = []
000133:         full_text = ""
000134:         
000135:         for segment in segments:
000136:             segment_data = {
000137:                 'start': segment.start,
000138:                 'end': segment.end,
000139:                 'text': segment.text,
000140:                 'confidence': segment.avg_logprob
000141:             }
000142:             transcription_segments.append(segment_data)
000143:             full_text += segment.text + " "
000144:         
000145:         full_text = full_text.strip()
000146:         
000147:         logger.info(f"Transcription complete: {len(full_text)} characters")
000148:         
000149:         # Clean up temp file
000150:         os.unlink(temp_path)
000151:         
000152:         # Return result
000153:         return jsonify({
000154:             'success': True,
000155:             'text': full_text,
000156:             'language': info.language,
000157:             'language_probability': info.language_probability,
000158:             'duration': info.duration,
000159:             'segments': transcription_segments
000160:         })
000161:     
000162:     except Exception as e:
000163:         logger.error(f"Transcription error: {str(e)}")
000164:         return jsonify({
000165:             'success': False,
000166:             'error': str(e)
000167:         }), 500
000168: 
000169: @app.route('/models', methods=['GET'])
000170: def list_models():
000171:     """List available Whisper models"""
000172:     models = {
000173:         'tiny': {'size': '39 MB', 'speed': 'Fastest', 'quality': 'Basic'},
000174:         'base': {'size': '74 MB', 'speed': 'Very Fast', 'quality': 'Good'},
000175:         'small': {'size': '244 MB', 'speed': 'Fast', 'quality': 'Very Good'},
000176:         'medium': {'size': '769 MB', 'speed': 'Moderate', 'quality': 'Excellent'},
000177:         'large-v3': {'size': '1550 MB', 'speed': 'Slower', 'quality': 'Best'}
000178:     }
000179:     return jsonify({

000181:         'available_models': models,

000183:     })
000184: 
000185: if __name__ == '__main__':
000186:     port = int(os.getenv('WHISPER_PORT', 5000))
000187:     logger.info(f"Starting Whisper server on port {port}")
000188:     logger.info(f"Model: {MODEL_SIZE} | Device: {DEVICE} | Compute: {COMPUTE_TYPE}")
000189:     try:
000190:         app.run(host='0.0.0.0', port=port, debug=False, threaded=True)
000191:     except KeyboardInterrupt:

000193:     except Exception as e:
000194:         logger.error(f"Server error: {e}")

000001: import React from 'react';

000004: 
000005: const BrandMark = ({
000006:   showTagline = false,
000007:   className = '',
000008:   iconWrapperClassName = 'w-9 h-9 sm:w-10 sm:h-10',

000013:   clickable = true,
000014: }) => {
000015:   const navigate = useNavigate?.();
000016: 
000017:   const handleActivate = (event) => {
000018:     if (!clickable || !navigate) return;
000019:     // Allow callers to prevent navigation
000020:     if (event?.defaultPrevented) return;
000021:     navigate('/');
000022:   };
000023: 
000024:   const handleKeyDown = (event) => {

000029:   };
000030: 
000031:   return (
000032:     <div
000033:       className={`flex items-start space-x-2 ${clickable ? 'cursor-pointer select-none' : ''} ${className}`}
000034:       role={clickable ? 'button' : undefined}

000036:       onClick={handleActivate}

000038:     >
000039:       <div

000052:           </span>

000055:     </div>

000003: 
000004: class ErrorBoundary extends React.Component {
000005:   constructor(props) {
000006:     super(props);
000007:     this.state = { hasError: false };
000008:   }
000009: 
000010:   static getDerivedStateFromError(error) {
000011:     return { hasError: true };
000012:   }

000035:   const storage = storageType === 'local' ? window.localStorage : window.sessionStorage;
000036:   storage.setItem(key, value);
000037: };
000038: 
000039: const clearStorageValue = (key, storageType = 'session') => {
000040:   if (typeof window === 'undefined') return;
000041:   const storage = storageType === 'local' ? window.localStorage : window.sessionStorage;
000042:   storage.removeItem(key);
000043: };
000044: 
000045: const getCompanyName = (user) =>
000046:   user?.companyName ||
000047:   user?.organizationContext?.organization?.displayName ||
000048:   user?.organizationContext?.organization?.name ||
000049:   '';
000050: 
000051: const getAccountDisplayName = (user) => {
000052:   if (!user) return '';
000053:   const baseName = user.fullName || user.email || 'InterviewAI Member';
000054:   const accountType = (user.accountType || '').toUpperCase();
000055:   if (accountType === 'COMPANY') {
000056:     const company = getCompanyName(user);
000057:     return company ? `${baseName} - ${company}` : baseName;
000058:   }
000059:   return baseName;
000060: };
000061: 
000062: const formatTimestamp = (value) => {
000063:   if (!value) return '';
000064:   const timestamp = typeof value === 'number' ? value : Date.parse(value);
000065:   if (!Number.isFinite(timestamp)) return '';
000066:   return new Date(timestamp).toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' });
000067: };
000068: 
000069: const DashboardLiveChatTab = ({ sizeSettings, isActive = true }) => {
000070:   const { user } = useAuth();
000071:   const { error: showError, success: showSuccess } = useToast();
000072:   const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(false);
000073:   const [chatSessionId, setChatSessionId] = useState(getStorageValue(CHAT_SESSION_KEY, ''));
000074:   const [chatStatus, setChatStatus] = useState('open');
000075:   const [messages, setMessages] = useState([]);
000076:   const [messageDraft, setMessageDraft] = useState('');
000077:   const [displayName, setDisplayName] = useState(getStorageValue(CHAT_NAME_KEY, '', 'local'));
000078:   const [nameDraft, setNameDraft] = useState(displayName);
000079:   const [isEditingName, setIsEditingName] = useState(false);
000080:   const [nameOverride, setNameOverride] = useState(getStorageValue(CHAT_NAME_OVERRIDE_KEY, '', 'local') === 'true');
000081:   const messagesEndRef = useRef(null);
000082:   const messageInputRef = useRef(null);
000083:   const guestNameInputRef = useRef(null);
000084:   const suggestionsTimerRef = useRef(null);
000085:   const lastSuggestionKeyRef = useRef('');
000086:   const [suggestions, setSuggestions] = useState([]);
000087:   const lastAccountTypeRef = useRef(getStorageValue(CHAT_LAST_ACCOUNT_TYPE_KEY, 'ANONYMOUS', 'local'));
000088:   const { getChatSuggestions, loading: suggestionsLoading } = useLLM();
000089:   const canStartChat = Boolean((nameDraft || guestNameInputRef.current?.value || '').trim());
000090: 
000091:   const accountDisplayName = useMemo(() => getAccountDisplayName(user), [user]);
000092:   const accountType = (user?.accountType || 'ANONYMOUS').toUpperCase();
000093: 
000094:   useEffect(() => {
000095:     const normalizedAccountType = accountType || 'ANONYMOUS';
000096:     const previousAccountType = lastAccountTypeRef.current || 'ANONYMOUS';
000097:     const hasAccountName = Boolean(accountDisplayName);
000098:     const accountTypeChanged = normalizedAccountType !== previousAccountType;
000099: 
000100:     if (normalizedAccountType === 'SYSTEM_ADMIN') {
000101:       lastAccountTypeRef.current = normalizedAccountType;
000102:       setStorageValue(CHAT_LAST_ACCOUNT_TYPE_KEY, normalizedAccountType, 'local');
000103:       return;
000104:     }
000105: 
000106:     if (accountTypeChanged) {
000107:       lastAccountTypeRef.current = normalizedAccountType;
000108:       setStorageValue(CHAT_LAST_ACCOUNT_TYPE_KEY, normalizedAccountType, 'local');
000109:       if (normalizedAccountType !== 'ANONYMOUS' && hasAccountName) {
000110:         setDisplayName(accountDisplayName);
000111:         setNameDraft(accountDisplayName);
000112:         setNameOverride(false);
000113:         setStorageValue(CHAT_NAME_OVERRIDE_KEY, 'false', 'local');
000114:         setStorageValue(CHAT_NAME_KEY, accountDisplayName, 'local');
000115:         if (chatSessionId && realtimeDb) {
000116:           update(ref(realtimeDb, `${CHAT_ROOT}/${chatSessionId}/user`), {
000117:             displayName: accountDisplayName,
000118:             accountType: normalizedAccountType
000119:           }).catch(() => {});
000120:         }
000121:       }
000122:       return;
000123:     }
000124: 
000125:     if (normalizedAccountType !== 'ANONYMOUS' && hasAccountName && !nameOverride && displayName !== accountDisplayName) {
000126:       setDisplayName(accountDisplayName);
000127:       setNameDraft(accountDisplayName);
000128:       setStorageValue(CHAT_NAME_KEY, accountDisplayName, 'local');
000129:       if (chatSessionId && realtimeDb) {
000130:         update(ref(realtimeDb, `${CHAT_ROOT}/${chatSessionId}/user`), {
000131:           displayName: accountDisplayName,
000132:           accountType: normalizedAccountType
000133:         }).catch(() => {});
000134:       }
000135:     }
000136:   }, [accountDisplayName, accountType, chatSessionId, displayName, nameOverride]);
000137: 
000138:   useEffect(() => {
000139:     if (!chatSessionId || !realtimeDb) return;
000140:     const chatRef = ref(realtimeDb, `${CHAT_ROOT}/${chatSessionId}`);
000141:     const unsubscribe = onValue(chatRef, (snapshot) => {
000142:       const data = snapshot.val();
000143:       if (!data) return;
000144:       setChatStatus(data.status || 'open');
000145:     });
000146:     return () => unsubscribe();
000147:   }, [chatSessionId]);
000148: 
000149:   useEffect(() => {
000150:     if (!chatSessionId || !realtimeDb) return;
000151:     const messagesRef = query(
000152:       ref(realtimeDb, `${CHAT_ROOT}/${chatSessionId}/messages`),
000153:       orderByChild('createdAt'),
000154:       limitToLast(50),
000155:     );
000156:     const unsubscribe = onValue(messagesRef, (snapshot) => {
000157:       const value = snapshot.val();
000158:       if (!value) {
000159:         setMessages([]);
000160:         return;
000161:       }
000162:       const nextMessages = Object.entries(value)
000163:         .map(([id, message]) => ({ id, ...message }))
000164:         .sort((a, b) => (a.createdAt || 0) - (b.createdAt || 0));
000165:       setMessages(nextMessages);
000166:     });
000167:     return () => unsubscribe();
000168:   }, [chatSessionId]);
000169: 
000170:   useEffect(() => {
000171:     if (!isActive) return;
000172:     messagesEndRef.current?.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'end' });
000173:   }, [messages, isActive]);
000174: 
000175:   const resizeMessageInput = useCallback(() => {
000176:     if (typeof window === 'undefined') return;
000177:     const input = messageInputRef.current;
000178:     if (!input) return;
000179:     input.style.height = 'auto';
000180:     const minHeight = parseFloat(window.getComputedStyle(input).minHeight || '0');
000181:     input.style.height = `${Math.max(input.scrollHeight, minHeight)}px`;
000182:   }, []);
000183: 
000184:   useEffect(() => {
000185:     if (!isActive) return;
000186:     resizeMessageInput();
000187:   }, [messageDraft, isActive, resizeMessageInput]);
000188: 
000189:   const conversationForLLM = useMemo(() => (
000190:     messages
000191:       .filter((message) => message?.text)
000192:       .map((message) => ({
000193:         role: message?.sender?.role === 'user' ? 'user' : 'assistant',
000194:         content: message.text
000195:       }))
000196:   ), [messages]);
000197: 
000198:   const lastMessageRole = messages.length > 0 ? messages[messages.length - 1]?.sender?.role : null;
000199:   const shouldShowSuggestions = messages.length === 0 || lastMessageRole !== 'user';
000200: 
000201:   const fallbackSuggestions = useMemo(() => ([
000202:     'Hi! I need help getting started with InterviewAI Pro.',
000203:     'Can you guide me on practice interviews or live sessions?',
000204:     'I have a question about accounts or dashboards.'
000205:   ]), []);
000206: 
000207:   useEffect(() => {
000208:     if (!isActive) return;
000209:     if (!shouldShowSuggestions) {
000210:       setSuggestions([]);
000211:       return;
000212:     }
000213:     const suggestionKey = `${conversationForLLM.length}:${conversationForLLM.map((msg) => `${msg.role}:${msg.content}`).join('|')}`;
000214:     if (suggestionKey === lastSuggestionKeyRef.current) return;
000215:     lastSuggestionKeyRef.current = suggestionKey;
000216: 
000217:     if (suggestionsTimerRef.current) {
000218:       clearTimeout(suggestionsTimerRef.current);
000219:     }
000220: 
000221:     suggestionsTimerRef.current = setTimeout(async () => {
000222:       try {
000223:         const result = await getChatSuggestions({
000224:           role: 'visitor',
000225:           audience: accountType,
000226:           conversation: conversationForLLM
000227:         });
000228:         if (result?.suggestions?.length) {
000229:           setSuggestions(result.suggestions);
000230:         } else {
000231:           setSuggestions(fallbackSuggestions);
000232:         }
000233:       } catch (error) {
000234:         setSuggestions(fallbackSuggestions);
000235:       }
000236:     }, 500);
000237: 
000238:     return () => {
000239:       if (suggestionsTimerRef.current) {
000240:         clearTimeout(suggestionsTimerRef.current);
000241:       }
000242:     };
000243:   }, [conversationForLLM, fallbackSuggestions, getChatSuggestions, isActive, shouldShowSuggestions, accountType]);
000244: 
000245:   const resetSession = useCallback(() => {
000246:     clearStorageValue(CHAT_SESSION_KEY);
000247:     setChatSessionId('');
000248:     setMessages([]);
000249:     setChatStatus('open');
000250:   }, []);
000251: 
000252:   const ensureAuthUser = useCallback(async () => {
000253:     if (auth.currentUser) return auth.currentUser;
000254:     const currentUser = await new Promise((resolve) => {
000255:       const unsubscribe = onAuthStateChanged(auth, (nextUser) => {
000256:         unsubscribe();
000257:         resolve(nextUser);
000258:       });
000259:     });
000260:     if (currentUser) return currentUser;
000261:     const result = await authHelpers.signInAnonymously();
000262:     if (result?.error) {
000263:       throw result.error;
000264:     }
000265:     return auth.currentUser;
000266:   }, []);
000267: 
000268:   const ensureChatSession = useCallback(async (overrideName = '') => {
000269:     if (!realtimeDb) {
000270:       throw new Error('Realtime database is not configured.');
000271:     }
000272:     if (chatSessionId) return chatSessionId;
000273: 
000274:     const trimmedName = (overrideName || displayName).trim();
000275:     if (!trimmedName) {
000276:       throw new Error('Please enter your name to start the chat.');
000277:     }
000278: 
000279:     const authUser = await ensureAuthUser();
000280:     const chatRef = push(ref(realtimeDb, CHAT_ROOT));
000281:     const companyName = accountType === 'COMPANY' ? getCompanyName(user) : '';
000282: 
000283:     const payload = {
000284:       status: 'open',
000285:       createdAt: serverTimestamp(),
000286:       lastMessageAt: serverTimestamp(),
000287:       lastMessagePreview: 'Session started',
000288:       user: {
000289:         uid: authUser.uid,
000290:         displayName: trimmedName,
000291:         accountType,
000292:         email: user?.email || null,
000293:         companyName: companyName || null,
000294:         userId: user?.id || null,
000295:       },
000296:     };
000297: 
000298:     await set(chatRef, payload);
000299:     const newChatId = chatRef.key;
000300:     setChatSessionId(newChatId);
000301:     setStorageValue(CHAT_SESSION_KEY, newChatId);
000302:     setChatStatus('open');
000303:     return newChatId;
000304:   }, [accountType, chatSessionId, displayName, ensureAuthUser, user]);
000305: 
000306:   const updateDisplayName = useCallback(async () => {
000307:     const trimmedName = nameDraft.trim();
000308:     if (!trimmedName) {
000309:       showError('Please enter a valid name.');
000310:       return;
000311:     }
000312:     setDisplayName(trimmedName);
000313:     setStorageValue(CHAT_NAME_KEY, trimmedName, 'local');
000314:     setStorageValue(CHAT_NAME_OVERRIDE_KEY, 'true', 'local');
000315:     setNameOverride(true);
000316:     setIsEditingName(false);
000317: 
000318:     if (chatSessionId && realtimeDb) {
000319:       await update(ref(realtimeDb, `${CHAT_ROOT}/${chatSessionId}/user`), {
000320:         displayName: trimmedName,
000321:       });
000322:     }
000323:   }, [chatSessionId, nameDraft, showError]);
000324: 
000325:   const handleStartChat = useCallback(async () => {
000326:     try {
000327:       setIsLoading(true);
000328:       const resolvedName = guestNameInputRef.current?.value || nameDraft;
000329:       const trimmedName = resolvedName.trim();
000330:       if (!trimmedName) {
000331:         showError('Please enter your name to start the chat.');
000332:         return;
000333:       }
000334:       setNameDraft(trimmedName);
000335:       setDisplayName(trimmedName);
000336:       setStorageValue(CHAT_NAME_KEY, trimmedName, 'local');
000337:       setStorageValue(CHAT_NAME_OVERRIDE_KEY, 'true', 'local');
000338:       setNameOverride(true);
000339:       await ensureChatSession(trimmedName);
000340:       showSuccess('Chat session started.');
000341:     } catch (error) {
000342:       showError(error?.message || 'Unable to start chat.');
000343:     } finally {
000344:       setIsLoading(false);
000345:     }
000346:   }, [ensureChatSession, nameDraft, showError, showSuccess]);
000347: 
000348:   const handleSendMessage = useCallback(async () => {
000349:     const trimmedMessage = messageDraft.trim();
000350:     if (!trimmedMessage) return;
000351:     if (trimmedMessage.length > MAX_MESSAGE_LENGTH) {
000352:       showError(`Message is too long. Please keep it under ${MAX_MESSAGE_LENGTH} characters.`);
000353:       return;
000354:     }
000355: 
000356:     try {
000357:       setIsLoading(true);
000358:       const chatId = await ensureChatSession();
000359:       const authUser = await ensureAuthUser();
000360: 
000361:       const messageRef = push(ref(realtimeDb, `${CHAT_ROOT}/${chatId}/messages`));
000362:       await set(messageRef, {
000363:         text: trimmedMessage,
000364:         createdAt: serverTimestamp(),
000365:         sender: {
000366:           uid: authUser.uid,
000367:           role: 'user',
000368:           displayName: displayName.trim(),
000369:         },
000370:       });
000371: 
000372:       await update(ref(realtimeDb, `${CHAT_ROOT}/${chatId}`), {
000373:         lastMessageAt: serverTimestamp(),
000374:         lastMessagePreview: trimmedMessage.slice(0, 160),
000375:         status: 'open',
000376:       });
000377: 
000378:       setMessageDraft('');
000379:     } catch (error) {
000380:       showError(error?.message || 'Failed to send message.');
000381:     } finally {
000382:       setIsLoading(false);
000383:     }
000384:   }, [displayName, ensureAuthUser, ensureChatSession, messageDraft, showError]);
000385: 
000386:   const handleEndSession = useCallback(async () => {
000387:     if (!chatSessionId || !realtimeDb) {
000388:       resetSession();
000389:       return;
000390:     }
000391:     try {
000392:       setIsLoading(true);
000393:       await update(ref(realtimeDb, `${CHAT_ROOT}/${chatSessionId}`), {
000394:         status: 'closed',
000395:         closedAt: serverTimestamp(),
000396:       });
000397:       resetSession();
000398:     } catch (error) {
000399:       showError(error?.message || 'Unable to close the session.');
000400:     } finally {
000401:       setIsLoading(false);
000402:     }
000403:   }, [chatSessionId, resetSession, showError]);
000404: 
000405:   const handleMessageKeyDown = (event) => {
000406:     if (event.key === 'Enter' && !event.shiftKey) {
000407:       event.preventDefault();
000408:       handleSendMessage();
000409:     }
000410:   };
000411: 
000412:   const handleSuggestionClick = (text) => {
000413:     setMessageDraft(text);
000414:     requestAnimationFrame(() => {
000415:       resizeMessageInput();
000416:       if (messageInputRef.current) {
000417:         messageInputRef.current.focus();
000418:         const length = messageInputRef.current.value.length;
000419:         messageInputRef.current.setSelectionRange(length, length);
000420:       }
000421:     });
000422:   };
000423: 
000424:   return (
000425:     <>
000426:       <div className="p-4 border-b border-white/30 dark:border-slate-700/50 bg-white/70 dark:bg-slate-900/70">
000427:         <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
000428:           <div>
000429:             <p className={`${sizeSettings.heading4} uppercase tracking-wide text-gray-400 dark:text-slate-500`}>
000430:               Your name
000431:             </p>
000432:             {!isEditingName ? (
000433:               <p className={`${sizeSettings.heading3} font-semibold text-gray-900 dark:text-slate-100`}>
000434:                 {displayName || 'Guest'}
000435:               </p>
000436:             ) : (
000437:               <input
000438:                 type="text"
000439:                 value={nameDraft}
000440:                 onChange={(event) => setNameDraft(event.target.value)}
000441:                 className={`mt-2 w-full rounded-full border border-white/40 dark:border-slate-700/60 bg-white/80 dark:bg-slate-800/80 px-3 py-2 ${sizeSettings.inputText} text-gray-900 dark:text-slate-100 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-400 dark:focus:ring-blue-500`}
000442:               />
000443:             )}
000444:             <p className={`${sizeSettings.heading4} text-gray-500 dark:text-slate-400`}>
000445:               {accountType === 'ANONYMOUS' ? 'Guest visitor' : accountType.replace('_', ' ')}
000446:             </p>
000447:           </div>
000448:           <div className="flex flex-col items-end gap-2">
000449:             {isEditingName ? (
000450:               <button
000451:                 type="button"
000452:                 onClick={updateDisplayName}
000453:                 className={`${sizeSettings.heading4} font-semibold text-blue-600 hover:text-blue-700`}
000454:               >
000455:                 Save
000456:               </button>
000457:             ) : (
000458:               <button
000459:                 type="button"
000460:                 onClick={() => setIsEditingName(true)}
000461:                 className={`${sizeSettings.heading4} font-semibold text-gray-500 hover:text-gray-700 dark:hover:text-slate-200`}
000462:               >
000463:                 Edit
000464:               </button>
000465:             )}
000466:             {chatSessionId && chatStatus !== 'closed' && (
000467:               <button
000468:                 type="button"
000469:                 onClick={handleEndSession}
000470:                 className={`${sizeSettings.heading4} font-semibold px-2 py-1 rounded-full border border-gray-200 dark:border-slate-700 text-gray-600 dark:text-slate-300 hover:border-rose-300 hover:text-rose-600 dark:hover:text-rose-300 transition`}
000471:               >
000472:                 End chat
000473:               </button>
000474:             )}
000475:           </div>
000476:         </div>
000477:       </div>
000478: 
000479:       <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto p-4 space-y-4 bg-white/60 dark:bg-slate-900/60">
000480:         {messages.length === 0 && (
000481:           <div className={`text-center ${sizeSettings.bodyAssistant} text-gray-500 dark:text-slate-400`}>
000482:             {chatSessionId ? 'Say hello! We are here to help.' : 'Start a chat to connect with support.'}
000483:           </div>
000484:         )}
000485: 
000486:         {messages.map((message) => {
000487:           const isUser = message?.sender?.role === 'user';
000488:           return (
000489:             <div
000490:               key={message.id}
000491:               className={`flex ${isUser ? 'justify-end' : 'justify-start'}`}
000492:             >
000493:               <div
000494:                 className={`max-w-[80%] rounded-lg p-3 ${
000495:                   isUser
000496:                     ? 'bg-gradient-to-r from-blue-600 to-purple-600 text-white shadow-lg shadow-blue-500/30'
000497:                     : 'bg-white dark:bg-slate-800 border border-white/40 dark:border-slate-700/50 text-gray-800 dark:text-slate-200 shadow-sm'
000498:                 }`}
000499:               >
000500:                 <p className={`text-xs font-semibold ${isUser ? 'text-white/85' : 'text-gray-500 dark:text-slate-400'}`}>
000501:                   {isUser ? 'You' : message?.sender?.displayName || 'Support'}
000502:                 </p>
000503:                 <p className={`${isUser ? sizeSettings.bodyUser : sizeSettings.bodyAssistant} whitespace-pre-wrap text-left`}>{message.text}</p>
000504:                 <p className={`text-xs mt-2 ${isUser ? 'text-white/80' : 'text-gray-400 dark:text-slate-500'}`}>
000505:                   {formatTimestamp(message.createdAt)}
000506:                 </p>
000507:               </div>
000508:             </div>
000509:           );
000510:         })}
000511:         <div ref={messagesEndRef} />
000512:       </div>
000513: 
000514:       <div className="p-4 border-t border-border dark:border-slate-700/60 bg-white/80 dark:bg-slate-900/80">
000515:         {chatStatus === 'closed' ? (
000516:           <div className="space-y-3 text-center">
000517:             <p className={`${sizeSettings.statusText} text-gray-500 dark:text-slate-400`}>
000518:               This session is closed. Start a new chat to reconnect.
000519:             </p>
000520:             <Button
000521:               onClick={resetSession}
000522:               className="w-full rounded-full bg-gradient-to-r from-blue-600 to-purple-600 text-white border-none shadow-md shadow-blue-500/30 hover:from-blue-700 hover:to-purple-700"
000523:             >
000524:               Start New Chat
000525:             </Button>
000526:           </div>
000527:         ) : (
000528:           <>
000529:             {!chatSessionId && !displayName.trim() ? (
000530:               <div className="space-y-3">
000531:                 <p className={`${sizeSettings.statusText} text-gray-500 dark:text-slate-400`}>
000532:                   Tell us your name to get started.
000533:                 </p>
000534:                 <input
000535:                   ref={guestNameInputRef}
000536:                   type="text"
000537:                   value={nameDraft}
000538:                   onChange={(event) => setNameDraft(event.target.value)}
000539:                   onInput={(event) => setNameDraft(event.currentTarget.value)}
000540:                   placeholder="Your name"
000541:                   className={`w-full rounded-full border border-white/40 dark:border-slate-700/60 bg-white/80 dark:bg-slate-800/80 px-3 py-2 ${sizeSettings.inputText} text-gray-900 dark:text-slate-100 placeholder:text-gray-400 dark:placeholder:text-slate-500 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-400 dark:focus:ring-blue-500`}
000542:                 />
000543:                 <Button
000544:                   onClick={handleStartChat}
000545:                   loading={isLoading}
000546:                   disabled={isLoading || !canStartChat}
000547:                   className="w-full rounded-full bg-gradient-to-r from-blue-600 to-purple-600 text-white border-none shadow-md shadow-blue-500/30 hover:from-blue-700 hover:to-purple-700"
000548:                 >
000549:                   Start Chat
000550:                 </Button>
000551:               </div>
000552:             ) : (
000553:               <div className="space-y-3">
000554:                 {shouldShowSuggestions && (
000555:                 <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
000556:                   {suggestionsLoading ? (
000557:                     <span className="text-xs text-gray-500 dark:text-slate-400">
000558:                       Generating suggestions...
000559:                     </span>
000560:                   ) : (
000561:                     suggestions.map((suggestion, index) => (
000562:                       <Button
000563:                         key={`${suggestion}-${index}`}
000564:                         type="button"
000565:                         onClick={() => handleSuggestionClick(suggestion)}

000498:     } finally {
000499:       setIsLoading(false);
000500:     }
000501:   }, [ensureChatSession, nameDraft, showError, showSuccess]);
000502: 
000503:   const handleSendMessage = useCallback(async () => {
000504:     const trimmedMessage = messageDraft.trim();
000505:     if (!trimmedMessage) return;
000506:     if (trimmedMessage.length > MAX_MESSAGE_LENGTH) {
000507:       showError(`Message is too long. Please keep it under ${MAX_MESSAGE_LENGTH} characters.`);
000508:       return;
000509:     }
000510: 
000511:     try {
000512:       setIsLoading(true);
000513:       const chatId = await ensureChatSession();
000514:       const authUser = await ensureAuthUser();
000515: 
000516:       const messageRef = push(ref(realtimeDb, `${CHAT_ROOT}/${chatId}/messages`));
000517:       await set(messageRef, {
000518:         text: trimmedMessage,
000519:         createdAt: serverTimestamp(),
000520:         sender: {
000521:           uid: authUser.uid,
000522:           role: 'user',
000523:           displayName: displayName.trim(),
000524:         },
000525:       });
000526: 
000527:       await update(ref(realtimeDb, `${CHAT_ROOT}/${chatId}`), {
000528:         lastMessageAt: serverTimestamp(),
000529:         lastMessagePreview: trimmedMessage.slice(0, 160),
000530:         status: 'open',
000531:       });
000532: 
000533:       setMessageDraft('');
000534:     } catch (error) {
000535:       showError(error?.message || 'Failed to send message.');
000536:     } finally {
000537:       setIsLoading(false);
000538:     }
000539:   }, [displayName, ensureAuthUser, ensureChatSession, messageDraft, showError]);

000548:       await update(ref(realtimeDb, `${CHAT_ROOT}/${chatSessionId}`), {
000549:         status: 'closed',
000550:         closedAt: serverTimestamp(),
000551:       });
000552:       resetSession();
000553:     } catch (error) {
000554:       showError(error?.message || 'Unable to close the session.');
000555:     } finally {
000556:       setIsLoading(false);
000557:     }
000558:   }, [chatSessionId, resetSession, showError]);

000579:   const buildAssistantConversation = useCallback((history = []) => (
000580:     history
000581:       .filter((message) => ['assistant', 'user'].includes(message?.type))
000582:       .slice(-12)
000583:       .map((message) => ({
000584:         role: message?.type === 'assistant' ? 'assistant' : 'user',
000585:         content: message?.content || ''
000586:       }))
000587:   ), []);
000588: 
000589:   const renderAssistantInlineFormatting = (text = '', type = 'assistant') => {
000590:     if (!text) return null;
000591: 
000592:     const pattern = /(\*\*[^*]+\*\*|__[^_]+__|_[^_]+_|`[^`]+`)/g;
000593:     const segments = [];
000594:     let lastIndex = 0;
000595:     let match;
000596: 
000597:     while ((match = pattern.exec(text)) !== null) {
000598:       if (match.index > lastIndex) {
000599:         segments.push({ type: 'text', value: text.slice(lastIndex, match.index) });
000600:       }
000601: 
000602:       const token = match[0];
000603:       if (token.startsWith('**')) {
000604:         segments.push({ type: 'bold', value: token.slice(2, -2) });
000605:       } else if (token.startsWith('__')) {
000606:         segments.push({ type: 'underline', value: token.slice(2, -2) });
000607:       } else if (token.startsWith('_')) {
000608:         segments.push({ type: 'italic', value: token.slice(1, -1) });
000609:       } else if (token.startsWith('`')) {
000610:         segments.push({ type: 'code', value: token.slice(1, -1) });
000611:       }
000612:       lastIndex = pattern.lastIndex;
000613:     }
000614: 
000615:     if (lastIndex < text.length) {
000616:       segments.push({ type: 'text', value: text.slice(lastIndex) });
000617:     }
000618: 
000619:     return segments.map((segment, index) => {
000620:       const key = `${segment.type}-${type}-${index}`;
000621:       const baseColor = type === 'user' ? 'text-white' : 'text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100';
000622: 
000623:       switch (segment.type) {
000624:         case 'bold':
000625:           return (
000626:             <span key={key} className={`${baseColor} font-semibold`}>
000627:               {segment.value}
000628:             </span>
000629:           );
000630:         case 'italic':
000631:           return (
000632:             <span key={key} className={`${baseColor} italic`}>
000633:               {segment.value}
000634:             </span>
000635:           );
000636:         case 'underline':
000637:           return (
000638:             <span key={key} className={`${baseColor} underline decoration-dashed decoration-2`}>
000639:               {segment.value}
000640:             </span>
000641:           );
000642:         case 'code':
000643:           return (
000644:             <code
000645:               key={key}
000646:               className={`font-mono text-xs px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded border ${
000647:                 type === 'user'
000648:                   ? 'bg-white/20 border-white/20 text-white'
000649:                   : 'bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-900/80 border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-100'
000650:               }`}
000651:             >
000652:               {segment.value}
000653:             </code>
000654:           );
000655:         default:
000656:           return (
000657:             <span key={key} className={type === 'user' ? 'text-white' : 'text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-100'}>
000658:               {segment.value}
000659:             </span>
000660:           );
000661:       }
000662:     });
000663:   };
000664: 
000665:   const renderAssistantMessageContent = (content = '', type = 'assistant', sizeProfile = sizeSettings) => {
000666:     const currentSize = sizeProfile || sizeSettings;
000667:     const lines = content.split('\n');
000668:     const blocks = [];
000669:     let currentList = null;
000670: 
000671:     const headingBase = type === 'user'
000672:       ? {
000673:           2: 'font-semibold text-white',
000674:           3: 'font-semibold text-white/90 uppercase tracking-wide',
000675:           4: 'font-semibold text-white/80'
000676:         }
000677:       : {
000678:           2: 'font-semibold text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100',
000679:           3: 'font-semibold text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-300 uppercase tracking-wide',
000680:           4: 'font-semibold text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400'
000681:         };
000682: 
000683:     const bodyColor = type === 'user'
000684:       ? 'text-white/90'
000685:       : 'text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200';
000686: 
000687:     const bodySize = type === 'user' ? currentSize.bodyUser : currentSize.bodyAssistant;
000688:     const paragraphClass = `${bodySize} leading-relaxed ${bodyColor}`;
000689:     const listSpacing = currentSize.listSpacing || 'space-y-1.5';
000690: 
000691:     const flushList = () => {
000692:       if (!currentList || currentList.items.length === 0) return;
000693:       const ListTag = currentList.type === 'ol' ? 'ol' : 'ul';
000694:       blocks.push(
000695:         <ListTag
000696:           key={`list-${blocks.length}`}
000697:           className={`${currentList.type === 'ol' ? 'list-decimal' : 'list-disc'} pl-5 ${listSpacing} ${bodySize} ${bodyColor}`}
000698:         >
000699:           {currentList.items.map((item, idx) => (
000700:             <li key={`list-item-${blocks.length}-${idx}`}>
000701:               {renderAssistantInlineFormatting(item, type)}
000702:             </li>
000703:           ))}
000704:         </ListTag>
000705:       );
000706:       currentList = null;
000707:     };
000708: 
000709:     lines.forEach((line, idx) => {
000710:       const trimmed = line.trim();
000711: 
000712:       if (!trimmed) {
000713:         flushList();
000714:         blocks.push(<div key={`spacer-${idx}`} className="h-2" aria-hidden="true" />);
000715:         return;
000716:       }
000717: 
000718:       const headingMatch = trimmed.match(/^(#{2,4})\s+(.*)$/);
000719:       if (headingMatch) {
000720:         flushList();
000721:         const level = headingMatch[1].length;
000722:         const headingText = headingMatch[2];
000723:         const sizeClass = currentSize[`heading${level}`] || currentSize.heading2 || '';
000724:         const headingClass = `${sizeClass} ${headingBase[level] || ''} leading-snug`;
000725: 
000726:         blocks.push(
000727:           <p key={`heading-${idx}`} className={headingClass}>
000728:             {renderAssistantInlineFormatting(headingText, type)}
000729:           </p>
000730:         );
000731:         return;
000732:       }
000733: 
000734:       const bulletMatch = trimmed.match(/^[-*]\s+(.*)$/);
000735:       if (bulletMatch) {
000736:         if (!currentList || currentList.type !== 'ul') {
000737:           flushList();
000738:           currentList = { type: 'ul', items: [] };
000739:         }
000740:         currentList.items.push(bulletMatch[1]);
000741:         return;
000742:       }
000743: 
000744:       const orderedMatch = trimmed.match(/^\d+\.\s+(.*)$/);
000745:       if (orderedMatch) {
000746:         if (!currentList || currentList.type !== 'ol') {
000747:           flushList();
000748:           currentList = { type: 'ol', items: [] };
000749:         }
000750:         currentList.items.push(orderedMatch[1]);
000751:         return;
000752:       }
000753: 
000754:       flushList();
000755:       blocks.push(
000756:         <p
000757:           key={`paragraph-${idx}`}
000758:           className={paragraphClass}
000759:         >
000760:           {renderAssistantInlineFormatting(trimmed, type)}
000761:         </p>
000762:       );
000763:     });
000764: 
000765:     flushList();
000766:     return blocks;
000767:   };

000769:   const handleAssistantSendMessage = useCallback(async (overrideText = null) => {
000770:     if (assistantTyping || assistantLoading) return;
000771:     if (assistantTranscribing && !overrideText) return;
000772: 
000773:     const messageContent = (overrideText ?? assistantInput).trim();
000774:     if (!messageContent) return;
000775: 
000776:     clearAssistantError?.();
000777: 
000778:     const userMessage = {
000779:       id: assistantMessages.length + 1,
000780:       type: 'user',
000781:       content: messageContent,
000782:       timestamp: Date.now()
000783:     };
000784: 
000785:     const updatedMessages = [...assistantMessages, userMessage];
000786:     setAssistantMessages(updatedMessages);
000787:     setAssistantInput('');
000788:     setAssistantTyping(true);
000789: 
000790:     try {
000791:       const aiResponse = await getWebsiteAssistantResponse({
000792:         conversation: buildAssistantConversation(updatedMessages),
000793:         pageContext: location.pathname
000794:       });
000795: 
000796:       const assistantMessage = {
000797:         id: updatedMessages.length + 1,
000798:         type: 'assistant',
000799:         content: aiResponse || "I'm still processing that request. Could you rephrase or share more detail?",
000800:         timestamp: Date.now()
000801:       };
000802: 
000803:       setAssistantMessages((prev) => [...prev, assistantMessage]);
000804:     } catch (error) {
000805:       const errorMessage = {
000806:         id: updatedMessages.length + 1,
000807:         type: 'assistant',
000808:         content: "I ran into an issue generating a response. Please ensure your local AI service (Ollama) is running and try again.",
000809:         timestamp: Date.now()
000810:       };
000811:       setAssistantMessages((prev) => [...prev, errorMessage]);
000812:     } finally {
000813:       setAssistantTyping(false);
000814:     }
000815:   }, [
000816:     assistantInput,
000817:     assistantLoading,
000818:     assistantMessages,
000819:     assistantTranscribing,
000820:     assistantTyping,
000821:     buildAssistantConversation,
000822:     clearAssistantError,
000823:     getWebsiteAssistantResponse,
000824:     location.pathname
000825:   ]);

000827:   const stopAssistantRecordingAndTranscribe = useCallback(async () => {
000828:     setAssistantRecordingError(null);
000829:     try {
000830:       setAssistantVoiceStatus('transcribing');
000831:       const audioBlob = await audioRecorderService.stop();
000832:       setAssistantRecording(false);
000833: 
000834:       if (!audioBlob || audioBlob.size === 0) {
000835:         setAssistantRecordingError('I could not capture any audio. Please try again.');
000836:         setAssistantVoiceStatus('idle');
000837:         return;
000838:       }
000839: 
000840:       setAssistantTranscribing(true);
000841:       const transcription = await transcribeWithFallback(audioBlob, { language: 'en' });
000842:       const transcriptText = transcription?.text?.trim()
000843:         || transcription?.segments?.map((segment) => segment?.text || '').join(' ').trim();
000844: 
000845:       if (transcriptText) {
000846:         if (assistantInput?.trim()) {
000847:           setAssistantInput((prev) => `${prev} ${transcriptText}`.trim());
000848:           setAssistantVoiceStatus('idle');
000849:         } else {
000850:           setAssistantVoiceStatus('processing');
000851:           await handleAssistantSendMessage(transcriptText);
000852:           setAssistantVoiceStatus('idle');
000853:         }
000854:       } else {
000855:         setAssistantRecordingError('I did not catch that. Could you try again?');
000856:         setAssistantVoiceStatus('idle');
000857:       }
000858:     } catch (error) {
000859:       console.error('Voice input error:', error);
000860:       setAssistantRecordingError(error?.message || 'Transcription failed. Please try again.');
000861:       setAssistantVoiceStatus('idle');
000862:     } finally {
000863:       setAssistantRecording(false);
000864:       setAssistantTranscribing(false);
000865:       if (!assistantTyping) {
000866:         setAssistantVoiceStatus('idle');
000867:       }
000868:     }

000871:   const handleAssistantMicClick = useCallback(async () => {

000001: import { useEffect } from 'react';
000002: import { useNavigate, useLocation } from 'react-router-dom';
000003: 
000004: /**
000005:  * Component to handle OAuth redirects that might land on any page
000006:  * This ensures OAuth callbacks are always redirected to verify-email
000007:  */
000008: const OAuthRedirectHandler = () => {
000009:   const navigate = useNavigate();
000010:   const location = useLocation();
000011: 
000012:   useEffect(() => {
000013:     // Check if current URL has OAuth callback tokens
000014:     const hash = window.location.hash;
000015:     const currentPath = location.pathname;
000016:     
000017:     // If we have an access_token in the hash and we're not already on verify-email
000018:     if (hash && hash.includes('access_token') && currentPath !== '/verify-email') {
000019:       console.log(`OAuth callback detected on ${currentPath}, redirecting to verify-email`);
000020:       // Redirect to verify-email with the hash
000021:       navigate(`/verify-email${hash}`, { replace: true });
000022:     }
000023:   }, [navigate, location]);
000024: 
000025:   return null; // This component doesn't render anything
000026: };
000027: 
000028: export default OAuthRedirectHandler;
000029: 
```

000001: import React from 'react';
000002: import { Navigate, useLocation } from 'react-router-dom';
000003: import { useAuth } from '../contexts/AuthContext.jsx';
000004: import LoadingState from './ui/LoadingState';
000005: import {
000006:   buildPendingApprovalRoute,
000007:   isRestrictedCompanyUser,
000008: } from '../utils/organizationAccess.js';
000009: import { hasPermission } from '../utils/rolePermissions.js';
000010: 
000011: const ProtectedRoute = ({ children, roles = [], requiredOrgPermissions = [] }) => {
000012:   const location = useLocation();
000013:   const { status, user } = useAuth();
000014:   const currentPath = `${location.pathname}${location.search || ''}`;
000015: 
000016:   if (status === 'loading') {
000017:     return (
000018:       <LoadingState
000019:         title="Checking your session and syncing your data"
000020:         message="Verifying secure access and preparing your workspace."
000021:         variant="fullscreen"
000022:         tone="primary"
000023:       />
000024:     );
000025:   }
000026: 
000027:   if (status === 'unauthenticated' || !user) {
000028:     return <Navigate to="/login" replace state={{ from: currentPath }} />;
000029:   }
000030: 
000031:   const isCompanyRoute = location.pathname.startsWith('/company-');
000032:   if (isCompanyRoute && isRestrictedCompanyUser(user)) {
000033:     return <Navigate to={buildPendingApprovalRoute(user)} replace state={{ from: currentPath }} />;
000034:   }
000035: 
000036:   const normalizedRole = (user.accountType || user.account_type || '').toString().toUpperCase();
000037: 
000038:   if (roles.length > 0) {
000039:     const isAllowed = roles.some(
000040:       (role) => role.toUpperCase() === normalizedRole,
000041:     );
000042: 
000043:     if (!isAllowed) {
000044:       // Determine fallback based on account type
000045:       let fallback = '/';
000046:       if (normalizedRole === 'COMPANY') {
000047:         fallback = isRestrictedCompanyUser(user)
000048:           ? buildPendingApprovalRoute(user)
000049:           : '/company-dashboard';
000050:       } else if (normalizedRole === 'CANDIDATE') {
000051:         fallback = '/candidate-dashboard';
000052:       } else if (normalizedRole === 'SYSTEM_ADMIN') {
000053:         fallback = '/system-admin-dashboard';
000054:       }
000055:       return <Navigate to={fallback} replace />;
000056:     }
000057:   }
000058: 
000059:   if (requiredOrgPermissions.length > 0) {
000060:     // Organization permissions only apply to company users.
000061:     if (normalizedRole !== 'COMPANY') {
000062:       if (normalizedRole === 'CANDIDATE') {
000063:         return <Navigate to="/candidate-dashboard" replace state={{ from: currentPath }} />;
000064:       }
000065:       if (normalizedRole === 'SYSTEM_ADMIN') {
000066:         return <Navigate to="/system-admin-dashboard" replace state={{ from: currentPath }} />;
000067:       }
000068:       return <Navigate to="/" replace state={{ from: currentPath }} />;
000069:     }
000070: 
000071:     const organizationRole = (user.organizationContext?.membership?.role || '').toString().toUpperCase();
000072:     const hasRequiredPermission = requiredOrgPermissions.some((permission) =>
000073:       hasPermission(organizationRole, permission),
000074:     );
000075: 
000076:     if (!hasRequiredPermission) {
000077:       const fallback = isRestrictedCompanyUser(user)
000078:         ? buildPendingApprovalRoute(user)
000079:         : '/company-dashboard';
000080:       return <Navigate to={fallback} replace state={{ from: currentPath }} />;
000081:     }
000082:   }
000083: 
000084:   return children;
000085: };
000086: 
000087: export default ProtectedRoute;
000088: 
000089: 
```

000008: 
000009: const ThemeToggleButton = () => {

000012:   const loadingScreenActive = useSyncExternalStore(

000020:   const currentIndex = THEME_OPTIONS.indexOf(theme);
000021:   const nextTheme =
000022:     currentIndex === -1 ? THEME_OPTIONS[0] : THEME_OPTIONS[(currentIndex + 1) % THEME_OPTIONS.length];
000023:   const nextLabel =
000024:     nextTheme === 'dark' ? 'Dark' : nextTheme === 'light' ? 'Light' : 'System';
000025:   const currentLabel =
000026:     theme === 'system'
000027:       ? `System (${resolvedTheme === 'dark' ? 'Dark' : 'Light'})`
000028:       : theme === 'dark'
000029:         ? 'Dark'
000030:         : 'Light';
000031:   const buttonLabel = `Theme: ${currentLabel}. Click to switch to ${nextLabel}.`;
000032:   const CurrentIcon = theme === 'light' ? Sun : theme === 'dark' ? Moon : Monitor;
000033:   const currentIconClassName =
000034:     theme === 'light'
000035:       ? 'text-yellow-500'
000036:       : theme === 'dark'
000037:         ? 'text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200'
000038:         : 'text-gray-700 dark:text-slate-300';
000039:   const isDashboardView = pathname?.startsWith('/company-')
000040:     || pathname?.startsWith('/candidate-')
000041:     || pathname === '/my-applications'
000042:     || pathname?.startsWith('/jobs')
000043:     || pathname === '/practice-interview-setup';
000044:   const themePositionClass = isDashboardView
000045:     ? 'bottom-36 lg:bottom-24'
000046:     : 'bottom-20 lg:bottom-24';
000047:   const backToTopPositionClass = isDashboardView
000048:     ? 'bottom-52 lg:bottom-40'
000049:     : 'bottom-36 lg:bottom-40';
000050:   const shouldShowBackToTop = showBackToTop;
000051:   const { initial, animate, exit, transition } = FLOATING_BUTTON_MOTION;
000052: 
000053:   useEffect(() => {
000054:     if (loadingScreenActive) {
000055:       setShowBackToTop(false);
000056:       return undefined;
000057:     }
000058: 
000059:     const handleScroll = () => {
000060:       setShowBackToTop(window.scrollY > 320);
000061:     };
000062: 
000063:     handleScroll();
000064:     window.addEventListener('scroll', handleScroll, { passive: true });
000065: 
000066:     return () => window.removeEventListener('scroll', handleScroll);
000067:   }, [loadingScreenActive]);
000068: 
000069:   useEffect(() => {
000070:     const handleAssistantToggle = (event) => {
000071:       setIsAssistantOpen(Boolean(event?.detail?.open));
000072:     };
000073: 
000074:     window.addEventListener('ai-assistant-toggle', handleAssistantToggle);
000075:     return () => window.removeEventListener('ai-assistant-toggle', handleAssistantToggle);
000076:   }, []);
000077: 
000078:   useEffect(() => {
000079:     const handleLiveChatToggle = (event) => {
000080:       setIsLiveChatOpen(Boolean(event?.detail?.open));
000081:     };
000082:

000084:     return () => window.removeEventListener('live-chat-toggle', handleLiveChatToggle);
000085:   }, []);
000086: 
000087:   if (loadingScreenActive) {
000088:     return null;
000089:   }
000090:   if (isAssistantOpen || isLiveChatOpen) {
000091:     return null;
000092:   }
000093: 
000094:   const handleBackToTop = () => {
000095:     window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: 'smooth' });
000096:   };
000097:   const overlayZIndexClass = (isAssistantOpen || isLiveChatOpen) ? 'z-0' : 'z-50';
000098: 
000099:   return (

000132:             aria-label="Back to top"

000039: const Button = React.forwardRef(({

000060:         lg: 18,
000061:         xl: 20,
000062:         icon: 16,
000063:     };
000064: 
000065:     const calculatedIconSize = iconSize || iconSizeMap?.[size] || 16;
000066: 
000067:     const spinnerSizeMap = {
000068:         xs: 12,
000069:         sm: 14,
000070:         default: 16,
000071:         lg: 18,
000072:         xl: 20,

000075:

000098:                 />

000101:             return null;
000102:         }
000103:     };
000104: 
000105:     const renderFallbackButton = () => (
000106:         <button
000107:             className={cn(
000108:                 buttonVariants({ variant, size, className }),
000109:                 fullWidth && "w-full"
000110:             )}
000111:             ref={ref}
000112:             disabled={disabled || loading}
000113:             {...props}
000114:         >
000115:             {loading && <LoadingSpinner />}
000116:             {iconName && iconPosition === 'left' && renderIcon()}
000117:             {children}
000118:             {iconName && iconPosition === 'right' && renderIcon()}
000119:         </button>
000120:     );

000146:                     fullWidth && "w-full",
000147:                     child?.props?.className
000148:                 ),
000149:                 disabled: disabled || loading || child?.props?.disabled,
000150:                 children: content,
000151:             });
000152: 
000153:             return <Comp ref={ref} {...props}>{clonedChild}</Comp>;
000154:         } catch {

000156:         }
000157:     }
000158: 
000159:     return (
000160:         <Comp
000161:             className={cn(
000162:                 buttonVariants({ variant, size, className }),

000164:             )}

000168:         >

000171:             {children}

000001: // components/ui/NavigationMenu.jsx - Collapsible navigation menu component
000002: import React, { useState, useRef, useEffect } from 'react';
000003: import { useLocation, useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
000004: import Icon from '../AppIcon';
000005: import { cn } from '../../utils/cn';
000006: 
000007: const normalizeRoute = (value = '') => {
000008:   const raw = typeof value === 'string' ? value : '';
000009:   const [pathnamePart = '', hashPart = ''] = raw.split('#');
000010:   const trimmedPathname = pathnamePart.replace(/\/+$/, '');
000011:   const pathname = trimmedPathname || '/';
000012:   const hash = hashPart ? `#${hashPart}` : '';
000013:   return { pathname, hash };
000014: };
000015: 
000016: const isRouteMatch = (currentRoute, targetRoute, { exact = false } = {}) => {
000017:   if (!targetRoute || typeof targetRoute !== 'string') return false;
000018: 
000019:   const current = normalizeRoute(currentRoute);
000020:   const target = normalizeRoute(targetRoute);
000021: 
000022:   // Hash targets should only match exact section hash for that page.
000023:   if (target.hash) {
000024:     return current.pathname === target.pathname && current.hash === target.hash;
000025:   }
000026: 
000027:   if (exact) return current.pathname === target.pathname;
000028:   if (target.pathname === '/') return current.pathname === '/';
000029:   return current.pathname === target.pathname || current.pathname.startsWith(`${target.pathname}/`);
000030: };
000031: 
000032: /**
000033:  * NavigationMenu - A collapsible menu component for navigation items with submenus
000034:  * Used in both Header (as dropdown) and UserContextNavigation (as accordion)
000035:  */
000036: export const NavigationMenu = ({
000037:   items = [],
000038:   isCollapsed = false,
000039:   variant = 'accordion', // 'accordion' for sidebar, 'dropdown' for header
000040:   onItemClick,
000041:   activeItem,
000042:   className = '',
000043: }) => {
000044:   const location = useLocation();
000045:   const navigate = useNavigate();
000046:   const [expandedGroups, setExpandedGroups] = useState(new Set());
000047:   const menuRef = useRef(null);
000048: 
000049:   // Determine if a path is active
000050:   const isActivePath = (path, exact = false) => {
000051:     if (!path) return false;
000052:     const current = activeItem || `${location.pathname || ''}${location.hash || ''}`;
000053:     return isRouteMatch(current, path, { exact });
000054:   };
000055: 
000056:   // Handle group toggle
000057:   const handleGroupToggle = (groupKey, e) => {
000058:     e?.stopPropagation();
000059:     setExpandedGroups((prev) => {
000060:       const next = new Set(prev);
000061:       if (next.has(groupKey)) {
000062:         next.delete(groupKey);
000063:       } else {
000064:         next.add(groupKey);
000065:       }
000066:       return next;
000067:     });
000068:   };
000069: 
000070:   // Handle item click
000071:   const handleItemClick = (item, e) => {
000072:     e?.stopPropagation();
000073:     if (item.path) {
000074:       if (onItemClick) {
000075:         onItemClick(item.path, e);
000076:       } else {
000077:         navigate(item.path);
000078:       }
000079:     }
000080:   };
000081: 
000082:   // Handle group click (if group has a path, navigate; otherwise toggle)
000083:   const handleGroupClick = (group, e) => {
000084:     e?.stopPropagation();
000085:     if (group.path) {
000086:       handleItemClick(group, e);
000087:     } else {
000088:       handleGroupToggle(group.key, e);
000089:     }
000090:   };
000091: 
000092:   // Auto-expand groups that contain the active item
000093:   useEffect(() => {
000094:     if (variant === 'accordion') {
000095:       const activePath = activeItem || `${location.pathname || ''}${location.hash || ''}`;
000096:       const activeGroup = items.find((item) => {
000097:         if (item.items && item.items.length > 0) {
000098:           return item.items.some((subItem) => isRouteMatch(activePath, subItem.path, { exact: subItem.exact === true }));
000099:         }
000100:         return false;
000101:       });
000102:       if (activeGroup && activeGroup.key) {
000103:         setExpandedGroups((prev) => new Set([...prev, activeGroup.key]));
000104:       }
000105:     }
000106:   }, [location.pathname, location.hash, activeItem, variant, items]);
000107: 
000108:   // Handle click outside for dropdown variant
000109:   useEffect(() => {
000110:     if (variant === 'dropdown') {
000111:       const handleClickOutside = (event) => {
000112:         if (menuRef.current && !menuRef.current.contains(event.target)) {
000113:           setExpandedGroups(new Set());
000114:         }
000115:       };
000116:       document.addEventListener('mousedown', handleClickOutside);
000117:       return () => document.removeEventListener('mousedown', handleClickOutside);
000118:     }
000119:   }, [variant]);
000120: 
000121:   if (variant === 'dropdown') {
000122:     // Dropdown variant for Header
000123:     return (
000124:       <nav ref={menuRef} className={cn('relative', className)}>
000125:         <div className="flex items-center gap-1 xl:gap-2">
000126:           {items.map((item, index) => {
000127:             const hasSubmenu = item.items && item.items.length > 0;
000128:             const isExpanded = expandedGroups.has(item.key);
000129:             const isActive = isActivePath(item.path, item.exact === true) || (hasSubmenu && item.items.some((subItem) => isActivePath(subItem.path, subItem.exact === true)));
000130:             const itemKey = item.key || item.path || item.label || `nav-item-${index}`;
000131: 
000132:             if (!hasSubmenu) {
000133:               // Regular navigation item (no submenu)
000134:               return (
000135:                 <button
000136:                   key={itemKey}
000137:                   onClick={(e) => handleItemClick(item, e)}
000138:                   className={cn(
000139:                     'flex items-center gap-1.5 xl:gap-2 text-xs xl:text-sm font-medium transition-all duration-200 px-2.5 xl:px-3 py-2 rounded-full min-h-touch',
000140:                     isActive
000141:                       ? 'bg-gradient-to-r from-blue-600 to-purple-600 text-white shadow-lg shadow-blue-500/30'
000142:                       : 'text-gray-500 dark:text-slate-400 hover:text-gray-900 dark:hover:text-slate-100 hover:bg-white/60 dark:hover:bg-slate-800/60'
000143:                   )}
000144:                   aria-current={isActive ? 'page' : undefined}
000145:                 >
000146:                   <Icon
000147:                     name={item.icon}
000148:                     size={16}
000149:                     className={cn('flex-shrink-0', isActive ? 'text-white' : 'text-gray-400')}
000150:                   />
000151:                   <span className="hidden xl:inline">{item.fullLabel || item.label}</span>
000152:                   <span className="xl:hidden">{item.label}</span>
000153:                 </button>
000154:               );
000155:             }
000156: 
000157:             // Group with submenu (dropdown)
000158:             return (
000159:               <div key={itemKey} className="relative">

000001: /**

000006:

000001: import React, { useEffect } from 'react';

000006: 
000007: const ProfileSettingsModal = ({ open = false, onClose, userType = 'candidate' }) => {
000008:   useEffect(() => {

000011:       if (event.key === 'Escape') {
000012:         onClose?.();

000023:     return () => {
000024:       document.body.style.overflow = originalOverflow;
000025:     };
000026:   }, [open]);
000027: 
000028:   if (!open || typeof document === 'undefined') return null;
000029: 
000030:   return createPortal(
000031:     <div className="fixed inset-0 z-[9999] flex items-center justify-center p-3 sm:p-4">
000032:       <div
000033:         className="absolute inset-0 bg-slate-900/45 backdrop-blur-sm"

000265: const normalizeUploadsPath = (value) => {
000266:   if (!value || typeof value !== 'string') return '';
000267:   const trimmed = value.trim();
000268:   if (!trimmed) return '';
000269:   if (trimmed.startsWith('/')) return trimmed;
000270: 
000271:   const lower = trimmed.toLowerCase();
000272:   if (lower.startsWith('uploads/')) {
000273:     return `/${trimmed}`;
000274:   }
000275: 
000276:   const uploadDirs = [
000277:     'profile-photos/',
000278:     'company-logos/',
000279:     'company-verifications/',
000280:     'resumes/',
000281:   ];
000282: 
000283:   const matched = uploadDirs.find((dir) => lower.startsWith(dir));
000284:   if (matched) {
000285:     return `/uploads/${trimmed}`;
000286:   }
000287: 
000288:   return '';
000289: };
000290: 
000291: const buildAssetSources = (value) => {
000292:   if (!value || typeof value !== 'string') return [];
000293:   const trimmed = value.trim();
000294:   if (!trimmed) return [];
000295: 
000296:   if (
000297:     trimmed.startsWith('http://') ||
000298:     trimmed.startsWith('https://') ||
000299:     trimmed.startsWith('data:') ||
000300:     trimmed.startsWith('blob:')
000301:   ) {
000302:     return [trimmed];
000303:   }
000304: 
000305:   const uploadsPath = normalizeUploadsPath(trimmed);
000306:   if (uploadsPath) {
000307:     const base = API_BASE_URL.replace(/\/$/, '');
000308:     const sources = [];
000309:     if (base) sources.push(`${base}${uploadsPath}`);
000310:     if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
000311:       const origin = window.location.origin;
000312:       if (origin && origin !== base) {
000313:         sources.push(`${origin}${uploadsPath}`);
000314:       }
000315:     }
000316:     return sources;
000317:   }
000318: 
000319:   if (trimmed.startsWith('gs://')) {
000320:     const match = trimmed.match(/^gs:\/\/([^/]+)\/(.+)$/);
000321:     if (match) {
000322:       const [, bucket, objectPath] = match;
000323:       return [
000324:         `https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/${bucket}/o/${encodeURIComponent(objectPath)}?alt=media`,
000325:       ];
000326:     }
000327:   }
000328: 
000329:   if (FIREBASE_STORAGE_BUCKET && !trimmed.startsWith('/')) {
000330:     return [
000331:       `https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/${FIREBASE_STORAGE_BUCKET}/o/${encodeURIComponent(trimmed)}?alt=media`,
000332:     ];
000333:   }
000334: 
000335:   const normalized = trimmed.startsWith('/') ? trimmed : `/${trimmed}`;
000336:   const base = API_BASE_URL.replace(/\/$/, '');
000337:   const sources = [];
000338:   if (base) sources.push(`${base}${normalized}`);
000339:   if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
000340:     const origin = window.location.origin;
000341:     if (origin && origin !== base) {
000342:       sources.push(`${origin}${normalized}`);
000343:     }
000344:   }
000345:   return sources;
000346: };
000347: 
000348: const normalizeOptionValue = (value) => (value ?? '').toString().toLowerCase().trim();
000349: 
000350: const resolveOptionValue = (options, value) => {
000351:   const normalized = normalizeOptionValue(value);
000352:   if (!normalized) return '';
000353:   const match = options.find((option) => (
000354:     normalizeOptionValue(option.value) === normalized
000355:     || normalizeOptionValue(option.label) === normalized
000356:   ));
000357:   return match ? match.value : value;
000358: };
000359: 
000360: const appendCurrentOption = (options, value) => {
000361:   const normalized = normalizeOptionValue(value);
000362:   if (!normalized) return options;
000363:   const hasMatch = options.some((option) => (
000364:     normalizeOptionValue(option.value) === normalized
000365:     || normalizeOptionValue(option.label) === normalized
000366:   ));
000367:   if (hasMatch) return options;
000368:   return [...options, { value, label: value }];
000369: };
000370: 
000371: const formatDetectedLocation = (data, coords) => {
000372:   if (!data && !coords) {
000373:     return '';
000374:   }
000375: 
000376:   const administrative = data?.localityInfo?.administrative || [];
000377:   const locality = data?.city
000378:     || data?.locality
000379:     || data?.principalSubdivision
000380:     || administrative.find((item) => (item.order ?? 0) >= 4)?.name;
000381: 
000382:   const region = data?.principalSubdivision
000383:     || administrative.find((item) => (item.order ?? 0) <= 3)?.name;
000384: 
000385:   const country = data?.countryName || data?.countryCode;
000386: 
000387:   const parts = [locality, region, country].filter(Boolean);
000388: 
000389:   if (parts.length > 0) {
000390:     return parts.join(', ');
000391:   }
000392: 
000393:   if (coords) {
000394:     const { latitude, longitude } = coords;
000395:     return `Lat ${latitude.toFixed(3)}, Long ${longitude.toFixed(3)}`;
000396:   }
000397: 
000398:   return '';
000399: };

000401: const StatusMessage = ({ status }) => {

000405:     : 'text-rose-500 dark:text-rose-400';
000406:   return <p className={`text-xs ${colorClass}`}>{status.message}</p>;
000407: };

000778:   const handleDetectLocation = async () => {
000779:     if (isDetectingLocation) {

000782: 
000783:     if (typeof window === 'undefined' || !navigator?.geolocation) {
000784:       setLocationFeedback({

000787:       });
000788:       return;

000791:     setIsDetectingLocation(true);
000792:     setLocationFeedback({
000793:       status: 'info',

000796: 
000797:     try {
000798:       const position = await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
000799:         navigator.geolocation.getCurrentPosition(resolve, reject, {
000800:           enableHighAccuracy: true,
000801:           timeout: 10000,
000802:           maximumAge: 0,
000803:         });
000804:       });
000805: 
000806:       setLocationFeedback({
000807:         status: 'info',
000808:         message: 'Detecting your city...',
000809:       });
000810: 
000811:       const { latitude, longitude } = position.coords || {};
000812: 
000813:       if (latitude == null || longitude == null) {
000814:         throw new Error('We could not read your coordinates. Please enter your location manually.');
000815:       }
000816: 
000817:       const response = await fetch(
000818:         `https://api.bigdatacloud.net/data/reverse-geocode-client?latitude=${latitude}&longitude=${longitude}&localityLanguage=en`
000819:       );
000820: 
000821:       if (!response.ok) {
000822:         throw new Error('Unable to determine your location automatically.');
000823:       }
000824: 
000825:       const data = await response.json();
000826:       const formattedLocation = formatDetectedLocation(data, { latitude, longitude });
000827: 
000828:       if (!formattedLocation) {
000829:         throw new Error('We could not convert your coordinates into a city. Please enter it manually.');
000830:       }
000831: 
000832:       handleProfileFieldChange('location', formattedLocation);
000833:       setLocationFeedback({ status: 'success', message: '' });
000834:     } catch (error) {
000835:       console.error('Location detection error:', error);
000836: 
000837:       let friendlyMessage = error?.message || 'Unable to detect your location. Please enter it manually.';
000838: 
000839:       if (error?.code === 1 || error?.message?.toLowerCase().includes('permission')) {
000840:         friendlyMessage = 'Location permission was denied. You can enable it in your browser or enter it manually.';
000841:       } else if (error?.code === 2) {
000842:         friendlyMessage = 'We could not determine your position. Please try again or enter it manually.';
000843:       } else if (error?.code === 3) {
000844:         friendlyMessage = 'Location request timed out. Please try again or enter it manually.';
000845:       }
000846: 
000847:       setLocationFeedback({
000848:         status: 'error',
000849:         message: friendlyMessage,
000850:       });
000851:     } finally {
000852:       setIsDetectingLocation(false);
000853:     }
000854:   };
000855: 
000856:   const handleSavePreferences = () => {
000857:     setPreferencesStatus(null);
000858:     try {
000859:       if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
000860:         window.localStorage.setItem(preferencesKey, JSON.stringify(preferences));
000861:       }
000862:       setPreferencesStatus({ type: 'success', message: 'Preferences saved.' });
000863:     } catch {
000864:       setPreferencesStatus({ type: 'error', message: 'Unable to save preferences.' });
000865:     }
000866:   };
000867: 
000868:   const handlePreferenceChange = (key, value) => {
000869:     setPreferences((prev) => ({ ...prev, [key]: value }));
000870:     if (preferencesStatus) {
000871:       setPreferencesStatus(null);
000872:     }
000873:   };

000879:       return;
000880:     }
