```text
000884:   const handleResumeFileChange = (event) => {
000885:     const file = event?.target?.files?.[0];
000886:     if (!file) {
000887:       setResumeFile(null);
000888:       return;
000889:     }
000890: 
000891:     // Validate file type
000892:     const allowedTypes = ['application/pdf', 'application/msword', 'application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document'];
000893:     if (!allowedTypes.includes(file.type)) {
000894:       setResumeStatus({
000895:         type: 'error',
000896:         message: 'Resume must be a PDF or Word document.',
000897:       });
000898:       setResumeFile(null);
000899:       if (resumeInputRef.current) {
000900:         resumeInputRef.current.value = '';
000901:       }
000902:       return;
000903:     }
000904: 
000905:     // Validate file size (10 MB max)
000906:     const maxSize = 10 * 1024 * 1024; // 10 MB
000907:     if (file.size > maxSize) {
000908:       setResumeStatus({
000909:         type: 'error',
000910:         message: 'Resume must be 10 MB or less.',
000911:       });
000912:       setResumeFile(null);
000913:       if (resumeInputRef.current) {
000914:         resumeInputRef.current.value = '';
000915:       }
000916:       return;
000917:     }
000918: 
000919:     setResumeStatus(null);
000920:     setResumeFile(file);
000921:   };
000922: 
000923:   const handleSaveResume = async () => {
000924:     if (!resumeFile) return;
000925:     setResumeStatus(null);
000926:     setIsSavingResume(true);
000927:     try {
000928:       const response = await apiClient.auth.updateResume(resumeFile);
000929:       if (!response?.success || !response?.user) {
000930:         throw new Error('Unable to update the resume. Please try again.');
000931:       }
000932:       setAuthenticatedUser(response.user);
000933:       setResumeFile(null);
000934:       if (resumeInputRef.current) {
000935:         resumeInputRef.current.value = '';
000936:       }
000937:       setResumeStatus({
000938:         type: 'success',
000939:         message: 'Resume updated successfully.',
000940:       });
000941:     } catch (error) {
000942:       setResumeStatus({
000943:         type: 'error',
000944:         message: error?.message || 'Failed to update resume.',
000945:       });
000946:     } finally {
000947:       setIsSavingResume(false);
000948:     }
000949:   };
```

```text
000001: import React, { createContext, useContext, useState, useCallback, useEffect } from 'react';

000006: const ToastContext = createContext(null);
000007: 
000008: export const ToastProvider = ({ children }) => {
000009:   const [toasts, setToasts] = useState([]);
000010: 
000011:   const showToast = useCallback((message, type = 'success', duration = 3000) => {
000012:     const id = Date.now() + Math.random();
000013:     const toast = { id, message, type, duration };
000014:     
000015:     setToasts(prev => [...prev, toast]);
000016: 
000017:     if (duration > 0) {
000018:       setTimeout(() => {
000019:         setToasts(prev => prev.filter(t => t.id !== id));
000020:       }, duration);
000021:     }
000022: 
000023:     return id;
000024:   }, []);
000025: 
000026:   const removeToast = useCallback((id) => {
000027:     setToasts(prev => prev.filter(t => t.id !== id));
000028:   }, []);
000029: 
000030:   const success = useCallback((message, duration) => showToast(message, 'success', duration), [showToast]);
000031:   const error = useCallback((message, duration) => showToast(message, 'error', duration), [showToast]);
000032:   const info = useCallback((message, duration) => showToast(message, 'info', duration), [showToast]);
000033:   const warning = useCallback((message, duration) => showToast(message, 'warning', duration), [showToast]);
000034: 
000035:   return (
000036:     <ToastContext.Provider value={{ showToast, success, error, info, warning, removeToast }}>
000037:       {children}
000038:       <ToastContainer toasts={toasts} onRemove={removeToast} />
000039:     </ToastContext.Provider>
000040:   );
000041: };
000042:
```

```text
000001: /**
000002:  * Default Voice Configuration
000003:  * Only includes voices that are pre-installed by default on Windows and macOS
000004:  * Differentiates between mobile and desktop variants
000005:  */
000006: 
000007: import { detectOS, detectDeviceType } from '../utils/osDetection';
000008: 
000009: /**
000010:  * Get all available default voices based on OS and device type
000011:  * @param {Array} availableVoices - Array of available SpeechSynthesisVoice objects
000012:  * @returns {Array} - Array of voice options with name, gender, and availability
000013:  */
000014: export function getDefaultVoices(availableVoices = []) {
000015:   const os = detectOS();
000016:   const deviceType = detectDeviceType();
000017:   
000018:   // Default voice definitions
000019:   const defaultVoiceDefinitions = {
000020:     windows: {
000021:       desktop: [
000022:         { name: 'Microsoft Zira', gender: 'female', baseName: 'Zira' },
000023:         { name: 'Microsoft David', gender: 'male', baseName: 'David' }
000024:       ],
000025:       mobile: [
000026:         { name: 'Microsoft Zira Mobile', gender: 'female', baseName: 'Zira' },
000027:         { name: 'Microsoft David Mobile', gender: 'male', baseName: 'David' }
000028:       ]
000029:     },
000030:     macos: {
000031:       desktop: [
000032:         { name: 'Samantha', gender: 'female' },
000033:         { name: 'Alex', gender: 'male' },
000034:         { name: 'Victoria', gender: 'female' },
000035:         { name: 'Daniel', gender: 'male' },
000036:         { name: 'Karen', gender: 'female' }, // Australian
000037:         { name: 'Moira', gender: 'female' }, // Irish
000038:         { name: 'Tessa', gender: 'female' }  // South African
000039:       ],
000040:       mobile: [
000041:         { name: 'Samantha', gender: 'female' },
000042:         { name: 'Alex', gender: 'male' },
000043:         { name: 'Victoria', gender: 'female' },
000044:         { name: 'Daniel', gender: 'male' },
000045:         { name: 'Karen', gender: 'female' },
000046:         { name: 'Moira', gender: 'female' },
000047:         { name: 'Tessa', gender: 'female' }
000048:       ]
000049:     }
000050:   };
000051: 
000052:   // Get OS-specific voices
000053:   const osVoices = defaultVoiceDefinitions[os]?.[deviceType] || defaultVoiceDefinitions[os]?.desktop || [];
000054:   
000055:   // Helper function to match voice names
000056:   const matchVoice = (voiceName, availableVoiceName) => {
000057:     const v1 = voiceName.toLowerCase();
000058:     const v2 = availableVoiceName.toLowerCase();
000059:     // Exact match
000060:     if (v1 === v2) return true;
000061:     // One contains the other
000062:     if (v1.includes(v2) || v2.includes(v1)) return true;
000063:     // Match base name (e.g., "Zira" matches "Microsoft Zira Desktop")
000064:     const baseName = voiceName.split(' ').pop().toLowerCase();
000065:     if (v2.includes(baseName)) return true;
000066:     return false;
000067:   };
000068: 
000069:   // Filter to only include voices that are actually available
000070:   return osVoices
000071:     .map(voiceDef => {
000072:       // Try to find the voice in available voices
000073:       const foundVoice = availableVoices.find(v => matchVoice(voiceDef.name, v.name));
000074:       
000075:       if (foundVoice) {
000076:         return {
000077:           id: foundVoice.name.toLowerCase().replace(/\s+/g, '-'),
000078:           name: foundVoice.name,
000079:           displayName: voiceDef.name.replace('Microsoft ', '').replace(' Mobile', ''),
000080:           gender: voiceDef.gender,
000081:           voice: foundVoice,
000082:           isAvailable: true
000083:         };
000084:       }
000085:       
000086:       // Voice not found, but include it anyway with isAvailable: false
000087:       return {
000088:         id: voiceDef.name.toLowerCase().replace(/\s+/g, '-'),
000089:         name: voiceDef.name,
000090:         displayName: voiceDef.name.replace('Microsoft ', '').replace(' Mobile', ''),
000091:         gender: voiceDef.gender,
000092:         voice: null,
000093:         isAvailable: false
000094:       };
000095:     })
000096:     .filter(v => v.isAvailable); // Only return available voices
000097: }
000098: 
000099: /**
000100:  * Get default voice configuration for a selected voice
000101:  * @param {string} voiceId - The voice ID
000102:  * @param {Array} availableVoices - Array of available SpeechSynthesisVoice objects
000103:  * @returns {Object} - Voice configuration with voiceName and voiceCriteria
000104:  */
000105: export function getVoiceConfig(voiceId, availableVoices = []) {
000106:   const voices = getDefaultVoices(availableVoices);
000107:   const selectedVoice = voices.find(v => v.id === voiceId);
000108:   
000109:   if (selectedVoice && selectedVoice.voice) {
000110:     return {
000111:       voiceName: selectedVoice.voice.name,
000112:       voiceCriteria: { gender: selectedVoice.gender, lang: 'en' }
000113:     };
000114:   }
000115:   
000116:   // Fallback to gender-based selection
000117:   const voice = voices.find(v => v.id === voiceId);
000118:   if (voice) {
000119:     return {
000120:       voiceName: null,
000121:       voiceCriteria: { gender: voice.gender, lang: 'en' }
000122:     };
000123:   }
000124:   
000125:   // Final fallback
000126:   return {
000127:     voiceName: null,
000128:     voiceCriteria: { gender: 'female', lang: 'en' }
000129:   };
000130: }
```

```text
000819: // ============================================================================
000820: // SECTION 9: CALCULATION FUNCTIONS
000821: // ============================================================================
000822: 
000823: /**
000824:  * Calculate Euclidean distance between two 2D points
000825:  */
000826: export function distance2D(p1, p2) {
000827:   if (!p1 || !p2) return 0;
000828:   return Math.sqrt(Math.pow(p1.x - p2.x, 2) + Math.pow(p1.y - p2.y, 2));
000829: }
000830: 
000831: /**
000832:  * Calculate Euclidean distance between two 3D points
000833:  */
000834: export function distance3D(p1, p2) {
000835:   if (!p1 || !p2) return 0;
000836:   return Math.sqrt(
000837:     Math.pow(p1.x - p2.x, 2) + 
000838:     Math.pow(p1.y - p2.y, 2) + 
000839:     Math.pow((p1.z || 0) - (p2.z || 0), 2)
000840:   );
000841: }
000842: 
000843: /**
000844:  * Calculate angle between three points (in degrees)
000845:  * Point B is the vertex
000846:  */
000847: export function calculateAngle(pointA, pointB, pointC) {
000848:   if (!pointA || !pointB || !pointC) return 0;
000849:   
000850:   const vectorBA = { x: pointA.x - pointB.x, y: pointA.y - pointB.y };
000851:   const vectorBC = { x: pointC.x - pointB.x, y: pointC.y - pointB.y };
000852:   
000853:   const dotProduct = vectorBA.x * vectorBC.x + vectorBA.y * vectorBC.y;
000854:   const magnitudeBA = Math.sqrt(vectorBA.x ** 2 + vectorBA.y ** 2);
000855:   const magnitudeBC = Math.sqrt(vectorBC.x ** 2 + vectorBC.y ** 2);
000856:   
000857:   if (magnitudeBA === 0 || magnitudeBC === 0) return 0;
000858:   
000859:   const cosAngle = dotProduct / (magnitudeBA * magnitudeBC);
000860:   const clampedCos = Math.max(-1, Math.min(1, cosAngle));
000861:   
000862:   return Math.acos(clampedCos) * (180 / Math.PI);
000863: }
000864: 
000865: /**
000866:  * Calculate Eye Aspect Ratio (EAR)
000867:  * 
000868:  * EAR = (vertical_distance) / (horizontal_distance)
000869:  * Used for blink detection and eye openness
000870:  * 
000871:  * @returns {number} EAR value (typically 0.1-0.4)
000872:  */
000873: export function calculateEAR(eyeTop, eyeBottom, eyeLeft, eyeRight) {
000874:   if (!eyeTop || !eyeBottom || !eyeLeft || !eyeRight) return 0.25;
000875:   
000876:   const verticalDist = distance2D(eyeTop, eyeBottom);
000877:   const horizontalDist = distance2D(eyeLeft, eyeRight);
000878:   
000879:   if (horizontalDist === 0) return 0.25;
000880:   return verticalDist / horizontalDist;
000881: }
000882: 
000883: /**
000884:  * Calculate Mouth Aspect Ratio (MAR)
000885:  * 
000886:  * MAR = (vertical_distance) / (horizontal_distance)
000887:  * Used for speech detection
000888:  * 
000889:  * @returns {number} MAR value (typically 0.0-0.5)
000890:  */
000891: export function calculateMAR(upperLip, lowerLip, leftMouth, rightMouth) {
000892:   if (!upperLip || !lowerLip || !leftMouth || !rightMouth) return 0.05;
000893:   
000894:   const verticalDist = distance2D(upperLip, lowerLip);
000895:   const horizontalDist = distance2D(leftMouth, rightMouth);
000896:   
000897:   if (horizontalDist === 0) return 0.05;
000898:   return verticalDist / horizontalDist;
000899: }
000900: 
000901: /**
000902:  * Calculate face orientation (yaw, pitch, roll)
000903:  * 
000904:  * @returns {Object} { yaw, pitch, roll } in degrees
000905:  */
000906: export function calculateFaceOrientation(noseTip, leftEye, rightEye, chin, forehead = null) {
000907:   if (!noseTip || !leftEye || !rightEye || !chin) {
000908:     return { yaw: 0, pitch: 0, roll: 0 };
000909:   }
000910:   
000911:   // Eye center
000912:   const eyeCenter = {
000913:     x: (leftEye.x + rightEye.x) / 2,
000914:     y: (leftEye.y + rightEye.y) / 2,
000915:     z: ((leftEye.z || 0) + (rightEye.z || 0)) / 2,
000916:   };
000917:   
000918:   // YAW (left-right rotation)
000919:   const yaw = Math.atan2(
000920:     eyeCenter.x - noseTip.x,
000921:     Math.abs((noseTip.z || 0) - eyeCenter.z) + 0.001
000922:   ) * (180 / Math.PI);
000923:   
000924:   // PITCH (up-down rotation)
000925:   const faceRef = forehead || eyeCenter;
000926:   const faceHeight = distance2D(faceRef, chin);
000927:   const noseHeight = noseTip.y - faceRef.y;
000928:   const expectedNoseHeight = faceHeight * 0.33;
000929:   const pitch = Math.atan2(
000930:     noseHeight - expectedNoseHeight,
000931:     faceHeight || 0.001
000932:   ) * (180 / Math.PI);
000933:   
000934:   // ROLL (head tilt)
000935:   const roll = Math.atan2(
000936:     rightEye.y - leftEye.y,
000937:     rightEye.x - leftEye.x
000938:   ) * (180 / Math.PI);
000939:   
000940:   return {
000941:     yaw: Math.round(yaw * 10) / 10,
000942:     pitch: Math.round(pitch * 10) / 10,
000943:     roll: Math.round(roll * 10) / 10,
000944:   };
000945: }
000946: 
000947: /**
000948:  * Calculate shoulder metrics
000949:  */
000950: export function calculateShoulderMetrics(leftShoulder, rightShoulder) {
000951:   if (!leftShoulder || !rightShoulder) {
000952:     return { slope: 0, width: 0, angle: 0, isLevel: true, score: 100, status: 'N/A' };
000953:   }
000954:   
000955:   const slope = Math.abs(leftShoulder.y - rightShoulder.y);
000956:   const width = Math.abs(leftShoulder.x - rightShoulder.x);
000957:   const angle = Math.atan2(
000958:     rightShoulder.y - leftShoulder.y,
000959:     rightShoulder.x - leftShoulder.x
000960:   ) * (180 / Math.PI);
000961:   
000962:   const ref = POSTURE_REFERENCE.shoulders.alignment;
000963:   let status, score;
000964:   
000965:   if (slope < ref.excellent) {
000966:     status = 'Excellent'; score = 100;
000967:   } else if (slope < ref.good) {
000968:     status = 'Good'; score = 85;
000969:   } else if (slope < ref.fair) {
000970:     status = 'Fair'; score = 70;
000971:   } else if (slope < ref.poor) {
000972:     status = 'Poor'; score = 50;
000973:   } else {
000974:     status = 'Critical'; score = 30;
000975:   }
000976:   
000977:   return { slope, width, angle, isLevel: slope < ref.good, score, status };
000978: }
000979: 
000980: /**
000981:  * Calculate spine alignment metrics
000982:  */
000983: export function calculateSpineAlignment(nose, leftShoulder, rightShoulder, leftHip = null, rightHip = null) {
000984:   if (!nose || !leftShoulder || !rightShoulder) {
000985:     return { forwardLean: 0, lateralLean: 0, isUpright: true, score: 100, status: 'N/A' };
000986:   }
000987:   
000988:   const shoulderCenter = {
000989:     x: (leftShoulder.x + rightShoulder.x) / 2,
000990:     y: (leftShoulder.y + rightShoulder.y) / 2,
000991:     z: ((leftShoulder.z || 0) + (rightShoulder.z || 0)) / 2,
000992:   };
000993:   
000994:   const forwardLean = (nose.z || 0) - shoulderCenter.z;
000995:   const lateralLean = nose.x - shoulderCenter.x;
000996:   
000997:   const ref = POSTURE_REFERENCE.spine;
000998:   let score = 100;
000999:   let status = 'Excellent';
001000:   
001001:   if (Math.abs(forwardLean) > ref.forwardLean.poorPosture) {
001002:     score -= 30; status = 'Poor';
001003:   } else if (Math.abs(forwardLean) > 0.04) {
001004:     score -= 15; status = 'Fair';
001005:   }
001006:   
001007:   if (Math.abs(lateralLean) > ref.lateralLean.moderate) {
001008:     score -= 20;
001009:     if (status === 'Excellent') status = 'Fair';
001010:   }
001011:   
001012:   return {
001013:     forwardLean,
001014:     lateralLean,
001015:     isUpright: Math.abs(forwardLean) < 0.05 && Math.abs(lateralLean) < 0.04,
001016:     score: Math.max(0, score),
001017:     status,
001018:   };
001019: }

001024: export function calculateArmAngle(shoulder, elbow, wrist) {

001028: /**
001029:  * Calculate finger curl (0 = extended, 1 = fully curled)
001030:  */
001031: export function calculateFingerCurl(mcp, pip, dip, tip) {
001032:   if (!mcp || !pip || !dip || !tip) return 0;
001033:   
001034:   const angle1 = calculateAngle(mcp, pip, dip);
001035:   const angle2 = calculateAngle(pip, dip, tip);
001036:   
001037:   // Normalize: 180° = straight (0 curl), 0° = fully curled (1 curl)
001038:   const avgAngle = (angle1 + angle2) / 2;
001039:   const curl = 1 - (avgAngle / 180);
001040:   
001041:   return Math.max(0, Math.min(1, curl));
001042: }

001044: /**
001045:  * Calculate finger spread between two fingertips
001046:  */
001047: export function calculateFingerSpread(tip1, tip2) {
001048:   if (!tip1 || !tip2) return 0;
001049:   return distance2D(tip1, tip2);

001052: /**
001053:  * Calculate hand openness (0 = fist, 1 = fully open)
001054:  */
001055: export function calculateHandOpenness(handLandmarks) {
001056:   if (!handLandmarks || handLandmarks.length < 21) return 0.5;
001057:   
001058:   const h = HAND_LANDMARKS;
001059:   
001060:   // Calculate curl for each finger
001061:   const thumbCurl = calculateFingerCurl(
001062:     handLandmarks[h.THUMB_CMC],
001063:     handLandmarks[h.THUMB_MCP],
001064:     handLandmarks[h.THUMB_IP],
001065:     handLandmarks[h.THUMB_TIP]
001066:   );
001067:   
001068:   const indexCurl = calculateFingerCurl(
001069:     handLandmarks[h.INDEX_FINGER_MCP],
001070:     handLandmarks[h.INDEX_FINGER_PIP],
001071:     handLandmarks[h.INDEX_FINGER_DIP],
001072:     handLandmarks[h.INDEX_FINGER_TIP]
001073:   );
001074:   
001075:   const middleCurl = calculateFingerCurl(
001076:     handLandmarks[h.MIDDLE_FINGER_MCP],
001077:     handLandmarks[h.MIDDLE_FINGER_PIP],
001078:     handLandmarks[h.MIDDLE_FINGER_DIP],
001079:     handLandmarks[h.MIDDLE_FINGER_TIP]
001080:   );
001081:   
001082:   const ringCurl = calculateFingerCurl(
001083:     handLandmarks[h.RING_FINGER_MCP],
001084:     handLandmarks[h.RING_FINGER_PIP],
001085:     handLandmarks[h.RING_FINGER_DIP],
001086:     handLandmarks[h.RING_FINGER_TIP]
001087:   );
001088:   
001089:   const pinkyCurl = calculateFingerCurl(
001090:     handLandmarks[h.PINKY_MCP],
001091:     handLandmarks[h.PINKY_PIP],
001092:     handLandmarks[h.PINKY_DIP],
001093:     handLandmarks[h.PINKY_TIP]
001094:   );
001095:   
001096:   // Average curl (inverted = openness)
001097:   const avgCurl = (thumbCurl + indexCurl + middleCurl + ringCurl + pinkyCurl) / 5;
001098:   return 1 - avgCurl;
001099: }

001101: /**
001102:  * Analyze complete hand metrics
001103:  */
001104: export function analyzeHand(handLandmarks) {
001105:   if (!handLandmarks || handLandmarks.length < 21) {
001106:     return {
001107:       detected: false,
001108:       openness: 0,
001109:       fingers: {
001110:         thumb: { curl: 0, extended: false },
001111:         index: { curl: 0, extended: false },
001112:         middle: { curl: 0, extended: false },
001113:         ring: { curl: 0, extended: false },
001114:         pinky: { curl: 0, extended: false },
001115:       },
001116:       spread: 0,
001117:       wristPosition: null,
001118:     };
001119:   }
001120:   
001121:   const h = HAND_LANDMARKS;
001122:   const extendedThreshold = HAND_REFERENCE.fingers.curl.extended;
001123:   
001124:   // Calculate each finger's curl
001125:   const thumbCurl = calculateFingerCurl(
001126:     handLandmarks[h.THUMB_CMC], handLandmarks[h.THUMB_MCP],
001127:     handLandmarks[h.THUMB_IP], handLandmarks[h.THUMB_TIP]
001128:   );
001129:   const indexCurl = calculateFingerCurl(
001130:     handLandmarks[h.INDEX_FINGER_MCP], handLandmarks[h.INDEX_FINGER_PIP],
001131:     handLandmarks[h.INDEX_FINGER_DIP], handLandmarks[h.INDEX_FINGER_TIP]
001132:   );
001133:   const middleCurl = calculateFingerCurl(
001134:     handLandmarks[h.MIDDLE_FINGER_MCP], handLandmarks[h.MIDDLE_FINGER_PIP],
001135:     handLandmarks[h.MIDDLE_FINGER_DIP], handLandmarks[h.MIDDLE_FINGER_TIP]
001136:   );
001137:   const ringCurl = calculateFingerCurl(
001138:     handLandmarks[h.RING_FINGER_MCP], handLandmarks[h.RING_FINGER_PIP],
001139:     handLandmarks[h.RING_FINGER_DIP], handLandmarks[h.RING_FINGER_TIP]
001140:   );
001141:   const pinkyCurl = calculateFingerCurl(
001142:     handLandmarks[h.PINKY_MCP], handLandmarks[h.PINKY_PIP],
001143:     handLandmarks[h.PINKY_DIP], handLandmarks[h.PINKY_TIP]
001144:   );
001145:   
001146:   // Calculate finger spread (average distance between adjacent fingertips)
001147:   const spreadIndex = distance2D(handLandmarks[h.INDEX_FINGER_TIP], handLandmarks[h.MIDDLE_FINGER_TIP]);
001148:   const spreadMiddle = distance2D(handLandmarks[h.MIDDLE_FINGER_TIP], handLandmarks[h.RING_FINGER_TIP]);
001149:   const spreadRing = distance2D(handLandmarks[h.RING_FINGER_TIP], handLandmarks[h.PINKY_TIP]);
001150:   const avgSpread = (spreadIndex + spreadMiddle + spreadRing) / 3;
001151:   
001152:   return {
001153:     detected: true,
001154:     openness: calculateHandOpenness(handLandmarks),
001155:     fingers: {
001156:       thumb: { curl: thumbCurl, extended: thumbCurl < extendedThreshold },
001157:       index: { curl: indexCurl, extended: indexCurl < extendedThreshold },
001158:       middle: { curl: middleCurl, extended: middleCurl < extendedThreshold },
001159:       ring: { curl: ringCurl, extended: ringCurl < extendedThreshold },
001160:       pinky: { curl: pinkyCurl, extended: pinkyCurl < extendedThreshold },
001161:     },
001162:     spread: avgSpread,
001163:     wristPosition: handLandmarks[h.WRIST],
001164:   };
001165: }

001167: /**
001168:  * Detect hand gesture
001169:  */
001170: export function detectHandGesture(handAnalysis) {
001171:   if (!handAnalysis.detected) return 'Not Detected';
001172:   
001173:   const { fingers, openness } = handAnalysis;
001174:   const extended = {
001175:     thumb: fingers.thumb.extended,
001176:     index: fingers.index.extended,
001177:     middle: fingers.middle.extended,
001178:     ring: fingers.ring.extended,
001179:     pinky: fingers.pinky.extended,
001180:   };
001181:   
001182:   // Count extended fingers
001183:   const extendedCount = Object.values(extended).filter(Boolean).length;
001184:   
001185:   // Open palm (all fingers extended)
001186:   if (extendedCount === 5 && openness > 0.7) {
001187:     return 'Open Palm';
001188:   }
001189:   
001190:   // Closed fist (no fingers extended)
001191:   if (extendedCount === 0 || openness < 0.2) {
001192:     return 'Closed Fist';
001193:   }
001194:   
001195:   // Pointing (only index extended)
001196:   if (extended.index && !extended.middle && !extended.ring && !extended.pinky) {
001197:     return 'Pointing';
001198:   }
001199:   
001200:   // Peace sign (index and middle extended)
001201:   if (extended.index && extended.middle && !extended.ring && !extended.pinky) {
001202:     return 'Peace Sign';
001203:   }
001204:   
001205:   // Thumbs up
001206:   if (extended.thumb && !extended.index && !extended.middle && !extended.ring && !extended.pinky) {
001207:     return 'Thumbs Up';
001208:   }
001209:   
001210:   // OK sign (thumb and index touching, others extended)
001211:   if (extended.middle && extended.ring && extended.pinky && !extended.index) {
001212:     return 'OK Sign';
001213:   }
001214:   
001215:   // Relaxed/natural
001216:   if (openness > 0.4 && openness < 0.7) {
001217:     return 'Relaxed';
001218:   }
001219:   
001220:   return 'Natural';
001221: }

001223: /**
001224:  * Calculate hand movement between frames
001225:  */
001226: export function calculateHandMovement(currentHand, previousHand) {
001227:   if (!currentHand || !previousHand) return 0;
001228:   
001229:   // Use wrist position for overall hand movement
001230:   const wristCurrent = currentHand[HAND_LANDMARKS.WRIST];
001231:   const wristPrevious = previousHand[HAND_LANDMARKS.WRIST];
001232:   
001233:   if (!wristCurrent || !wristPrevious) return 0;
001234:

001238: /**
001239:  * Calculate body stability
001240:  */
001241: export function calculateStability(currentPose, previousPose, history = []) {
001242:   if (!currentPose || !previousPose) {
001243:     return { stability: 1, movement: 0, isStable: true, score: 100, history: [] };
001244:   }
001245:   
001246:   // Calculate movement for key points
001247:   const keyPoints = ['nose', 'leftShoulder', 'rightShoulder'];
001248:   let totalMovement = 0;
001249:   let count = 0;
001250:   
001251:   keyPoints.forEach(point => {
001252:     if (currentPose[point] && previousPose[point]) {
001253:       totalMovement += distance2D(currentPose[point], previousPose[point]);
001254:       count++;
001255:     }
001256:   });
001257:   
001258:   const avgMovement = count > 0 ? totalMovement / count : 0;
001259:   const newHistory = [...history, avgMovement].slice(-30);
001260:   const avgHistorical = newHistory.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / newHistory.length;
001261:   
001262:   const ref = MOVEMENT_REFERENCE.stability.magnitude;
001263:   let score = 100;
001264:   
001265:   if (avgHistorical < ref.veryStill) score = 100;
001266:   else if (avgHistorical < ref.stable) score = 90;
001267:   else if (avgHistorical < ref.normal) score = 75;
001268:   else if (avgHistorical < ref.active) score = 60;
001269:   else if (avgHistorical < ref.restless) score = 40;
001270:   else score = 20;
001271:   
001272:   return {
001273:     stability: Math.max(0, 1 - (avgHistorical / ref.excessive)),
001274:     movement: avgMovement,
001275:     averageMovement: avgHistorical,
001276:     isStable: avgHistorical < ref.normal,
001277:     score,
001278:     history: newHistory,
001279:   };
001280: }
```

```text
000001: import React, {
000002:   createContext,
000003:   useCallback,
000004:   useContext,
000005:   useEffect,
000006:   useMemo,
000007:   useState,
000008: } from 'react';
000009: import { authHelpers } from '../config/firebase.js';
000010: import apiClient from '../services/apiClient.js';
000011: 
000012: const AuthContext = createContext(null);
000013: 
000014: const AUTH_SESSION_STORAGE_KEYS = [
000015:   'user',
000016:   'isAuthenticated',
000017: ];
000018: 
000019: const AUTH_FLOW_STORAGE_KEYS = [
000020:   'socialAuthVerified',
000021:   'socialAuthData',
000022:   'socialAuthIntent',
000023:   'socialAuthProvider',
000024:   'pendingRegistration',
000025:   'pendingAccountType',
000026: ];
000027: 
000028: const clearSessionStorage = () => {
000029:   if (typeof window === 'undefined') return;
000030:   AUTH_SESSION_STORAGE_KEYS.forEach((key) => window.localStorage.removeItem(key));
000031: };
000032: 
000033: const clearAllAuthStorage = () => {
000034:   if (typeof window === 'undefined') return;
000035:   [...AUTH_SESSION_STORAGE_KEYS, ...AUTH_FLOW_STORAGE_KEYS].forEach((key) =>
000036:     window.localStorage.removeItem(key),
000037:   );
000038: };
000039: 
000040: const shouldDeferProfileSync = () => {
000041:   if (typeof window === 'undefined') return false;
000042:   const intent = window.localStorage.getItem('socialAuthIntent');
000043:   const pendingRegistration = window.localStorage.getItem('pendingRegistration');
000044:   const pendingAccountType = window.localStorage.getItem('pendingAccountType');
000045:   if (intent !== 'register' && !pendingRegistration && !pendingAccountType) return false;
000046:   const path = window.location.pathname || '';
000047:   return path.startsWith('/register') || path.startsWith('/verify-email');
000048: };
000049: 
000050: export const AuthProvider = ({ children }) => {
000051:   const [user, setUser] = useState(null);
000052:   const [status, setStatus] = useState('loading'); // loading | authenticated | unauthenticated
000053:   const [error, setError] = useState(null);
000054: 
000055:   const applyAuthenticatedUser = useCallback((nextUser) => {
000056:     if (!nextUser) return;
000057:     if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
000058:       window.localStorage.setItem('user', JSON.stringify(nextUser));
000059:       window.localStorage.setItem('isAuthenticated', 'true');
000060:     }
000061:     setUser(nextUser);
000062:     setStatus('authenticated');
000063:   }, []);
000064: 
000065:   const syncUser = useCallback(async () => {
000066:     setStatus('loading');
000067:     setError(null);
000068:     try {
000069:       const { data } = await authHelpers.getSession();
000070:       if (!data?.session) {
000071:         throw new Error('No active session found');
000072:       }
000073: 
000074:       if (shouldDeferProfileSync()) {
000075:         setUser(null);
000076:         setStatus('unauthenticated');
000077:         return null;
000078:       }
000079: 
000080:       const profile = await apiClient.auth.getMe();
000081:       if (!profile.success || !profile.user) {
000082:         throw new Error('User not found');
000083:       }
000084: 
000085:       applyAuthenticatedUser(profile.user);
000086:       return profile.user;
000087:     } catch (err) {
000088:       if (err?.message !== 'No active session found') {
000089:         console.error('Auth sync error:', err);
000090:       }
000091:       clearSessionStorage();
000092:       setUser(null);
000093:       setStatus('unauthenticated');
000094:       setError(err);
000095:       return null;
000096:     }
000097:   }, [applyAuthenticatedUser]);
000098: 
000099:   const logout = useCallback(async () => {
000100:     try {
000101:       await authHelpers.signOut();
000102:     } catch (err) {
000103:       console.error('Failed to sign out:', err);
000104:     } finally {
000105:       clearAllAuthStorage();
000106:       setUser(null);
000107:       setStatus('unauthenticated');
000108:     }
000109:   }, []);
000110: 
000111:   useEffect(() => {
000112:     if (typeof authHelpers.onAuthStateChange !== 'function') {
000113:       // Fallback: immediately attempt to sync the user once
000114:       syncUser();
000115:       return undefined;
000116:     }
000117: 
000118:     const unsubscribe = authHelpers.onAuthStateChange(async (event) => {
000119:       if (event === 'SIGNED_IN') {
000120:         await syncUser();
000121:         return;
000122:       }
000123: 
000124:       if (event === 'SIGNED_OUT') {
000125:         clearAllAuthStorage();
000126:         setUser(null);
000127:         setStatus('unauthenticated');
000128:       }
000129:     });
000130: 
000131:     return () => {
000132:       if (typeof unsubscribe === 'function') {
000133:         unsubscribe();
000134:       }
000135:     };
000136:   }, [syncUser]);
000137: 
000138:   const value = useMemo(
000139:     () => ({
000140:       user,
000141:       status,
000142:       error,
000143:       organizationContext: user?.organizationContext || null,
000144:       organization: user?.organizationContext?.organization || null,
000145:       organizationMembership: user?.organizationContext?.membership || null,
000146:       organizationRole: user?.organizationContext?.membership?.role || null,
000147:       isOrgAdmin: user?.organizationContext?.membership?.role === 'ADMIN',
000148:       isAuthenticated: status === 'authenticated',
000149:       loading: status === 'loading',
000150:       refresh: syncUser,
000151:       logout,
000152:       setAuthenticatedUser: applyAuthenticatedUser,
000153:     }),
000154:     [user, status, error, syncUser, logout, applyAuthenticatedUser],
000155:   );
000156: 
000157:   return <AuthContext.Provider value={value}>{children}</AuthContext.Provider>;
000158: };
000159: 
000160: export const useAuth = () => {
000161:   const context = useContext(AuthContext);
000162:   if (!context) {
000163:     throw new Error('useAuth must be used within an AuthProvider');
000164:   }
000165:   return context;
000166: };
000167: 
000168: export { AuthContext };
000169: 
000170:
```

```text
000001: import React, { createContext, useContext, useEffect, useState } from 'react';
000002: 
000003: export const THEME_OPTIONS = ['light', 'dark', 'system'];
000004: 
000005: const getSystemTheme = () => {
000006:   if (window.matchMedia && window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)').matches) {
000007:     return 'dark';
000008:   }
000009:   return 'light';
000010: };
000011: 
000012: const getStoredTheme = () => {
000013:   const savedTheme = localStorage.getItem('theme');
000014:   return THEME_OPTIONS.includes(savedTheme) ? savedTheme : null;
000015: };
000016: 
000017: const resolveTheme = (themePreference, systemTheme) =>
000018:   themePreference === 'system' ? systemTheme : themePreference;
000019: 
000020: const ThemeContext = createContext({
000021:   theme: 'system',
000022:   resolvedTheme: 'light',
000023:   setTheme: () => {},
000024:   toggleTheme: () => {},
000025: });
000026: 
000027: export const useTheme = () => {
000028:   const context = useContext(ThemeContext);
000029:   if (!context) {
000030:     throw new Error('useTheme must be used within a ThemeProvider');
000031:   }
000032:   return context;
000033: };
000034: 
000035: export const ThemeProvider = ({ children }) => {
000036:   // Initialize theme synchronously to prevent flash
000037:   const getInitialTheme = () => getStoredTheme() || getSystemTheme();
000038: 
000039:   const [theme, setTheme] = useState(() => {
000040:     const initialTheme = getInitialTheme();
000041:     const initialResolvedTheme = resolveTheme(initialTheme, getSystemTheme());
000042:     // Apply theme immediately to prevent flash
000043:     const root = document.documentElement;
000044:     if (initialResolvedTheme === 'dark') {
000045:       root.classList.add('dark');
000046:     } else {
000047:       root.classList.remove('dark');
000048:     }
000049:     return initialTheme;
000050:   });
000051: 
000052:   const [systemTheme, setSystemTheme] = useState(() => getSystemTheme());
000053:   const resolvedTheme = resolveTheme(theme, systemTheme);
000054: 
000055:   useEffect(() => {
000056:     const root = document.documentElement;
000057:     if (resolvedTheme === 'dark') {
000058:       root.classList.add('dark');
000059:     } else {
000060:       root.classList.remove('dark');
000061:     }
000062:     localStorage.setItem('theme', theme);
000063:   }, [theme, resolvedTheme]);
000064: 
000065:   useEffect(() => {
000066:     if (!window.matchMedia) return undefined;
000067:     const mediaQuery = window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)');
000068:     const handleChange = (event) => {
000069:       setSystemTheme(event.matches ? 'dark' : 'light');
000070:     };
000071:     if (mediaQuery.addEventListener) {
000072:       mediaQuery.addEventListener('change', handleChange);
000073:       return () => {
000074:         mediaQuery.removeEventListener('change', handleChange);
000075:       };
000076:     }
000077:     mediaQuery.addListener(handleChange);
000078:     return () => {
000079:       mediaQuery.removeListener(handleChange);
000080:     };
000081:   }, []);
000082: 
000083:   const setThemePreference = (nextTheme) => {
000084:     if (!THEME_OPTIONS.includes(nextTheme)) return;
000085:     setTheme(nextTheme);
000086:   };
000087: 
000088:   const toggleTheme = () => {
000089:     setTheme((prevTheme) => {
000090:       const currentIndex = THEME_OPTIONS.indexOf(prevTheme);
000091:       const nextIndex = currentIndex === -1 ? 0 : (currentIndex + 1) % THEME_OPTIONS.length;
000092:       return THEME_OPTIONS[nextIndex];
000093:     });
000094:   };
000095: 
000096:   return (
000097:     <ThemeContext.Provider value={{ theme, resolvedTheme, setTheme: setThemePreference, toggleTheme }}>
000098:       {children}
000099:     </ThemeContext.Provider>
000100:   );
000101: };
000102: 
000103: 
```

```text
000001: /**
000002:  * useAIInterviewer Hook
000003:  * 
000004:  * React hook for managing the AI interviewer conversation flow
000005:  * Provides easy-to-use interface for components to interact with the AI interviewer
000006:  */
000007: 
000008: import { useState, useCallback, useRef, useEffect } from 'react';
000009: import { createAIInterviewer } from '../services/aiInterviewer';
000010: import speechService from '../services/speechService';
000011: import speechRecognitionService from '../services/speechRecognitionService';
000012: import audioRecorderService from '../services/audioRecorderService';
000013: import { transcribeWithFallback, checkLocalWhisperHealth } from '../services/localWhisperService';
000014: import InterviewBackendSync from '../services/interviewBackendSync';
000015: 
000016: export const useAIInterviewer = (config = {}) => {
000017:   const [isInitialized, setIsInitialized] = useState(false);
000018:   const [currentMessage, setCurrentMessage] = useState('');
000019:   const [phase, setPhase] = useState('not_started'); // not_started, introduction, questions, candidate_questions, closing, completed
000020:   const [isProcessing, setIsProcessing] = useState(false);
000021:   const [isSpeaking, setIsSpeaking] = useState(false);
000022:   const [isListening, setIsListening] = useState(false); // active capture (browser STT or recording)
000023:   const [currentTranscript, setCurrentTranscript] = useState(''); // interim transcript (browser STT)
000024:   const [whisperAvailable, setWhisperAvailable] = useState(false); // local whisper health
000025:   const [isTranscribing, setIsTranscribing] = useState(false); // uploading + waiting whisper
000026:   const [error, setError] = useState(null);
000027:   const [conversationHistory, setConversationHistory] = useState([]);
000028:   const [interviewState, setInterviewState] = useState(null);
000029:   const [canCandidateSpeak, setCanCandidateSpeak] = useState(false);
000030:   
000031:   const interviewerRef = useRef(null);
000032:   const backendSyncRef = useRef(null);
000033:   const currentQuestionIdRef = useRef(null); // Track current question ID from backend
000034: 
000035:   useEffect(() => {
000036:     return () => {
000037:       backendSyncRef.current?.destroy?.();
000038:       speechRecognitionService.stop();
000039:       audioRecorderService.abort?.();
000040:       speechService.cancel?.();
000041:     };
000042:   }, []);
000043: 
000044:   /**
000045:    * Speak a message using TTS
000046:    */
000047:   const speakMessage = useCallback(async (message) => {
000048:     if (!message) return;
000049:     
000050:     try {
000051:       setIsSpeaking(true);
000052:       setCanCandidateSpeak(false); // AI is speaking, candidate cannot
000053:       
000054:       await speechService.speak(message, {
000055:         rate: 0.95,
000056:         pitch: 1.0,
000057:         volume: 1.0,
000058:         onEnd: () => {
000059:           setIsSpeaking(false);
000060:           setCanCandidateSpeak(true); // AI finished, candidate can now speak
000061:         },
000062:         onError: (error) => {
000063:           console.error('TTS error:', error);
000064:           setIsSpeaking(false);
000065:           setCanCandidateSpeak(true); // On error, allow candidate to speak
000066:         }
000067:       });
000068:     } catch (err) {
000069:       console.error('Speech error:', err);
000070:       setIsSpeaking(false);
000071:       setCanCandidateSpeak(true);
000072:     }
000073:   }, []);
000074: 
000075:   /**
000076:    * Start listening to candidate's speech
000077:    */
000078:   const startListening = useCallback(async () => {
000079:     if (!canCandidateSpeak || isListening) return false;
000080: 
000081:     // If Whisper is available -> record raw audio, else fallback to browser STT
000082:     if (whisperAvailable) {
000083:       const started = await audioRecorderService.start();
000084:       if (!started) return false;
000085:       setIsListening(true);
000086:       setCurrentTranscript('');
000087:       return true;
000088:     }
000089: 
000090:     // Browser STT fallback
000091:     speechRecognitionService.onResult = (result) => {
000092:       setCurrentTranscript(result.full);
000093:     };
000094:     speechRecognitionService.onSilenceDetected = () => {
000095:       stopListening();
000096:     };
000097:     speechRecognitionService.onStart = () => {
000098:       setIsListening(true);
000099:       setCurrentTranscript('');
000100:     };
000101:     speechRecognitionService.onEnd = () => setIsListening(false);
000102:     speechRecognitionService.onError = (err) => {
000103:       console.error('Speech recognition error:', err);
000104:       setIsListening(false);
000105:     };
000106:     const started = speechRecognitionService.start();
000107:     if (started) setIsListening(true);
000108:     return started;
000109:   }, [canCandidateSpeak, isListening, whisperAvailable]);
000110: 
000111:   /**
000112:    * Stop listening to candidate's speech
000113:    */
000114:   const stopListening = useCallback(async () => {
000115:     if (!isListening) return null;
000116: 
000117:     // Whisper path
000118:     if (whisperAvailable && audioRecorderService.isRecording) {
000119:       const blob = await audioRecorderService.stop();
000120:       setIsListening(false);
000121:       setIsTranscribing(true);
000122:       try {
000123:         const result = await transcribeWithFallback(blob, { language: 'en' });
000124:         setIsTranscribing(false);
000125:         return result.text;
000126:       } catch (err) {
000127:         console.warn('Whisper transcription failed, falling back:', err.message);
000128:         setIsTranscribing(false);
000129:         // Fallback: no transcript -> user retry
000130:         return '';
000131:       }
000132:     }
000133: 
000134:     // Browser STT path
000135:     speechRecognitionService.stop();
000136:     const transcript = speechRecognitionService.getTranscript();
000137:     setIsListening(false);
000138:     const final = transcript.final;
000139:     setCurrentTranscript('');
000140:     return final;
000141:   }, [isListening, whisperAvailable]);
000142: 
000143:   /**
000144:    * Initialize the AI interviewer
000145:    */
000146:   const initializeInterview = useCallback(async (interviewConfig = {}) => {
000147:     try {
000148:       setIsProcessing(true);
000149:       setError(null);

000151:       // Check local whisper server once at init

000154:         setWhisperAvailable(healthy);

000156:         setWhisperAvailable(false);
000157:       }
```

```text
000213:   /**

000216:   const analyzePose = useCallback((landmarks) => {
000217:     // Key landmarks

000219:     const rightShoulder = landmarks[POSE_LANDMARKS.RIGHT_SHOULDER];
000220:     const leftHip = landmarks[POSE_LANDMARKS.LEFT_HIP];
000221:     const rightHip = landmarks[POSE_LANDMARKS.RIGHT_HIP];
000222:     const nose = landmarks[POSE_LANDMARKS.NOSE];
000223:     const leftEye = landmarks[POSE_LANDMARKS.LEFT_EYE];
000224:     const rightEye = landmarks[POSE_LANDMARKS.RIGHT_EYE];
000225:     const leftWrist = landmarks[POSE_LANDMARKS.LEFT_WRIST];
000226:     const rightWrist = landmarks[POSE_LANDMARKS.RIGHT_WRIST];
000227: 
000228:     // === SHOULDER ALIGNMENT ===
000229:     const shoulderSlope = Math.abs(leftShoulder.y - rightShoulder.y);
000230:     let shoulderScore = 100;
000231:     let shoulderStatus = 'good';
000232:     
000233:     if (shoulderSlope > POSTURE_REFERENCE.shoulder.poorSlopeThreshold) {
000234:       shoulderScore = 40;
000235:       shoulderStatus = 'poor';
000236:     } else if (shoulderSlope > POSTURE_REFERENCE.shoulder.moderateSlopeThreshold) {
000237:       shoulderScore = 70;
000238:       shoulderStatus = 'fair';
000239:     } else if (shoulderSlope > POSTURE_REFERENCE.shoulder.maxSlopeThreshold) {
000240:       shoulderScore = 85;
000241:     }
000242: 
000243:     // === SPINE/FORWARD HEAD ===
000244:     const shoulderMidpoint = {
000245:       x: (leftShoulder.x + rightShoulder.x) / 2,
000246:       y: (leftShoulder.y + rightShoulder.y) / 2,
000247:       z: ((leftShoulder.z || 0) + (rightShoulder.z || 0)) / 2,
000248:     };
000249:     
000250:     const forwardHeadDistance = (nose.z || 0) - shoulderMidpoint.z;
000251:     const forwardHead = forwardHeadDistance > POSTURE_REFERENCE.spine.maxForwardHeadThreshold;
000252:     
000253:     let spineScore = 100;
000254:     if (forwardHeadDistance > POSTURE_REFERENCE.spine.poorForwardHeadThreshold) {
000255:       spineScore = 40;
000256:     } else if (forwardHeadDistance > POSTURE_REFERENCE.spine.moderateForwardHeadThreshold) {
000257:       spineScore = 70;
000258:     } else if (forwardHeadDistance > POSTURE_REFERENCE.spine.maxForwardHeadThreshold) {
000259:       spineScore = 85;
000260:     }

000262:     // === HEAD POSITION ===
000263:     const eyeSlope = Math.abs(leftEye.y - rightEye.y);
000264:     const eyeMidpoint = (leftEye.y + rightEye.y) / 2;
000265:     const headLowered = nose.y > eyeMidpoint + POSTURE_REFERENCE.head.loweredThreshold;
000266:     
000267:     let headPosition = 'centered';
```

```text
000101:       : null
000102:   ), [eventTypeKey]);
000103: 
000104:   useEffect(() => {
000105:     callbackRef.current = onFeedUpdate;
000106:   }, [onFeedUpdate]);
000107: 
000108:   const feedPath = useMemo(
000109:     () => (userId ? `userInterviewFeeds/${userId}` : null),
000110:     [userId],
000111:   );
000112: 
000113:   useEffect(() => {
000114:     if (!enabled || !feedPath || !realtimeDb) {
000115:       hasInitializedRef.current = false;
000116:       lastSignatureRef.current = '';
000117:       lastFeedMapRef.current = new Map();
000118:       return undefined;
000119:     }
000120: 
000121:     const feedRef = dbRef(realtimeDb, feedPath);
000122:     const unsubscribe = onValue(
000123:       feedRef,
000124:       (snapshot) => {
000125:         const feed = snapshot.val() || {};
000126:         const nextFeedMap = buildFeedMap(feed);
000127:         const signature = buildFeedSignature(nextFeedMap);
000128:         if (signature === lastSignatureRef.current) {
000129:           return;
000130:         }
000131: 
000132:         const isInitial = !hasInitializedRef.current;
000133:         const changedEntries = resolveChangedEntries(lastFeedMapRef.current, nextFeedMap);
000134:         lastSignatureRef.current = signature;
000135:         lastFeedMapRef.current = nextFeedMap;
000136: 
000137:         const shouldFilterByEventType = Boolean(
000138:           !isInitial
000139:           && normalizedEventTypes
000140:           && normalizedEventTypes.size > 0,
000141:         );
000142:         if (shouldFilterByEventType) {
000143:           const hasMatchingEvent = changedEntries.some((entry) => (
000144:             typeof entry?.lastEventType === 'string'
000145:             && normalizedEventTypes.has(entry.lastEventType.toLowerCase())
000146:           ));
000147:           if (!hasMatchingEvent) {
000148:             hasInitializedRef.current = true;
000149:             return;
000150:           }
000151:         }
000152: 
000153:         if (typeof callbackRef.current === 'function') {
000154:           callbackRef.current(feed, { initial: isInitial, changedEntries });
000155:         }
000156:         hasInitializedRef.current = true;
000157:       },
000158:       () => {
000159:         // Keep fail-open behavior: caller still has HTTP/manual refresh.
000160:       },
000161:     );
000162: 
000163:     return () => {
000164:       hasInitializedRef.current = false;
000165:       lastSignatureRef.current = '';
000166:       lastFeedMapRef.current = new Map();
000167:       if (typeof unsubscribe === 'function') {
000168:         unsubscribe();
000169:       }
000170:     };
000171:   }, [enabled, eventTypeKey, feedPath, normalizedEventTypes]);
000172: };
000173: 
000174: export default useInterviewRealtimeFeed;
```

```text
000001: /**
000002:  * Custom hook for FREE Local LLM functionality
000003:  * Replaces useOpenAI hook - zero API costs
000004:  */
000005: 
000006: import { useState, useCallback } from 'react';
000007: import {
000008:   generateInterviewQuestions,
000009:   generateNextQuestion,
000010:   analyzeAnswer,
000011:   generateInterviewSummary,
000012:   generateStudyPlan,
000013:   generateCareerAssistantResponse,
000014:   generateWebsiteAssistantResponse,
000015:   generateChatReplySuggestions
000016: } from '../services/llmServices.js';
000017: import { checkOllamaHealth } from '../services/llmClient.js';
000018: 
000019: /**
000020:  * Hook for local LLM operations
000021:  */
000022: export const useLLM = () => {
000023:   const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
000024:   const [error, setError] = useState(null);
000025: 
000026:   const handleLLMCall = useCallback(async (apiCall, ...args) => {
000027:     setLoading(true);
000028:     setError(null);
000029:     
000030:     try {
000031:       const result = await apiCall(...args);
000032:       return result;
000033:     } catch (err) {
000034:       const errorMessage = err?.message || 'An unexpected error occurred';
000035:       setError(errorMessage);
000036:       console.error('LLM API Error:', err);
000037:       throw new Error(errorMessage);
000038:     } finally {
000039:       setLoading(false);
000040:     }
000041:   }, []);
000042: 
000043:   const generateQuestions = useCallback(async (config) => {
000044:     return handleLLMCall(generateInterviewQuestions, config);
000045:   }, [handleLLMCall]);
000046: 
000047:   const getNextQuestion = useCallback(async (context) => {
000048:     return handleLLMCall(generateNextQuestion, context);
000049:   }, [handleLLMCall]);
000050: 
000051:   const evaluateAnswer = useCallback(async (analysisData) => {
000052:     return handleLLMCall(analyzeAnswer, analysisData);
000053:   }, [handleLLMCall]);
000054: 
000055:   const generateSummary = useCallback(async (sessionData) => {
000056:     return handleLLMCall(generateInterviewSummary, sessionData);
000057:   }, [handleLLMCall]);
000058: 
000059:   const createStudyPlan = useCallback(async (evaluationData) => {
000060:     return handleLLMCall(generateStudyPlan, evaluationData);
000061:   }, [handleLLMCall]);
000062: 
000063:   const getCareerAssistantResponse = useCallback(async (conversationPayload) => {
000064:     return handleLLMCall(generateCareerAssistantResponse, conversationPayload);
000065:   }, [handleLLMCall]);
000066: 
000067:   const getWebsiteAssistantResponse = useCallback(async (conversationPayload) => {
000068:     return handleLLMCall(generateWebsiteAssistantResponse, conversationPayload);
000069:   }, [handleLLMCall]);
000070: 
000071:   const getChatSuggestions = useCallback(async (conversationPayload) => {
000072:     return handleLLMCall(generateChatReplySuggestions, conversationPayload);
000073:   }, [handleLLMCall]);
000074: 
000075:   const checkHealth = useCallback(async () => {
000076:     return handleLLMCall(checkOllamaHealth);
000077:   }, [handleLLMCall]);
000078: 
000079:   const clearError = useCallback(() => {
000080:     setError(null);
000081:   }, []);
000082: 
000083:   return {
000084:     loading,
000085:     error,
000086:     clearError,
000087:     generateQuestions,
000088:     getNextQuestion,
000089:     evaluateAnswer,
000090:     generateSummary,
000091:     createStudyPlan,
000092:     getCareerAssistantResponse,
000093:     getWebsiteAssistantResponse,
000094:     getChatSuggestions,
000095:     checkHealth
000096:   };
000097: };
000098: 
000099: // Export as default for backward compatibility
000100: export default useLLM;
000101: 
```

```text
000001: import { useState, useEffect, useMemo } from 'react';
000002: import { onValue, ref as dbRef } from 'firebase/database';
000003: import { useAuth } from '../contexts/AuthContext';
000004: import { realtimeDb } from '../config/firebase.js';
000005: 
000006: const API_URL = import.meta.env.VITE_API_URL || 'http://localhost:3000';
000007: 
000008: /**
000009:  * Hook to check maintenance mode status
000010:  * System admins always return false (no maintenance mode for them)
000011:  * 
000012:  * FIXED: Changed dependency from entire `user` object to `accountType` to prevent
000013:  * unnecessary re-runs when the user object reference changes (which was causing
000014:  * excessive API calls). Now the effect only re-runs when the account type actually changes.
000015:  */
000016: export const useMaintenanceMode = () => {
000017:   const { user } = useAuth();
000018:   // Use memoized accountType instead of depending on the entire user object
000019:   // This prevents the effect from re-running when user object reference changes
000020:   const accountType = useMemo(() => user?.accountType, [user?.accountType]);
000021:   const [maintenanceMode, setMaintenanceMode] = useState(false);
000022:   const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
000023: 
000024:   useEffect(() => {
000025:     let unsubRealtime = null;
000026:     let isCancelled = false;
000027: 
000028:     // System admins bypass maintenance mode
000029:     if (accountType === 'SYSTEM_ADMIN') {
000030:       setMaintenanceMode(false);
000031:       setLoading(false);
000032:       return;
000033:     }
000034: 
000035:     const checkMaintenanceModeViaHttp = async () => {
000036:       try {
000037:         const response = await fetch(`${API_URL}/api/public/maintenance-status`);
000038:         const data = await response.json();
000039:         if (!isCancelled) {
000040:           setMaintenanceMode(Boolean(data.success && data.maintenanceMode));
000041:           setLoading(false);
000042:         }
000043:       } catch (error) {
000044:         // If we can't check, assume no maintenance mode
000045:         if (!isCancelled) {
000046:           setMaintenanceMode(false);
000047:           setLoading(false);
000048:         }
000049:       }
000050:     };
000051: 
000052:     try {
000053:       // Prefer realtime subscription for instant maintenance mode updates
000054:       if (realtimeDb) {
000055:         const settingsRef = dbRef(realtimeDb, 'public/systemSettings');
000056:         unsubRealtime = onValue(
000057:           settingsRef,
000058:           (snapshot) => {
000059:             const data = snapshot.val();
000060:             if (data && typeof data.maintenanceMode === 'boolean') {
000061:               setMaintenanceMode(Boolean(data.maintenanceMode));
000062:               setLoading(false);
000063:               return;
000064:             }
000065: 
000066:             // Fallback if public settings are not available in RTDB
000067:             void checkMaintenanceModeViaHttp();
000068:           },
000069:           () => {
000070:             // Fallback to HTTP if realtime subscription fails
000071:             void checkMaintenanceModeViaHttp();
000072:           },
000073:         );
000074:       } else {
000075:         void checkMaintenanceModeViaHttp();
000076:       }
000077:     } catch {
000078:       void checkMaintenanceModeViaHttp();
000079:     }
000080: 
000081:     return () => {
000082:       isCancelled = true;
000083:       if (typeof unsubRealtime === 'function') {
000084:         unsubRealtime();
000085:       }
000086:     };
000087:   }, [accountType]); // Only depend on accountType, not entire user object
000088: 
000089:   return { maintenanceMode, loading };
000090: };
000091: 
```

```text
000001: import { useEffect, useMemo, useRef } from 'react';
000002: import { onValue, ref as dbRef } from 'firebase/database';
000003: import { realtimeDb } from '../config/firebase.js';
000004: 
000005: const buildFeedSignature = (feed = {}) => (
000006:   `${feed?.lastEventId || ''}|${feed?.lastEventType || ''}|${feed?.lastEventAt || ''}|${feed?.updatedAt || ''}`
000007: );
000008: 
000009: const buildEventTypeKey = (eventTypes) => {
000010:   if (!Array.isArray(eventTypes) || eventTypes.length === 0) {
000011:     return '';
000012:   }
000013: 
000014:   return Array.from(
000015:     new Set(
000016:       eventTypes
000017:         .map((eventType) => (typeof eventType === 'string' ? eventType.toLowerCase().trim() : ''))
000018:         .filter(Boolean),
000019:     ),
000020:   )
000021:     .sort()
000022:     .join('|');
000023: };
000024: 
000025: /**
000026:  * Generic RTDB feed listener for paths that expose a single feed object.
000027:  */
000028: export const useRealtimePathFeed = ({
000029:   path,
000030:   enabled = true,
000031:   eventTypes = null,
000032:   onFeedUpdate,
000033: }) => {
000034:   const callbackRef = useRef(onFeedUpdate);
000035:   const lastSignatureRef = useRef('');
000036:   const hasInitializedRef = useRef(false);
000037:   const eventTypeKey = buildEventTypeKey(eventTypes);
000038:   const normalizedEventTypes = useMemo(() => (
000039:     eventTypeKey
000040:       ? new Set(eventTypeKey.split('|'))
000041:       : null
000042:   ), [eventTypeKey]);
000043: 
000044:   useEffect(() => {
000045:     callbackRef.current = onFeedUpdate;
000046:   }, [onFeedUpdate]);
000047: 
000048:   useEffect(() => {
000049:     if (!enabled || !path || !realtimeDb) {
000050:       hasInitializedRef.current = false;
000051:       lastSignatureRef.current = '';
000052:       return undefined;
000053:     }
000054: 
000055:     const feedRef = dbRef(realtimeDb, path);
000056:     const unsubscribe = onValue(
000057:       feedRef,
000058:       (snapshot) => {
000059:         const feed = snapshot.val() || {};
000060:         const signature = buildFeedSignature(feed);
000061:         if (signature === lastSignatureRef.current) return;
000062: 
000063:         lastSignatureRef.current = signature;
000064:         const isInitial = !hasInitializedRef.current;
000065:         const lastEventType = typeof feed?.lastEventType === 'string'
000066:           ? feed.lastEventType.trim()
000067:           : '';
000068:         const eventType = lastEventType || null;
000069:         const shouldFilterByEventType = Boolean(!isInitial && normalizedEventTypes && normalizedEventTypes.size > 0);
000070:         if (
000071:           shouldFilterByEventType
000072:           && !normalizedEventTypes.has(lastEventType.toLowerCase())
000073:         ) {
000074:           hasInitializedRef.current = true;
000075:           return;
000076:         }
000077: 
000078:         if (typeof callbackRef.current === 'function') {
000079:           callbackRef.current(feed, { initial: isInitial, eventType });
000080:         }
000081:         hasInitializedRef.current = true;
000082:       },
000083:       () => {
000084:         // Keep fail-open behavior: caller still has HTTP/manual refresh fallback.
000085:       },
000086:     );
000087: 
000088:     return () => {
000089:       hasInitializedRef.current = false;
000090:       lastSignatureRef.current = '';
000091:       if (typeof unsubscribe === 'function') {
000092:         unsubscribe();
000093:       }
000094:     };
000095:   }, [enabled, eventTypeKey, normalizedEventTypes, path]);
000096: };
000097: 
000098: export default useRealtimePathFeed;
```

```text
000267:   const handleSendMessage = async (overrideText = null) => {

000318:   const stopRecordingAndTranscribe = async () => {
000319:     setRecordingError(null);
000320:     try {
000321:       setVoiceStatus('transcribing');
000322:       const audioBlob = await audioRecorderService.stop();
000323:       setIsRecording(false);

000325:       if (!audioBlob || audioBlob.size === 0) {

000330: 
000331:       setIsTranscribing(true);

000333:       const transcriptText = transcription?.text?.trim()
000334:         || transcription?.segments?.map((segment) => segment?.text || '').join(' ').trim();
000335: 
000336:       if (transcriptText) {
000337:         if (inputValue?.trim()) {
000338:           setInputValue(prev => `${prev} ${transcriptText}`.trim());
000339:           setVoiceStatus('idle');
000340:         } else {
000341:           setVoiceStatus('processing');
000342:           await handleSendMessage(transcriptText);
000343:           setVoiceStatus('idle');

000345:       } else {

000347:         setVoiceStatus('idle');

000439:   const formatTime = (timestamp) => {

000441:       hour: '2-digit', 
000442:       minute: '2-digit' 
000443:     });
000444:   };
000445: 
000446:   const renderInlineFormatting = (text = '', type = 'assistant') => {
000447:     if (!text) return null;
000448: 
000449:     const pattern = /(\*\*[^*]+\*\*|__[^_]+__|_[^_]+_|`[^`]+`)/g;
000450:     const segments = [];
000451:     let lastIndex = 0;
000452:     let match;
000453: 
000454:     while ((match = pattern.exec(text)) !== null) {
000455:       if (match.index > lastIndex) {
000456:         segments.push({ type: 'text', value: text.slice(lastIndex, match.index) });
000457:       }
000458: 
000459:       const token = match[0];
000460:       if (token.startsWith('**')) {
000461:         segments.push({ type: 'bold', value: token.slice(2, -2) });
000462:       } else if (token.startsWith('__')) {
000463:         segments.push({ type: 'underline', value: token.slice(2, -2) });
000464:       } else if (token.startsWith('_')) {
000465:         segments.push({ type: 'italic', value: token.slice(1, -1) });
000466:       } else if (token.startsWith('`')) {
000467:         segments.push({ type: 'code', value: token.slice(1, -1) });
000468:       }
000469:       lastIndex = pattern.lastIndex;
000470:     }
000471: 
000472:     if (lastIndex < text.length) {
000473:       segments.push({ type: 'text', value: text.slice(lastIndex) });
000474:     }
000475: 
000476:     return segments.map((segment, index) => {
000477:       const key = `${segment.type}-${type}-${index}`;
000478:       const baseColor = type === 'user' ? 'text-white' : 'text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100';
000479: 
000480:       switch (segment.type) {
000481:         case 'bold':
000482:           return (
000483:             <span key={key} className={`${baseColor} font-semibold`}>
000484:               {segment.value}
000485:             </span>
000486:           );
000487:         case 'italic':
000488:           return (
000489:             <span key={key} className={`${baseColor} italic`}>
000490:               {segment.value}
000491:             </span>
000492:           );
000493:         case 'underline':
000494:           return (
000495:             <span key={key} className={`${baseColor} underline decoration-dashed decoration-2`}>
000496:               {segment.value}
000497:             </span>
000498:           );
000499:         case 'code':
000500:           return (
000501:             <code
000502:               key={key}
000503:               className={`font-mono text-xs px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded border ${
000504:                 type === 'user'
000505:                   ? 'bg-white/20 border-white/20 text-white'
000506:                   : 'bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-900/80 border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-100'
000507:               }`}
000508:             >
000509:               {segment.value}
000510:             </code>
000511:           );
000512:         default:
000513:           return (
000514:             <span key={key} className={type === 'user' ? 'text-white' : 'text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-100'}>
000515:               {segment.value}
000516:             </span>
000517:           );
000518:       }
000519:     });
000520:   };

000522:   const renderMessageContent = (content = '', type = 'assistant', sizeProfile = sizeSettings) => {
000523:     const currentSize = sizeProfile || sizeSettings;
000524:     const lines = content.split('\n');
000525:     const blocks = [];
000526:     let currentList = null;
000527: 
000528:     const headingBase = type === 'user'
000529:       ? {
000530:           2: 'font-semibold text-white',
000531:           3: 'font-semibold text-white/90 uppercase tracking-wide',
000532:           4: 'font-semibold text-white/80'
000533:         }
000534:       : {
000535:           2: 'font-semibold text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100',
000536:           3: 'font-semibold text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-300 uppercase tracking-wide',
000537:           4: 'font-semibold text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400'
000538:         };
000539: 
000540:     const bodyColor = type === 'user'
000541:       ? 'text-white/90'
000542:       : 'text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200';
000543: 
000544:     const bodySize = type === 'user' ? currentSize.bodyUser : currentSize.bodyAssistant;
000545:     const paragraphClass = `${bodySize} leading-relaxed ${bodyColor}`;
000546:     const listSpacing = currentSize.listSpacing || 'space-y-1.5';
000547: 
000548:     const flushList = () => {
000549:       if (!currentList || currentList.items.length === 0) return;
000550:       const ListTag = currentList.type === 'ol' ? 'ol' : 'ul';
000551:       blocks.push(
000552:         <ListTag
000553:           key={`list-${blocks.length}`}
000554:           className={`${currentList.type === 'ol' ? 'list-decimal' : 'list-disc'} pl-5 ${listSpacing} ${bodySize} ${bodyColor}`}
000555:         >
000556:           {currentList.items.map((item, idx) => (
000557:             <li key={`list-item-${blocks.length}-${idx}`}>
000558:               {renderInlineFormatting(item, type)}
000559:             </li>
000560:           ))}
000561:         </ListTag>
000562:       );
000563:       currentList = null;
000564:     };
000565: 
000566:     lines.forEach((line, idx) => {
000567:       const trimmed = line.trim();
000568: 
000569:       if (!trimmed) {
000570:         flushList();
000571:         blocks.push(<div key={`spacer-${idx}`} className="h-2" aria-hidden="true" />);
000572:         return;
000573:       }
000574: 
000575:       const headingMatch = trimmed.match(/^(#{2,4})\s+(.*)$/);
000576:       if (headingMatch) {
000577:         flushList();
000578:         const level = headingMatch[1].length;
000579:         const headingText = headingMatch[2];
000580:         const sizeClass = currentSize[`heading${level}`] || currentSize.heading2 || '';
000581:         const headingClass = `${sizeClass} ${headingBase[level] || ''} leading-snug`;
000582: 
000583:         blocks.push(
000584:           <p key={`heading-${idx}`} className={headingClass}>
000585:             {renderInlineFormatting(headingText, type)}
000586:           </p>
000587:         );
000588:         return;
000589:       }
000590: 
000591:       const bulletMatch = trimmed.match(/^[-*]\s+(.*)$/);
000592:       if (bulletMatch) {
000593:         if (!currentList || currentList.type !== 'ul') {
000594:           flushList();
000595:           currentList = { type: 'ul', items: [] };
000596:         }
000597:         currentList.items.push(bulletMatch[1]);
000598:         return;
000599:       }
000600: 
000601:       const orderedMatch = trimmed.match(/^\d+\.\s+(.*)$/);
000602:       if (orderedMatch) {
000603:         if (!currentList || currentList.type !== 'ol') {
000604:           flushList();
000605:           currentList = { type: 'ol', items: [] };
000606:         }
000607:         currentList.items.push(orderedMatch[1]);
000608:         return;
000609:       }
000610: 
000611:       flushList();
000612:       blocks.push(
000613:         <p
000614:           key={`paragraph-${idx}`}
000615:           className={paragraphClass}
000616:         >
000617:           {renderInlineFormatting(trimmed, type)}
000618:         </p>
000619:       );
000620:     });
000621: 
000622:     flushList();
000623:     return blocks;
000624:   };
```

```text
000049:   if (logoPath.startsWith('http://') || logoPath.startsWith('https://')) {
000050:     return logoPath;
000051:   }
000052:   // Convert relative path to absolute URL
000053:   const base = API_URL.replace(/\/$/, '');
000054:   return `${base}${logoPath.startsWith('/') ? logoPath : `/${logoPath}`}`;
000055: };
000056: 
000057: // Helper function to get candidate profile image URL
000058: const getCandidateImageUrl = (candidate) => {
000059:   if (!candidate) return null;
000060:   const photoUrl = candidate.profilePhotoUrl || candidate.photoURL || candidate.user_metadata?.photoURL;
000061:   if (!photoUrl) return null;
000062:   if (photoUrl.startsWith('http://') || photoUrl.startsWith('https://')) {
000063:     return photoUrl;
000064:   }
000065:   // Convert relative path to absolute URL
000066:   const base = API_URL.replace(/\/$/, '');
000067:   return `${base}${photoUrl.startsWith('/') ? photoUrl : `/${photoUrl}`}`;
000068: };
000069: 
000070: const getStatusConfig = (applicationOrStatus, withdrawnBy = null, dispositionCode = null) => {
000071:   const application = typeof applicationOrStatus === 'object' && applicationOrStatus !== null
000072:     ? applicationOrStatus
000073:     : {
000074:       status: applicationOrStatus,
000075:       withdrawnBy,
000076:       dispositionCode,
000077:     };
000078:   const derivedStatus = getDerivedApplicationStatus(application);
000079: 
000080:   if (derivedStatus === 'WITHDRAWN') {
000081:     return {
000082:       label: 'Withdrew',
000083:       color: 'bg-orange-100 text-orange-700 dark:bg-orange-900/30 dark:text-orange-300',
000084:       icon: 'XCircle',
000085:     };
000086:   }
000087: 
000088:   if (derivedStatus === 'POSITION_CLOSED') {
000089:     return {
000090:       label: 'Position Closed',
000091:       color: 'bg-slate-100 text-slate-700 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200',
000092:       icon: 'Archive',
000093:     };
000094:   }
000095:   
000096:   const configs = {
000097:     SUBMITTED: {
000098:       label: 'New',
000099:       color: 'bg-blue-100 text-blue-700 dark:bg-blue-900/30 dark:text-blue-300',
000100:       icon: 'Send',
000101:     },
000102:     SCREENING: {
000103:       label: 'Screening',
000104:       color: 'bg-yellow-100 text-yellow-700 dark:bg-yellow-900/30 dark:text-yellow-300',
000105:       icon: 'Eye',
000106:     },
000107:     INTERVIEWING: {
000108:       label: 'Interviewing',
000109:       color: 'bg-purple-100 text-purple-700 dark:bg-purple-900/30 dark:text-purple-300',
000110:       icon: 'Video',
000111:     },
000112:     SHORTLISTED: {
000113:       label: 'Shortlisted',
000114:       color: 'bg-green-100 text-green-700 dark:bg-green-900/30 dark:text-green-300',
000115:       icon: 'Star',
000116:     },
000117:     REJECTED: {
000118:       label: 'Not Selected',
000119:       color: 'bg-rose-100 text-rose-700 dark:bg-rose-900/30 dark:text-rose-200',
000120:       icon: 'XCircle',
000121:     },
000122:     HIRED: {
000123:       label: 'Hired',
000124:       color: 'bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-700 dark:bg-emerald-900/30 dark:text-emerald-300',
000125:       icon: 'CheckCircle',
000126:     },
000127:     UNKNOWN: {
000128:       label: 'Unknown',
000129:       color: 'bg-gray-100 text-gray-700 dark:bg-gray-900/30 dark:text-gray-300',
000130:       icon: 'HelpCircle',
000131:     },
000132:   };
000133:   return configs[derivedStatus] || configs.UNKNOWN;
000134: };
000135: 
000136: // Helper to format dates
000137: const formatDate = (dateInput) => {
000138:   if (!dateInput) return 'N/A';
000139:   let date;
000140:   if (dateInput.toDate) { // Firestore Timestamp
000141:     date = dateInput.toDate();
000142:   } else if (typeof dateInput === 'string' || typeof dateInput === 'number') {
000143:     date = new Date(dateInput);
000144:   } else {
000145:     return 'N/A';
000146:   }
000147: 
000148:   if (isNaN(date.getTime())) {
000149:     return 'N/A';
000150:   }
000151:   return date.toLocaleDateString();
000152: };

000154: const resolveReviewStartStatus = (status) => {
000155:   const normalizedStatus = String(status || '').trim().toUpperCase();
000156:   if (normalizedStatus === 'SUBMITTED') return 'SCREENING';
000157:   return null;
000158: };
```
