000160: const ApplicationsManager = ({ jobId = null, canUpdateStatus = true }) => {
000161:   const navigate = useNavigate();
000162:   const { organization, user } = useAuth();
000163:   const organizationRole = user?.organizationContext?.membership?.role;
000164:   const canStartReview = hasPermission(organizationRole, 'START_CANDIDATE_REVIEW');
000165:   const [applications, setApplications] = useState([]);
000166:   const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
000167:   const [error, setError] = useState('');
000168:   const [filters, setFilters] = useState(DEFAULT_COMPANY_APPLICATION_FILTERS);
000169:   const [showAdvancedFilters, setShowAdvancedFilters] = useState(false);
000170:   const [selectedApplication, setSelectedApplication] = useState(null);
000171:   const [showDetails, setShowDetails] = useState(false);
000172:   const [updating, setUpdating] = useState(null);
000173:   const [expandedJobs, setExpandedJobs] = useState(new Set());
000174:   const [startingReview, setStartingReview] = useState(false);
000175:   const [currentPage, setCurrentPage] = useState(1);
000176:   const [itemsPerPage] = useState(3);
000177:   const realtimeRefreshTimeoutRef = useRef(null);
000178:   const loadApplicationsRef = useRef(null);
000179: 
000180:   useEffect(() => {
000181:     loadApplications();
000182:   }, [jobId]);
000183: 
000184:   // Reset to page 1 when filters change
000185:   useEffect(() => {
000186:     setCurrentPage(1);
000187:   }, [filters, jobId]);
000188: 
000189:   const updateFilter = (key, value) => {
000190:     setFilters((previous) => ({
000191:       ...previous,
000192:       [key]: value,
000193:     }));
000194:   };
000195: 
000196:   const clearFilters = () => {
000197:     setFilters(DEFAULT_COMPANY_APPLICATION_FILTERS);
000198:   };
000199: 
000200:   const loadApplications = async () => {
000201:     try {
000202:       setLoading(true);
000203:       setError('');
000204:       const result = jobId
000205:         ? await apiClient.applications.getJobApplications(jobId)
000206:         : await apiClient.applications.getOrganizationApplications();
000207:       
000208:       if (result.success) {
000209:         setApplications(result.applications || []);
000210:         // Auto-expand first job by default
000211:         if (!jobId && result.applications?.length > 0) {
000212:           const firstJobId = result.applications[0]?.job?.id;
000213:           if (firstJobId) {
000214:             setExpandedJobs(new Set([firstJobId]));
000215:           }
000216:         }
000217:       } else {
000218:         setError('Failed to load applications');
000219:       }
000220:     } catch (err) {
000221:       console.error('Failed to load applications:', err);
000222:       setError(err.message || 'Failed to load applications');
000223:     } finally {
000224:       setLoading(false);
000225:     }
000226:   };
000227: 
000228:   useEffect(() => {
000229:     loadApplicationsRef.current = loadApplications;
000230:   }, [loadApplications]);
000231: 
000232:   useRealtimePathFeed({
000233:     path: organization?.id ? `organizationFeeds/${organization.id}` : null,
000234:     enabled: Boolean(organization?.id),
000235:     eventTypes: combineRealtimeEventTypes(
000236:       ORGANIZATION_FEED_EVENTS.applications,
000237:       ORGANIZATION_FEED_EVENTS.pipeline,
000238:     ),
000239:     onFeedUpdate: (_feed, { initial }) => {
000240:       if (initial) return;
000241:       if (realtimeRefreshTimeoutRef.current) {
000242:         clearTimeout(realtimeRefreshTimeoutRef.current);
000243:       }
000244:       realtimeRefreshTimeoutRef.current = setTimeout(() => {
000245:         loadApplicationsRef.current?.();
000246:       }, 300);
000247:     },
000248:   });
000249: 
000250:   useEffect(
000251:     () => () => {
000252:       if (realtimeRefreshTimeoutRef.current) {
000253:         clearTimeout(realtimeRefreshTimeoutRef.current);
000254:       }
000255:     },
000256:     [],
000257:   );
000258: 
000259:   const promptRejectionDisposition = () => {
000260:     const selectableOptions = APPLICATION_DISPOSITION_OPTIONS.filter(
000261:       (item) => item.value !== 'CANDIDATE_WITHDREW' && item.value !== 'JOB_CLOSED' && item.value !== 'HIRED',
000262:     );
000263:     const choiceText = selectableOptions
000264:       .map((option, index) => `${index + 1}. ${option.label}`)
000265:       .join('\n');
000266:     const selection = window.prompt(
000267:       `Select a rejection reason:\n${choiceText}\n\nEnter number (default: 1).`,
000268:       '1',
000269:     );
000270:     if (selection === null) return null;
000271: 
000272:     const parsedIndex = Number.parseInt(String(selection).trim(), 10);
000273:     const selectedOption = Number.isInteger(parsedIndex) && parsedIndex >= 1 && parsedIndex <= selectableOptions.length
000274:       ? selectableOptions[parsedIndex - 1]
000275:       : selectableOptions[0];
000276:     const notes = window.prompt(
000277:       'Optional recruiter note for audit trail (leave blank to skip):',
000278:       '',
000279:     );
000280:     if (notes === null) return null;
000281: 
000282:     return {
000283:       dispositionCode: selectedOption.value,
000284:       dispositionCategory: selectedOption.category,
000285:       dispositionReason: selectedOption.reason || selectedOption.label,
000286:       dispositionNotes: notes.trim() || null,
000287:     };
000288:   };
000289: 
000290:   const handleStatusChange = async (applicationId, newStatus) => {
000291:     try {
000292:       setUpdating(applicationId);
000293:       const payload = { status: newStatus };
000294:       if (newStatus === 'REJECTED') {
000295:         const rejectionDisposition = promptRejectionDisposition();
000296:         if (!rejectionDisposition) {
000297:           setUpdating(null);
000298:           return;
000299:         }
000300:         Object.assign(payload, rejectionDisposition);
000301:       }
000302: 
000303:       const result = await apiClient.applications.updateStatus(applicationId, payload);
000304:       if (result.success) {
000305:         await loadApplications();
000306:         if (selectedApplication?.id === applicationId) {
000307:           setSelectedApplication(result.application);
000308:         }
000309:       }
000310:     } catch (err) {
000311:       alert('Failed to update status: ' + err.message);
000312:     } finally {
000313:       setUpdating(null);
000314:     }
000315:   };
000316: 
000317:   const isWithdrawn = (application) => {
000318:     return application.status === 'REJECTED' && application.withdrawnBy;
000319:   };
000320: 
000321:   const handleViewDetails = (application) => {
000322:     setSelectedApplication(application);
000323:     setShowDetails(true);
000324:   };
000325: 
000326:   const handleStartReview = async () => {
000327:     if (!canStartReview) {
000328:       setError('You do not have permission to start candidate reviews.');
000329:       setTimeout(() => setError(''), 5000);
000330:       return;
000331:     }
000332: 
000333:     if (!selectedApplication || !selectedApplication.candidateId) return;
000334: 
000335:     try {
000336:       setStartingReview(true);
000337:       setError('');
000338:       const statusToApply = resolveReviewStartStatus(selectedApplication.status);
000339: 
000340:       // Check if interview already exists for this application
000341:       let interviewId = selectedApplication.interviewId;
000342:       
000343:       if (!interviewId) {
000344:         // Create a HIRING interview for this candidate and job
000345:         const interviewData = {
000346:           mode: 'HIRING',
000347:           jobId: selectedApplication.jobId,
000348:           candidateId: selectedApplication.candidateId,
000349:           jobRole: selectedApplication.job?.title || 'Position',
000350:           experienceLevel: selectedApplication.job?.experienceLevel || 'MID',
000351:           industry: selectedApplication.job?.department || 'Technology',
000352:           interviewTypes: ['BEHAVIORAL', 'TECHNICAL'],
000353:           skillFocus: selectedApplication.job?.skills || [],
000354:           duration: 30,
000355:           jobStage: 'INITIAL_SCREENING',
000356:         };
000357: 
000358:         const result = await apiClient.interviews.create(interviewData);
000359:         
000360:         if (result.success && result.interview) {
000361:           interviewId = result.interview.id;
000362:         } else {
000363:           throw new Error(result.error || 'Failed to create interview');
000364:         }
000365:       }
000366: 
000367:       if (interviewId && statusToApply) {
000368:         try {
000369:           await apiClient.applications.updateStatus(selectedApplication.id, statusToApply);
000370:           await loadApplications();
000371:         } catch (updateErr) {
000372:           console.warn('Failed to update application status:', updateErr);
000373:         }
000374:       }
000375: 
000376:       // Navigate to the interview review page
000377:       if (interviewId) {
000378:         navigate(`/company-dashboard?interviewId=${interviewId}&tab=reviews`);
000379:         setShowDetails(false);
000380:       }
000381:     } catch (err) {
000382:       console.error('Failed to start review:', err);
000383:       setError(err.message || 'Failed to start review. Please try again.');
000384:       setTimeout(() => setError(''), 5000);
000385:     } finally {
000386:       setStartingReview(false);
000387:     }
000388:   };
000389: 
000390:   const toggleJob = (jobId) => {
000391:     setExpandedJobs(prev => {
000392:       const newSet = new Set(prev);
000393:       if (newSet.has(jobId)) {
000394:         newSet.delete(jobId);
000395:       } else {
000396:         newSet.add(jobId);
000397:       }
000398:       return newSet;
000399:     });
000400:   };
000401: 
000402:   const effectiveFilters = useMemo(
000403:     () => (jobId ? { ...filters, jobFilter: String(jobId) } : filters),
000404:     [filters, jobId],
000405:   );
000406: 
000407:   const filteredApplications = useMemo(
000408:     () => filterCompanyApplications(applications, effectiveFilters),
000409:     [applications, effectiveFilters],
000410:   );
000411: 
000412:   const groupedApplications = useMemo(
000413:     () => groupCompanyApplicationsByJob(filteredApplications, { sortBy: effectiveFilters.sortBy }),
000414:     [filteredApplications, effectiveFilters.sortBy],
000415:   );
000416: 
000417:   const {
000418:     jobOptions,
000419:     companyOptions,
000420:     employmentTypeOptions,
000421:     dispositionOptions,
000422:   } = useMemo(
000423:     () => buildCompanyApplicationFilterOptions(applications),
000424:     [applications],
000425:   );
000426: 
000427:   const activeFilterCount = useMemo(() => {
000428:     const filterStateForCount = jobId
000429:       ? { ...effectiveFilters, jobFilter: 'all' }
000430:       : effectiveFilters;
000431:     return countActiveCompanyFilters(filterStateForCount);
000432:   }, [effectiveFilters, jobId]);
000433: 
000434:   useEffect(() => {
000435:     setExpandedJobs((previous) => {
000436:       const visibleJobIds = groupedApplications.map((group) => group.jobId);
000437:       const visibleLookup = new Set(visibleJobIds);
000438:       const next = new Set([...previous].filter((groupJobId) => visibleLookup.has(groupJobId)));
000439: 
000440:       if (next.size === 0 && visibleJobIds.length > 0) {
000441:         next.add(visibleJobIds[0]);
000442:       }
000443: 
000444:       const previousIds = [...previous];
000445:       const nextIds = [...next];
000446:       const unchanged = previousIds.length === nextIds.length
000447:         && previousIds.every((groupJobId, index) => groupJobId === nextIds[index]);
000448: 
000449:       return unchanged ? previous : next;
000450:     });
000451:   }, [groupedApplications]);
000452: 
000453:   if (loading) {
000454:     return (
000455:       <LoadingState
000456:         title="Loading applications"
000457:         message="Syncing candidate submissions and review queues."
000458:         variant="card"
000459:         tone="primary"
000460:       />
000461:     );
000462:   }
000463: 
000464:   if (error) {
000465:     return (
000466:       <div className="rounded-2xl border border-white/40 dark:border-slate-700/50 bg-white/90 dark:bg-slate-800/90 p-6 shadow-lg">
000467:         <div className="text-center py-12">
000468:           <Icon name="AlertCircle" className="w-12 h-12 text-red-600 mx-auto mb-3" />
000469:           <p className="text-gray-900 dark:text-slate-100 mb-4">{error}</p>
000470:           <Button onClick={loadApplications}>Retry</Button>
000471:         </div>
000472:       </div>
000473:     );
000474:   }
000475: 
000476:   if (applications.length === 0) {
000477:     return (
000478:       <div className="rounded-2xl border border-white/40 dark:border-slate-700/50 bg-white/90 dark:bg-slate-800/90 p-6 shadow-lg">
000479:         <div className="text-center py-12">
000480:           <div className="p-3 rounded-full bg-blue-100 dark:bg-blue-900/30 inline-flex mb-4">
000481:             <Icon name="FileText" className="w-8 h-8 text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400" />
000482:           </div>
000483:           <h3 className="text-lg font-semibold text-gray-900 dark:text-slate-100 mb-2">
000484:             No Applications Yet
000485:           </h3>
000486:           <p className="text-gray-600 dark:text-slate-400 mb-4">
000487:             {jobId ? 'No applications have been submitted for this job yet.' : 'No applications have been submitted yet.'}
000488:           </p>
000489:         </div>
000490:       </div>
000491:     );
000492:   }
000493: 
000494:   const totalApplicationsCount = groupedApplications.reduce((sum, jobData) => sum + jobData.filteredCount, 0);
000495:   const totalJobsCount = groupedApplications.length;
000496: 
000497:   // Pagination calculations
000498:   const jobsArray = groupedApplications;
000499:   const totalPages = Math.ceil(jobsArray.length / itemsPerPage);
000500:   const startIndex = (currentPage - 1) * itemsPerPage;
000501:   const endIndex = startIndex + itemsPerPage;
000502:   const paginatedJobs = jobsArray.slice(startIndex, endIndex);
000503: 
000504:   return (
000505:     <div className="rounded-2xl border border-white/40 dark:border-slate-700/50 bg-white/90 dark:bg-slate-800/90 p-4 sm:p-6 shadow-lg">
000506:       <div className="space-y-4">
000507:         <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between gap-4">
000508:           <div>
000509:             <h2 className="text-lg font-semibold text-gray-900 dark:text-slate-100">
000510:               Job Applications
000511:             </h2>
000512:             <p className="text-sm text-gray-600 dark:text-slate-400 mt-1">
000513:               {totalApplicationsCount} {totalApplicationsCount === 1 ? 'application' : 'applications'} across {totalJobsCount} {totalJobsCount === 1 ? 'job' : 'jobs'}
000514:             </p>
000515:           </div>
000516:           <Button
000517:             variant="ghost"
000518:             size="sm"
000519:             onClick={loadApplications}
000520:             className="flex items-center gap-2"
000521:           >
000522:             <Icon name="RefreshCw" className="w-4 h-4" />
000523:             Refresh
000524:           </Button>
000525:         </div>
000526: 
000527:         {/* Filters */}
000528:         <UnifiedFilterPanel
000529:           title="Application Filters"
000530:           description="Search candidates and refine applications by role, status, disposition, and hiring timeline."
000531:           activeCount={activeFilterCount}
000532:           onClear={clearFilters}
000533:           headerActions={(
000534:             <UnifiedFilterToggleButton

000538:             />
000539:           )}
000540:         >

000549:             />
000550:             <UnifiedFilterSelect
000551:               label="Status"

000555:               placeholder="All statuses"

000558: 
000559:           {showAdvancedFilters && (

000571:                 <UnifiedFilterSelect

000576:                   placeholder="All companies"

000578:                 <UnifiedFilterSelect

000583:                   placeholder="All employment types"
000584:                 />
000585:                 <UnifiedFilterSelect

000590:                   placeholder="All outcomes"
000591:                 />
000592:                 <UnifiedFilterSelect

000597:                   placeholder="All review states"

000599:                 <UnifiedFilterSelect

000604:                   placeholder="All job states"

000619:                 <UnifiedFilterSelect

000938:     const csvFunnelStages = [
000939:       { status: 'SUBMITTED', label: 'Applications Submitted' },
000940:       { status: 'SCREENING', label: 'Under Screening' },
000941:       { status: 'INTERVIEWING', label: 'Interviewing' },
000942:       { status: 'SHORTLISTED', label: 'Shortlisted' },
000943:       { status: 'HIRED', label: 'Hired' },
000944:     ];
000945:     
000946:     let csvPrevCount = total;
000947:     csvFunnelStages.forEach((stage, index) => {
000948:       const count = data.stats.byStatus[stage.status] || 0;
000949:       const percentage = total > 0 ? ((count / total) * 100).toFixed(1) : '0.0';
000950:       // Drop-off from previous stage
000951:       const stageDropOff = index > 0 && csvPrevCount > 0 
000952:         ? (((csvPrevCount - count) / csvPrevCount) * 100).toFixed(1) 
000953:         : '-';
000954:       // Retention rate from total
000955:       const retentionRate = total > 0 ? ((count / total) * 100).toFixed(1) : '0.0';
000956:       csv += `"${stage.label}","${count}","${percentage}%","${index > 0 ? stageDropOff + '%' : '-'}","${retentionRate}%"\n`;
000957:       csvPrevCount = count > 0 ? count : csvPrevCount; // Only update if count > 0
000958:     });
000959:     csv += `\n`;
000960: 
000961:     // =====================================
000962:     // SECTION 4: TOP JOB POSTINGS
000963:     // =====================================
000964:     if (data.stats.topJobs.length > 0) {
000965:       csv += `"4. TOP PERFORMING JOB POSTINGS"\n`;
000966:       csv += `"Rank","Job Title","Applications","% of Total","Status"\n`;
000967:       data.stats.topJobs.forEach((job, index) => {
000968:         const jobPercentage = total > 0 ? ((job.count / total) * 100).toFixed(1) : '0.0';
000969:         const rank = index + 1;
000970:         csv += `"#${rank}","${job.title.replace(/"/g, '""')}","${job.count}","${jobPercentage}%","Active"\n`;
000971:       });
000972:       csv += `\n`;
000973:     }
000974: 
000975:     // =====================================
000976:     // SECTION 5: RECENT APPLICATION ACTIVITY
000977:     // =====================================
000978:     if (data.stats.recentActivity.length > 0) {
000979:       csv += `"5. RECENT APPLICATION ACTIVITY (Last 10)"\n`;
000980:       csv += `"#","Candidate Name","Email","Position","Status","Date","Application ID"\n`;
000981:       data.stats.recentActivity.slice(0, 10).forEach((activity, index) => {
000982:         const candidateName = (activity.candidate?.fullName || 'Unknown').replace(/"/g, '""');
000983:         const candidateEmail = activity.candidate?.email || 'N/A';
000984:         const jobTitle = (activity.job?.title || 'Deleted position').replace(/"/g, '""');
000985:         const date = new Date(activity.submittedAt).toLocaleDateString('en-GB', { 
000986:           year: 'numeric', 
000987:           month: 'short', 
000988:           day: 'numeric' 
000989:         });
000990:         const appId = activity.id || 'N/A';
000991:         csv += `"${index + 1}","${candidateName}","${candidateEmail}","${jobTitle}","${activity.status}","${date}","${appId}"\n`;
000992:       });
000993:       csv += `\n`;
000994:     }
000995: 
000996:     // =====================================
000997:     // SECTION 6: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
000998:     // =====================================
000999:     csv += `"6. EXECUTIVE SUMMARY"\n`;
001000:     csv += `"Category","Details"\n`;
001001:     csv += `"Overview","This analytics report covers ${timeRangeLabel.toLowerCase()} of hiring activity for ${companyName}."\n`;
001002:     csv += `"Total Applications","${data.stats.total} application${data.stats.total !== 1 ? 's' : ''} received across all job postings."\n`;
001003:     csv += `"Conversion Rate","${data.stats.conversionRate}% of applications resulted in successful hires."\n`;
001004:     csv += `"Hiring Success","${data.stats.byStatus.HIRED} candidate${data.stats.byStatus.HIRED !== 1 ? 's' : ''} successfully hired during this period."\n`;
001005:     csv += `"Active Pipeline","${data.stats.byStatus.INTERVIEWING || 0} candidate${(data.stats.byStatus.INTERVIEWING || 0) !== 1 ? 's are' : ' is'} currently in the interviewing stage."\n`;
001006:     if (data.stats.topJobs.length > 0) {
001007:       csv += `"Top Position","${data.stats.topJobs[0].title.replace(/"/g, '""')} received the most applications (${data.stats.topJobs[0].count})."\n`;
001008:     }
001009:     csv += `\n`;
001010: 
001011:     // =====================================
001012:     // FOOTER SECTION
001013:     // =====================================
001014:     csv += `"REPORT INFORMATION"\n`;
001015:     csv += `"Field","Value"\n`;
001016:     csv += `"Report ID","${reportId}"\n`;
001017:     csv += `"Generated","${reportDate} at ${reportTime}"\n`;
001018:     csv += `"Generated By","${companyName}"\n`;
001019:     if (companyEmail) csv += `"Contact","${companyEmail}"\n`;
001020:     if (companyWebsite) csv += `"Website","${companyWebsite}"\n`;
001021:     csv += `\n`;
001022:     csv += `"DOCUMENT CLASSIFICATION"\n`;
001023:     csv += `"Field","Value"\n`;
001024:     csv += `"Classification","CONFIDENTIAL"\n`;
001025:     csv += `"Distribution","Internal Use Only"\n`;
001026:     csv += `"Copyright","${currentYear} ${companyName}"\n`;
001027:     csv += `"Rights","All Rights Reserved"\n`;
001028:     csv += `\n`;
001029:     csv += `"END OF REPORT"\n`;
001030: 
001031:     // Create and download file
001032:     const blob = new Blob([csv], { type: 'text/csv;charset=utf-8;' });
001033:     const link = document.createElement('a');
001034:     link.href = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
001035:     const fileName = `${companyName.replace(/[^a-z0-9]/gi, '_')}_Analytics_Report_${now.toISOString().split('T')[0]}.csv`;
001036:     link.download = fileName;
001037:     link.style.visibility = 'hidden';
001038:     document.body.appendChild(link);
001039:     link.click();
001040:     document.body.removeChild(link);

001043:   const StatCard = ({ icon, label, value, trend, color = 'purple' }) => {
001044:     const colorClasses = {
001045:       blue: {
001046:         bg: 'bg-gradient-to-br from-blue-50 to-blue-100 dark:from-blue-900/20 dark:to-blue-900/10',
001047:         border: 'border-blue-200 dark:border-blue-800',

001049:         text: 'text-blue-900 dark:text-blue-100',
001050:       },
001051:       green: {

001053:         border: 'border-green-200 dark:border-green-800',
001054:         iconBg: 'bg-green-600 dark:bg-green-600/80',
001055:         text: 'text-green-900 dark:text-green-100',

001057:       purple: {

001059:         border: 'border-purple-200 dark:border-purple-800',
001060:         iconBg: 'bg-purple-600 dark:bg-purple-600/80',
001061:         text: 'text-purple-900 dark:text-purple-100',
001062:       },
001063:       emerald: {

001065:         border: 'border-emerald-200 dark:border-emerald-800',
001066:         iconBg: 'bg-emerald-600 dark:bg-emerald-600/80',
001067:         text: 'text-emerald-900 dark:text-emerald-100',
001068:       },
001069:     };
001070:     
001071:     const classes = colorClasses[color] || colorClasses.purple;
001072:     
001073:     return (
001074:       <motion.div

001079:           <div className={`p-3 rounded-lg ${classes.iconBg}`}>
001080:             <Icon name={icon} className="w-6 h-6 text-white" />

001082:           {trend && (
001083:             <div className={`px-2 py-1 rounded-full text-xs font-medium ${
001084:               trend > 0
001085:                 ? 'bg-green-100 text-green-700 dark:bg-green-900/30 dark:text-green-300'
001086:                 : 'bg-red-100 text-red-700 dark:bg-red-900/30 dark:text-red-300'
001087:             }`}>
001088:               {trend > 0 ? '+' : ''}{trend}%
001089:             </div>
001090:           )}
001091:         </div>
001092:         <p className="text-sm text-gray-600 dark:text-slate-400 mb-1">{label}</p>
001093:         <p className={`text-3xl font-bold ${classes.text}`}>{value}</p>
001094:       </motion.div>
001095:     );
001096:   };

001098:   const StatusPieChart = ({ data }) => {
001099:     const total = Object.values(data).reduce((sum, val) => sum + val, 0);
001100:     if (total === 0) return null;
001101: 
001102:     const colors = {
001103:       SUBMITTED: '#3B82F6',
001104:       SCREENING: '#EAB308',
001105:       INTERVIEWING: '#A855F7',
001106:       SHORTLISTED: '#10B981',
001107:       HIRED: '#059669',
001108:       REJECTED: '#6B7280',
001109:     };
001110: 
001111:     let currentAngle = 0;
001112: 
001113:     return (
001114:       <div className="flex items-center justify-center gap-8">
001115:         <svg width="200" height="200" viewBox="0 0 200 200">
001116:           {Object.entries(data).map(([status, count], index) => {
001117:             const percentage = (count / total) * 100;
001118:             const angle = (percentage / 100) * 360;
001119:             const largeArcFlag = angle > 180 ? 1 : 0;
001120:             
001121:             const startX = 100 + 80 * Math.cos((currentAngle - 90) * Math.PI / 180);
001122:             const startY = 100 + 80 * Math.sin((currentAngle - 90) * Math.PI / 180);
001123:             const endX = 100 + 80 * Math.cos((currentAngle + angle - 90) * Math.PI / 180);
001124:             const endY = 100 + 80 * Math.sin((currentAngle + angle - 90) * Math.PI / 180);
001125:             
001126:             const path = count > 0 ? `
001127:               M 100 100
001128:               L ${startX} ${startY}
001129:               A 80 80 0 ${largeArcFlag} 1 ${endX} ${endY}
001130:               Z
001131:             ` : '';
001132: 
001133:             currentAngle += angle;
001134: 
001135:             return count > 0 ? (
001136:               <path
001137:                 key={status}
001138:                 d={path}
001139:                 fill={colors[status]}
001140:                 opacity="0.9"
001141:               />
001142:             ) : null;
001143:           })}
001144:           <circle cx="100" cy="100" r="50" fill="white" className="dark:fill-slate-900" />
001145:           <text x="100" y="100" textAnchor="middle" dy=".3em" fontSize="24" fontWeight="bold" className="fill-gray-900 dark:fill-slate-100">
001146:             {total}
001147:           </text>
001148:           <text x="100" y="120" textAnchor="middle" fontSize="12" className="fill-gray-600 dark:fill-slate-400">
001149:             Total
001150:           </text>
001151:         </svg>
001152: 
001153:         <div className="space-y-2">
001154:           {Object.entries(data).map(([status, count]) => (
001155:             count > 0 && (
001156:               <div key={status} className="flex items-center gap-3">
001157:                 <div
001158:                   className="w-4 h-4 rounded"
001159:                   style={{ backgroundColor: colors[status] }}
001160:                 />
001161:                 <div className="flex-1">
001162:                   <p className="text-sm text-gray-700 dark:text-slate-300">
001163:                     {status}
001164:                   </p>
001165:                   <p className="text-xs text-gray-500 dark:text-slate-500">
001166:                     {count} ({((count / total) * 100).toFixed(0)}%)
001167:                   </p>
001168:                 </div>
001169:               </div>
001170:             )
001171:           ))}
001172:         </div>
001173:       </div>
001174:     );
001175:   };

000406:                               {skill}

000409:                         </div>
000410:                       </div>
000411:                     )}
000412:                   </div>
000413:                 </div>
000414: 
000415:                 {/* Interview Details */}

000419:                     Interview Details
000420:                   </h3>
000421:                   <div className="space-y-3">
000422:                     <div>
000423:                       <p className="text-xs text-gray-600 dark:text-slate-400">Position</p>
000424:                       <p className="text-sm font-medium text-gray-900 dark:text-slate-100">
000425:                         {interview.jobRole || 'N/A'}

000427:                     </div>

000431:                         {interview.interviewTypes && interview.interviewTypes.length > 0 ? (
000432:                           interview.interviewTypes.map((type, idx) => (
000433:                             <span
000434:                               key={idx}

000436:                             >
000437:                               {type}
000438:                             </span>
000439:                           ))

000441:                           <span className="text-sm text-gray-600 dark:text-slate-400">N/A</span>

000448:                         {interview.duration || 30} minutes
000449:                       </p>
000450:                     </div>
000451:                     <div>

000453:                       <p className="text-sm font-medium text-gray-900 dark:text-slate-100">
000454:                         {interview.startedAt
000455:                           ? new Date(interview.startedAt).toLocaleString()
000456:                           : 'Not started'}
000457:                       </p>
000458:                     </div>
000459:                   </div>
000460:                 </div>

000466:                   onClick={() => setActiveTab('transcript')}
000467:                   className="flex-1 bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-700"

000469:                   <Icon name="FileText" className="w-4 h-4 mr-2" />
000470:                   View Transcript
000471:                 </Button>

000473:                   onClick={() => setActiveTab('review')}
000474:                   className="flex-1 bg-purple-600 hover:bg-purple-700"
000475:                 >
000476:                   <Icon name="Star" className="w-4 h-4 mr-2" />
000477:                   Submit Review
000478:                 </Button>
000479:               </div>
000480:             </div>
000481:           )}
000482: 
000483:           {/* Calibration Tab: AI vs SME comparison */}
000484:           {activeTab === 'calibration' && (
000485:             <div className="space-y-6">
000486:               <h3 className="text-lg font-semibold text-gray-900 dark:text-slate-100 mb-4">
000487:                 AI vs SME Calibration
000488:               </h3>
000489:               <p className="text-sm text-gray-600 dark:text-slate-400">
000490:                 Compare AI-generated scores with your (SME) ratings. Use &quot;My Review&quot; to submit or update your scores, and optionally override the final score with your assessment.
000491:               </p>
000492: 
000493:               <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-6">
000494:                 <div className="p-6 rounded-xl bg-white dark:bg-slate-900/50 border border-purple-200 dark:border-purple-800">
000495:                   <h4 className="text-base font-semibold text-purple-700 dark:text-purple-300 mb-4 flex items-center gap-2">
000496:                     <Icon name="Brain" className="w-5 h-5" />
000497:                     AI Evaluation
000498:                   </h4>
000499:                   <div className="space-y-3">
000500:                     <div>
000501:                       <p className="text-xs text-gray-500 dark:text-slate-500">Overall Score</p>
000502:                       <p className="text-2xl font-bold text-gray-900 dark:text-slate-100">
000503:                         {interview.overallScore != null ? interview.overallScore : 'N/A'}
000504:                       </p>
000505:                     </div>
000506:                     {interview.evaluation && typeof interview.evaluation === 'object' && (
000507:                       <>
000508:                         {interview.evaluation.technicalSkills?.score != null && (
000509:                           <div>
000510:                             <p className="text-xs text-gray-500 dark:text-slate-500">Technical</p>
000511:                             <p className="text-lg font-medium">{interview.evaluation.technicalSkills.score}</p>
000512:                           </div>
000513:                         )}
000514:                         {interview.evaluation.communicationSkills?.score != null && (
000515:                           <div>
000516:                             <p className="text-xs text-gray-500 dark:text-slate-500">Communication</p>
000517:                             <p className="text-lg font-medium">{interview.evaluation.communicationSkills.score}</p>
000518:                           </div>
000519:                         )}
000520:                       </>
000521:                     )}
000522:                   </div>
000523:                 </div>
000524: 
000525:                 <div className="p-6 rounded-xl bg-white dark:bg-slate-900/50 border border-amber-200 dark:border-amber-800">
000526:                   <h4 className="text-base font-semibold text-amber-700 dark:text-amber-300 mb-4 flex items-center gap-2">
000527:                     <Icon name="UserCheck" className="w-5 h-5" />
000528:                     SME (Your) Review
000529:                   </h4>
000530:                   <div className="space-y-3">
000531:                     <div>
000532:                       <p className="text-xs text-gray-500 dark:text-slate-500">Overall (0–10 → 0–100)</p>
000533:                       <p className="text-2xl font-bold text-gray-900 dark:text-slate-100">
000534:                         {review.rating != null ? review.rating * 10 : '—'}
000535:                       </p>
000536:                     </div>
000537:                     <div>
000538:                       <p className="text-xs text-gray-500 dark:text-slate-500">Technical</p>
000539:                       <p className="text-lg font-medium">{review.technicalScore}/10</p>
000540:                     </div>
000541:                     <div>
000542:                       <p className="text-xs text-gray-500 dark:text-slate-500">Communication</p>
000543:                       <p className="text-lg font-medium">{review.communicationScore}/10</p>
000544:                     </div>
000545:                     <div>
000546:                       <p className="text-xs text-gray-500 dark:text-slate-500">Problem Solving</p>
000547:                       <p className="text-lg font-medium">{review.problemSolvingScore}/10</p>
000548:                     </div>
000549:                     <div>
000550:                       <p className="text-xs text-gray-500 dark:text-slate-500">Cultural Fit</p>
000551:                       <p className="text-lg font-medium">{review.culturalFitScore}/10</p>
000552:                     </div>
000553:                   </div>
000554:                 </div>
000555:               </div>
000556: 
000557:               {(interview.overallScore != null || review.rating > 0) && (
000558:                 <div className="p-4 rounded-xl bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800/50 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700">
000559:                   <p className="text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 dark:text-slate-300">
000560:                     Agreement: AI overall {interview.overallScore != null ? interview.overallScore : 'N/A'} vs SME overall {review.rating != null ? review.rating * 10 : '—'}
000561:                     {interview.overallScore != null && review.rating != null && (
000562:                       <span className="ml-2 text-gray-500 dark:text-slate-500">
000563:                         (diff: {Math.abs(interview.overallScore - review.rating * 10).toFixed(0)} pts)
000564:                       </span>
000565:                     )}
000566:                   </p>
000567:                 </div>
000568:               )}
000569:             </div>
000570:           )}
000571: 
000572:           {/* Transcript Tab */}
000573:           {activeTab === 'transcript' && (
000574:             <div className="space-y-4">
000575:               <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-4">
000576:                 <h3 className="text-lg font-semibold text-gray-900 dark:text-slate-100">
000577:                   Interview Transcript
000578:                 </h3>
000579:                 {interview.transcript && (
000580:                   <Button
000581:                     variant="outline"
000582:                     size="sm"
000583:                     onClick={() => {
000584:                       const blob = new Blob([interview.transcript], { type: 'text/plain' });
000585:                       const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
000586:                       const a = document.createElement('a');
000587:                       a.href = url;
000588:                       a.download = `interview-transcript-${interviewId}.txt`;
000589:                       a.click();
000590:                     }}
000591:                   >
000592:                     <Icon name="Download" className="w-4 h-4 mr-2" />
000593:                     Download
000594:                   </Button>
000595:                 )}
000596:               </div>
000597: 
000598:               {interview.transcript ? (
000599:                 <div className="p-6 rounded-xl bg-white dark:bg-slate-900/50 border border-gray-200 dark:border-slate-700 max-h-[600px] overflow-y-auto">
000600:                   <pre className="text-sm text-gray-700 dark:text-slate-300 whitespace-pre-wrap font-sans leading-relaxed">
000601:                     {interview.transcript}
000602:                   </pre>
000603:                 </div>
000604:               ) : (
000605:                 <div className="p-12 text-center rounded-xl bg-gray-50 dark:bg-slate-900/50 border border-gray-200 dark:border-slate-700">
000606:                   <Icon name="FileText" className="w-12 h-12 text-gray-400 mx-auto mb-3" />
000607:                   <p className="text-gray-600 dark:text-slate-400">
000608:                     Transcript not available for this interview
000609:                   </p>
000610:                 </div>
000611:               )}
000612:             </div>
000613:           )}
000614: 
000615:           {/* Video Tab */}
000616:           {activeTab === 'video' && (
000617:             <div className="space-y-4">
000618:               <h3 className="text-lg font-semibold text-gray-900 dark:text-slate-100 mb-4">
000619:                 Interview Recording
000620:               </h3>
000621: 
000622:               {interview.recordingUrl ? (
000623:                 <div className="rounded-xl overflow-hidden bg-black">
000624:                   <video
000625:                     controls
000626:                     className="w-full"
000627:                     src={interview.recordingUrl}
000628:                   >
000629:                     Your browser does not support video playback.
000630:                   </video>
000631:                 </div>
000632:               ) : (
000633:                 <div className="p-12 text-center rounded-xl bg-gray-50 dark:bg-slate-900/50 border border-gray-200 dark:border-slate-700">
000634:                   <Icon name="Video" className="w-12 h-12 text-gray-400 mx-auto mb-3" />
000635:                   <p className="text-gray-600 dark:text-slate-400 mb-2">
000636:                     Video recording not available
000637:                   </p>
000638:                   <p className="text-xs text-gray-500 dark:text-slate-500">
000639:                     This interview may not have been recorded or the recording is still processing
000640:                   </p>
000641:                 </div>
000642:               )}
000643:             </div>
000644:           )}
000645: 
000646:           {/* AI Evaluation Tab — rubric-tied explainability for recruiters/SMEs */}
000647:           {activeTab === 'evaluation' && (
000648:             <div className="space-y-6">
000649:               <h3 className="text-lg font-semibold text-gray-900 dark:text-slate-100 mb-4">
000650:                 AI-Generated Evaluation
000651:               </h3>
000652: 
000653:               {interview.evaluation ? (
000654:                 <>
000655:                   {/* Overall Score */}
000656:                   <div className="p-6 rounded-xl bg-gradient-to-r from-purple-50 to-blue-50 dark:from-purple-900/20 dark:to-blue-900/20 border border-purple-200 dark:border-purple-800">
000657:                     <div className="text-center">
000658:                       <p className="text-sm text-gray-600 dark:text-slate-400 mb-2">
000659:                         Overall Score
000660:                       </p>
000661:                       <div className="text-3xl font-bold text-purple-600 dark:text-purple-400">
000662:                         {interview.overallScore != null ? interview.overallScore : 'N/A'}
000663:                       </div>
000664:                       <p className="text-sm text-gray-600 dark:text-slate-400 mt-2">
000665:                         Readiness: {interview.readinessLevel || 'Not assessed'}
000666:                       </p>
000667:                     </div>
000668:                   </div>
000669: 
000670:                   {/* Rubric-tied criteria: score + feedback per criterion */}
000671:                   {typeof interview.evaluation === 'object' && interview.evaluation !== null && (
000672:                     <>
000673:                       <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
000674:                         {EVALUATION_RUBRIC_CRITERIA.map(({ key, label, icon }) => {
000675:                           const criterion = interview.evaluation[key];
000676:                           if (!criterion || (criterion.score == null && !criterion.feedback)) return null;
000677:                           const score = criterion.score != null ? criterion.score : null;
000678:                           const feedback = typeof criterion.feedback === 'string' ? criterion.feedback : null;
000679:                           return (
000680:                             <div
000681:                               key={key}
000682:                               className="p-5 rounded-xl bg-white dark:bg-slate-900/50 border border-gray-200 dark:border-slate-700"
000683:                             >
000684:                               <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-2">
000685:                                 <Icon name={icon} className="w-4 h-4 text-purple-600 dark:text-purple-400" />
000686:                                 <h4 className="font-semibold text-gray-900 dark:text-slate-100">{label}</h4>
000687:                               </div>
000688:                               {score != null && (
000689:                                 <p className="text-sm text-gray-600 dark:text-slate-400 mb-1">
000690:                                   <span className="font-medium text-gray-900 dark:text-slate-100">Score: </span>
000691:                                   {score}/100
000692:                                 </p>
000693:                               )}
000694:                               {feedback && (
000695:                                 <p className="text-sm text-gray-700 dark:text-slate-300 mt-2 leading-relaxed">
000696:                                   {feedback}
000697:                                 </p>
000698:                               )}
000699:                             </div>
000700:                           );
000701:                         })}
000702:                       </div>
000703: 
000704:                       {/* Strengths */}
000705:                       {Array.isArray(interview.evaluation.strengths) && interview.evaluation.strengths.length > 0 && (
000706:                         <div className="p-5 rounded-xl bg-green-50 dark:bg-green-900/20 border border-green-200 dark:border-green-800">
000707:                           <h4 className="font-semibold text-green-800 dark:text-green-200 mb-2 flex items-center gap-2">
000708:                             <Icon name="ThumbsUp" className="w-4 h-4" />
000709:                             Strengths
000710:                           </h4>
000711:                           <ul className="list-disc list-inside space-y-1 text-sm text-green-800 dark:text-green-200">
000712:                             {interview.evaluation.strengths.map((s, i) => (
000713:                               <li key={i}>{typeof s === 'string' ? s : String(s)}</li>
000714:                             ))}
000715:                           </ul>
000716:                         </div>
000717:                       )}
000718: 
000719:                       {/* Weaknesses */}
000720:                       {Array.isArray(interview.evaluation.weaknesses) && interview.evaluation.weaknesses.length > 0 && (
000721:                         <div className="p-5 rounded-xl bg-amber-50 dark:bg-amber-900/20 border border-amber-200 dark:border-amber-800">
000722:                           <h4 className="font-semibold text-amber-800 dark:text-amber-200 mb-2 flex items-center gap-2">
000723:                             <Icon name="AlertCircle" className="w-4 h-4" />
000724:                             Areas for Improvement
000725:                           </h4>
000726:                           <ul className="list-disc list-inside space-y-1 text-sm text-amber-800 dark:text-amber-200">
000727:                             {interview.evaluation.weaknesses.map((w, i) => (
000728:                               <li key={i}>{typeof w === 'string' ? w : String(w)}</li>
000729:                             ))}
000730:                           </ul>
000731:                         </div>
000732:                       )}
000733: 
000734:                       {/* Recommendations */}
000735:                       {Array.isArray(interview.evaluation.recommendations) && interview.evaluation.recommendations.length > 0 && (
000736:                         <div className="p-5 rounded-xl bg-blue-50 dark:bg-blue-900/20 border border-blue-200 dark:border-blue-800">
000737:                           <h4 className="font-semibold text-blue-800 dark:text-blue-200 mb-2 flex items-center gap-2">
000738:                             <Icon name="Lightbulb" className="w-4 h-4" />
000739:                             Recommendations
000740:                           </h4>
000741:                           <ul className="list-disc list-inside space-y-1 text-sm text-blue-800 dark:text-blue-200">
000742:                             {interview.evaluation.recommendations.map((r, i) => (
000743:                               <li key={i}>{typeof r === 'string' ? r : String(r)}</li>
000744:                             ))}
000745:                           </ul>
000746:                         </div>
000747:                       )}
000748: 
000749:                       {/* Detailed feedback */}
000750:                       {interview.evaluation.detailedFeedback && (
000751:                         <div className="p-5 rounded-xl bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-900/50 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700">
000752:                           <h4 className="font-semibold text-gray-900 dark:text-slate-100 mb-2 flex items-center gap-2">
000753:                             <Icon name="FileText" className="w-4 h-4" />
000754:                             Detailed Feedback
000755:                           </h4>
000756:                           <p className="text-sm text-gray-700 dark:text-slate-300 whitespace-pre-wrap leading-relaxed">
000757:                             {interview.evaluation.detailedFeedback}
000758:                           </p>
000759:                         </div>
000760:                       )}
000761: 
000762:                       {/* Per-answer STAR component assessment (2.6.4 i, NFR4: explain in terms consistent with STAR) */}
000763:                       {Array.isArray(interview.questions) &&
000764:                         interview.questions.some((q) => q?.feedback?.starAnalysis && typeof q.feedback.starAnalysis === 'object') && (
000765:                         <div className="p-5 rounded-xl bg-indigo-50 dark:bg-indigo-900/20 border border-indigo-200 dark:border-indigo-800">
000766:                           <h4 className="font-semibold text-indigo-900 dark:text-indigo-100 mb-2 flex items-center gap-2">
000767:                             <Icon name="ListOrdered" className="w-4 h-4" />
000768:                             Per-answer STAR component assessment
000769:                           </h4>
000770:                           <p className="text-xs text-indigo-700 dark:text-indigo-300 mb-4">
000771:                             Explanations are aligned with the STAR method (Situation, Task, Action, Result) for each answered question.
000772:                           </p>
000773:                           <div className="space-y-4">
000774:                             {interview.questions
000775:                               .filter((q) => q?.feedback?.starAnalysis && typeof q.feedback.starAnalysis === 'object')
000776:                               .map((q, idx) => {
000777:                                 const sa = q.feedback.starAnalysis;
000778:                                 return (
000779:                                   <div
000780:                                     key={q.id || idx}
000781:                                     className="p-4 rounded-lg bg-white dark:bg-slate-800/50 border border-indigo-100 dark:border-indigo-800"
000782:                                   >
000783:                                     <p className="text-xs font-medium text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400 mb-1">
000784:                                       Question {idx + 1}
000785:                                     </p>
000786:                                     <p className="text-sm font-medium text-gray-900 dark:text-slate-100 mb-2 line-clamp-2">
000787:                                       {q.question}
000788:                                     </p>
000789:                                     {q.answer && (
000790:                                       <p className="text-xs text-gray-600 dark:text-slate-400 mb-3 line-clamp-2">
000791:                                         Answer: {q.answer}
000792:                                       </p>
000793:                                     )}
000794:                                     {q.feedback?.score != null && (
000795:                                       <p className="text-xs text-gray-500 dark:text-slate-500 mb-2">
000796:                                         Score: {q.feedback.score}/10
000797:                                       </p>
000798:                                     )}
000799:                                     <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-2">
000800:                                       {STAR_COMPONENTS.map(({ key, label, icon }) => {
000801:                                         const comp = sa[key];
000802:                                         if (!comp || (comp.present == null && !comp.quality && !comp.feedback))
000803:                                           return null;
000804:                                         const present = comp.present;
000805:                                         const quality = comp.quality;
000806:                                         const feedback = typeof comp.feedback === 'string' ? comp.feedback : null;
000807:                                         return (
000808:                                           <div
000809:                                             key={key}
000810:                                             className="p-2 rounded bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-900/50 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700"
000811:                                           >
000812:                                             <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 mb-1">
000813:                                               <Icon name={icon} className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400" />
000814:                                               <span className="text-xs font-semibold text-gray-900 dark:text-slate-100">
000815:                                                 {label}
000816:                                               </span>
000817:                                               {present != null && (
000818:                                                 <span
000819:                                                   className={`text-xs ${present ? 'text-green-600 dark:text-green-400' : 'text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400'}`}
000820:                                                 >
000821:                                                   {present ? 'Present' : 'Missing'}
000822:                                                 </span>
000823:                                               )}
000824:                                             </div>
000825:                                             {quality && (
000826:                                               <p className="text-xs text-gray-600 dark:text-slate-400">Quality: {quality}</p>
000827:                                             )}
000828:                                             {feedback && (
000829:                                               <p className="text-xs text-gray-700 dark:text-slate-300 mt-1 leading-relaxed">
000830:                                                 {feedback}
000831:                                               </p>
000832:                                             )}
000833:                                           </div>
000834:                                         );
000835:                                       })}
000836:                                     </div>
000837:                                   </div>
000838:                                 );
000839:                               })}
000840:                           </div>
000841:                         </div>
000842:                       )}
000843: 
000844:                       {/* Raw evaluation (collapsible for transparency) */}
000845:                       <details className="p-4 rounded-xl bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800/50 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700">
000846:                         <summary className="cursor-pointer text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 dark:text-slate-300">
000847:                           Raw evaluation (JSON)
000848:                         </summary>
000849:                         <pre className="mt-3 text-xs text-gray-600 dark:text-slate-400 whitespace-pre-wrap font-mono overflow-x-auto">
000850:                           {JSON.stringify(interview.evaluation, null, 2)}
000851:                         </pre>
000852:                       </details>
000853:                     </>
000854:                   )}
000855: 
000856:                   {/* Legacy: evaluation as string or unknown shape */}
000857:                   {(typeof interview.evaluation !== 'object' || interview.evaluation === null) && (
000858:                     <div className="p-6 rounded-xl bg-white dark:bg-slate-900/50 border border-gray-200 dark:border-slate-700">
000859:                       <pre className="text-sm text-gray-700 dark:text-slate-300 whitespace-pre-wrap font-sans leading-relaxed">

000074:   const preset = normalizeFilterText(filters.datePreset || 'all');
000075:   if (preset === 'all') return { from: null, to: null };
000076:   if (preset === 'custom') {
000077:     const from = filters.from ? new Date(filters.from) : null;
000078:     const to = filters.to ? new Date(filters.to) : null;
000079:     if (from && !Number.isNaN(from.getTime())) from.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
000080:     if (to && !Number.isNaN(to.getTime())) to.setHours(23, 59, 59, 999);
000081:     return {
000082:       from: from && !Number.isNaN(from.getTime()) ? from : null,
000083:       to: to && !Number.isNaN(to.getTime()) ? to : null,
000084:     };
000085:   }
000086:   const from = new Date();
000087:   if (preset === 'last7') from.setDate(from.getDate() - 7);
000088:   if (preset === 'last30') from.setDate(from.getDate() - 30);
000089:   if (preset === 'last90') from.setDate(from.getDate() - 90);
000090:   from.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
000091:   return { from, to: null };
000092: };
000093: 
000094: const countActiveCompanyInterviewFilters = (filters = {}) => {
000095:   let count = 0;
000096:   if (normalizeFilterText(filters.searchQuery)) count += 1;
000097:   if ((filters.statusFilter || 'all') !== 'all') count += 1;
000098:   if ((filters.jobRoleFilter || 'all') !== 'all') count += 1;
000099:   if ((filters.scheduleFilter || 'all') !== 'all') count += 1;
000100:   if ((filters.scoreFilter || 'all') !== 'all') count += 1;
000101:   if ((filters.datePreset || 'all') !== 'all') count += 1;
000102:   if ((filters.sortBy || 'recent') !== 'recent') count += 1;
000103:   return count;
000104: };
000105: 
000106: const CompanyInterviews = () => {
000107:   const navigate = useNavigate();
000108:   const { user, logout, status } = useAuth();
000109:   const [isSidebarCollapsed, setIsSidebarCollapsed] = useState(false);
000110:   const [interviews, setInterviews] = useState([]);
000111:   const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
000112:   const [error, setError] = useState('');
000113:   const [filters, setFilters] = useState(DEFAULT_COMPANY_INTERVIEW_FILTERS);
000114:   const [showAdvancedFilters, setShowAdvancedFilters] = useState(false);
000115:   const [selectedInterview, setSelectedInterview] = useState(null);
000116:   const [showDetails, setShowDetails] = useState(false);
000117:   const [currentPage, setCurrentPage] = useState(1);
000118:   const [itemsPerPage] = useState(3);
000119:   const [pendingRealtimeInterviewUpdates, setPendingRealtimeInterviewUpdates] = useState(0);
000120: 
000121:   useEffect(() => {
000122:     document.title = 'Interviews - InterviewAI Pro';
000123:   }, []);
000124: 
000125:   const loadInterviews = useCallback(async () => {
000126:     try {
000127:       setLoading(true);
000128:       setError('');
000129:       const result = await apiClient.interviews.getCompanyInterviews();
000130:       if (result.success) {
000131:         setInterviews(result.interviews || []);
000132:         setPendingRealtimeInterviewUpdates(0);
000133:       } else {
000134:         setError(result.error || 'Failed to load interviews.');
000135:       }
000136:     } catch (err) {
000137:       setError(err.message || 'Failed to load interviews.');
000138:     } finally {
000139:       setLoading(false);
000140:     }
000141:   }, []);
000142: 
000143:   useInterviewRealtimeFeed({
000144:     userId: user?.id,
000145:     enabled: Boolean(user?.id),
000146:     eventTypes: combineRealtimeEventTypes(
000147:       INTERVIEW_FEED_EVENTS.lifecycle,
000148:       INTERVIEW_FEED_EVENTS.pipeline,
000149:       INTERVIEW_FEED_EVENTS.reviews,
000150:     ),
000151:     onFeedUpdate: (_feed, { initial }) => {
000152:       if (initial) return;
000153:       // Keep interview list stable while users are browsing/filtering.
000154:       setPendingRealtimeInterviewUpdates((prev) => Math.min(prev + 1, 99));
000155:     },
000156:   });
000157: 
000158:   useEffect(() => {
000159:     loadInterviews();
000160:   }, [loadInterviews]);
000161: 
000162:   const handleLogout = async () => {
000163:     await logout();
000164:     navigate('/login');
000165:   };
000166: 
000167:   const getStatusBadge = (status) => {
000168:     const statusConfig = {
000169:       SCHEDULED: { label: 'Scheduled', color: 'bg-blue-100 dark:bg-blue-900/30 text-blue-700 dark:text-blue-200 border-blue-200 dark:border-blue-700' },
000170:       IN_PROGRESS: { label: 'In Progress', color: 'bg-yellow-100 dark:bg-yellow-900/30 text-yellow-700 dark:text-yellow-200 border-yellow-200 dark:border-yellow-700' },
000171:       COMPLETED: { label: 'Completed', color: 'bg-emerald-100 dark:bg-emerald-900/30 text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-200 border-emerald-200 dark:border-emerald-700' },
000172:       CANCELLED: { label: 'Cancelled', color: 'bg-gray-100 dark:bg-gray-800 text-gray-700 dark:text-gray-300 border-gray-200 dark:border-gray-700' },
000173:     };
000174:     const config = statusConfig[status?.toUpperCase()] || statusConfig.SCHEDULED;
000175:     return (
000176:       <span className={`px-2 py-1 rounded-full text-xs font-medium border ${config.color}`}>
000177:         {config.label}
000178:       </span>
000179:     );
000180:   };
000181: 
000182:   const updateFilter = (key, value) => {
000183:     setFilters((previous) => ({
000184:       ...previous,
000185:       [key]: value,
000186:     }));
000187:   };
000188: 
000189:   const clearFilters = () => {
000190:     setFilters(DEFAULT_COMPANY_INTERVIEW_FILTERS);
000191:     setShowAdvancedFilters(false);
000192:   };
000193: 
000194:   const interviewFilterOptions = useMemo(
000195:     () => ({
000196:       jobRoleOptions: [
000197:         { value: 'all', label: 'All Roles' },
000198:         ...Array.from(
000199:           new Set(
000200:             interviews
000201:               .map((interview) => interview?.jobRole)
000202:               .map((value) => value?.toString?.().trim())
000203:               .filter(Boolean),
000204:           ),
000205:         ).map((value) => ({ value, label: value })),
000206:       ],
000207:     }),
000208:     [interviews],
000209:   );
000210: 
000211:   const activeFilterCount = countActiveCompanyInterviewFilters(filters);
000212: 
000213:   const filteredInterviews = useMemo(
000214:     () => {
000215:       const interviewDateWindow = getCompanyInterviewDateWindow(filters);
000216:       const searchTokens = normalizeFilterText(filters.searchQuery).split(' ').filter(Boolean);
000217:       return interviews
000218:         .filter((interview) => {
000219:         const status = (interview?.status || '').toString().toUpperCase();
000220:         const jobRole = (interview?.jobRole || '').toString();
000221:         const scheduledDate = interview?.scheduledFor ? new Date(interview.scheduledFor) : null;
000222:         const createdDate = interview?.createdAt ? new Date(interview.createdAt) : null;
000223:         const primaryDate = scheduledDate && !Number.isNaN(scheduledDate.getTime())
000224:           ? scheduledDate
000225:           : (createdDate && !Number.isNaN(createdDate.getTime()) ? createdDate : null);
000226:         const score = Number(interview?.overallScore);
000227:         const hasScore = Number.isFinite(score);
000228:         const now = new Date();
000229:         const startOfToday = new Date(now.getFullYear(), now.getMonth(), now.getDate());
000230:         const endOfToday = new Date(now.getFullYear(), now.getMonth(), now.getDate(), 23, 59, 59, 999);
000231: 
000232:         if (filters.statusFilter !== 'all' && status !== filters.statusFilter) return false;
000233:         if (filters.jobRoleFilter !== 'all' && jobRole !== filters.jobRoleFilter) return false;
000234: 
000235:         if (filters.scheduleFilter !== 'all') {
000236:           if (!scheduledDate || Number.isNaN(scheduledDate.getTime())) {
000237:             if (filters.scheduleFilter !== 'unscheduled') return false;
000238:           } else {
000239:             if (filters.scheduleFilter === 'unscheduled') return false;
000240:             if (filters.scheduleFilter === 'upcoming' && scheduledDate < now) return false;
000241:             if (filters.scheduleFilter === 'past' && scheduledDate >= now) return false;
000242:             if (filters.scheduleFilter === 'today' && (scheduledDate < startOfToday || scheduledDate > endOfToday)) return false;
000243:           }
000244:         }
000245: 
000246:         if (filters.scoreFilter === 'scored' && !hasScore) return false;
000247:         if (filters.scoreFilter === 'unscored' && hasScore) return false;
000248:         if (filters.scoreFilter === '80+' && !(hasScore && score >= 80)) return false;
000249:         if (filters.scoreFilter === '60-79' && !(hasScore && score >= 60 && score < 80)) return false;
000250:         if (filters.scoreFilter === '<60' && !(hasScore && score < 60)) return false;
000251: 
000252:         if (interviewDateWindow.from || interviewDateWindow.to) {
000253:           if (!primaryDate) return false;
000254:           if (interviewDateWindow.from && primaryDate < interviewDateWindow.from) return false;
000255:           if (interviewDateWindow.to && primaryDate > interviewDateWindow.to) return false;
000256:         }
000257: 
000258:         if (searchTokens.length) {
000259:           const searchableText = [
000260:             interview?.candidate?.fullName || '',
000261:             interview?.candidate?.email || '',
000262:             interview?.jobRole || '',
000263:             interview?.status || '',
000264:             interview?.pipelineStatus || '',
000265:           ]
000266:             .join(' ')
000267:             .toLowerCase();
000268:           if (!searchTokens.every((token) => searchableText.includes(token))) return false;
000269:         }
000270: 
000271:         return true;
000272:       })
000273:       .sort((left, right) => {
000274:         const leftScheduled = left?.scheduledFor ? new Date(left.scheduledFor).getTime() : 0;
000275:         const rightScheduled = right?.scheduledFor ? new Date(right.scheduledFor).getTime() : 0;
000276:         const leftCreated = left?.createdAt ? new Date(left.createdAt).getTime() : 0;
000277:         const rightCreated = right?.createdAt ? new Date(right.createdAt).getTime() : 0;
000278: 
000279:         if (filters.sortBy === 'oldest') return leftCreated - rightCreated;
000280:         if (filters.sortBy === 'scheduledSoon') {
000281:           if (!leftScheduled && !rightScheduled) return rightCreated - leftCreated;
000282:           if (!leftScheduled) return 1;
000283:           if (!rightScheduled) return -1;
000284:           return leftScheduled - rightScheduled;
000285:         }
000286:         if (filters.sortBy === 'candidateAsc') {
000287:           const leftName = left?.candidate?.fullName || left?.candidate?.email || '';
000288:           const rightName = right?.candidate?.fullName || right?.candidate?.email || '';
000289:           return leftName.localeCompare(rightName);
000290:         }
000291:         if (filters.sortBy === 'scoreDesc') return Number(right?.overallScore || 0) - Number(left?.overallScore || 0);
000292:         return rightCreated - leftCreated;
000293:       });
000294:     },
000295:     [filters, interviews],
000296:   );
000297: 
000298:   // Pagination calculations
000299:   const totalPages = Math.ceil(filteredInterviews.length / itemsPerPage);
000300:   const startIndex = (currentPage - 1) * itemsPerPage;
000301:   const endIndex = startIndex + itemsPerPage;
000302:   const paginatedInterviews = filteredInterviews.slice(startIndex, endIndex);
000303: 
000304:   // Reset to page 1 when filters change
000305:   React.useEffect(() => {
000306:     setCurrentPage(1);
000307:   }, [filters]);
000308: 
000309:   const handleViewDetails = (interview) => {
000310:     setSelectedInterview(interview);
000311:     setShowDetails(true);
000312:   };
000313: 
000314:   if (status === 'loading' || !user) {
000315:     return (
000316:       <LoadingState
000317:         title="Loading interviews"
000318:         message="Pulling the latest interview activity."
000319:         variant="fullscreen"
000320:         tone="primary"
000321:       />
000322:     );
000323:   }
000324: 
000325:   return (
000326:     <div className="relative min-h-screen bg-gradient-to-b from-blue-50 via-white to-purple-50 dark:from-slate-900 dark:via-slate-900 dark:to-slate-950 transition-colors duration-300">
000327:       <Header 
000328:         userType="company"
000329:         isAuthenticated
000330:         onLogout={handleLogout}
000331:         organizationRole={user?.organizationContext?.membership?.role}
000332:       />
000333:       
000334:       <div className="h-14 xs:h-16" />
000335:       
000336:       <div className="relative z-10">
000337:         <div className="flex flex-col lg:flex-row">
000338:           <UserContextNavigation
000339:             userType="company"
000340:             isCollapsed={isSidebarCollapsed}
000341:             onToggleCollapse={() => setIsSidebarCollapsed(!isSidebarCollapsed)}
000342:           />
000343:           
000344:           <main className={`flex-1 transition-all duration-300 pb-20 lg:pb-0 ${
000345:             isSidebarCollapsed ? 'lg:ml-20' : 'lg:ml-72 xl:ml-80'
000346:           }`}>
000347:             <motion.section
000348:               initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 32 }}
000349:               animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
000350:               transition={{ duration: 0.6, ease: 'easeOut' }}
000351:               className="container-responsive py-6 xs:py-8 sm:py-10 space-y-4 xs:space-y-5 sm:space-y-6"
000352:             >
000353:               <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between gap-4 mb-6">
000354:                 <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
000355:                   <div className="w-12 h-12 rounded-2xl bg-gradient-to-br from-purple-600 to-blue-600 flex items-center justify-center shadow-lg shadow-purple-500/30">
000356:                     <Icon name="Calendar" size={22} color="white" />
000357:                   </div>
000358:                   <div>
000359:                     <h1 className="text-xl xs:text-2xl sm:text-3xl font-bold text-gray-900 dark:text-slate-100 leading-tight">
000360:                       Interviews
000361:                     </h1>
000362:                     <p className="text-sm text-gray-600 dark:text-slate-400">
000363:                       Manage and review all interview sessions
000364:                     </p>
000365:                   </div>
000366:                 </div>
000367:                 <Button
000368:                   variant="ghost"
000369:                   size="sm"
000370:                   iconName="RefreshCw"
000371:                   onClick={loadInterviews}
000372:                   disabled={loading}
000373:                   className="rounded-full text-gray-500 dark:text-slate-400 hover:text-blue-600 dark:hover:text-blue-400"
000374:                 >
000375:                   Refresh
000376:                 </Button>
000377:               </div>
000378: 
000379:               {pendingRealtimeInterviewUpdates > 0 && (
000380:                 <div className="rounded-2xl border border-blue-200 dark:border-blue-500/30 bg-blue-50 dark:bg-blue-500/10 px-4 py-3 sm:px-5 sm:py-4 flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between gap-3">
000381:                   <div className="flex items-start gap-2">
000382:                     <Icon name="Bell" className="w-4 h-4 mt-0.5 text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-300" />
000383:                     <p className="text-sm text-blue-800 dark:text-blue-200">
000384:                       {pendingRealtimeInterviewUpdates} new interview update{pendingRealtimeInterviewUpdates === 1 ? '' : 's'} available.
000385:                       Refresh when you are ready.
000386:                     </p>
000387:                   </div>
000388:                   <Button
000389:                     variant="outline"
000390:                     size="sm"
000391:                     onClick={loadInterviews}
000392:                     disabled={loading}
000393:                     className="border-blue-300 text-blue-700 hover:bg-blue-100 dark:border-blue-500/40 dark:text-blue-200 dark:hover:bg-blue-500/20"
000394:                   >
000395:                     <Icon name="RefreshCw" size={14} className="mr-1.5" />
000396:                     Refresh List
000397:                   </Button>
000398:                 </div>
000399:               )}
000400: 
000401:               {/* Filters */}
000402:               <motion.div

000405:                 transition={{ delay: 0.1 }}
000406:               >

000410:                   activeCount={activeFilterCount}
000411:                   onClear={clearFilters}
000412:                   headerActions={(

000428:                     />
000429:                     <UnifiedFilterSelect

000432:                       onChange={(value) => updateFilter('statusFilter', value)}
000433:                       options={[

000441:                     <UnifiedFilterSelect

000448: 
000449:                   {showAdvancedFilters && (

000452:                         <UnifiedFilterSelect
000453:                           label="Schedule State"

000455:                           onChange={(value) => updateFilter('scheduleFilter', value)}
000456:                           options={COMPANY_INTERVIEW_SCHEDULE_OPTIONS}
000457:                         />
000458:                         <UnifiedFilterSelect
000459:                           label="Score Band"
000460:                           value={filters.scoreFilter}
000461:                           onChange={(value) => updateFilter('scoreFilter', value)}
000462:                           options={COMPANY_INTERVIEW_SCORE_OPTIONS}
000463:                         />
000464:                         <UnifiedFilterSelect
