000466:                           value={filters.datePreset}
000467:                           onChange={(value) => updateFilter('datePreset', value)}
000468:                           options={COMPANY_INTERVIEW_DATE_PRESET_OPTIONS}
000469:                         />
000470:                         <UnifiedFilterSelect
000471:                           label="Sort By"
000472:                           value={filters.sortBy}
000473:                           onChange={(value) => updateFilter('sortBy', value)}
000474:                           options={COMPANY_INTERVIEW_SORT_OPTIONS}
000475:                         />
000476:                       </div>
000477: 
000478:                       {filters.datePreset === 'custom' && (
000479:                         <div className={FILTER_DATE_GRID_CLASS}>
000480:                           <label className="space-y-1.5">
000481:                             <span className="text-[11px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.08em] text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">From</span>
000482:                             <UnifiedTextInput
000483:                               type="date"
000484:                               value={filters.from}
000485:                               onChange={(event) => updateFilter('from', event.target.value)}
000486:                             />
000487:                           </label>
000488:                           <label className="space-y-1.5">
000489:                             <span className="text-[11px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.08em] text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">To</span>
000490:                             <UnifiedTextInput
000491:                               type="date"
000492:                               value={filters.to}
000493:                               onChange={(event) => updateFilter('to', event.target.value)}
000494:                             />
000495:                           </label>
000496:                         </div>
000497:                       )}
000498:                     </div>
000499:                   )}
000500:                 </UnifiedFilterPanel>
000501:               </motion.div>
000502: 
000503:               {/* Error Message */}
000504:               {error && (
000505:                 <motion.div
000506:                   initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 20 }}
000507:                   animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
000508:                   className="rounded-xl border border-red-200 bg-red-50 px-3 py-2 text-xs sm:text-sm text-red-700 dark:border-red-500/30 dark:bg-red-500/10 dark:text-red-200"
000509:                 >
000510:                   {error}
000511:                 </motion.div>
000512:               )}
000513: 
000514:               {/* Interviews List */}
000515:               {loading ? (
000516:                 <LoadingState
000517:                   title="Loading interviews"
000518:                   message="Updating interview schedules and status."
000519:                   variant="card"
000520:                   tone="primary"
000521:                 />
000522:               ) : filteredInterviews.length === 0 ? (
000523:                 <motion.div
000524:                   initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 20 }}
000525:                   animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
000526:                   className="rounded-2xl border border-white/30 dark:border-slate-700/50 bg-white/80 dark:bg-slate-800/80 p-8 text-center"
000527:                 >
000528:                   <Icon name="FileText" className="w-12 h-12 text-gray-400 mx-auto mb-3" />
000529:                   <p className="text-sm text-gray-500 dark:text-slate-400">
000530:                     {activeFilterCount > 0
000531:                       ? 'No interviews match your filters.' 
000532:                       : 'No interviews found. Create an invitation to schedule an interview.'}
000533:                   </p>
000534:                 </motion.div>
000535:               ) : (
000536:                 <>
000537:                 <motion.div
000538:                   initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 20 }}
000539:                   animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
000540:                   transition={{ delay: 0.2 }}
000541:                   className="space-y-2 sm:space-y-3"
000542:                 >
000543:                   {paginatedInterviews.map((interview) => (
000544:                     <div
000545:                       key={interview.id}
000546:                       className="rounded-xl border border-white/40 dark:border-slate-700/50 bg-white/80 dark:bg-slate-800/80 p-3 sm:p-4 hover:-translate-y-0.5 hover:shadow-[0_10px_30px_rgba(15,23,42,0.1)] dark:hover:shadow-[0_10px_30px_rgba(0,0,0,0.3)] transition-all duration-200"
000547:                     >
000548:                       <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between gap-3 sm:gap-4">
000549:                         <div className="flex items-start gap-3 sm:gap-4 flex-1 min-w-0">
000550:                           <div className="w-10 h-10 sm:w-12 sm:h-12 rounded-full bg-gradient-to-br from-blue-500 to-purple-500 flex items-center justify-center text-white font-semibold text-sm sm:text-base flex-shrink-0">
000551:                             {interview.candidate?.fullName?.charAt(0)?.toUpperCase() || 
000552:                              interview.candidate?.email?.charAt(0)?.toUpperCase() || 
000553:                              '?'}
000554:                           </div>
000555:                           <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
000556:                             <h3 className="font-semibold text-gray-900 dark:text-slate-100 text-sm sm:text-base truncate">
000557:                               {interview.candidate?.fullName || interview.candidate?.email || 'Unknown Candidate'}
000558:                             </h3>
000559:                             <p className="text-xs sm:text-sm text-gray-500 dark:text-slate-400 truncate">
000560:                               {interview.candidate?.email}
000561:                             </p>
000562:                             <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 mt-2">
000563:                               <span className="text-xs text-gray-600 dark:text-slate-300">
000564:                                 {interview.jobRole || 'Position'}
000565:                               </span>
000566:                               {interview.scheduledFor && (

000146:   if ((filters.status || 'all') !== 'all') count += 1;
000147:   if ((filters.employmentType || 'all') !== 'all') count += 1;
000148:   if ((filters.experienceLevel || 'all') !== 'all') count += 1;
000149:   if ((filters.department || 'all') !== 'all') count += 1;
000150:   if ((filters.locationMode || 'all') !== 'all') count += 1;
000151:   if ((filters.applicationState || 'all') !== 'all') count += 1;
000152:   if ((filters.publishState || 'all') !== 'all') count += 1;
000153:   if ((filters.datePreset || 'all') !== 'all') count += 1;
000154:   if ((filters.sortBy || 'newest') !== 'newest') count += 1;
000155:   return count;
000156: };
000157: 
000158: const normalizeSkillValue = (value = '') => value.trim().toLowerCase();
000159: 
000160: const mergeUniqueSkills = (existingSkills = [], incomingSkills = []) => {
000161:   const seen = new Set(existingSkills.map((skill) => normalizeSkillValue(skill)));
000162:   const merged = [...existingSkills];
000163: 
000164:   incomingSkills.forEach((rawSkill) => {
000165:     const skill = rawSkill?.trim();
000166:     if (!skill) return;
000167:     const normalized = normalizeSkillValue(skill);
000168:     if (seen.has(normalized)) return;
000169:     seen.add(normalized);
000170:     merged.push(skill);
000171:   });
000172: 
000173:   return merged;
000174: };
000175: 
000176: const normalizeAdvertImageUrls = (job = {}) => {
000177:   if (Array.isArray(job?.advertImageUrls)) {
000178:     return job.advertImageUrls
000179:       .map((url) => (typeof url === 'string' ? url.trim() : ''))
000180:       .filter(Boolean);
000181:   }
000182:   if (typeof job?.advertImageUrl === 'string' && job.advertImageUrl.trim()) {
000183:     return [job.advertImageUrl.trim()];
000184:   }
000185:   return [];
000186: };
000187: 
000188: const toAbsoluteAssetUrl = (value) => {
000189:   if (!value || typeof value !== 'string') return '';
000190:   const trimmed = value.trim();
000191:   if (!trimmed) return '';
000192:   if (trimmed.startsWith('http://') || trimmed.startsWith('https://') || trimmed.startsWith('blob:') || trimmed.startsWith('data:')) {
000193:     return trimmed;
000194:   }
000195:   const base = API_URL.replace(/\/$/, '');
000196:   return `${base}${trimmed.startsWith('/') ? trimmed : `/${trimmed}`}`;
000197: };
000198: 
000199: const toDateTimeLocalValue = (isoValue) => {
000200:   if (!isoValue || typeof isoValue !== 'string') return '';
000201:   const parsed = new Date(isoValue);
000202:   if (Number.isNaN(parsed.getTime())) return '';
000203:   const localDate = new Date(parsed.getTime() - parsed.getTimezoneOffset() * 60 * 1000);
000204:   return localDate.toISOString().slice(0, 16);
000205: };
000206: 
000207: const formatDateTime = (value) => {
000208:   if (!value) return '';
000209:   const parsed = new Date(value);
000210:   if (Number.isNaN(parsed.getTime())) return '';
000211:   return parsed.toLocaleString();
000212: };
000213: 
000214: const isResizeHandleClick = (event) => {
000215:   if (!event?.currentTarget?.getBoundingClientRect) return false;
000216:   const rect = event.currentTarget.getBoundingClientRect();
000217:   const resizeHandleZone = 22;
000218:   const nearRight = rect.right - event.clientX <= resizeHandleZone;
000219:   const nearBottom = rect.bottom - event.clientY <= resizeHandleZone;
000220:   return nearRight && nearBottom;
000221: };
000222: 
000223: const SCHEDULE_WEEKDAY_LABELS = ['Su', 'Mo', 'Tu', 'We', 'Th', 'Fr', 'Sa'];
000224: const parseLocalDateTimeValue = (value) => {
000225:   if (!value || typeof value !== 'string') return null;
000226:   const parsed = new Date(value);
000227:   if (Number.isNaN(parsed.getTime())) return null;
000228:   return parsed;
000229: };
000230: 
000231: const formatLocalDateTimeValue = (date) => {
000232:   if (!(date instanceof Date) || Number.isNaN(date.getTime())) return '';
000233:   const year = date.getFullYear();
000234:   const month = String(date.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0');
000235:   const day = String(date.getDate()).padStart(2, '0');
000236:   const hours = String(date.getHours()).padStart(2, '0');
000237:   const minutes = String(date.getMinutes()).padStart(2, '0');
000238:   return `${year}-${month}-${day}T${hours}:${minutes}`;
000239: };
000240: 
000241: const areSameCalendarDate = (left, right) => (
000242:   left?.getFullYear?.() === right?.getFullYear?.()
000243:   && left?.getMonth?.() === right?.getMonth?.()
000244:   && left?.getDate?.() === right?.getDate?.()
000245: );
000246: 
000247: const buildCalendarGridDays = (monthDate) => {
000248:   const monthStart = new Date(monthDate.getFullYear(), monthDate.getMonth(), 1);
000249:   const firstGridDate = new Date(monthStart);
000250:   firstGridDate.setDate(monthStart.getDate() - monthStart.getDay());
000251:   return Array.from({ length: 42 }, (_, index) => {
000252:     const day = new Date(firstGridDate);
000253:     day.setDate(firstGridDate.getDate() + index);
000254:     return day;
000255:   });
000256: };
000257: 
000258: const isDateBeforeMinimumDay = (date, minDate) => {
000259:   if (!minDate) return false;
000260:   const endOfDay = new Date(date.getFullYear(), date.getMonth(), date.getDate(), 23, 59, 59, 999);
000261:   return endOfDay.getTime() < minDate.getTime();
000262: };
000263: 
000264: const clampToMinDate = (date, minDate) => {
000265:   if (!date) return null;
000266:   if (!minDate) return date;
000267:   return date.getTime() < minDate.getTime() ? new Date(minDate) : date;
000268: };
000269: 
000270: const ScheduleDateTimePicker = ({ value, minValue, timezoneLabel, onChange, required = false }) => {
000271:   const selectedDate = parseLocalDateTimeValue(value);
000272:   const minDate = parseLocalDateTimeValue(minValue);
000273:   const fallbackDate = minDate || new Date();
000274:   const activeDate = selectedDate || fallbackDate;
000275:   const [visibleMonth, setVisibleMonth] = useState(
000276:     new Date(activeDate.getFullYear(), activeDate.getMonth(), 1),
000277:   );
000278: 
000279:   useEffect(() => {
000280:     const anchorDate = parseLocalDateTimeValue(value) || parseLocalDateTimeValue(minValue) || new Date();
000281:     setVisibleMonth((previousMonth) => {
000282:       if (
000283:         previousMonth.getFullYear() === anchorDate.getFullYear()
000284:         && previousMonth.getMonth() === anchorDate.getMonth()
000285:       ) {
000286:         return previousMonth;
000287:       }
000288:       return new Date(anchorDate.getFullYear(), anchorDate.getMonth(), 1);
000289:     });
000290:   }, [value, minValue]);
000291: 
000292:   const hour24 = activeDate.getHours();
000293:   const selectedHour = String(((hour24 + 11) % 12) + 1).padStart(2, '0');
000294:   const selectedMinute = String(activeDate.getMinutes()).padStart(2, '0');
000295:   const selectedPeriod = hour24 >= 12 ? 'PM' : 'AM';
000296:   const [hourInput, setHourInput] = useState(selectedHour);
000297:   const [minuteInput, setMinuteInput] = useState(selectedMinute);
000298:   const calendarDays = buildCalendarGridDays(visibleMonth);
000299:   const selectedDateLabel = selectedDate
000300:     ? selectedDate.toLocaleString([], { dateStyle: 'full', timeStyle: 'short' })
000301:     : 'Select a date and time';
000302:   const monthLabel = visibleMonth.toLocaleString([], { month: 'long', year: 'numeric' });
000303: 
000304:   const emitDateChange = (candidateDate) => {
000305:     const clampedDate = clampToMinDate(candidateDate, minDate);
000306:     if (!clampedDate) return;
000307:     onChange?.(formatLocalDateTimeValue(clampedDate));
000308:   };
000309: 
000310:   const handleDaySelect = (dayDate) => {
000311:     if (isDateBeforeMinimumDay(dayDate, minDate)) return;
000312:     const next = new Date(activeDate);
000313:     next.setFullYear(dayDate.getFullYear(), dayDate.getMonth(), dayDate.getDate());
000314:     next.setSeconds(0, 0);
000315:     emitDateChange(next);
000316:   };
000317: 
000318:   const applyTimeChange = ({ nextHour = selectedHour, nextMinute = selectedMinute, nextPeriod = selectedPeriod }) => {
000319:     const hour = Number(nextHour);
000320:     const minute = Number(nextMinute);
000321:     if (!Number.isInteger(hour) || !Number.isInteger(minute)) return;
000322: 
000323:     const next = new Date(activeDate);
000324:     let convertedHour = hour % 12;
000325:     if (nextPeriod === 'PM') {
000326:       convertedHour += 12;
000327:     }
000328:     next.setHours(convertedHour, minute, 0, 0);
000329:     emitDateChange(next);
000330:   };
000331: 
000332:   useEffect(() => {
000333:     setHourInput(selectedHour);
000334:   }, [selectedHour]);
000335: 
000336:   useEffect(() => {
000337:     setMinuteInput(selectedMinute);
000338:   }, [selectedMinute]);
000339: 
000340:   const commitHourInput = () => {
000341:     const sanitized = hourInput.replace(/\D/g, '');
000342:     if (!sanitized) {
000343:       setHourInput(selectedHour);
000344:       return;
000345:     }
000346:     const parsedHour = Number.parseInt(sanitized, 10);
000347:     if (!Number.isInteger(parsedHour)) {
000348:       setHourInput(selectedHour);
000349:       return;
000350:     }
000351:     const clampedHour = Math.min(12, Math.max(1, parsedHour));
000352:     const normalizedHour = String(clampedHour).padStart(2, '0');
000353:     setHourInput(normalizedHour);
000354:     applyTimeChange({ nextHour: normalizedHour });
000355:   };
000356: 
000357:   const commitMinuteInput = () => {
000358:     const sanitized = minuteInput.replace(/\D/g, '');
000359:     if (!sanitized) {
000360:       setMinuteInput(selectedMinute);
000361:       return;
000362:     }
000363:     const parsedMinute = Number.parseInt(sanitized, 10);
000364:     if (!Number.isInteger(parsedMinute)) {
000365:       setMinuteInput(selectedMinute);
000366:       return;
000367:     }
000368:     const clampedMinute = Math.min(59, Math.max(0, parsedMinute));
000369:     const normalizedMinute = String(clampedMinute).padStart(2, '0');
000370:     setMinuteInput(normalizedMinute);
000371:     applyTimeChange({ nextMinute: normalizedMinute });
000372:   };
000373: 
000374:   const applyRelativeMinutesPreset = (minutesToAdd) => {
000375:     const quickDate = new Date();
000376:     quickDate.setMinutes(quickDate.getMinutes() + minutesToAdd, 0, 0);
000377:     emitDateChange(quickDate);
000378:   };
000379: 
000380:   const applyTomorrowAtPreset = (hours, minutes = 0) => {
000381:     const quickDate = new Date();
000382:     quickDate.setDate(quickDate.getDate() + 1);
000383:     quickDate.setHours(hours, minutes, 0, 0);
000384:     emitDateChange(quickDate);
000385:   };
000386: 
000387:   const applyNextWeekdayAtPreset = (targetWeekday, hours, minutes = 0) => {
000388:     const quickDate = new Date();
000389:     const currentWeekday = quickDate.getDay();
000390:     let daysToAdd = (targetWeekday - currentWeekday + 7) % 7;
000391:     if (daysToAdd === 0) {
000392:       daysToAdd = 7;
000393:     }
000394:     quickDate.setDate(quickDate.getDate() + daysToAdd);
000395:     quickDate.setHours(hours, minutes, 0, 0);
000396:     emitDateChange(quickDate);
000397:   };
000398: 
000399:   const shortPresetOptions = [
000400:     { label: '+15 min', onClick: () => applyRelativeMinutesPreset(15) },
000401:     { label: '+30 min', onClick: () => applyRelativeMinutesPreset(30) },
000402:     { label: '+1 hour', onClick: () => applyRelativeMinutesPreset(60) },
000403:     { label: '+2 hours', onClick: () => applyRelativeMinutesPreset(120) },
000404:   ];
000405: 
000406:   const longPresetOptions = [
000407:     { label: 'Tomorrow 9:00 AM', onClick: () => applyTomorrowAtPreset(9, 0) },
000408:     { label: 'Next Monday 9:00 AM', onClick: () => applyNextWeekdayAtPreset(1, 9, 0) },
000409:   ];
000410: 
000411:   const baseTimeInputClass = 'h-11 w-full rounded-xl border border-input bg-background dark:bg-slate-900 px-3 text-center text-sm font-semibold text-foreground dark:text-slate-100 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-ring focus:ring-offset-2 transition-all duration-200';
000412: 
000413:   return (
000414:     <div className="space-y-3 rounded-xl border border-gray-200 dark:border-slate-700 bg-white/70 dark:bg-slate-900/40 p-4">
000415:       <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2">
000416:         <label className="text-sm font-medium text-gray-900 dark:text-slate-100">
000417:           Scheduled Publish Date & Time
000418:           {required && <span className="ml-1 text-red-500">*</span>}
000419:         </label>
000420:         <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded-full border border-gray-200 dark:border-slate-700 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 px-2.5 py-1 text-xs text-gray-600 dark:text-slate-300">
000421:           <Icon name="Globe2" size={12} />
000422:           {timezoneLabel}
000423:         </span>
000424:       </div>
000425: 
000426:       <div className="rounded-xl border border-blue-200 dark:border-blue-500/30 bg-blue-50/60 dark:bg-blue-500/10 px-3 py-2.5">
000427:         <div className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 text-sm font-medium text-blue-800 dark:text-blue-200">
000428:           <Icon name="CalendarClock" size={16} />
000429:           {selectedDateLabel}
000430:         </div>
000431:       </div>
000432: 
000433:       <div className="grid gap-4 lg:grid-cols-[1.35fr_1fr]">
000434:         <div className="rounded-xl border border-gray-200 dark:border-slate-700 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 p-3">
000435:           <div className="mb-3 flex items-center justify-between">
000436:             <button
000437:               type="button"
000438:               onClick={() => setVisibleMonth((prev) => new Date(prev.getFullYear(), prev.getMonth() - 1, 1))}
000439:               className="h-8 w-8 rounded-lg border border-gray-200 dark:border-slate-700 text-gray-600 dark:text-slate-300 hover:bg-gray-100 dark:hover:bg-slate-800 transition-colors"
000440:               aria-label="Previous month"
000441:             >
000442:               <Icon name="ChevronLeft" size={16} className="mx-auto" />
000443:             </button>
000444:             <div className="text-sm font-semibold text-gray-900 dark:text-slate-100">
000445:               {monthLabel}
000446:             </div>
000447:             <button
000448:               type="button"
000449:               onClick={() => setVisibleMonth((prev) => new Date(prev.getFullYear(), prev.getMonth() + 1, 1))}
000450:               className="h-8 w-8 rounded-lg border border-gray-200 dark:border-slate-700 text-gray-600 dark:text-slate-300 hover:bg-gray-100 dark:hover:bg-slate-800 transition-colors"
000451:               aria-label="Next month"
000452:             >
000453:               <Icon name="ChevronRight" size={16} className="mx-auto" />
000454:             </button>
000455:           </div>
000456: 
000457:           <div className="grid grid-cols-7 gap-1">
000458:             {SCHEDULE_WEEKDAY_LABELS.map((weekday) => (
000459:               <div
000460:                 key={weekday}
000461:                 className="text-center text-[11px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide text-gray-500 dark:text-slate-400 py-1"
000462:               >
000463:                 {weekday}
000464:               </div>
000465:             ))}
000466:             {calendarDays.map((dayDate) => {
000467:               const isCurrentMonth = dayDate.getMonth() === visibleMonth.getMonth();
000468:               const isSelected = selectedDate ? areSameCalendarDate(dayDate, selectedDate) : false;
000469:               const isToday = areSameCalendarDate(dayDate, new Date());
000470:               const isDisabled = isDateBeforeMinimumDay(dayDate, minDate);
000471: 
000472:               return (
000473:                 <button
000474:                   key={dayDate.toISOString()}
000475:                   type="button"
000476:                   onClick={() => handleDaySelect(dayDate)}
000477:                   disabled={isDisabled}
000478:                   className={cn(
000479:                     'h-9 w-9 rounded-lg text-sm font-medium transition-colors',
000480:                     isSelected
000481:                       ? 'bg-blue-600 text-white shadow-md shadow-blue-500/30'
000482:                       : isDisabled
000483:                         ? 'cursor-not-allowed text-gray-300 dark:text-slate-600'
000484:                         : isCurrentMonth
000485:                           ? 'text-gray-800 dark:text-slate-200 hover:bg-blue-50 dark:hover:bg-blue-500/20'
000486:                           : 'text-gray-400 dark:text-slate-500 hover:bg-gray-100 dark:hover:bg-slate-800',
000487:                     isToday && !isSelected && !isDisabled && 'ring-1 ring-blue-400/70 dark:ring-blue-500/60',
000488:                   )}
000489:                 >
000490:                   {dayDate.getDate()}
000491:                 </button>
000492:               );
000493:             })}
000494:           </div>
000495:         </div>
000496: 
000497:         <div className="space-y-3 rounded-xl border border-gray-200 dark:border-slate-700 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 p-3">
000498:           <div className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 text-sm font-medium text-gray-900 dark:text-slate-100">
000499:             <Icon name="Clock3" size={16} />
000500:             Time
000501:           </div>
000502:           <div className="grid grid-cols-[1fr_1fr_auto] gap-2">
000503:             <input
000504:               value={hourInput}
000505:               onChange={(event) => setHourInput(event.target.value.replace(/\D/g, '').slice(0, 2))}
000506:               onBlur={commitHourInput}
000507:               onKeyDown={(event) => {

000509:                   event.preventDefault();

000520:             <input

000524:               onKeyDown={(event) => {

000527:                   commitMinuteInput();

000549:               {shortPresetOptions.map((option) => (

000555:                 >
000556:                   {option.label}
000557:                 </button>
000558:               ))}

000560:             <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-2">
000561:               {longPresetOptions.map((option) => (

000563:                   key={option.label}
000564:                   type="button"
000565:                   onClick={option.onClick}
000566:                   className="h-9 rounded-lg border border-gray-200 dark:border-slate-700 px-3 text-xs font-medium text-gray-700 dark:text-slate-300 hover:bg-gray-100 dark:hover:bg-slate-800 transition-colors whitespace-nowrap"
000567:                 >

000582: const CompanyJobsPage = () => {
000583:   const { user, logout, organizationContext, refresh } = useAuth();
000584:   const navigate = useNavigate();
000585:   const organizationId = organizationContext?.organization?.id || user?.organizationContext?.organization?.id;
000586:   
000587:   // Get organization role for permission checks
000588:   const organizationRole = user?.organizationContext?.membership?.role;
000589:   const canCreateJobs = hasPermission(organizationRole, 'CREATE_JOBS');
000590:   const canEditJobs = hasPermission(organizationRole, 'EDIT_JOBS');
000591:   const canDeleteJobs = hasPermission(organizationRole, 'DELETE_JOBS');
000592: 
000593:   const handleLogout = async () => {
000594:     await logout();
000595:     navigate('/login');
000596:   };
000597:   const [isSidebarCollapsed, setIsSidebarCollapsed] = useState(false);
000598:   const [jobs, setJobs] = useState([]);
000599:   const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
000600:   const [showCreateModal, setShowCreateModal] = useState(false);
000601:   const [selectedJob, setSelectedJob] = useState(null);
000602:   const [jobFilters, setJobFilters] = useState(DEFAULT_COMPANY_JOB_FILTERS);
000603:   const [showAdvancedFilters, setShowAdvancedFilters] = useState(false);
000604:   const keySkillsInputRef = useRef(null);
000605:   const [showAddSkillsSection, setShowAddSkillsSection] = useState(false);
000606:   const advertImageInputRef = useRef(null);
000607:   const advertVideoInputRef = useRef(null);
000608:   const advertImageUploadsRef = useRef([]);
000609:   const [advertImageUploads, setAdvertImageUploads] = useState([]);
000610:   const [advertVideoFile, setAdvertVideoFile] = useState(null);
000611:   const [advertVideoPreview, setAdvertVideoPreview] = useState('');
000612:   
000613:   // Location detection state
000614:   const [isDetectingLocation, setIsDetectingLocation] = useState(false);
000615:   const [locationFeedback, setLocationFeedback] = useState({ status: 'idle', message: '' });
000616: 
000617:   // Local testing currently supports only Sri Lankan Rupees.
000618:   const currencyOptions = [
000619:     { value: 'LKR', label: 'LKR (Rs)', symbol: 'Rs', locale: 'si-LK' },
000620:   ];
000621: 
000622:   // Format salary based on currency
000623:   const formatSalary = (value, currency = 'LKR') => {
000624:     if (!value) return '';
000625:     // Remove all non-digit characters
000626:     const numericValue = value.replace(/[^0-9]/g, '');
000627:     if (!numericValue) return '';
000628:     
000629:     const currencyConfig = currencyOptions.find(c => c.value === currency) || currencyOptions[0];
000630:     
000631:     try {
000632:       const number = parseInt(numericValue, 10);
000633:       return new Intl.NumberFormat(currencyConfig.locale, {
000634:         style: 'decimal',
000635:         maximumFractionDigits: 0,
000636:       }).format(number);
000637:     } catch {
000638:       return numericValue;
000639:     }
000640:   };
000641: 
000642:   // Parse formatted salary to raw number string
000643:   const parseSalary = (formattedValue) => {
000644:     if (!formattedValue) return '';
000645:     return formattedValue.replace(/[^0-9]/g, '');
000646:   };
000647: 
000648:   // Format detected location from geocoding API response
000649:   const formatDetectedLocation = (data, coords) => {
000650:     if (!data && !coords) {
000651:       return '';
000652:     }
000653: 
000654:     const administrative = data?.localityInfo?.administrative || [];
000655:     const locality = data?.city
000656:       || data?.locality
000657:       || data?.principalSubdivision
000658:       || administrative.find((item) => (item.order ?? 0) >= 4)?.name;
000659: 
000660:     const region = data?.principalSubdivision
000661:       || administrative.find((item) => (item.order ?? 0) <= 3)?.name;
000662: 
000663:     const country = data?.countryName || data?.countryCode;
000664: 
000665:     const parts = [locality, region, country].filter(Boolean);
000666: 
000667:     if (parts.length > 0) {
000668:       return parts.join(', ');
000669:     }
000670: 
000671:     if (coords) {
000672:       const { latitude, longitude } = coords;
000673:       return `Lat ${latitude.toFixed(3)}, Long ${longitude.toFixed(3)}`;
000674:     }
000675: 
000676:     return '';
000677:   };
000678: 
000679:   // Handle location detection
000680:   const handleDetectLocation = async () => {
000681:     if (isDetectingLocation) {
000682:       return;
000683:     }
000684: 
000685:     if (typeof window === 'undefined' || !navigator?.geolocation) {
000686:       setLocationFeedback({
000687:         status: 'error',
000688:         message: 'Your browser does not support location detection. Please enter it manually.',
000689:       });
000690:       return;
000691:     }
000692: 
000693:     setIsDetectingLocation(true);
000694:     setLocationFeedback({
000695:       status: 'info',
000696:       message: 'Requesting location permission…',
000697:     });
000698: 
000699:     try {
000700:       const position = await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
000701:         navigator.geolocation.getCurrentPosition(resolve, reject, {
000702:           enableHighAccuracy: true,
000703:           timeout: 10000,
000704:           maximumAge: 0,
000705:         });
000706:       });
000707: 
000708:       setLocationFeedback({
000709:         status: 'info',
000710:         message: 'Detecting your city…',
000711:       });
000712: 
000713:       const { latitude, longitude } = position.coords || {};
000714: 
000715:       if (latitude == null || longitude == null) {
000716:         throw new Error('We could not read your coordinates. Please enter your location manually.');
000717:       }
000718: 
000719:       const response = await fetch(
000720:         `https://api.bigdatacloud.net/data/reverse-geocode-client?latitude=${latitude}&longitude=${longitude}&localityLanguage=en`
000721:       );
000722: 
000723:       if (!response.ok) {
000724:         throw new Error('Unable to determine your location automatically.');
000725:       }
000726: 
000727:       const data = await response.json();
000728:       const formattedLocation = formatDetectedLocation(data, { latitude, longitude });
000729: 
000730:       if (!formattedLocation) {
000731:         throw new Error('We couldn\'t convert your coordinates into a city. Please enter it manually.');
000732:       }
000733: 
000734:       setFormData(prev => ({ ...prev, location: formattedLocation }));
000735: 
000736:       // Clear location feedback on success
000737:       setLocationFeedback({ status: 'success', message: '' });
000738:     } catch (error) {
000739:       console.error('Location detection error:', error);
000740: 
000741:       let friendlyMessage = error?.message || 'Unable to detect your location. Please enter it manually.';
000742: 
000743:       if (error?.code === 1 || error?.message?.toLowerCase().includes('permission')) {
000744:         friendlyMessage = 'Location permission was denied. You can enable it in your browser or enter the location manually.';
000745:       } else if (error?.code === 2) {
000746:         friendlyMessage = 'We could not determine your position. Please try again or enter it manually.';
000747:       } else if (error?.code === 3) {
000748:         friendlyMessage = 'Location request timed out. Please try again or enter it manually.';
000749:       }
000750: 
000751:       setLocationFeedback({
000752:         status: 'error',
000753:         message: friendlyMessage,
000754:       });
000755:     } finally {
000756:       setIsDetectingLocation(false);
000757:     }
000758:   };

001040:         const maxValue = parseInt(parseSalary(formData.salaryMax), 10);

001047:

001049:       if (!Number.isInteger(postingDurationValue) || postingDurationValue < 1 || postingDurationValue > 365) {
001050:         setError('Posting duration must be between 1 and 365 days.');
001051:         setSubmitting(false);
001052:         return;
001053:       }
001054: 
001055:       const shouldSchedulePublish = formData.status === 'PUBLISHED' && formData.publishTiming === 'scheduled';

001069:         if (scheduledDate.getTime() <= Date.now()) {

001074:         scheduledPublishAtIso = scheduledDate.toISOString();

001079:       let salaryRangeString = '';

001081:         const formattedMin = formData.salaryMin ? formatSalary(formData.salaryMin, formData.salaryCurrency) : '';
001082:         const formattedMax = formData.salaryMax ? formatSalary(formData.salaryMax, formData.salaryCurrency) : '';
001083:         if (formattedMin && formattedMax) {

001095:       const primaryAdvertImageUrl = sanitizedAdvertImageUrls[0] || null;
001096: 
001097:       // Prepare payload to match backend validation

001100:         department: formData.department || undefined,

001111:           ? (shouldSchedulePublish ? scheduledPublishAtIso : null)
001112:           : null,

001120:         // Convert requirements string to array if provided

001201:   const handleDeleteJob = async (jobId) => {
001202:     if (!confirm('Are you sure you want to delete this job?')) return;
001203: 
001204:     try {
001205:       const result = await apiClient.jobs.remove(jobId);
001206:       if (result.success) {
001207:         setError('');
001208:         await loadJobs();
001209:       }
001210:     } catch (err) {
001211:       let deleteError = err;
001212: 
001213:       if (deleteError?.code === 'JOB_MUST_BE_ARCHIVED_BEFORE_DELETE') {
001214:         const shouldArchiveFirst = confirm(
001215:           'This job must be archived before deletion.\n\n' +
001216:           'Press OK to archive it now and continue deleting.\n' +
001217:           'Press Cancel to keep the job.',
001218:         );
001219: 
001220:         if (!shouldArchiveFirst) {
001221:           setError('Deletion cancelled. Archive the job first when you are ready to remove it.');
001222:           return;
001223:         }
001224: 
001225:         try {
001226:           const archiveResult = await apiClient.jobs.update(jobId, { status: 'ARCHIVED' });
001227:           if (!archiveResult?.success) {
001228:             throw new Error(archiveResult?.error || 'Failed to archive job before deletion');
001229:           }
001230: 
001231:           const archivedDeleteResult = await apiClient.jobs.remove(jobId);
001232:           if (archivedDeleteResult.success) {
001233:             setError('');
001234:             await loadJobs();
001235:             return;
001236:           }
001237:         } catch (archiveErr) {
001238:           if (archiveErr?.code === 'ACTIVE_APPLICATIONS_REQUIRE_RESOLUTION') {
001239:             deleteError = archiveErr;
001240:           } else {
001241:             console.error('Failed to archive job before delete:', archiveErr);
001242:             setError(archiveErr.message || 'Failed to archive job before deleting');
001243:             return;
001244:           }
001245:         }
001246:       }
001247: 
001248:       if (deleteError?.code === 'ACTIVE_APPLICATIONS_REQUIRE_RESOLUTION') {
001249:         const activeApplications = deleteError?.details?.activeApplications ?? 0;
001250:         const shouldResolveAndDelete = confirm(
001251:           `This job has ${activeApplications} active application${activeApplications === 1 ? '' : 's'}.\n\n` +
001252:           'Best practice is to notify candidates and close these applications before deleting.\n\n' +
001253:           'Press OK to auto-reject active applications, notify candidates, and then delete this job.\n' +
001254:           'Press Cancel to keep the job and review candidates manually.',
001255:         );
001256: 
001257:         if (!shouldResolveAndDelete) {
001258:           setError('Deletion cancelled. You can archive the job to stop new applications while you review current candidates.');
001259:           return;
001260:         }
001261: 
001262:         try {
001263:           const optionalResolutionMessage = prompt(
001264:             'Optional message for candidates (included in closure email):',
001265:             '',
001266:           );
001267:           if (optionalResolutionMessage === null) {
001268:             setError('Deletion cancelled. No candidate message was sent.');
001269:             return;
001270:           }
001271: 
001272:           const resolvedResult = await apiClient.jobs.remove(jobId, {
001273:             resolveActiveApplications: true,
001274:             notifyCandidates: true,
001275:             resolutionMessage: optionalResolutionMessage.trim() || undefined,
001276:           });
001277: 
001278:           if (resolvedResult.success) {
001279:             setError('');
001280:             await loadJobs();
001281:           }
001282:           return;
001283:         } catch (resolveErr) {
001284:           console.error('Failed to resolve active applications before delete:', resolveErr);
001285:           setError(resolveErr.message || 'Failed to resolve applications and delete job');
001286:           return;
001287:         }
001288:       }
001289: 
001290:       console.error('Failed to delete job:', deleteError);
001291:       setError(deleteError.message || 'Failed to delete job');
001292:     }

001385:         if (jobFilters.employmentType !== 'all' && (job?.employmentType || '') !== jobFilters.employmentType) return false;
001386:         if (jobFilters.experienceLevel !== 'all' && (job?.experienceLevel || '') !== jobFilters.experienceLevel) return false;

001389:         if (jobFilters.publishState !== 'all' && publishState !== jobFilters.publishState) return false;
001390:

001392:         if (jobFilters.applicationState === 'without-applications' && applicationCount > 0) return false;
001393:

000029:   const navigate = useNavigate();
000030:   const { user, logout, isAuthenticated } = useAuth();
000031:   const [isNavCollapsed, setIsNavCollapsed] = useState(false);
000032:   const [job, setJob] = useState(null);
000033:   const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
000034:   const [error, setError] = useState('');
000035:   const [showApplicationForm, setShowApplicationForm] = useState(false);
000036:   const [applicationSuccess, setApplicationSuccess] = useState(false);
000037:   const [hasApplied, setHasApplied] = useState(false);
000038:   const [applicationStatus, setApplicationStatus] = useState(null);
000039:   const realtimeRefreshTimeoutRef = useRef(null);
000040:   const loadJobRef = useRef(null);
000041:   const checkApplicationRef = useRef(null);
000042: 
000043:   const userType = user?.accountType?.toLowerCase() === 'company' ? 'company' : 'candidate';
000044: 
000045:   const handleLogout = async () => {
000046:     await logout();
000047:     navigate('/login');
000048:   };
000049: 
000050:   const loadJob = async () => {
000051:     setLoading(true);
000052:     setError('');
000053:     try {
000054:       const result = await apiClient.jobs.getPublic(id);
000055:       if (result.success) {
000056:         setJob(result.job);
000057:       } else {
000058:         setError('Job not found');
000059:       }
000060:     } catch (err) {
000061:       setError(err.message || 'Failed to load job details');
000062:     } finally {
000063:       setLoading(false);
000064:     }
000065:   };
000066: 
000067:   const checkApplication = async () => {
000068:     if (user?.accountType?.toUpperCase() !== 'CANDIDATE') {
000069:       setHasApplied(false);
000070:       setApplicationStatus(null);
000071:       return;
000072:     }
000073:     try {
000074:       const result = await apiClient.applications.getMyApplications();
000075:       if (result.success && result.applications) {
000076:         const application = result.applications.find((app) => app.jobId === id);
000077:         if (application) {
000078:           setHasApplied(true);
000079:           setApplicationStatus(application.status);
000080:           return;
000081:         }
000082:       }
000083:       setHasApplied(false);
000084:       setApplicationStatus(null);
000085:     } catch (err) {
000086:       console.error('Failed to check application status:', err);
000087:     }
000088:   };
000089: 
000090:   useEffect(() => {
000091:     loadJobRef.current = loadJob;
000092:   }, [loadJob]);
000093: 
000094:   useEffect(() => {
000095:     checkApplicationRef.current = checkApplication;
000096:   }, [checkApplication]);
000097: 
000098:   useEffect(() => {
000099:     if (id) {
000100:       loadJob();
000101:     }
000102:     // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
000103:   }, [id]);
000104: 
000105:   useEffect(() => {
000106:     checkApplication();
000107:     // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
000108:   }, [user, id]);
000109: 
000110:   useRealtimePathFeed({
000111:     path: 'publicFeeds/jobs',
000112:     enabled: true,
000113:     eventTypes: PUBLIC_FEED_EVENTS.jobs,
000114:     onFeedUpdate: (feed, { initial }) => {
000115:       if (initial || !id) return;
000116:       const eventJobId = typeof feed?.payload?.jobId === 'string' ? feed.payload.jobId : null;
000117:       if (eventJobId && eventJobId !== id) return;
000118:       if (realtimeRefreshTimeoutRef.current) {
000119:         clearTimeout(realtimeRefreshTimeoutRef.current);
000120:       }
000121:       realtimeRefreshTimeoutRef.current = setTimeout(() => {
000122:         loadJobRef.current?.();
000123:       }, 300);
000124:     },
000125:   });
000126: 
000127:   useRealtimePathFeed({
000128:     path: user?.id ? `candidateFeeds/${user.id}` : null,
000129:     enabled: Boolean(user?.id && user?.accountType?.toUpperCase() === 'CANDIDATE'),
000130:     eventTypes: CANDIDATE_FEED_EVENTS.applications,
000131:     onFeedUpdate: (feed, { initial }) => {
000132:       if (initial) return;
000133:       const eventJobId = typeof feed?.payload?.jobId === 'string' ? feed.payload.jobId : null;
000134:       if (eventJobId && eventJobId !== id) return;
000135:       if (realtimeRefreshTimeoutRef.current) {
000136:         clearTimeout(realtimeRefreshTimeoutRef.current);
000137:       }
000138:       realtimeRefreshTimeoutRef.current = setTimeout(() => {
000139:         checkApplicationRef.current?.();
000140:       }, 300);
000141:     },
000142:   });
000143: 
000144:   useEffect(
000145:     () => () => {
000146:       if (realtimeRefreshTimeoutRef.current) {
000147:         clearTimeout(realtimeRefreshTimeoutRef.current);
000148:       }
000149:     },
000150:     [],
000151:   );

000153:   // Format helpers
000154:   const formatExperienceLevel = (level) => {
000155:     if (!level) return null;
000156:     const mapping = {
000157:       'ENTRY': 'Entry Level',
000158:       'JUNIOR': 'Junior',
000159:       'MID': 'Mid-Level',
000160:       'SENIOR': 'Senior',
000161:       'LEAD': 'Lead',
000162:       'PRINCIPAL': 'Principal',
000163:       'EXECUTIVE': 'Executive'
000164:     };
000165:     return mapping[level] || level.charAt(0) + level.slice(1).toLowerCase();
000166:   };
000167: 
000168:   const formatEmploymentType = (type) => {
000169:     if (!type) return null;
000170:     const mapping = {
000171:       'FULL_TIME': 'Full-time',
000172:       'PART_TIME': 'Part-time',
000173:       'CONTRACT': 'Contract',
000174:       'INTERNSHIP': 'Internship',
000175:     };
000176:     return mapping[type] || type.replace('_', '-').replace(/\b\w/g, l => l.toUpperCase());
000177:   };
000178: 
000179:   const getDaysLeft = (job) => {
000180:     if (!job) return null;
000181:     
000182:     // If expiresAt is available, use it directly
000183:     if (job.expiresAt) {
000184:       const expires = new Date(job.expiresAt);
000185:       const now = new Date();
000186:       const daysLeft = Math.ceil((expires - now) / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24));
000187:       if (daysLeft <= 0) return null;
000188:       return daysLeft;
000189:     }
000190:     
000191:     // Fallback: calculate from publishedAt + postingDuration
000192:     if (job.publishedAt) {
000193:       const published = new Date(job.publishedAt);
000194:       const now = new Date();
000195:       const postingDuration = job.postingDuration || 30;
000196:       const daysSincePublished = Math.floor((now - published) / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24));
000197:       const daysLeft = postingDuration - daysSincePublished;
000198:       if (daysLeft <= 0) return null;
000199:       return daysLeft;
000200:     }
000201:     
000202:     return null;
000203:   };
000204: 
000205:   const formatCompanySize = (size) => {
000206:     if (!size) return null;
000207:     const mapping = {
000208:       '1-10': '1-10 employees',
000209:       '11-50': '11-50 employees',
000210:       '51-200': '51-200 employees',
000211:       '201-1000': '201-1K employees',
000212:       '1000+': '1K+ employees',
000213:     };
000214:     return mapping[size] || size;
000215:   };
000216: 
000217:   const extractCityFromLocation = (location) => {
000218:     if (!location) return null;
000219:     // Extract city from "City, Region" or just "City" format
000220:     const parts = location.split(',');
000221:     return parts[0]?.trim() || location.trim();
000222:   };
000223: 
000224:   const handleApply = () => {

000226:       alert('Only candidates can apply to jobs.');
000227:       return;
000228:     }

000230:   };
000231: 
000232:   const handleApplicationSuccess = () => {

000234:     setApplicationSuccess(true);
000235:     setHasApplied(true);
000236:     setApplicationStatus('SUBMITTED');
000237:     setTimeout(() => setApplicationSuccess(false), 5000);
000238:   };
000239: 
000240:   const handlePractice = () => {
000241:     if (job) {
000242:       try {
000243:         const draft = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('interviewSetupDraft') || '{}');
000244:         localStorage.setItem(
000245:           'interviewSetupDraft',
000246:           JSON.stringify({
000247:             ...draft,
000248:             jobRole: job.title,
000249:             industry: job.department || draft.industry,
000250:           }),
000251:         );
000252:       } catch {
000253:         // ignore
000254:       }
000255:     }
000256:     navigate('/practice-interview-setup');
000257:   };
000258: 
000259:   const handleShare = (platform) => {
000260:     const jobUrl = window.location.href;
000261:     const shareText = `Check out this job: ${job?.title} at ${job?.organization?.name || 'Company'}`;
000262:     
000263:     let shareUrl = '';
000264:     switch (platform) {
000265:       case 'whatsapp':
000266:         shareUrl = `https://wa.me/?text=${encodeURIComponent(shareText + ' ' + jobUrl)}`;
000267:         break;
000268:       case 'facebook':
000269:         shareUrl = `https://www.facebook.com/sharer/sharer.php?u=${encodeURIComponent(jobUrl)}`;
000270:         break;
000271:       case 'twitter':
000272:         shareUrl = `https://twitter.com/intent/tweet?text=${encodeURIComponent(shareText)}&url=${encodeURIComponent(jobUrl)}`;
000273:         break;
000274:       case 'linkedin':
000275:         shareUrl = `https://www.linkedin.com/sharing/share-offsite/?url=${encodeURIComponent(jobUrl)}`;
000276:         break;
000277:       default:
000278:         if (navigator.share) {
000279:           navigator.share({ title: job?.title, text: shareText, url: jobUrl });
000280:           return;
000281:         } else {
000282:           navigator.clipboard.writeText(jobUrl);
000283:           alert('Job URL copied to clipboard!');
000284:           return;
000285:         }
000286:     }
000287:     
000288:     if (shareUrl) {
000289:       window.open(shareUrl, '_blank', 'width=600,height=400');
000290:     }
000291:   };
000292: 
000293:   const daysLeft = job ? getDaysLeft(job) : null;
000294:   const advertImageUrls = (Array.isArray(job?.advertImageUrls) ? job.advertImageUrls : (job?.advertImageUrl ? [job.advertImageUrl] : []))
000295:     .map((url) => getAssetUrl(url))
000296:     .filter(Boolean);
000297:   const advertVideoUrl = getAssetUrl(job?.advertVideoUrl);
000298: 
000299:   return (

000304:         <div className="absolute bottom-0 left-[-10%] h-[300px] w-[300px] sm:h-[420px] sm:w-[420px] bg-gradient-to-tr from-indigo-300/25 via-blue-200/20 to-transparent blur-[120px]" />
000305:       </div>

000357:                   >

000497:                                 </svg>

000096:     if (from && !Number.isNaN(from.getTime())) from.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
000097:     if (to && !Number.isNaN(to.getTime())) to.setHours(23, 59, 59, 999);
000098:     return {
000099:       from: from && !Number.isNaN(from.getTime()) ? from : null,
000100:       to: to && !Number.isNaN(to.getTime()) ? to : null,
000101:     };
000102:   }
000103: 
000104:   const from = new Date(now);
000105:   if (preset === 'last7') from.setDate(from.getDate() - 7);
000106:   if (preset === 'last30') from.setDate(from.getDate() - 30);
000107:   if (preset === 'last90') from.setDate(from.getDate() - 90);
000108:   from.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
000109:   return { from, to: null };
000110: };
000111: 
000112: const countActiveJobFilters = (filters = {}) => {
000113:   let count = 0;
000114:   if (normalizeText(filters.searchQuery)) count += 1;
000115:   if ((filters.bookmarkFilter || 'all') !== 'all') count += 1;
000116:   if ((filters.applicationFilter || 'all') !== 'all') count += 1;
000117:   if ((filters.employmentType || 'all') !== 'all') count += 1;
000118:   if ((filters.experienceLevel || 'all') !== 'all') count += 1;
000119:   if ((filters.department || 'all') !== 'all') count += 1;
000120:   if ((filters.locationMode || 'all') !== 'all') count += 1;
000121:   if ((filters.datePreset || 'all') !== 'all') count += 1;
000122:   if ((filters.deadlineWindow || 'all') !== 'all') count += 1;
000123:   if ((filters.sortBy || 'newest') !== 'newest') count += 1;
000124:   return count;
000125: };

000127: // Helper function to convert relative upload paths to absolute URLs
000128: const getAssetUrl = (assetPath) => {
000129:   if (!assetPath) return null;
000130:   if (assetPath.startsWith('http://') || assetPath.startsWith('https://') || assetPath.startsWith('blob:') || assetPath.startsWith('data:')) {
000131:     return assetPath;
000132:   }
000133:   // Convert relative path to absolute URL
000134:   const base = API_URL.replace(/\/$/, '');
000135:   return `${base}${assetPath.startsWith('/') ? assetPath : `/${assetPath}`}`;
000136: };

000138: const parseBookmarkIds = (raw) => {
000139:   if (!raw) return [];
000140:   try {
000141:     const parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
000142:     if (!Array.isArray(parsed)) return [];
000143:     return parsed
000144:       .map((id) => String(id || '').trim())
000145:       .filter(Boolean);
000146:   } catch {
000147:     return [];
000148:   }
000149: };

000363:   // Check if location should be shown as Remote (only when no location was provided)

000367:     // If location is not a string, show Remote
000368:     if (typeof location !== 'string') return true;

000380:   // Calculate days left for application based on expiresAt or publishedAt + postingDuration
000381:   const getDaysLeft = (job) => {
000382:     if (!job) return null;
000383:     
000384:     // If expiresAt is available, use it directly
000385:     if (job.expiresAt) {
000386:       const expires = new Date(job.expiresAt);
000387:       const now = new Date();
000388:       const daysLeft = Math.ceil((expires - now) / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24));
000389:       if (daysLeft <= 0) return null;
000390:       return daysLeft;
000391:     }
000392:     
000393:     // Fallback: calculate from publishedAt + postingDuration
000394:     if (job.publishedAt) {
000395:       const published = new Date(job.publishedAt);
000396:       const now = new Date();
000397:       const postingDuration = job.postingDuration || 30;
000398:       const daysSincePublished = Math.floor((now - published) / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24));
000399:       const daysLeft = postingDuration - daysSincePublished;
000400:       if (daysLeft <= 0) return null;
000401:       return daysLeft;
000402:     }
000403:     
000404:     return null;
000405:   };

000518:   const activeFilterCount = countActiveJobFilters(filters);
000519:   const normalizedQuery = normalizeText(filters.searchQuery);
000520:   const queryTokens = normalizedQuery.split(' ').filter(Boolean);
000521:   const dateWindow = getDateWindow(filters);
000522:   const filteredJobs = jobs
000523:     .filter((job) => {
000524:       const isSaved = bookmarkedJobIds.has(job.id);
000525:       const applicationInfo = applicationsByJobId.get(job.id);
000526:       const isWithdrawn = applicationInfo?.status === 'REJECTED' && Boolean(applicationInfo?.withdrawnBy);
000527:       const isRejected = applicationInfo?.status === 'REJECTED' && !applicationInfo?.withdrawnBy;
000528:       const isApplied = Boolean(applicationInfo) && !isWithdrawn && !isRejected;
000529:       const canReapply = isWithdrawn;
000530:       const locationLabel = getDisplayLocation(job?.location);
000531:       const normalizedLocation = normalizeText(locationLabel);
000532:       const locationMode = normalizedLocation.includes('remote')
000533:         ? 'remote'
000534:         : normalizedLocation.includes('hybrid')
000535:           ? 'hybrid'
000536:           : 'onsite';
000537:       const postedAtValue = job?.publishedAt || job?.createdAt || null;
000538:       const postedAt = postedAtValue ? new Date(postedAtValue) : null;
000539:       const hasValidPostedAt = postedAt && !Number.isNaN(postedAt.getTime());
000540:       const daysLeft = getDaysLeft(job);
000541: 
000542:       if (filters.bookmarkFilter === 'saved' && !isSaved) return false;
000543:       if (filters.bookmarkFilter === 'unsaved' && isSaved) return false;
000544: 
000545:       if (filters.applicationFilter === 'not-applied' && applicationInfo) return false;
000546:       if (filters.applicationFilter === 'applied' && !isApplied) return false;
000547:       if (filters.applicationFilter === 'withdrawn' && !isWithdrawn) return false;
000548:       if (filters.applicationFilter === 'not-selected' && !isRejected) return false;
000549:       if (filters.applicationFilter === 'can-reapply' && !canReapply) return false;
000550: 
000551:       if (filters.employmentType !== 'all' && (job?.employmentType || '') !== filters.employmentType) return false;
000552:       if (filters.experienceLevel !== 'all' && (job?.experienceLevel || '') !== filters.experienceLevel) return false;
000553:       if (filters.department !== 'all' && (job?.department || '') !== filters.department) return false;
000554:       if (filters.locationMode !== 'all' && locationMode !== filters.locationMode) return false;
000555: 
000556:       if (filters.deadlineWindow === '7' && !(Number.isFinite(daysLeft) && daysLeft <= 7)) return false;
000557:       if (filters.deadlineWindow === '30' && !(Number.isFinite(daysLeft) && daysLeft <= 30)) return false;
000558:       if (filters.deadlineWindow === 'none' && Number.isFinite(daysLeft)) return false;
000559: 
000560:       if (dateWindow.from || dateWindow.to) {
000561:         if (!hasValidPostedAt) return false;
000562:         if (dateWindow.from && postedAt < dateWindow.from) return false;
000563:         if (dateWindow.to && postedAt > dateWindow.to) return false;
000564:       }
000565: 
000566:       if (queryTokens.length) {
000567:         const searchableText = [
000568:           job?.title || '',
000569:           job?.organization?.name || '',
000570:           job?.department || '',
000571:           locationLabel,
000572:           job?.description || '',
000573:           job?.employmentType || '',
000574:           job?.experienceLevel || '',
000575:           ...(Array.isArray(job?.skills) ? job.skills : []),
000576:         ]
000577:           .join(' ')
000578:           .toLowerCase();
000579: 
000580:         if (!queryTokens.every((token) => searchableText.includes(token))) return false;
000581:       }
000582: 
000583:       return true;
000584:     })
000585:     .sort((left, right) => {
000586:       const leftPosted = new Date(left?.publishedAt || left?.createdAt || 0).getTime() || 0;
000587:       const rightPosted = new Date(right?.publishedAt || right?.createdAt || 0).getTime() || 0;
000588: 
000589:       switch (filters.sortBy) {
000590:         case 'oldest':
000591:           return leftPosted - rightPosted;
000592:         case 'closingSoon': {
000593:           const leftDays = getDaysLeft(left);
000594:           const rightDays = getDaysLeft(right);
000595:           if (!Number.isFinite(leftDays) && !Number.isFinite(rightDays)) return rightPosted - leftPosted;
000596:           if (!Number.isFinite(leftDays)) return 1;
000597:           if (!Number.isFinite(rightDays)) return -1;
000598:           return leftDays - rightDays;
000599:         }
000600:         case 'titleAsc':
000601:           return (left?.title || '').localeCompare(right?.title || '');
000602:         case 'companyAsc':
000603:           return (left?.organization?.name || '').localeCompare(right?.organization?.name || '');
000604:         case 'newest':
000605:         default:
000606:           return rightPosted - leftPosted;
000607:       }
000608:     });
000609: 
000610:   const totalPages = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(filteredJobs.length / jobsPerPage));
000611:   const startIndex = (currentPage - 1) * jobsPerPage;
000612:   const endIndex = startIndex + jobsPerPage;
000613:   const paginatedJobs = filteredJobs.slice(startIndex, endIndex);
000614:   const bookmarkedCount = jobs.filter((job) => bookmarkedJobIds.has(job.id)).length;
000615: 
000616:   useEffect(() => {
000617:     setCurrentPage(1);
000618:   }, [filters]);
000619: 
000620:   useEffect(() => {
000621:     if (currentPage > totalPages) {
000622:       setCurrentPage(totalPages);
000623:     }
000624:   }, [currentPage, totalPages]);
000625: 
000626:   return (
000627:     <div className="relative min-h-screen bg-gradient-to-b from-blue-50 via-white to-purple-50 dark:from-slate-900 dark:via-slate-900 dark:to-slate-950 transition-colors duration-300">
000628:       <div

000631:       >

000633:         <div className="absolute bottom-0 left-[-10%] h-[300px] w-[300px] sm:h-[420px] sm:w-[420px] bg-gradient-to-tr from-indigo-300/25 via-blue-200/20 to-transparent blur-[120px]" />
000634:         <div className="absolute inset-0 opacity-50 bg-[radial-gradient(circle_at_20%_20%,rgba(59,130,246,0.12),transparent_45%),radial-gradient(circle_at_80%_0%,rgba(147,51,234,0.12),transparent_40%)]" />
000635:       </div>

000640:       <div className="h-14 xs:h-16" />

000001: /**
000002:  * Recording Consent Screen

000005:  * Aligns with FR2: Consent and user controls for recorded text/audio/video.

000008: 
000009: import React, { useState } from 'react';

000014: 
000015: const RECORDING_CONSENT_VERSION = '1.0';
000016: 
000017: const RecordingConsentScreen = ({ onConsentGiven }) => {
000018:   const [consentRecording, setConsentRecording] = useState(false);
000019:   const [consentPrivacy, setConsentPrivacy] = useState(false);
000020:   const [isSubmitting, setIsSubmitting] = useState(false);

000022:   const canContinue = consentRecording && !isSubmitting;

000043:       exit={{ opacity: 0 }}
000044:       transition={{ duration: 0.3 }}

000046:     >

000050:         transition={{ duration: 0.35, ease: 'easeOut' }}
000051:         className="w-full max-w-lg rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 shadow-xl dark:shadow-slate-950/50 overflow-hidden"

000198:     const loadInterviewConfig = async () => {
000199:       try {
000200:         // Load interview configuration from localStorage
000201:         const configStr = localStorage.getItem('interviewConfig');
000202:         const config = configStr ? JSON.parse(configStr) : {
000203:           jobRole: 'Software Engineer',
000204:           company: 'Tech Company',
000205:           experienceLevel: 'Mid-level',
000206:           industry: 'Technology',
000207:           totalQuestions: 10
000208:         };
000209: 
000210:         // Add interviewId to config if available from URL
000211:         const idFromUrl = interviewId.current;
000212:         if (isBackendInterviewId(idFromUrl)) {
000213:           config.interviewId = idFromUrl;
000214:         }
000215: 
000216:         // Initialize the AI interviewer
000217:         await initializeInterview(config);
000218:         
000219:         // Update session state with AI config
000220:         setSessionState(prev => ({
000221:           ...prev,
000222:           totalQuestions: config.totalQuestions || 10
000223:         }));
000224:       } catch (error) {
000225:         console.error('Failed to initialize AI interviewer:', error);
000226:       }

000229:     loadInterviewConfig();
000230:   }, []);

000232:   // Realtime interview lifecycle synchronization for backend interviews.
000233:   useEffect(() => {
000234:     if (!realtimeDb || !isBackendInterviewId(interviewId.current)) {
000235:       return undefined;
000236:     }
000237: 
000238:     const lastEventRef = realtimeRef(realtimeDb, `sessions/${interviewId.current}/lastEvent`);
000239:     const unsubscribe = onValue(
000240:       lastEventRef,
000241:       (snapshot) => {
000242:         const event = snapshot.val();
000243:         if (!event || !event.eventType) return;
000244: 
000245:         const eventKey = `${event.eventType}:${event.timestamp || ''}`;
000246:         if (lastRealtimeEventRef.current === eventKey) {
000247:           return;
000248:         }
000249:         lastRealtimeEventRef.current = eventKey;
000250: 
000251:         if (event.eventType === 'interview-started') {
000252:           setSessionState((prev) => ({
000253:             ...prev,
000254:             isActive: true,
000255:             isPaused: false,
000256:           }));
000257:           return;
000258:         }
000259: 
000260:         if (event.eventType === 'question-asked') {
000261:           setSessionState((prev) => ({
000262:             ...prev,
000263:             currentQuestion: Math.min(
000264:               (prev?.currentQuestion || 0) + 1,
000265:               prev?.totalQuestions || (prev?.currentQuestion || 0) + 1,
000266:             ),
000267:           }));
000268:           return;
000269:         }
000270: 
000271:         if (event.eventType === 'interview-ended') {
000272:           setSessionState((prev) => (
000273:             prev?.isActive ? { ...prev, isActive: false, isPaused: false } : prev
000274:           ));
000275:         }
000276:       },
000277:       () => {
000278:         // Fail open if realtime session updates are unavailable.
000279:       },
000280:     );
000281: 
000282:     return () => {
000283:       if (typeof unsubscribe === 'function') {
000284:         unsubscribe();
000285:       }
000286:     };
000287:   }, [user?.id]);

000297:         }));
000298:       }, 1000);
000299:     }
000300:     return () => clearInterval(interval);
000301:   }, [sessionState?.isActive, sessionState?.isPaused]);

000093:

000120:       microphoneStatus = stream?.getAudioTracks()?.length ? 'success' : 'error';
000121:       stream?.getTracks()?.forEach(track => track?.stop());
000122:     } catch {

000001: import React from 'react';

000018:         icon: 'CheckCircle'
000019:       };
000020:     } else {

000022:         matches: false,
000023:         label: 'Passwords Do Not Match',
000024:         color: 'text-error',
000025:         bgColor: 'bg-error',
000026:         icon: 'XCircle'
000027:       };
000028:     }
000029:   };
000030:

000032:

000044:         <span className={`text-xs ${status?.color}`}>

000001: import React from 'react';
000002: import Icon from '../../../components/AppIcon';
000003: import { getPasswordChecks, PASSWORD_REQUIREMENTS } from '../../../utils/passwordValidation';
000004: 
000005: const PasswordStrengthIndicator = ({ password, className = '' }) => {
000006:   const getPasswordStrength = (pwd) => {
000007:     if (!pwd) return { score: 0, label: '', color: '', checks: {} };
000008: 
000009:     const checks = getPasswordChecks(pwd);
000010:     const score = Object.values(checks).filter(Boolean)?.length;
000011:     
000012:     const strengthLevels = {
000013:       0: { label: '', color: '', bgColor: '' },
000014:       1: { label: 'Very Weak', color: 'text-error', bgColor: 'bg-error' },
000015:       2: { label: 'Weak', color: 'text-warning', bgColor: 'bg-warning' },
000016:       3: { label: 'Fair', color: 'text-accent', bgColor: 'bg-accent' },
000017:       4: { label: 'Good', color: 'text-success', bgColor: 'bg-success' },
000018:       5: { label: 'Strong', color: 'text-success', bgColor: 'bg-success' }
000019:     };
000020:     
000021:     return { score, checks, ...strengthLevels?.[score] };
000022:   };
000023: 
000024:   const strength = getPasswordStrength(password);
000025: 
000026:   if (!password) return null;
000027: 
000028:   return (
000029:     <div className={`space-y-3 ${className}`}>
000030:       {/* Strength Bar */}
000031:       <div className="space-y-2">
000032:         <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
000033:           <span className="text-sm font-medium text-foreground">Password Strength</span>
000034:           <span className={`text-sm font-medium ${strength?.color}`}>
000035:             {strength?.label}
000036:           </span>
000037:         </div>
000038:         
000039:         <div className="flex space-x-1">
000040:           {[1, 2, 3, 4, 5]?.map((level) => (
000041:             <div
000042:               key={level}
000043:               className={`h-2 flex-1 rounded-full transition-colors duration-200 ${
000044:                 level <= strength?.score ? strength?.bgColor : 'bg-muted'
000045:               }`}
000046:             />
000047:           ))}
000048:         </div>
000049:       </div>
000050:       {/* Requirements Checklist */}
000051:       <div className="space-y-2">
000052:         <span className="text-sm font-medium text-foreground">Requirements:</span>
000053:         <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-2">
000054:           {PASSWORD_REQUIREMENTS?.map((requirement) => (
000055:             <div
000056:               key={requirement?.key}
000057:               className="flex items-center space-x-2"
000058:             >
000059:               <Icon
000060:                 name={strength?.checks?.[requirement?.key] ? "CheckCircle" : "XCircle"}
000061:                 size={16}
000062:                 className={strength?.checks?.[requirement?.key] ? 'text-success' : 'text-error'}
000063:               />
000064:               <span className={`text-xs ${
000065:                 strength?.checks?.[requirement?.key] ? 'text-success' : 'text-error'
000066:               }`}>
000067:                 {requirement?.label}
000068:               </span>
000069:             </div>
000070:           ))}
000071:         </div>
000072:       </div>
000073:     </div>
000074:   );
000075: };
000076: 
000077: export default PasswordStrengthIndicator;

000969:   const handleDetectLocation = async (fieldKey) => {
000970:     if (isDetectingLocation || !fieldKey) {
000971:       return;
000972:     }
000973: 
000974:     if (typeof window === 'undefined' || !navigator?.geolocation) {
000975:       setLocationHelper({
000976:         targetField: fieldKey,
000977:         status: 'error',
000978:         message: 'Your browser does not support location detection. Please enter it manually.',
000979:       });
000980:       return;
000981:     }
000982: 
000983:     setIsDetectingLocation(true);
000984:     setLocationHelper({
000985:       targetField: fieldKey,
000986:       status: 'info',
000987:       message: 'Requesting location permissionâ€¦',
000988:     });
000989: 
000990:     try {
000991:       const position = await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
000992:         navigator.geolocation.getCurrentPosition(resolve, reject, {
000993:           enableHighAccuracy: true,
000994:           timeout: 10000,
000995:           maximumAge: 0,
000996:         });
000997:       });
000998: 
000999:       setLocationHelper({
001000:         targetField: fieldKey,
001001:         status: 'info',
001002:         message: 'Detecting your cityâ€¦',
001003:       });
001004: 
001005:       const { latitude, longitude } = position.coords || {};
001006: 
001007:       if (latitude == null || longitude == null) {
001008:         throw new Error('We could not read your coordinates. Please enter your location manually.');
001009:       }
001010: 
001011:       const response = await fetch(
001012:         `https://api.bigdatacloud.net/data/reverse-geocode-client?latitude=${latitude}&longitude=${longitude}&localityLanguage=en`
001013:       );
001014: 
001015:       if (!response.ok) {
001016:         throw new Error('Unable to determine your location automatically.');
001017:       }
001018: 
001019:       const data = await response.json();
001020:       const formattedLocation = formatDetectedLocation(data, { latitude, longitude });
001021: 
001022:       if (!formattedLocation) {
001023:         throw new Error('We couldnâ€™t convert your coordinates into a city. Please enter it manually.');
001024:       }
001025: 
001026:       handleFieldChange(fieldKey, formattedLocation);
001027: 
001028:       // Clear location helper on success - location is visible in the input field
001029:       setLocationHelper({ targetField: null, status: 'idle', message: '' });
001030:     } catch (error) {
001031:       console.error('Location detection error:', error);
001032: 
001033:       let friendlyMessage = error?.message || 'Unable to detect your location. Please enter it manually.';
001034: 
001035:       if (error?.code === 1 || error?.message?.toLowerCase().includes('permission')) {
001036:         friendlyMessage = 'Location permission was denied. You can enable it in your browser or enter the location manually.';
001037:       } else if (error?.code === 2) {
001038:         friendlyMessage = 'We could not determine your position. Please try again or enter it manually.';
001039:       } else if (error?.code === 3) {
001040:         friendlyMessage = 'Location request timed out. Please try again or enter it manually.';
001041:       }
001042: 
001043:       setLocationHelper({
001044:         targetField: fieldKey,
001045:         status: 'error',
001046:         message: friendlyMessage,
001047:       });
001048:     } finally {
001049:       setIsDetectingLocation(false);
001050:     }
001051:   };

000001: /**
000002:  * LLM Data Aggregator Component
000003:  * 
000004:  * Combines interview data from multiple sources for LLM training.
000005:  * Features:
000006:  * - Import data from various formats (JSON, CSV, JSONL)
000007:  * - Manual Q&A entry
000008:  * - Data validation and quality scoring
000009:  * - Convert to training format (JSONL)
000010:  * - Export combined dataset
000011:  */
000012: 
000013: import React, { useState, useCallback, useEffect } from 'react';
000014: import { motion } from 'framer-motion';
000015: import Icon from '../../../components/AppIcon';
000016: import Button from '../../../components/ui/Button';
000017: import { useToast } from '../../../components/ui/Toast';
000018: 
000019: const STORAGE_KEY = 'research_llm_aggregated_data';
000020: 
000021: const LLMDataAggregator = () => {
000022:   const toast = useToast();
000023:   const [dataSources, setDataSources] = useState([]);
000024:   const [manualEntry, setManualEntry] = useState({
000025:     question: '',
000026:     answer: '',
000027:     jobRole: '',
000028:     category: 'behavioral',
000029:   });
000030:   const [importFormat, setImportFormat] = useState('json');
000031:   const [systemPrompt, setSystemPrompt] = useState(
000032:     'You are an experienced interviewer conducting a professional job interview. Ask relevant questions, provide follow-ups, and assess the candidate\'s responses thoughtfully.'
000033:   );
000034: 
000035:   // Load saved data
000036:   useEffect(() => {
000037:     const saved = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY);
000038:     if (saved) {
000039:       try {
000040:         setDataSources(JSON.parse(saved));
000041:       } catch (e) {
000042:         console.error('Failed to load aggregated data:', e);
000043:       }
000044:     }
000045:   }, []);
000046: 
000047:   // Save data
000048:   const saveData = useCallback((data) => {
000049:     setDataSources(data);
000050:     localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(data));
000051:     
000052:     // Update stats
000053:     const totalQA = data.reduce((sum, source) => sum + source.entries.length, 0);
000054:     localStorage.setItem('research_qa_count', totalQA.toString());
000055:     localStorage.setItem('research_sources_count', data.length.toString());
000056:   }, []);
000057: 
000058:   // Handle file import
000059:   const handleFileImport = useCallback(async (event) => {
000060:     const file = event.target.files[0];
000061:     if (!file) return;
000062: 
000063:     try {
000064:       const text = await file.text();
000065:       let entries = [];
000066: 
000067:       if (importFormat === 'json') {
000068:         const data = JSON.parse(text);
000069:         // Handle various JSON structures
000070:         if (Array.isArray(data)) {
000071:           entries = data.map(normalizeEntry);
000072:         } else if (data.entries) {
000073:           entries = data.entries.map(normalizeEntry);
000074:         } else if (data.messages) {
000075:           entries = [normalizeEntry(data)];
000076:         }
000077:       } else if (importFormat === 'jsonl') {
000078:         const lines = text.split('\n').filter(line => line.trim());
000079:         entries = lines.map(line => {
000080:           try {
000081:             return normalizeEntry(JSON.parse(line));
000082:           } catch {
000083:             return null;
000084:           }
000085:         }).filter(Boolean);
000086:       } else if (importFormat === 'csv') {
000087:         entries = parseCSV(text);
000088:       }
000089: 
000090:       if (entries.length === 0) {
000091:         toast.warning('No valid entries found in file');
000092:         return;
000093:       }
000094: 
000095:       const source = {
000096:         id: Date.now().toString(),
000097:         name: file.name,
000098:         type: importFormat,
000099:         importedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
000100:         entries,
000101:       };
000102: 
000103:       saveData([...dataSources, source]);
000104:       toast.success(`Imported ${entries.length} entries from ${file.name}`);
000105:     } catch (error) {
000106:       console.error('Import error:', error);
000107:       toast.error('Failed to import file: ' + error.message);
000108:     }
000109: 
000110:     event.target.value = '';
000111:   }, [importFormat, dataSources, saveData, toast]);
000112: 
000113:   // Normalize entry to standard format
000114:   const normalizeEntry = (entry) => {
000115:     // Handle different formats
000116:     if (entry.messages) {
000117:       // OpenAI format
000118:       const userMsg = entry.messages.find(m => m.role === 'user');
000119:       const assistantMsg = entry.messages.find(m => m.role === 'assistant');
000120:       return {
000121:         question: userMsg?.content || '',
000122:         answer: assistantMsg?.content || '',
000123:         metadata: entry.metadata || {},
000124:       };
000125:     }
000126:     
000127:     if (entry.question || entry.input) {
000128:       return {
000129:         question: entry.question || entry.input || '',
000130:         answer: entry.answer || entry.response || entry.output || '',
000131:         metadata: {
000132:           jobRole: entry.jobRole || entry.role || entry.job_role || '',
000133:           category: entry.category || entry.type || 'general',
000134:           source: entry.source || '',
000135:         },
000136:       };
000137:     }
000138: 
000139:     return {
000140:       question: String(entry.q || entry.Q || ''),
000141:       answer: String(entry.a || entry.A || ''),
000142:       metadata: {},
000143:     };
000144:   };
000145: 
000146:   // Parse CSV
000147:   const parseCSV = (text) => {
000148:     const lines = text.split('\n');
000149:     const headers = lines[0].split(',').map(h => h.trim().toLowerCase());
000150:     
000151:     const questionIdx = headers.findIndex(h => 
000152:       h.includes('question') || h.includes('input') || h === 'q'

000154:     const answerIdx = headers.findIndex(h => 
000155:       h.includes('answer') || h.includes('response') || h.includes('output') || h === 'a'

000182:         result.push(current.trim());
000183:         current = '';

000187:     }
