000167:             landmarks: landmarks.map(l => ({ x: l.x, y: l.y, z: l.z, visibility: l.visibility })),
000168:           };
000169:         }
000170:       }
000171:     }
000172: 
000173:     // Face detection
000174:     if (faceLandmarker) {
000175:       const faceResults = faceLandmarker.detectForVideo(video, timestamp);
000176:       if (faceResults.faceLandmarks && faceResults.faceLandmarks.length > 0) {
000177:         const landmarks = faceResults.faceLandmarks[0];
000178:         
000179:         // Eye Aspect Ratio
000180:         const leftEAR = calculateEAR(
000181:           landmarks[FACE_LANDMARKS.LEFT_EYE_TOP],
000182:           landmarks[FACE_LANDMARKS.LEFT_EYE_BOTTOM],
000183:           landmarks[FACE_LANDMARKS.LEFT_EYE_LEFT],
000184:           landmarks[FACE_LANDMARKS.LEFT_EYE_RIGHT]
000185:         );
000186:         
000187:         const rightEAR = calculateEAR(
000188:           landmarks[FACE_LANDMARKS.RIGHT_EYE_TOP],
000189:           landmarks[FACE_LANDMARKS.RIGHT_EYE_BOTTOM],
000190:           landmarks[FACE_LANDMARKS.RIGHT_EYE_LEFT],
000191:           landmarks[FACE_LANDMARKS.RIGHT_EYE_RIGHT]
000192:         );
000193:         
000194:         const avgEAR = (leftEAR + rightEAR) / 2;
000195:         
000196:         // Mouth Aspect Ratio
000197:         const mar = calculateMAR(
000198:           landmarks[FACE_LANDMARKS.UPPER_LIP],
000199:           landmarks[FACE_LANDMARKS.LOWER_LIP],
000200:           landmarks[FACE_LANDMARKS.LIPS_OUTER[0]],
000201:           landmarks[FACE_LANDMARKS.LIPS_OUTER[10]]
000202:         );
000203:         
000204:         // Face orientation
000205:         const orientation = calculateFaceOrientation(
000206:           landmarks[FACE_LANDMARKS.NOSE_TIP],
000207:           landmarks[FACE_LANDMARKS.LEFT_EYE_LEFT],
000208:           landmarks[FACE_LANDMARKS.RIGHT_EYE_RIGHT],
000209:           landmarks[FACE_LANDMARKS.CHIN]
000210:         );
000211: 
000212:         metrics.face = {
000213:           leftEAR,
000214:           rightEAR,
000215:           avgEAR,
000216:           mar,
000217:           yaw: orientation.yaw,
000218:           pitch: orientation.pitch,
000219:           roll: orientation.roll,
000220:           blendshapes: faceResults.faceBlendshapes?.[0] || null,
000221:         };
000222:       }
000223:     }
000224: 
000225:     return metrics;
000226:   }, [poseLandmarker, faceLandmarker]);

000228:   // Analyze video
000229:   const analyzeVideo = useCallback(async (recording) => {
000230:     if (!isInitialized) {
000231:       toast.warning('Please initialize MediaPipe first');
000232:       return;
000233:     }
000234: 
000235:     setIsAnalyzing(true);
000236:     setProgress(0);
000237:     setSelectedRecording(recording);
000238: 
000239:     try {
000240:       const blob = await loadVideoBlob(recording.id);
000241:       const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
000242:       
000243:       const video = videoRef.current;
000244:       video.src = url;
000245:       
000246:       await new Promise((resolve) => {
000247:         video.onloadedmetadata = resolve;
000248:       });
000249: 
000250:       const duration = video.duration;
000251:       const fps = 10; // Analyze 10 frames per second
000252:       const frameInterval = 1000 / fps;
000253:       const totalFrames = Math.floor(duration * fps);
000254:       
000255:       const frameMetrics = [];
000256:       
000257:       for (let i = 0; i < totalFrames; i++) {
000258:         const currentTime = i / fps;
000259:         video.currentTime = currentTime;
000260:         
000261:         await new Promise((resolve) => {
000262:           video.onseeked = resolve;
000263:         });
000264:         
000265:         const timestamp = Math.floor(currentTime * 1000);
000266:         const metrics = analyzeFrame(video, timestamp);
000267:         frameMetrics.push(metrics);
000268:         
000269:         setProgress(Math.round((i / totalFrames) * 100));
000270:       }
000271: 
000272:       // Calculate statistics
000273:       const analysis = calculateStatistics(frameMetrics, recording);
000274:       setCurrentAnalysis(analysis);
000275:       
000276:       // Save results
000277:       const newResults = [...analysisResults.filter(r => r.recordingId !== recording.id), analysis];
000278:       setAnalysisResults(newResults);
000279:       localStorage.setItem('research_analysis_results', JSON.stringify(newResults));
000280:       localStorage.setItem('research_analysis_count', newResults.length.toString());
000281:       
000282:       URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
000283:       toast.success('Analysis complete!');
000284:     } catch (error) {
000285:       console.error('Analysis error:', error);
000286:       toast.error('Failed to analyze video: ' + error.message);
000287:     } finally {
000288:       setIsAnalyzing(false);
000289:       setProgress(100);
000290:     }
000291:   }, [isInitialized, analyzeFrame, analysisResults, toast]);
000292: 
000293:   // Calculate statistics from frame metrics
000294:   const calculateStatistics = (frameMetrics, recording) => {
000295:     const validPoseFrames = frameMetrics.filter(f => f.pose);
000296:     const validFaceFrames = frameMetrics.filter(f => f.face);
000297: 
000298:     const stats = {
000299:       recordingId: recording.id,
000300:       category: recording.category,
000301:       quality: recording.quality,
000302:       description: recording.description,
000303:       analyzedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
000304:       totalFrames: frameMetrics.length,
000305:       validPoseFrames: validPoseFrames.length,
000306:       validFaceFrames: validFaceFrames.length,
000307:       pose: {},
000308:       face: {},
000309:     };
000310: 
000311:     // Pose statistics
000312:     if (validPoseFrames.length > 0) {
000313:       const shoulderSlopes = validPoseFrames.map(f => f.pose.shoulderSlope);
000314:       const headTilts = validPoseFrames.map(f => f.pose.headTilt);
000315:       const headForwards = validPoseFrames.map(f => f.pose.headForward);
000316: 
000317:       stats.pose = {
000318:         shoulderSlope: {
000319:           mean: average(shoulderSlopes),
000320:           std: standardDeviation(shoulderSlopes),
000321:           min: Math.min(...shoulderSlopes),
000322:           max: Math.max(...shoulderSlopes),
000323:         },
000324:         headTilt: {
000325:           mean: average(headTilts),
000326:           std: standardDeviation(headTilts),
000327:           min: Math.min(...headTilts),
000328:           max: Math.max(...headTilts),
000329:         },
000330:         headForward: {
000331:           mean: average(headForwards),
000332:           std: standardDeviation(headForwards),
000333:           min: Math.min(...headForwards),
000334:           max: Math.max(...headForwards),
000335:         },
000336:       };
000337:     }
000338: 
000339:     // Face statistics
000340:     if (validFaceFrames.length > 0) {
000341:       const ears = validFaceFrames.map(f => f.face.avgEAR);
000342:       const mars = validFaceFrames.map(f => f.face.mar);
000343:       const yaws = validFaceFrames.map(f => f.face.yaw);
000344:       const pitches = validFaceFrames.map(f => f.face.pitch);
000345:       const rolls = validFaceFrames.map(f => f.face.roll);
000346: 
000347:       stats.face = {
000348:         eyeAspectRatio: {
000349:           mean: average(ears),
000350:           std: standardDeviation(ears),
000351:           min: Math.min(...ears),
000352:           max: Math.max(...ears),
000353:         },
000354:         mouthAspectRatio: {
000355:           mean: average(mars),
000356:           std: standardDeviation(mars),
000357:           min: Math.min(...mars),
000358:           max: Math.max(...mars),
000359:         },
000360:         yaw: {
000361:           mean: average(yaws),
000362:           std: standardDeviation(yaws),
000363:           min: Math.min(...yaws),
000364:           max: Math.max(...yaws),
000365:         },
000366:         pitch: {
000367:           mean: average(pitches),
000368:           std: standardDeviation(pitches),
000369:           min: Math.min(...pitches),
000370:           max: Math.max(...pitches),
000371:         },
000372:         roll: {
000373:           mean: average(rolls),
000374:           std: standardDeviation(rolls),
000375:           min: Math.min(...rolls),
000376:           max: Math.max(...rolls),
000377:         },
000378:       };
000379:     }
000380: 
000381:     return stats;
000382:   };

000384:   // Helper functions
000385:   const average = (arr) => arr.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / arr.length;
000386:   const standardDeviation = (arr) => {
000387:     const avg = average(arr);
000388:     const squareDiffs = arr.map(value => Math.pow(value - avg, 2));
000389:     return Math.sqrt(average(squareDiffs));

000001: /**
000002:  * ============================================================================

000006:  * 
000007:  * This component provides complete body language detection using:
000008:  * 1. PoseLandmarker - 33 body landmarks (full skeleton)
000009:  * 2. FaceLandmarker - 478 facial landmarks (face mesh + iris)
000010:  * 3. HandLandmarker - 21 landmarks per hand (detailed finger tracking)
000011:  * 
000012:  * TOTAL: 553 landmarks tracked in real-time
000013:  * 
000014:  * Features:
000015:  * - Real-time detection overlay with color-coded landmarks
000016:  * - Complete metrics panel with all tracked values
000017:  * - Finger-level analysis for each hand
000018:  * - Comprehensive scoring system
000019:  * - Recording with metadata for research
000020:  * 
000021:  * @version 3.0.0 - Complete Research Edition
000022:  */
000023:

000087: const VideoRecorder = () => {

000101:

000117:   const [description, setDescription] = useState('');

000119:   
000120:   // MediaPipe states

000122:   const [isMediaPipeLoading, setIsMediaPipeLoading] = useState(false);
000123:   const [loadingStatus, setLoadingStatus] = useState('');
000124:   
000125:   // Display toggles

000127:   const [showPose, setShowPose] = useState(true);
000128:   const [showFace, setShowFace] = useState(true);
000129:   const [showHands, setShowHands] = useState(true);
000130:   const [showMetrics, setShowMetrics] = useState(true);

000132:   
000133:   // === SESSION RECORDING FOR RESEARCH ===

000193:       body: {

000200:

000229:         score: 0,
000230:       },
000231:       // Mouth
000232:       mouth: {
000233:         mar: 0,
000234:         isSpeaking: false,
000235:         openness: 'closed',
000236:         status: 'N/A',
000237:       },
000238:       // Expression
000239:       expression: {
000240:         isSmiling: false,
000241:         smileIntensity: 0,
000242:         eyebrowPosition: 'neutral',
000243:         status: 'N/A',
000244:       },
000245:       // Overall
000246:       overallScore: 0,
000247:     },
000248:     
000249:     // === LEFT HAND (from HandLandmarker) ===
000250:     leftHand: {
000251:       detected: false,
000252:       openness: 0,
000253:       gesture: 'Not Detected',
000254:       wristPosition: { x: 0, y: 0, z: 0 },
000255:       movement: 0,
000256:       fingers: {
000257:         thumb: { curl: 0, extended: false },
000258:         index: { curl: 0, extended: false },
000259:         middle: { curl: 0, extended: false },
000260:         ring: { curl: 0, extended: false },
000261:         pinky: { curl: 0, extended: false },
000262:       },
000263:       spread: 0,
000264:       score: 0,
000265:     },
000266:     
000267:     // === RIGHT HAND (from HandLandmarker) ===
000268:     rightHand: {
000269:       detected: false,
000270:       openness: 0,
000271:       gesture: 'Not Detected',
000272:       wristPosition: { x: 0, y: 0, z: 0 },
000273:       movement: 0,
000274:       fingers: {
000275:         thumb: { curl: 0, extended: false },
000276:         index: { curl: 0, extended: false },
000277:         middle: { curl: 0, extended: false },
000278:         ring: { curl: 0, extended: false },
000279:         pinky: { curl: 0, extended: false },
000280:       },
000281:       spread: 0,
000282:       score: 0,
000283:     },
000284:     
000285:     // === MOVEMENT/STABILITY ===
000286:     movement: {
000287:       bodyStability: 0,
000288:       bodyMovement: 0,
000289:       avgMovement: 0,
000290:       isStable: true,
000291:       isFidgeting: false,
000292:       status: 'N/A',
000293:       score: 0,
000294:     },
000295:     
000296:     // === COMPOSITE SCORES ===
000297:     scores: {
000298:       posture: 0,
000299:       eyeContact: 0,
000300:       expression: 0,
000301:       hands: 0,
000302:       stability: 0,
000303:       overall: 0,
000304:       level: 'fair',
000305:     },
000306:   });
000307: 
000308:   // ============================================================================
000309:   // INITIALIZATION
000310:   // ============================================================================
000311: 
000312:   // Load saved recordings
000313:   useEffect(() => {
000314:     const saved = localStorage.getItem('research_video_recordings');
000315:     if (saved) {
000316:       try {
000317:         setRecordings(JSON.parse(saved));
000318:       } catch (e) {
000319:         console.error('Failed to load recordings:', e);
000320:       }
000321:     }
000322:   }, []);
000323: 
000324:   // Recording timer
000325:   useEffect(() => {
000326:     let interval;
000327:     if (isRecording) {
000328:       interval = setInterval(() => {
000329:         setRecordingTime(prev => prev + 1);
000330:       }, 1000);
000331:     }
000332:     return () => clearInterval(interval);
000333:   }, [isRecording]);
000334: 
000335:   // Initialize MediaPipe models
000336:   const initializeMediaPipe = useCallback(async () => {
000337:     if (isMediaPipeReady || isMediaPipeLoading) return;
000338:     
000339:     setIsMediaPipeLoading(true);
000340:     try {
000341:       setLoadingStatus('Loading MediaPipe Vision...');
000342:       const vision = await FilesetResolver.forVisionTasks(
000343:         'https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@mediapipe/tasks-vision@latest/wasm'
000344:       );
000345: 
000346:       // Initialize PoseLandmarker (33 landmarks)
000347:       setLoadingStatus('Loading Pose Model (33 landmarks)...');
000348:       const poseDetector = await PoseLandmarker.createFromOptions(vision, {
000349:         baseOptions: {
000350:           modelAssetPath: 'https://storage.googleapis.com/mediapipe-models/pose_landmarker/pose_landmarker_lite/float16/1/pose_landmarker_lite.task',
000351:           delegate: 'GPU',
000352:         },
000353:         runningMode: 'VIDEO',
000354:         numPoses: 1,
000355:       });
000356:       poseLandmarkerRef.current = poseDetector;
000357: 
000358:       // Initialize FaceLandmarker (478 landmarks)
000359:       setLoadingStatus('Loading Face Model (478 landmarks)...');
000360:       const faceDetector = await FaceLandmarker.createFromOptions(vision, {
000361:         baseOptions: {
000362:           modelAssetPath: 'https://storage.googleapis.com/mediapipe-models/face_landmarker/face_landmarker/float16/1/face_landmarker.task',
000363:           delegate: 'GPU',
000364:         },
000365:         runningMode: 'VIDEO',
000366:         numFaces: 1,
000367:         outputFaceBlendshapes: false,
000368:         outputFacialTransformationMatrixes: false,
000369:       });
000370:       faceLandmarkerRef.current = faceDetector;
000371: 
000372:       // Initialize HandLandmarker (21 landmarks per hand)
000373:       setLoadingStatus('Loading Hand Model (21 landmarks × 2)...');
000374:       const handDetector = await HandLandmarker.createFromOptions(vision, {
000375:         baseOptions: {
000376:           modelAssetPath: 'https://storage.googleapis.com/mediapipe-models/hand_landmarker/hand_landmarker/float16/1/hand_landmarker.task',
000377:           delegate: 'GPU',
000378:         },
000379:         runningMode: 'VIDEO',
000380:         numHands: 2,
000381:       });
000382:       handLandmarkerRef.current = handDetector;
000383: 
000384:       setIsMediaPipeReady(true);
000385:       setLoadingStatus('');
000386:       toast.success('MediaPipe initialized - All 3 models loaded (553 total landmarks)');
000387:     } catch (error) {
000388:       console.error('MediaPipe init error:', error);
000389:       toast.error('Failed to initialize MediaPipe: ' + error.message);
000390:       setLoadingStatus('Error: ' + error.message);
000391:     } finally {
000392:       setIsMediaPipeLoading(false);
000393:     }
000394:   }, [isMediaPipeReady, isMediaPipeLoading, toast]);
000395: 
000396:   // ============================================================================
000397:   // DETECTION LOOP
000398:   // ============================================================================
000399: 
000400:   const runDetection = useCallback(() => {
000401:     if (!videoRef.current || !canvasRef.current || !isStreaming) return;
000402:     if (!poseLandmarkerRef.current || !faceLandmarkerRef.current || !handLandmarkerRef.current) return;
000403: 
000404:     const video = videoRef.current;
000405:     const canvas = canvasRef.current;
000406:     const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
000407:     
000408:     canvas.width = video.videoWidth;
000409:     canvas.height = video.videoHeight;
000410: 
000411:     let lastTime = performance.now();
000412:     let frameCount = 0;
000413: 
000414:     const detect = () => {
000415:       if (!isStreaming) return;
000416:       
000417:       const now = performance.now();
000418:       frameCount++;
000419:       
000420:       // Calculate FPS
000421:       if (now - lastTime >= 1000) {
000422:         setMetrics(prev => ({ ...prev, fps: frameCount, timestamp: now }));
000423:         frameCount = 0;
000424:         lastTime = now;
000425:       }
000426: 
000427:       ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
000428: 
000429:       const timestamp = performance.now();
000430:       let poseResults = null;
000431:       let faceResults = null;
000432:       let handResults = null;
000433: 
000434:       // Run pose detection
000435:       try {
000436:         poseResults = poseLandmarkerRef.current.detectForVideo(video, timestamp);
000437:       } catch (e) { /* ignore */ }
000438: 
000439:       // Run face detection
000440:       try {
000441:         faceResults = faceLandmarkerRef.current.detectForVideo(video, timestamp);
000442:       } catch (e) { /* ignore */ }
000443: 
000444:       // Run hand detection
000445:       try {
000446:         handResults = handLandmarkerRef.current.detectForVideo(video, timestamp);
000447:       } catch (e) { /* ignore */ }
000448: 
000449:       // Draw overlays
000450:       if (showOverlay) {
000451:         drawOverlay(ctx, canvas, poseResults, faceResults, handResults);
000452:       }
000453: 
000454:       // Update metrics
000455:       updateMetrics(poseResults, faceResults, handResults);
000456: 
000457:       animationRef.current = requestAnimationFrame(detect);
000458:     };
000459: 
000460:     detect();
000461:   }, [isStreaming, showOverlay, showPose, showFace, showHands]);
000462: 
000463:   // Start detection when ready
000464:   useEffect(() => {
000465:     if (isStreaming && isMediaPipeReady) {
000466:       runDetection();
000467:     }
000468:     return () => {
000469:       if (animationRef.current) {
000470:         cancelAnimationFrame(animationRef.current);
000471:       }
000472:     };
000473:   }, [isStreaming, isMediaPipeReady, runDetection]);
000474: 
000475:   // ============================================================================
000476:   // DRAWING FUNCTIONS
000477:   // ============================================================================
000478: 
000479:   const drawOverlay = (ctx, canvas, poseResults, faceResults, handResults) => {
000480:     // Draw Pose (Green)
000481:     if (showPose && poseResults?.landmarks?.[0]) {
000482:       const landmarks = poseResults.landmarks[0];
000483:       
000484:       // Draw connections
000485:       ctx.strokeStyle = '#00FF00';
000486:       ctx.lineWidth = 3;
000487:       POSE_CONNECTIONS.forEach(([start, end]) => {
000488:         if (landmarks[start] && landmarks[end]) {
000489:           ctx.beginPath();
000490:           ctx.moveTo(landmarks[start].x * canvas.width, landmarks[start].y * canvas.height);
000491:           ctx.lineTo(landmarks[end].x * canvas.width, landmarks[end].y * canvas.height);
000492:           ctx.stroke();
000493:         }
000494:       });
000495: 
000496:       // Draw landmarks
000497:       landmarks.forEach((landmark, idx) => {
000498:         if (landmark.visibility > 0.5) {
000499:           ctx.beginPath();
000500:           ctx.arc(
000501:             landmark.x * canvas.width,
000502:             landmark.y * canvas.height,
000503:             idx === 0 ? 8 : 5,
000504:             0, 2 * Math.PI
000505:           );
000506:           ctx.fillStyle = idx === 0 ? '#FF0000' : '#00FF00';
000507:           ctx.fill();
000508:           ctx.strokeStyle = '#FFFFFF';
000509:           ctx.lineWidth = 2;
000510:           ctx.stroke();
000511:         }
000512:       });
000513:     }
000514: 
000515:     // Draw Face Mesh (Cyan)
000516:     if (showFace && faceResults?.faceLandmarks?.[0]) {
000517:       const landmarks = faceResults.faceLandmarks[0];
000518:       
000519:       // Draw eyes
000520:       ctx.strokeStyle = '#00FFFF';
000521:       ctx.lineWidth = 2;
000522:       
000523:       // Left eye
000524:       ctx.beginPath();
000525:       FACE_LANDMARKS.LEFT_EYE.forEach((idx, i) => {
000526:         if (landmarks[idx]) {
000527:           const x = landmarks[idx].x * canvas.width;
000528:           const y = landmarks[idx].y * canvas.height;
000529:           i === 0 ? ctx.moveTo(x, y) : ctx.lineTo(x, y);
000530:         }
000531:       });
000532:       ctx.closePath();
000533:       ctx.stroke();
000534:       
000535:       // Right eye
000536:       ctx.beginPath();
000537:       FACE_LANDMARKS.RIGHT_EYE.forEach((idx, i) => {
000538:         if (landmarks[idx]) {
000539:           const x = landmarks[idx].x * canvas.width;
000540:           const y = landmarks[idx].y * canvas.height;
000541:           i === 0 ? ctx.moveTo(x, y) : ctx.lineTo(x, y);
000542:         }
000543:       });
000544:       ctx.closePath();
000545:       ctx.stroke();
000546: 
000547:       // Draw lips (Pink)
000548:       ctx.strokeStyle = '#FF69B4';
000549:       ctx.beginPath();
000550:       FACE_LANDMARKS.LIPS_OUTER.forEach((idx, i) => {
000551:         if (landmarks[idx]) {
000552:           const x = landmarks[idx].x * canvas.width;
000553:           const y = landmarks[idx].y * canvas.height;
000554:           i === 0 ? ctx.moveTo(x, y) : ctx.lineTo(x, y);
000555:         }
000556:       });
000557:       ctx.closePath();
000558:       ctx.stroke();
000559: 
000560:       // Draw iris centers (Yellow)
000561:       [FACE_LANDMARKS.LEFT_IRIS_CENTER, FACE_LANDMARKS.RIGHT_IRIS_CENTER].forEach(idx => {
000562:         if (landmarks[idx]) {
000563:           ctx.beginPath();
000564:           ctx.arc(
000565:             landmarks[idx].x * canvas.width,
000566:             landmarks[idx].y * canvas.height,
000567:             4, 0, 2 * Math.PI
000568:           );
000569:           ctx.fillStyle = '#FFFF00';
000570:           ctx.fill();
000571:         }
000572:       });
000573: 
000574:       // Draw face mesh points (sparse)
000575:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0, 255, 255, 0.3)';
000576:       for (let i = 0; i < landmarks.length; i += 15) {
000577:         if (landmarks[i]) {
000578:           ctx.beginPath();
000579:           ctx.arc(
000580:             landmarks[i].x * canvas.width,
000581:             landmarks[i].y * canvas.height,
000582:             1, 0, 2 * Math.PI
000583:           );
000584:           ctx.fill();
000585:         }
000586:       }
000587:     }
000588: 
000589:     // Draw Hands (Orange for left, Blue for right)
000590:     if (showHands && handResults?.landmarks) {
000591:       handResults.landmarks.forEach((handLandmarks, handIdx) => {
000592:         const isLeft = handResults.handednesses?.[handIdx]?.[0]?.categoryName === 'Left';
000593:         const color = isLeft ? '#FFA500' : '#4169E1';
000594:         
000595:         // Draw connections
000596:         ctx.strokeStyle = color;
000597:         ctx.lineWidth = 2;
000598:         HAND_CONNECTIONS.forEach(([start, end]) => {
000599:           if (handLandmarks[start] && handLandmarks[end]) {
000600:             ctx.beginPath();
000601:             ctx.moveTo(handLandmarks[start].x * canvas.width, handLandmarks[start].y * canvas.height);
000602:             ctx.lineTo(handLandmarks[end].x * canvas.width, handLandmarks[end].y * canvas.height);
000603:             ctx.stroke();
000604:           }
000605:         });
000606: 
000607:         // Draw landmarks
000608:         handLandmarks.forEach((landmark, idx) => {
000609:           ctx.beginPath();
000610:           ctx.arc(
000611:             landmark.x * canvas.width,
000612:             landmark.y * canvas.height,
000613:             idx === 0 ? 6 : (idx % 4 === 0 ? 5 : 3),
000614:             0, 2 * Math.PI
000615:           );
000616:           ctx.fillStyle = idx === 0 ? '#FFFFFF' : color;
000617:           ctx.fill();
000618:           if (idx % 4 === 0) {
000619:             ctx.strokeStyle = '#FFFFFF';
000620:             ctx.lineWidth = 1;
000621:             ctx.stroke();
000622:           }
000623:         });
000624:       });
000625:     }
000626:   };
000627: 
000628:   // ============================================================================
000629:   // METRICS CALCULATION
000630:   // ============================================================================
000631: 
000632:   const updateMetrics = (poseResults, faceResults, handResults) => {
000633:     const newMetrics = { ...metrics };
000634:     
000635:     // === DETECTION STATUS ===
000636:     const poseDetected = poseResults?.landmarks?.[0]?.length > 0;
000637:     const faceDetected = faceResults?.faceLandmarks?.[0]?.length > 0;
000638:     
000639:     let leftHandLandmarks = null;
000640:     let rightHandLandmarks = null;
000641:     
000642:     if (handResults?.landmarks) {
000643:       handResults.landmarks.forEach((landmarks, idx) => {
000644:         const isLeft = handResults.handednesses?.[idx]?.[0]?.categoryName === 'Left';
000645:         if (isLeft) leftHandLandmarks = landmarks;
000646:         else rightHandLandmarks = landmarks;
000647:       });
000648:     }
000649:     
000650:     newMetrics.detection = {
000651:       poseDetected,
000652:       faceDetected,
000653:       leftHandDetected: !!leftHandLandmarks,
000654:       rightHandDetected: !!rightHandLandmarks,
000655:       landmarksCount: {
000656:         pose: poseDetected ? 33 : 0,
000657:         face: faceDetected ? 478 : 0,
000658:         leftHand: leftHandLandmarks ? 21 : 0,
000659:         rightHand: rightHandLandmarks ? 21 : 0,
000660:         total: (poseDetected ? 33 : 0) + (faceDetected ? 478 : 0) + 
000661:                (leftHandLandmarks ? 21 : 0) + (rightHandLandmarks ? 21 : 0),
000662:       },
000663:     };
000664: 
000665:     // === POSTURE METRICS ===
000666:     if (poseDetected) {
000667:       const pl = poseResults.landmarks[0];
000668:       
000669:       // Shoulders
000670:       const shoulderMetrics = calculateShoulderMetrics(
000671:         pl[POSE_LANDMARKS.LEFT_SHOULDER],
000672:         pl[POSE_LANDMARKS.RIGHT_SHOULDER]
000673:       );
000674:       newMetrics.posture.shoulders = shoulderMetrics;
000675:       
000676:       // Spine
000677:       const spineMetrics = calculateSpineAlignment(
000678:         pl[POSE_LANDMARKS.NOSE],
000679:         pl[POSE_LANDMARKS.LEFT_SHOULDER],
000680:         pl[POSE_LANDMARKS.RIGHT_SHOULDER],
000681:         pl[POSE_LANDMARKS.LEFT_HIP],
000682:         pl[POSE_LANDMARKS.RIGHT_HIP]
000683:       );
000684:       newMetrics.posture.spine = spineMetrics;
000685:       
000686:       // Head
000687:       const shoulderMidX = (pl[POSE_LANDMARKS.LEFT_SHOULDER].x + pl[POSE_LANDMARKS.RIGHT_SHOULDER].x) / 2;
000688:       const shoulderMidZ = ((pl[POSE_LANDMARKS.LEFT_SHOULDER].z || 0) + (pl[POSE_LANDMARKS.RIGHT_SHOULDER].z || 0)) / 2;
000689:       newMetrics.posture.head = {
000690:         tilt: Math.abs(pl[POSE_LANDMARKS.NOSE].x - shoulderMidX),
000691:         forwardPosition: (pl[POSE_LANDMARKS.NOSE].z || 0) - shoulderMidZ,
000692:         status: Math.abs((pl[POSE_LANDMARKS.NOSE].z || 0) - shoulderMidZ) < 0.06 ? 'Good' : 'Forward',
000693:       };
000694:       
000695:       // Arms
000696:       newMetrics.posture.arms = {
000697:         leftAngle: calculateArmAngle(
000698:           pl[POSE_LANDMARKS.LEFT_SHOULDER],
000699:           pl[POSE_LANDMARKS.LEFT_ELBOW],
000700:           pl[POSE_LANDMARKS.LEFT_WRIST]
000701:         ),
000702:         rightAngle: calculateArmAngle(
000703:           pl[POSE_LANDMARKS.RIGHT_SHOULDER],
000704:           pl[POSE_LANDMARKS.RIGHT_ELBOW],
000705:           pl[POSE_LANDMARKS.RIGHT_WRIST]
000706:         ),
000707:         leftStatus: 'Detected',
000708:         rightStatus: 'Detected',
000709:       };
000710:       
000711:       // Body alignment
000712:       newMetrics.posture.body = {
000713:         symmetry: 1 - Math.abs(pl[POSE_LANDMARKS.LEFT_SHOULDER].y - pl[POSE_LANDMARKS.RIGHT_SHOULDER].y) * 10,
000714:         centering: Math.abs(shoulderMidX - 0.5),
000715:       };
000716:       
000717:       // Overall posture score
000718:       newMetrics.posture.overallScore = Math.round(
000719:         shoulderMetrics.score * 0.4 + spineMetrics.score * 0.4 +
000720:         (newMetrics.posture.head.status === 'Good' ? 100 : 60) * 0.2
000721:       );
000722:       
000723:       // Movement/Stability
000724:       const currentPose = {
000725:         nose: pl[POSE_LANDMARKS.NOSE],
000726:         leftShoulder: pl[POSE_LANDMARKS.LEFT_SHOULDER],
000727:         rightShoulder: pl[POSE_LANDMARKS.RIGHT_SHOULDER],
000728:       };
000729:       const stabilityMetrics = calculateStability(currentPose, previousPoseRef.current, stabilityHistoryRef.current);
000730:       previousPoseRef.current = currentPose;
000731:       stabilityHistoryRef.current = stabilityMetrics.history;
000732:       
000733:       newMetrics.movement = {
000734:         bodyStability: stabilityMetrics.stability,
000735:         bodyMovement: stabilityMetrics.movement,
000736:         avgMovement: stabilityMetrics.averageMovement,
000737:         isStable: stabilityMetrics.isStable,
000738:         isFidgeting: stabilityMetrics.averageMovement > MOVEMENT_REFERENCE.stability.magnitude.active,
000739:         status: stabilityMetrics.isStable ? 'Stable' : 'Moving',
000740:         score: stabilityMetrics.score,
000741:       };
000742:     }
000743: 
000744:     // === FACE METRICS ===
000745:     if (faceDetected) {
000746:       const fl = faceResults.faceLandmarks[0];
000747:       
000748:       // Eyes (EAR)
000749:       const leftEAR = calculateEAR(
000750:         fl[FACE_LANDMARKS.LEFT_EYE_TOP],
000751:         fl[FACE_LANDMARKS.LEFT_EYE_BOTTOM],
000752:         fl[FACE_LANDMARKS.LEFT_EYE_OUTER],
000753:         fl[FACE_LANDMARKS.LEFT_EYE_INNER]
000754:       );
000755:       const rightEAR = calculateEAR(
000756:         fl[FACE_LANDMARKS.RIGHT_EYE_TOP],
000757:         fl[FACE_LANDMARKS.RIGHT_EYE_BOTTOM],
000758:         fl[FACE_LANDMARKS.RIGHT_EYE_OUTER],
000759:         fl[FACE_LANDMARKS.RIGHT_EYE_INNER]
000760:       );
000761:       const avgEAR = (leftEAR + rightEAR) / 2;
000762:       const isBlinking = avgEAR < FACE_REFERENCE.eyes.blink.threshold;
000763:       
000764:       // Blink rate calculation
000765:       if (isBlinking && !lastBlinkStateRef.current) {
000766:         blinkCountRef.current++;
000767:       }
000768:       lastBlinkStateRef.current = isBlinking;
000769:       
000770:       const elapsed = (Date.now() - blinkTimeRef.current) / 1000;
000771:       let blinkRate = newMetrics.face.eyes.blinkRate;
000772:       if (elapsed >= 10) {
000773:         blinkRate = Math.round((blinkCountRef.current / elapsed) * 60);
000774:         blinkCountRef.current = 0;
000775:         blinkTimeRef.current = Date.now();
000776:       }
000777:       
000778:       let eyeStatus = 'Open';
000779:       let eyeScore = 100;
000780:       if (isBlinking) { eyeStatus = 'Blinking'; eyeScore = 50; }
000781:       else if (avgEAR < FACE_REFERENCE.eyes.aspectRatio.narrowed) { eyeStatus = 'Narrowed'; eyeScore = 70; }
000782:       else if (avgEAR > FACE_REFERENCE.eyes.aspectRatio.wideOpen) { eyeStatus = 'Wide Open'; eyeScore = 90; }
000783:       
000784:       newMetrics.face.eyes = {
000785:         leftEAR,
000786:         rightEAR,
000787:         avgEAR,
000788:         asymmetry: Math.abs(leftEAR - rightEAR),
000789:         isBlinking,
000790:         blinkRate,
000791:         status: eyeStatus,
000792:         score: eyeScore,
000793:       };
000794:       
000795:       // Face Orientation
000796:       const orientation = calculateFaceOrientation(
000797:         fl[FACE_LANDMARKS.NOSE_TIP],
000798:         fl[FACE_LANDMARKS.LEFT_EYE_OUTER],
000799:         fl[FACE_LANDMARKS.RIGHT_EYE_OUTER],
000800:         fl[FACE_LANDMARKS.CHIN],
000801:         fl[FACE_LANDMARKS.FOREHEAD_CENTER]
000802:       );
000803:       
000804:       const absYaw = Math.abs(orientation.yaw);
000805:       const absPitch = Math.abs(orientation.pitch);
000806:       const absRoll = Math.abs(orientation.roll);
000807:       const combined = absYaw + absPitch + absRoll;
000808:       
000809:       let orientStatus = 'Facing Camera';
000810:       let orientScore = 100;
000811:       if (absYaw > 40 || absPitch > 30) { orientStatus = 'Turned Away'; orientScore = 30; }
000812:       else if (absYaw > 25 || absPitch > 20) { orientStatus = 'Looking Away'; orientScore = 50; }
000813:       else if (absYaw > 15) { orientStatus = 'Slight Turn'; orientScore = 75; }
000814:       
000815:       newMetrics.face.orientation = {
000816:         yaw: orientation.yaw,
000817:         pitch: orientation.pitch,
000818:         roll: orientation.roll,
000819:         combined,
000820:         status: orientStatus,
000821:         score: orientScore,
000822:       };
000823:       
000824:       // Gaze
000825:       const gazeScore = Math.max(20, orientScore - (combined * 0.5));
000826:       newMetrics.face.gaze = {
000827:         isLookingAtCamera: absYaw < 15 && absPitch < 12,
000828:         direction: absYaw < 10 ? 'center' : (orientation.yaw > 0 ? 'left' : 'right'),
000829:         deviation: combined / 90,
000830:         status: absYaw < 15 ? 'Direct' : 'Averted',
000831:         score: Math.round(gazeScore),
000832:       };
000833:       
000834:       // Mouth
000835:       const mar = calculateMAR(
000836:         fl[FACE_LANDMARKS.UPPER_LIP_BOTTOM],
000837:         fl[FACE_LANDMARKS.LOWER_LIP_TOP],
000838:         fl[FACE_LANDMARKS.MOUTH_LEFT],
000839:         fl[FACE_LANDMARKS.MOUTH_RIGHT]
000840:       );
000841:       const isSpeaking = mar > FACE_REFERENCE.mouth.speaking.threshold;
000842:       
000843:       newMetrics.face.mouth = {
000844:         mar,
000845:         isSpeaking,
000846:         openness: mar < 0.08 ? 'closed' : (mar < 0.15 ? 'slightly open' : (mar < 0.3 ? 'speaking' : 'wide open')),
000847:         status: isSpeaking ? 'Speaking' : 'Silent',
000848:       };
000849:       
000850:       // Expression (simplified)
000851:       const leftLipCorner = fl[FACE_LANDMARKS.LEFT_LIP_CORNER];
000852:       const rightLipCorner = fl[FACE_LANDMARKS.RIGHT_LIP_CORNER];
000853:       const noseTip = fl[FACE_LANDMARKS.NOSE_TIP];
000854:       
000855:       const avgLipCornerY = (leftLipCorner.y + rightLipCorner.y) / 2;
000856:       const smileIndicator = noseTip.y - avgLipCornerY;
000857:       const isSmiling = smileIndicator > 0.02;
000858:       
000859:       newMetrics.face.expression = {
000860:         isSmiling,
000861:         smileIntensity: Math.max(0, Math.min(1, smileIndicator * 20)),
000862:         eyebrowPosition: 'neutral',
000863:         status: isSmiling ? 'Smiling' : 'Neutral',
000864:       };
000865:       
000866:       // Overall face score
000867:       newMetrics.face.overallScore = Math.round(
000868:         eyeScore * 0.3 + orientScore * 0.4 + gazeScore * 0.3
000869:       );
000870:     }
000871: 
000872:     // === HAND METRICS ===
000873:     // Left Hand
000874:     if (leftHandLandmarks) {
000875:       const analysis = analyzeHand(leftHandLandmarks);
000876:       const gesture = detectHandGesture(analysis);
000877:       
000878:       newMetrics.leftHand = {
000879:         detected: true,
000880:         openness: analysis.openness,
000881:         gesture,
000882:         wristPosition: analysis.wristPosition || { x: 0, y: 0, z: 0 },
000883:         movement: previousLeftHandRef.current ? 
000884:           Math.sqrt(
000885:             Math.pow((analysis.wristPosition?.x || 0) - (previousLeftHandRef.current.x || 0), 2) +
000886:             Math.pow((analysis.wristPosition?.y || 0) - (previousLeftHandRef.current.y || 0), 2)
000887:           ) : 0,
000888:         fingers: analysis.fingers,
000889:         spread: analysis.spread,
000890:         score: Math.round(analysis.openness * 50 + 50),
000891:       };
000892:       previousLeftHandRef.current = analysis.wristPosition;
000893:     } else {
000894:       newMetrics.leftHand = { ...newMetrics.leftHand, detected: false, gesture: 'Not Detected' };
000895:     }
000896:     
000897:     // Right Hand
000898:     if (rightHandLandmarks) {
000899:       const analysis = analyzeHand(rightHandLandmarks);
000900:       const gesture = detectHandGesture(analysis);
000901:       
000902:       newMetrics.rightHand = {
000903:         detected: true,
000904:         openness: analysis.openness,
000905:         gesture,
000906:         wristPosition: analysis.wristPosition || { x: 0, y: 0, z: 0 },
000907:         movement: previousRightHandRef.current ?
000908:           Math.sqrt(
000909:             Math.pow((analysis.wristPosition?.x || 0) - (previousRightHandRef.current.x || 0), 2) +
000910:             Math.pow((analysis.wristPosition?.y || 0) - (previousRightHandRef.current.y || 0), 2)
000911:           ) : 0,
000912:         fingers: analysis.fingers,
000913:         spread: analysis.spread,
000914:         score: Math.round(analysis.openness * 50 + 50),
000915:       };
000916:       previousRightHandRef.current = analysis.wristPosition;
000917:     } else {
000918:       newMetrics.rightHand = { ...newMetrics.rightHand, detected: false, gesture: 'Not Detected' };
000919:     }
000920: 
000921:     // =========================================================================
000922:     // COMPOSITE SCORES - Research-Grade Calculations
000923:     // =========================================================================
000924:     
000925:     /**
000926:      * POSTURE SCORE (0-100)
000927:      * Components:
000928:      * - Shoulder alignment (40%): How level the shoulders are
000929:      * - Spine alignment (40%): Forward/lateral lean
000930:      * - Head position (20%): Tilt and forward position
000931:      */
000932:     let postureScore = 50; // Default when not detected
000933:     if (poseDetected) {
000934:       const shoulderScore = newMetrics.posture.shoulders.score || 50;
000935:       const spineScore = newMetrics.posture.spine.score || 50;
000936:       
000937:       // Head score based on tilt and forward position
000938:       const headTilt = newMetrics.posture.head.tilt;
000939:       const headForward = Math.abs(newMetrics.posture.head.forwardPosition);
000940:       let headScore = 100;
000941:       // Penalize for head tilt (lateral offset from center)
000942:       if (headTilt > 0.08) headScore -= 40;
000943:       else if (headTilt > 0.05) headScore -= 25;
000944:       else if (headTilt > 0.03) headScore -= 10;
000945:       // Penalize for forward head position
000946:       if (headForward > 0.10) headScore -= 30;
000947:       else if (headForward > 0.06) headScore -= 15;
000948:       else if (headForward > 0.03) headScore -= 5;
000949:       headScore = Math.max(0, headScore);
000950:       
000951:       postureScore = Math.round(
000952:         shoulderScore * 0.40 +
000953:         spineScore * 0.40 +
000954:         headScore * 0.20
000955:       );
000956:     }
000957:     newMetrics.posture.overallScore = postureScore;
000958:     
000959:     /**
000960:      * EYE CONTACT SCORE (0-100)
000961:      * Components:
000962:      * - Face orientation (50%): Yaw, pitch, roll - how directly facing camera
000963:      * - Gaze direction (30%): Where eyes are looking
000964:      * - Eye openness (20%): EAR value indicating alertness
000965:      */
000966:     let eyeContactScore = 50; // Default when not detected
000967:     if (faceDetected) {
000968:       const yaw = newMetrics.face.orientation.yaw;
000969:       const pitch = newMetrics.face.orientation.pitch;
000970:       const roll = newMetrics.face.orientation.roll;
000971:       
000972:       // Orientation score - penalize for turning away
000973:       // Perfect = facing camera (yaw, pitch, roll all ~0)
000974:       let orientationScore = 100;
000975:       const absYaw = Math.abs(yaw);
000976:       const absPitch = Math.abs(pitch);
000977:       const absRoll = Math.abs(roll);
000978:       
000979:       // Yaw penalty (most important for eye contact)
000980:       if (absYaw > 45) orientationScore -= 60;
000981:       else if (absYaw > 30) orientationScore -= 45;
000982:       else if (absYaw > 20) orientationScore -= 30;
000983:       else if (absYaw > 10) orientationScore -= 15;
000984:       else if (absYaw > 5) orientationScore -= 5;
000985:       
000986:       // Pitch penalty
000987:       if (absPitch > 30) orientationScore -= 25;
000988:       else if (absPitch > 20) orientationScore -= 15;
000989:       else if (absPitch > 10) orientationScore -= 8;
000990:       
000991:       // Roll penalty (head tilt)
000992:       if (absRoll > 20) orientationScore -= 15;
000993:       else if (absRoll > 10) orientationScore -= 8;
000994:       
000995:       orientationScore = Math.max(0, orientationScore);
000996:       
000997:       // Gaze score - based on whether looking at camera
000998:       let gazeScore = newMetrics.face.gaze.isLookingAtCamera ? 100 : 50;
000999:       // Adjust based on deviation
001000:       const deviation = newMetrics.face.gaze.deviation;
001001:       if (deviation > 0.5) gazeScore -= 30;
001002:       else if (deviation > 0.3) gazeScore -= 15;
001003:       gazeScore = Math.max(0, gazeScore);
001004:       
001005:       // Eye openness score
001006:       const avgEAR = newMetrics.face.eyes.avgEAR;
001007:       let eyeOpennessScore = 100;
001008:       if (newMetrics.face.eyes.isBlinking) {
001009:         eyeOpennessScore = 70; // Blinking is normal, slight penalty
001010:       } else if (avgEAR < 0.15) {
001011:         eyeOpennessScore = 40; // Eyes nearly closed
001012:       } else if (avgEAR < 0.18) {
001013:         eyeOpennessScore = 60; // Drowsy/narrowed
001014:       } else if (avgEAR < 0.22) {
001015:         eyeOpennessScore = 80; // Slightly narrowed
001016:       } else if (avgEAR > 0.35) {
001017:         eyeOpennessScore = 90; // Wide open (alert)
001018:       }
001019:       
001020:       eyeContactScore = Math.round(
001021:         orientationScore * 0.50 +
001022:         gazeScore * 0.30 +
001023:         eyeOpennessScore * 0.20
001024:       );
001025:       
001026:       // Update the stored orientation score
001027:       newMetrics.face.orientation.score = orientationScore;
001028:       newMetrics.face.gaze.score = gazeScore;
001029:       newMetrics.face.eyes.score = eyeOpennessScore;
001030:     }
001031:     newMetrics.face.overallScore = eyeContactScore;
001032:     
001033:     /**
001034:      * EXPRESSION SCORE (0-100)
001035:      * Components:
001036:      * - Facial naturalness (40%): Not tense, relaxed expression
001037:      * - Smile/positive expression (30%): Appropriate smiling
001038:      * - Mouth state (30%): Appropriate for speaking/listening
001039:      */
001040:     let expressionScore = 70; // Default neutral
001041:     if (faceDetected) {
001042:       // Naturalness score - based on not having extreme values
001043:       let naturalnessScore = 100;
001044:       const mar = newMetrics.face.mouth.mar;
001045:       // Penalize for unusual mouth states
001046:       if (mar > 0.4) naturalnessScore -= 30; // Mouth too wide (yawning?)
001047:       else if (mar > 0.3 && !newMetrics.face.mouth.isSpeaking) naturalnessScore -= 15;
001048:       naturalnessScore = Math.max(50, naturalnessScore);
001049:       
001050:       // Smile score
001051:       let smileScore = 70; // Neutral is acceptable
001052:       if (newMetrics.face.expression.isSmiling) {
001053:         const intensity = newMetrics.face.expression.smileIntensity;
001054:         if (intensity > 0.7) smileScore = 100; // Good smile
001055:         else if (intensity > 0.4) smileScore = 90;
001056:         else if (intensity > 0.2) smileScore = 85;
001057:         else smileScore = 80;
001058:       }
001059:       
001060:       // Mouth state score
001061:       let mouthScore = 80; // Default acceptable
001062:       if (newMetrics.face.mouth.isSpeaking) {
001063:         mouthScore = 90; // Speaking is good (engaged)
001064:       } else if (newMetrics.face.mouth.openness === 'closed') {
001065:         mouthScore = 85; // Closed mouth when listening is good
001066:       } else if (newMetrics.face.mouth.openness === 'slightly open') {
001067:         mouthScore = 75; // Slightly open is okay
001068:       } else if (newMetrics.face.mouth.openness === 'wide open') {
001069:         mouthScore = 50; // Wide open without speaking is unusual
001070:       }
001071:       
001072:       expressionScore = Math.round(
001073:         naturalnessScore * 0.40 +
001074:         smileScore * 0.30 +
001075:         mouthScore * 0.30
001076:       );
001077:     }
001078:     
001079:     /**
001080:      * HANDS SCORE (0-100)
001081:      * Components:
001082:      * - Visibility (40%): Hands visible in frame (trust indicator)
001083:      * - Steadiness (35%): Low movement (not fidgeting)
001084:      * - Openness/relaxation (25%): Open hands = confidence
001085:      */
001086:     let handsScore = 70; // Default when hands not visible
001087:     const leftDetected = newMetrics.leftHand.detected;
001088:     const rightDetected = newMetrics.rightHand.detected;
001089:     const handsDetectedCount = (leftDetected ? 1 : 0) + (rightDetected ? 1 : 0);
001090:     
001091:     // Visibility score
001092:     let visibilityScore = 50; // No hands visible
001093:     if (handsDetectedCount === 2) visibilityScore = 100;
001094:     else if (handsDetectedCount === 1) visibilityScore = 75;
001095:     
001096:     // Steadiness score (lower movement = better)
001097:     let steadinessScore = 100;
001098:     if (leftDetected || rightDetected) {
001099:       const leftMovement = leftDetected ? newMetrics.leftHand.movement : 0;
001100:       const rightMovement = rightDetected ? newMetrics.rightHand.movement : 0;
001101:       const avgMovement = handsDetectedCount > 0 ? 
001102:         (leftMovement + rightMovement) / handsDetectedCount : 0;
001103:       
001104:       if (avgMovement > 0.08) steadinessScore = 30; // Excessive movement
001105:       else if (avgMovement > 0.05) steadinessScore = 50; // Fidgeting
001106:       else if (avgMovement > 0.03) steadinessScore = 70; // Some movement
001107:       else if (avgMovement > 0.015) steadinessScore = 85; // Mild movement
001108:       else steadinessScore = 100; // Very steady
001109:     }
001110:     
001111:     // Openness/relaxation score
001112:     let opennessScore = 70; // Default
001113:     if (leftDetected || rightDetected) {
001114:       const leftOpenness = leftDetected ? newMetrics.leftHand.openness : 0.5;
001115:       const rightOpenness = rightDetected ? newMetrics.rightHand.openness : 0.5;
001116:       const avgOpenness = (leftOpenness + rightOpenness) / 2;
001117:       
001118:       // Relaxed open hands (0.4-0.7) are ideal
001119:       if (avgOpenness >= 0.4 && avgOpenness <= 0.7) {
001120:         opennessScore = 100; // Ideal relaxed position
001121:       } else if (avgOpenness > 0.7) {
001122:         opennessScore = 90; // Very open (confident but possibly tense)
001123:       } else if (avgOpenness >= 0.25) {
001124:         opennessScore = 80; // Partially closed
001125:       } else {
001126:         opennessScore = 60; // Closed fist (tension indicator)
001127:       }
001128:     }
001129:     
001130:     handsScore = Math.round(
001131:       visibilityScore * 0.40 +
001132:       steadinessScore * 0.35 +
001133:       opennessScore * 0.25
001134:     );
001135:     
001136:     // Update individual hand scores
001137:     if (leftDetected) {
001138:       newMetrics.leftHand.score = Math.round(
001139:         (newMetrics.leftHand.openness >= 0.4 && newMetrics.leftHand.openness <= 0.7 ? 100 : 
001140:          newMetrics.leftHand.openness > 0.7 ? 90 : 
001141:          newMetrics.leftHand.openness >= 0.25 ? 75 : 50) * 0.6 +
001142:         (newMetrics.leftHand.movement < 0.02 ? 100 : newMetrics.leftHand.movement < 0.04 ? 80 : 50) * 0.4
001143:       );
001144:     }
001145:     if (rightDetected) {
001146:       newMetrics.rightHand.score = Math.round(
001147:         (newMetrics.rightHand.openness >= 0.4 && newMetrics.rightHand.openness <= 0.7 ? 100 : 
001148:          newMetrics.rightHand.openness > 0.7 ? 90 : 
001149:          newMetrics.rightHand.openness >= 0.25 ? 75 : 50) * 0.6 +
001150:         (newMetrics.rightHand.movement < 0.02 ? 100 : newMetrics.rightHand.movement < 0.04 ? 80 : 50) * 0.4
001151:       );
001152:     }
001153:     
001154:     /**
001155:      * STABILITY SCORE (0-100)
001156:      * Already calculated in movement metrics
001157:      * Based on body movement over time
001158:      */
001159:     const stabilityScore = newMetrics.movement.score || 70;
001160:     
001161:     /**
001162:      * OVERALL SCORE (0-100)
001163:      * Weighted combination of all components
001164:      * Weights based on interview research:
001165:      * - Eye Contact: Most important for connection (25%)
001166:      * - Posture: Professional appearance (20%)
001167:      * - Stability: Composure indicator (20%)
001168:      * - Expression: Engagement/approachability (20%)
001169:      * - Hands: Trust and confidence (15%)
001170:      */
001171:     const overallScore = Math.round(
001172:       postureScore * 0.20 +
001173:       eyeContactScore * 0.25 +
001174:       expressionScore * 0.20 +
001175:       handsScore * 0.15 +
001176:       stabilityScore * 0.20
001177:     );
001178:     
001179:     newMetrics.scores = {
001180:       posture: postureScore,
001181:       eyeContact: eyeContactScore,
001182:       expression: expressionScore,
001183:       hands: handsScore,
001184:       stability: stabilityScore,
001185:       overall: overallScore,
001186:       level: getScoreLevel(overallScore),
001187:     };
001188: 
001189:     setMetrics(newMetrics);
001190:   };

001195: 
001196:   const startCamera = useCallback(async () => {
001197:     try {
001198:       const stream = await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({
001199:         video: { width: 1280, height: 720, facingMode: 'user' },
001200:         audio: false,
001201:       });
001202:       
001203:       if (videoRef.current) {
001204:         videoRef.current.srcObject = stream;
001205:         await videoRef.current.play();
001206:       }
001207:       
001208:       setIsStreaming(true);
001209:       toast.success('Camera started');
001210:       
001211:       if (!isMediaPipeReady) {
001212:         await initializeMediaPipe();
001213:       }
001214:     } catch (error) {
001215:       console.error('Camera error:', error);
001216:       toast.error('Failed to access camera');
001217:     }
001218:   }, [toast, isMediaPipeReady, initializeMediaPipe]);
001219: 
001220:   const stopCamera = useCallback(() => {
001221:     if (animationRef.current) cancelAnimationFrame(animationRef.current);
001222:     if (videoRef.current?.srcObject) {
001223:       videoRef.current.srcObject.getTracks().forEach(track => track.stop());
001224:       videoRef.current.srcObject = null;
001225:     }
001226:     setIsStreaming(false);
001227:   }, []);
001228: 
001229:   const startRecording = useCallback(() => {
001230:     if (!videoRef.current?.srcObject) return;
001231:     chunksRef.current = [];
001232:     const mediaRecorder = new MediaRecorder(videoRef.current.srcObject, {
001233:       mimeType: 'video/webm;codecs=vp9',
001234:     });
001235:     mediaRecorder.ondataavailable = (e) => {
001236:       if (e.data.size > 0) chunksRef.current.push(e.data);
001237:     };
001238:     mediaRecorder.onstop = () => {
001239:       const blob = new Blob(chunksRef.current, { type: 'video/webm' });
001240:       const recording = {
001241:         id: Date.now().toString(),
001242:         category,
001243:         quality,
001244:         description: description || `${category}_${quality}`,
001245:         duration: recordingTime,
001246:         timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
001247:         blobSize: blob.size,
001248:         filename: `${category}_${quality}_${Date.now()}.webm`,
001249:       };
001250:       saveVideoBlob(recording.id, blob);
001251:       const newRecordings = [...recordings, recording];
001252:       setRecordings(newRecordings);
001253:       localStorage.setItem('research_video_recordings', JSON.stringify(newRecordings));
001254:       toast.success('Recording saved!');
001255:     };
001256:     mediaRecorderRef.current = mediaRecorder;
001257:     mediaRecorder.start(1000);
001258:     setIsRecording(true);
001259:     setRecordingTime(0);
001260:   }, [category, quality, description, recordings, toast, recordingTime]);
001261: 
001262:   const stopRecording = useCallback(() => {
001263:     if (mediaRecorderRef.current && isRecording) {
001264:       mediaRecorderRef.current.stop();
001265:       setIsRecording(false);
001266:     }
001267:   }, [isRecording]);
001268: 
001269:   const saveVideoBlob = async (id, blob) => {
001270:     const request = indexedDB.open('ResearchVideoDB', 1);
001271:     request.onupgradeneeded = (e) => {
001272:       const db = e.target.result;
001273:       if (!db.objectStoreNames.contains('videos')) {
001274:         db.createObjectStore('videos', { keyPath: 'id' });
001275:       }
001276:     };
001277:     request.onsuccess = (e) => {
001278:       const db = e.target.result;
001279:       const tx = db.transaction(['videos'], 'readwrite');
001280:       tx.objectStore('videos').put({ id, blob, timestamp: Date.now() });
001281:     };
001282:   };
001283: 
001284:   const downloadRecording = async (recording) => {
001285:     const request = indexedDB.open('ResearchVideoDB', 1);
001286:     request.onsuccess = (e) => {
001287:       const db = e.target.result;
001288:       const tx = db.transaction(['videos'], 'readonly');
001289:       const req = tx.objectStore('videos').get(recording.id);
001290:       req.onsuccess = () => {
001291:         if (req.result) {
001292:           const url = URL.createObjectURL(req.result.blob);
001293:           const a = document.createElement('a');
001294:           a.href = url;
001295:           a.download = recording.filename;
001296:           a.click();
001297:           URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
001298:         }
001299:       };
001300:     };
001301:   };
001302: 
001303:   const deleteRecording = (id) => {

001305:     setRecordings(newRecordings);
001306:     localStorage.setItem('research_video_recordings', JSON.stringify(newRecordings));
001307:     toast.info('Recording deleted');

002345:       {/* Recordings List */}

002371:                   </button>
002372:                   <button onClick={() => deleteRecording(r.id)} className="p-1.5 text-red-600 hover:bg-red-100 rounded">
002373:                     <Icon name="Trash2" className="w-4 h-4" />
002374:                   </button>
002375:                 </div>
002376:               </div>
002377:             ))}
002378:           </div>
002379:         )}

000781: 
000782:       <ConfirmDialog

000793:     </div>

000099:     helper: 'Owner/contact identity could not be confidently tied to the company.',
000100:   },
000101:   {
000102:     code: 'DOMAIN_MISMATCH',

000104:     helper: 'Company website and email domains are inconsistent.',

000106:   {

000113:     label: 'Insufficient public footprint',

000133: const REJECTION_PRESET_MAP = REJECTION_REASON_PRESETS.reduce((map, preset) => {
000134:   map[preset.code] = preset;
000135:   return map;

000137: const FOCUSABLE_SELECTOR = [
000138:   'a[href]',
000139:   'button:not([disabled])',
000140:   'input:not([disabled]):not([type="hidden"])',
000141:   'select:not([disabled])',
000142:   'textarea:not([disabled])',
000143:   '[tabindex]:not([tabindex="-1"])',
000144:   '[contenteditable="true"]',
000145: ].join(',');
000146: 
000147: const isElementVisible = (element) => Boolean(
000148:   element
000149:   && (element.offsetWidth || element.offsetHeight || element.getClientRects().length),
000150: );
000151: 
000152: const getFocusableElements = (container) => {
000153:   if (!container) return [];
000154:   return Array.from(container.querySelectorAll(FOCUSABLE_SELECTOR))
000155:     .filter((element) => isElementVisible(element) && element.getAttribute('aria-hidden') !== 'true');
000156: };
000157: 
000158: const formatDate = (value) => {
000159:   if (!value) return 'Not provided';
000160:   const date = new Date(value);
000161:   if (Number.isNaN(date.getTime())) return 'Not provided';
000162:   return date.toLocaleDateString();
000163: };
000164: 
000165: const formatDateTime = (value) => {
000166:   if (!value) return 'Not provided';
000167:   const date = new Date(value);
000168:   if (Number.isNaN(date.getTime())) return 'Not provided';
000169:   return `${date.toLocaleDateString()} ${date.toLocaleTimeString()}`;
000170: };
000171: 
000172: const getOrganizationStatusBadgeClass = (status) => {
000173:   switch ((status || '').toUpperCase()) {
000174:     case 'APPROVED':
000175:       return 'bg-green-100 dark:bg-green-900/30 text-green-700 dark:text-green-300';
000176:     case 'PENDING':
000177:       return 'bg-amber-100 dark:bg-amber-900/30 text-amber-700 dark:text-amber-300';
000178:     case 'REJECTED':
000179:       return 'bg-red-100 dark:bg-red-900/30 text-red-700 dark:text-red-300';
000180:     case 'SUSPENDED':
000181:       return 'bg-orange-100 dark:bg-orange-900/30 text-orange-700 dark:text-orange-300';
000182:     default:
000183:       return 'bg-gray-100 dark:bg-gray-900/30 text-gray-700 dark:text-gray-300';
000184:   }
000185: };
000186: 
000187: const getApiOrigin = () => {
000188:   const fallback = 'http://localhost:3000';
000189:   const apiUrl = import.meta.env.VITE_API_URL || fallback;
000190:   const browserOrigin = typeof window !== 'undefined' ? window.location.origin : fallback;
000191:   try {
000192:     return new URL(apiUrl, browserOrigin).origin;
000193:   } catch {
000194:     return apiUrl.replace(/\/api\/?$/i, '').replace(/\/$/, '');
000195:   }
000196: };
000197: 
000198: const normalizeUrl = (value) => {
000199:   if (!value || typeof value !== 'string') return null;
000200:   if (/^https?:\/\//i.test(value)) return value;
000201:   if (value.startsWith('/')) return value;
000202:   return `https://${value}`;
000203: };
000204: 
000205: const normalizeAssetUrl = (value) => {
000206:   if (!value || typeof value !== 'string') return null;
000207:   const trimmed = value.trim();
000208:   if (!trimmed) return null;
000209:   if (/^https?:\/\//i.test(trimmed)) return trimmed;
000210: 
000211:   const apiOrigin = getApiOrigin();
000212:   if (trimmed.startsWith('/')) return `${apiOrigin}${trimmed}`;
000213:   if (trimmed.startsWith('uploads/')) return `${apiOrigin}/${trimmed}`;
000214:   return `https://${trimmed}`;
000215: };
000216: 
000217: const summarizeCountryStatus = (value) => {
000218:   switch (value) {
000219:     case 'match':
000220:       return 'Country matched';
000221:     case 'mismatch':
000222:       return 'Country mismatch';
000223:     case 'missing_in_document':
000224:       return 'Country not detected in document';
000225:     case 'not_provided':
000226:       return 'Country not provided by registrant';
000227:     default:
000228:       return 'Country check unavailable';
000229:   }
000230: };
000231: 
000232: const humanizeValue = (value) => {
000233:   if (!value || typeof value !== 'string') return value;
000234:   return value
000235:     .replace(/[-_]/g, ' ')
000236:     .replace(/\s+/g, ' ')
000237:     .trim()
000238:     .replace(/\b\w/g, (char) => char.toUpperCase());
000239: };

000241: const DetailField = ({
000242:   label,
000243:   value,
000244:   icon = 'Info',
000245:   href = null,
000246:   fullWidth = false,
000247:   singleLine = false,
000248: }) => {
000249:   const hasValue = value !== undefined && value !== null && String(value).trim() !== '';
000250:   const rowClass = fullWidth ? 'sm:col-span-2' : '';
000251:   const valueString = hasValue ? String(value) : '';
000252: 
000253:   return (
000254:     <div className={`rounded-lg border border-gray-200 dark:border-slate-700 bg-gray-50/70 dark:bg-slate-900/60 p-3 ${rowClass}`}>
000255:       <div className="flex items-start gap-2">
000256:         <Icon name={icon} className="w-4 h-4 text-gray-400 dark:text-slate-500 mt-0.5 shrink-0" />
000257:         <div className="min-w-0">
000258:           <p className="text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide text-gray-500 dark:text-slate-500">
000259:             {label}
000260:           </p>
000261:           {hasValue ? (
000262:             href ? (
000263:               <a
000264:                 href={href}
000265:                 target="_blank"
000266:                 rel="noreferrer"
000267:                 title={valueString}
000268:                 className={`mt-1 block text-base font-medium text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400 hover:underline ${singleLine ? 'truncate whitespace-nowrap overflow-hidden' : 'break-all'}`}
000269:               >
000270:                 {value}
000271:               </a>
000272:             ) : (
000273:               <p
000274:                 title={valueString}
000275:                 className={`mt-1 text-base font-medium text-gray-900 dark:text-slate-100 ${singleLine ? 'truncate whitespace-nowrap overflow-hidden' : 'break-words'}`}
000276:               >
000277:                 {value}
000278:               </p>
000279:             )
000280:           ) : (
000281:             <p className="mt-1 text-base text-gray-500 dark:text-slate-500">Not provided</p>
000282:           )}
000283:         </div>
000284:       </div>
000285:     </div>
000286:   );
000287: };

000289: const OrganizationApprovalQueue = ({ onApprovalChange }) => {
000290:   const { success: showSuccessToast, error: showErrorToast, warning: showWarningToast } = useToast();
000291:   const [organizations, setOrganizations] = useState([]);
000292:   const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
000293:   const [actionLoading, setActionLoading] = useState(null);
000294:   const [selectedOrg, setSelectedOrg] = useState(null);
000295:   const [rejectTarget, setRejectTarget] = useState(null);
000296:   const [rejectReason, setRejectReason] = useState('');
000297:   const [rejectReasonCode, setRejectReasonCode] = useState(DEFAULT_REJECTION_REASON_CODE);
000298:   const [rejectReasonTags, setRejectReasonTags] = useState([]);
000299:   const [rejectReasonTagOther, setRejectReasonTagOther] = useState('');
000300:   const [rejectReasonTagOtherItems, setRejectReasonTagOtherItems] = useState([]);
000301:   const [showRejectModal, setShowRejectModal] = useState(false);
000302:   const [approveDialog, setApproveDialog] = useState({ open: false, org: null });
000303:   const [isApproving, setIsApproving] = useState(false);
000304:   const [approvalFilters, setApprovalFilters] = useState(DEFAULT_ADMIN_APPROVAL_FILTERS);
000305:   const [expandedSections, setExpandedSections] = useState({
000306:     risk: true,
000307:     checklist: false,
000308:   });
000309:   const rejectModalRef = useRef(null);
000310:   const detailsModalRef = useRef(null);
000311:   const previousFocusedRef = useRef(null);
000312:   const actionLoadingRef = useRef(actionLoading);
000313:   const realtimeRefreshTimeoutRef = useRef(null);
000314:   const loadPendingOrganizationsRef = useRef(null);
000315: 
000316:   useEffect(() => {
000317:     loadPendingOrganizations();
000318:   }, []);
000319: 
000320:   useEffect(() => {
000321:     actionLoadingRef.current = actionLoading;
000322:   }, [actionLoading]);
000323: 
000324:   useEffect(() => {
000325:     setRejectReasonTags((prev) => prev.filter((tag) => tag !== rejectReasonCode));
000326:   }, [rejectReasonCode]);
000327: 
000328:   useEffect(() => {
000329:     if (!rejectReasonTags.includes(OTHER_REJECTION_TAG)) {
000330:       setRejectReasonTagOther('');
000331:       setRejectReasonTagOtherItems([]);
000332:     }
000333:   }, [rejectReasonTags]);
000334: 
000335:   const loadPendingOrganizations = async () => {
000336:     try {
000337:       setLoading(true);
000338:       const result = await apiClient.admin.listPendingOrganizations();
000339:       if (result.success) {
000340:         setOrganizations(result.organizations || []);
000341:       }
000342:     } catch (error) {
000343:       console.error('Failed to load pending organizations:', error);
000344:       showErrorToast('Failed to load pending organizations.');
000345:     } finally {
000346:       setLoading(false);
000347:     }
000348:   };
000349: 
000350:   useEffect(() => {
000351:     loadPendingOrganizationsRef.current = loadPendingOrganizations;
000352:   }, [loadPendingOrganizations]);
000353: 
000354:   useRealtimePathFeed({
000355:     path: 'adminFeeds/global',
000356:     enabled: true,
000357:     eventTypes: ADMIN_FEED_EVENTS.organizations,
000358:     onFeedUpdate: (_feed, { initial }) => {
000359:       if (initial) return;
000360:       if (realtimeRefreshTimeoutRef.current) {
000361:         clearTimeout(realtimeRefreshTimeoutRef.current);
000362:       }
000363:       realtimeRefreshTimeoutRef.current = setTimeout(() => {
000364:         loadPendingOrganizationsRef.current?.();
000365:       }, 300);
000366:     },
000367:   });
000368: 
000369:   useEffect(
000370:     () => () => {
000371:       if (realtimeRefreshTimeoutRef.current) {
000372:         clearTimeout(realtimeRefreshTimeoutRef.current);
000373:       }
000374:     },
000375:     [],
000376:   );
000377: 
000378:   const handleApprove = (org) => {
000379:     if (actionLoading) return;
000380:     setApproveDialog({ open: true, org });
000381:   };
000382: 
000383:   const handleApproveConfirm = async () => {
000384:     if (!approveDialog.org || isApproving) return;
000385: 
000386:     try {
000387:       setIsApproving(true);
000388:       setActionLoading(approveDialog.org.id);
000389:       const result = await apiClient.admin.approveOrganization(approveDialog.org.id);
000390:       if (result.success) {
000391:         // Remove from pending list
000392:         setOrganizations(prev => prev.filter(o => o.id !== approveDialog.org.id));
000393:         if (selectedOrg?.id === approveDialog.org.id) {
000394:           setSelectedOrg(null);
000395:         }
000396:         setApproveDialog({ open: false, org: null });
000397:         showSuccessToast('Organization approved successfully.');
000398:         if (onApprovalChange) onApprovalChange();
000399:       } else {
000400:         throw new Error('Failed to approve organization');
000401:       }
000402:     } catch (error) {
000403:       console.error('Failed to approve organization:', error);
000404:       setApproveDialog({ open: false, org: null });
000405:       showErrorToast(error?.message || 'Failed to approve organization. Please try again.');
000406:     } finally {
000407:       setIsApproving(false);
000408:       setActionLoading(null);
000409:     }
000410:   };
000411: 
000412:   const handleApproveCancel = () => {
000413:     setApproveDialog({ open: false, org: null });
000414:   };
000415: 
000416:   const handleReject = (org) => {
000417:     setRejectTarget(org);
000418:     setRejectReason('');
000419:     setRejectReasonCode(DEFAULT_REJECTION_REASON_CODE);
000420:     setRejectReasonTags([]);
000421:     setRejectReasonTagOther('');
000422:     setRejectReasonTagOtherItems([]);
000423:     setShowRejectModal(true);
000424:   };
000425: 
000426:   const closeRejectModal = useCallback(() => {
000427:     if (actionLoading) return;
000428:     setShowRejectModal(false);
000429:     setRejectTarget(null);
000430:     setRejectReason('');
000431:     setRejectReasonCode(DEFAULT_REJECTION_REASON_CODE);
000432:     setRejectReasonTags([]);
000433:     setRejectReasonTagOther('');
000434:     setRejectReasonTagOtherItems([]);
000435:   }, [actionLoading]);
000436: 
000437:   const addRejectReasonOtherDetail = () => {
000438:     const trimmed = rejectReasonTagOther.trim();
000439:     if (!trimmed) return;
000440: 
000441:     if (trimmed.length < MIN_REJECTION_TAG_OTHER_LENGTH) {
000442:       showWarningToast(`Please provide at least ${MIN_REJECTION_TAG_OTHER_LENGTH} characters for each "Other" detail.`);
000443:       return;
000444:     }
000445: 
000446:     const normalized = trimmed.toLowerCase();
000447:     const hasDuplicate = rejectReasonTagOtherItems.some((item) => item.toLowerCase() === normalized);
000448:     if (hasDuplicate) {
000449:       showWarningToast('This "Other" detail is already added.');
000450:       return;
000451:     }
000452: 
000453:     if (rejectReasonTagOtherItems.length >= MAX_REJECTION_OTHER_DETAILS) {
000454:       showWarningToast(`You can add up to ${MAX_REJECTION_OTHER_DETAILS} custom "Other" details.`);
000455:       return;
000456:     }
000457: 
000458:     setRejectReasonTagOtherItems((prev) => [...prev, trimmed]);
000459:     setRejectReasonTagOther('');
000460:   };
000461: 
000462:   const removeRejectReasonOtherDetail = (detailToRemove) => {
000463:     setRejectReasonTagOtherItems((prev) => prev.filter((item) => item !== detailToRemove));
000464:   };
000465: 
000466:   const toggleRejectTag = (tagCode) => {
000467:     setRejectReasonTags((prev) => {
000468:       if (prev.includes(tagCode)) {
000469:         return prev.filter((tag) => tag !== tagCode);
000470:       }
000471: 
000472:       if (prev.length >= MAX_REJECTION_TAGS) {
000473:         showWarningToast(`You can select up to ${MAX_REJECTION_TAGS} rejection tags.`);
000474:         return prev;
000475:       }
000476: 
000477:       return [...prev, tagCode];
000478:     });
000479:   };
000480: 
000481:   useEffect(() => {
000482:     if (approveDialog.open) return undefined;
000483: 
000484:     const activeModal = showRejectModal ? rejectModalRef.current : selectedOrg ? detailsModalRef.current : null;
000485:     if (!activeModal) return undefined;
000486: 
000487:     previousFocusedRef.current = document.activeElement instanceof HTMLElement
000488:       ? document.activeElement
000489:       : null;
000490: 
000491:     const focusFirstElement = () => {
000492:       const focusableElements = getFocusableElements(activeModal);
000493:       if (focusableElements.length > 0) {
000494:         focusableElements[0].focus();
000495:         return;
000496:       }
000497:       activeModal.focus();
000498:     };
000499: 
000500:     if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
000501:       window.requestAnimationFrame(focusFirstElement);
000502:     } else {
000503:       focusFirstElement();
000504:     }
000505: 
000506:     const handleKeyDown = (event) => {
000507:       if (!activeModal) return;
000508: 
000509:       if (event.key === 'Escape') {
000510:         if (actionLoadingRef.current) return;
000511: 
000512:         if (showRejectModal) {
000513:           setShowRejectModal(false);
000514:           setRejectTarget(null);
000515:           setRejectReason('');
000516:           setRejectReasonCode(DEFAULT_REJECTION_REASON_CODE);
000517:           setRejectReasonTags([]);
000518:           return;
000519:         }
000520: 
000521:         if (selectedOrg) {
000522:           setSelectedOrg(null);
000523:         }
000524:         return;
000525:       }
000526: 
000527:       if (event.key !== 'Tab') return;
000528: 
000529:       const focusableElements = getFocusableElements(activeModal);
000530:       if (focusableElements.length === 0) {
000531:         event.preventDefault();
000532:         activeModal.focus();
000533:         return;
000534:       }
000535: 
000536:       const firstFocusable = focusableElements[0];
000537:       const lastFocusable = focusableElements[focusableElements.length - 1];
000538:       const activeElement = document.activeElement;
000539:       const focusInsideModal = activeElement instanceof Node && activeModal.contains(activeElement);
000540: 
000541:       if (event.shiftKey) {
000542:         if (!focusInsideModal || activeElement === firstFocusable) {
000543:           event.preventDefault();
000544:           lastFocusable.focus();
000545:         }
000546:         return;
000547:       }
000548: 
000549:       if (!focusInsideModal || activeElement === lastFocusable) {
000550:         event.preventDefault();
000551:         firstFocusable.focus();
000552:       }
000553:     };
000554: 
000555:     document.addEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
000556:     return () => {
000557:       document.removeEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
000558:       if (previousFocusedRef.current && typeof previousFocusedRef.current.focus === 'function') {
000559:         previousFocusedRef.current.focus();
000560:       }
000561:     };
000562:   }, [showRejectModal, selectedOrg, approveDialog.open]);
000563: 
000564:   useEffect(() => {
000565:     const shouldLockBody = showRejectModal || Boolean(selectedOrg);
000566:     if (!shouldLockBody) return undefined;
000567: 
000568:     const previousOverflow = document.body.style.overflow;
000569:     document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
000570: 
000571:     return () => {
000572:       document.body.style.overflow = previousOverflow;
000573:     };
000574:   }, [showRejectModal, selectedOrg]);
000575: 
000576:   const toggleSection = (section) => {
000577:     setExpandedSections((prev) => ({
000578:       ...prev,
000579:       [section]: !prev[section],
000580:     }));
000581:   };
000582: 
000583:   const confirmReject = async () => {
000584:     if (!rejectTarget || actionLoading) return;
000585: 
000586:     const trimmedReason = rejectReason.trim();
000587: 
000588:     if (!trimmedReason) {
000589:       showWarningToast('Please provide a reason for rejection.');
000590:       return;
000591:     }
000592: 
000593:     if (trimmedReason.length < MIN_REJECTION_REASON_LENGTH) {
000594:       showWarningToast(`Please provide at least ${MIN_REJECTION_REASON_LENGTH} characters for the rejection reason.`);
000595:       return;
000596:     }
000597: 
000598:     const otherTagSelected = rejectReasonTags.includes(OTHER_REJECTION_TAG);
000599:     const trimmedReasonTagOther = rejectReasonTagOther.trim();
000600: 
000601:     if (
000602:       otherTagSelected
000603:       && trimmedReasonTagOther
000604:       && trimmedReasonTagOther.length < MIN_REJECTION_TAG_OTHER_LENGTH
000605:       && rejectReasonTagOtherItems.length === 0
000606:     ) {
000607:       showWarningToast(`Please provide at least ${MIN_REJECTION_TAG_OTHER_LENGTH} characters for each "Other" detail.`);
000608:       return;
000609:     }
000610: 
000611:     let nextOtherItems = [...rejectReasonTagOtherItems];
000612:     if (otherTagSelected && trimmedReasonTagOther.length >= MIN_REJECTION_TAG_OTHER_LENGTH) {
000613:       const exists = nextOtherItems.some((item) => item.toLowerCase() === trimmedReasonTagOther.toLowerCase());
000614:       if (!exists) {
000615:         if (nextOtherItems.length >= MAX_REJECTION_OTHER_DETAILS) {
000616:           showWarningToast(`You can add up to ${MAX_REJECTION_OTHER_DETAILS} custom "Other" details.`);
000617:           return;
000618:         }
000619:         nextOtherItems.push(trimmedReasonTagOther);
000620:       }
000621:     }
000622: 
000623:     if (otherTagSelected && nextOtherItems.length === 0) {
000624:       showWarningToast('Please add at least one "Other" supporting detail (press Enter or click Add).');
000625:       return;
000626:     }
000627: 
000628:     try {
000629:       setActionLoading(rejectTarget.id);
000630:       const rejectPayload = {
000631:         reason: trimmedReason,
000632:         reasonCode: rejectReasonCode || DEFAULT_REJECTION_REASON_CODE,
000633:         reasonTags: rejectReasonTags,
000634:       };
000635:       if (otherTagSelected) {
000636:         rejectPayload.reasonTagOther = nextOtherItems.join('; ');
000637:       }
000638: 
000639:       const result = await apiClient.admin.rejectOrganization(rejectTarget.id, rejectPayload);
000640:       if (result.success) {
000641:         // Remove from pending list
000642:         setOrganizations(prev => prev.filter(o => o.id !== rejectTarget.id));
000643:         if (selectedOrg?.id === rejectTarget.id) {
000644:           setSelectedOrg(null);
000645:         }
000646:         setShowRejectModal(false);
000647:         setRejectTarget(null);
000648:         setRejectReason('');
000649:         setRejectReasonCode(DEFAULT_REJECTION_REASON_CODE);
000650:         setRejectReasonTags([]);
000651:         setRejectReasonTagOther('');
000652:         setRejectReasonTagOtherItems([]);
000653:         showSuccessToast('Organization rejected successfully.');
000654:         if (onApprovalChange) onApprovalChange();
000655:       }
000656:     } catch (error) {
000657:       console.error('Failed to reject organization:', error);
000658:       showErrorToast(error?.message || 'Failed to reject organization. Please try again.');
000659:     } finally {
000660:       setActionLoading(null);
000661:     }
000662:   };
000663: 
000664:   const handleViewDetails = async (org) => {
000665:     try {
000666:       const result = await apiClient.admin.getOrganization(org.id);
000667:       if (result.success) {
000668:         const nextRiskFlags = Array.isArray(result.verification?.riskFlags)
000669:           ? result.verification.riskFlags
000670:           : [];
000671:         setSelectedOrg({
000672:           ...org,
000673:           ...result.organization,

000679:         setExpandedSections({

000689:
