001189:                     className="flex-1 rounded-xl"
001190:                   >
001191:                     Cancel
001192:                   </Button>
001193:                   <Button
001194:                     onClick={confirmReject}
001195:                     size="lg"
001196:                     disabled={
001197:                       actionLoading
001198:                       || rejectReason.trim().length < MIN_REJECTION_REASON_LENGTH
001199:                       || (
001200:                         rejectReasonTags.includes(OTHER_REJECTION_TAG)
001201:                         && (
001202:                           rejectReasonTagOtherItems.length === 0
001203:                           && rejectReasonTagOther.trim().length < MIN_REJECTION_TAG_OTHER_LENGTH
001204:                         )
001205:                       )
001206:                     }
001207:                     loading={actionLoading === rejectTarget.id}
001208:                     className="flex-1 rounded-xl bg-red-600 hover:bg-red-700 text-white"
001209:                   >
001210:                     {actionLoading === rejectTarget.id ? 'Rejecting...' : 'Confirm Rejection'}
001211:                   </Button>
001212:                 </div>
001213:                 </div>
001214:               </motion.div>
001215:             </motion.div>
001216:           )}
001217:         </AnimatePresence>,

000001: /**

000014: import { callOllama, parseJSONResponse } from './llmClient.js';

000016: /**

000020: export class AIInterviewer {

000028:       interviewDuration: config.interviewDuration || 30,

000034:     this.currentPhase = 'introduction'; // introduction, questions, candidate_questions, closing
000035:     this.questionsAsked = 0;

000045:   /**

000048:   async startInterview() {
000049:     const systemPrompt = `You're an interviewer for ${this.config.jobRole} at ${this.config.company}. Welcome the candidate warmly and ask them to introduce themselves. Keep it brief (2-3 sentences).`;
000050: 
000051:     const userPrompt = `Welcome the candidate and ask for their introduction.`;
000052: 
000053:     try {
000054:       const messages = [
000055:         { role: 'system', content: systemPrompt },
000056:         { role: 'user', content: userPrompt }
000057:       ];
000058: 
000059:       const response = await callOllama(messages, { 
000060:         temperature: 0.8,
000061:         max_tokens: 150
000062:       });
000063: 
000064:       this.conversationHistory.push({
000065:         role: 'interviewer',
000066:         content: response,
000067:         timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
000068:         phase: 'introduction'
000069:       });
000070: 
000071:       return {
000072:         message: response,
000073:         phase: 'introduction',
000074:         nextAction: 'wait_for_introduction'
000075:       };
000076:     } catch (error) {
000077:       console.error('Error starting interview:', error);
000078:       throw new Error('Failed to start interview');
000079:     }
000080:   }
000081: 
000082:   /**
000083:    * Process candidate's introduction
000084:    */
000085:   async processIntroduction(candidateIntroduction) {
000086:     this.conversationHistory.push({
000087:       role: 'candidate',
000088:       content: candidateIntroduction,
000089:       timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
000090:       phase: 'introduction'
000091:     });
000092: 
000093:     const systemPrompt = `You're interviewing for ${this.config.jobRole} at ${this.config.company}.
000094: Candidate introduced themselves. Acknowledge briefly and ask a relevant interview question.
000095: 
000096: Respond in JSON:
000097: {
000098:   "message": "Brief acknowledgment + your question",
000099:   "type": "behavioral|technical",
000100:   "insights": ["key point 1", "key point 2"]
000101: }`;
000102: 
000103:     const userPrompt = `Candidate: "${candidateIntroduction}"
000104: 
000105: Acknowledge and ask first question.`;
000106: 
000107:     try {
000108:       const messages = [
000109:         { role: 'system', content: systemPrompt },
000110:         { role: 'user', content: userPrompt }
000111:       ];
000112: 
000113:       const response = await callOllama(messages, { 
000114:         temperature: 0.7,
000115:         max_tokens: 400
000116:       });
000117: 
000118:       const parsed = parseJSONResponse(response);
000119:       
000120:       // Update context memory
000121:       this.contextMemory.candidateBackground = parsed.insights?.join(', ') || '';
000122:       this.contextMemory.strengths = parsed.insights || [];
000123:       
000124:       // Update phase
000125:       this.currentPhase = 'questions';
000126:       this.questionsAsked = 1;
000127: 
000128:       this.conversationHistory.push({
000129:         role: 'interviewer',
000130:         content: parsed.message,
000131:         timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
000132:         phase: 'questions',
000133:         questionNumber: 1
000134:       });
000135: 
000136:       return {
000137:         message: parsed.message,
000138:         phase: 'questions',
000139:         questionNumber: 1,
000140:         totalQuestions: this.config.totalQuestions,
000141:         nextAction: 'wait_for_answer'
000142:       };
000143:     } catch (error) {
000144:       console.error('Error processing introduction:', error);
000145:       throw new Error('Failed to process introduction');
000146:     }
000147:   }
000148: 
000149:   /**
000150:    * Evaluate candidate's answer and determine next action
000151:    * - If answer is good: move to next question

000153:    * - If answer has errors: provide correction and ask for better response
000154:    */
000155:   async processAnswer(candidateAnswer) {
000156:     this.conversationHistory.push({
000157:       role: 'candidate',

000160:       phase: this.currentPhase

000162: 
000163:     // Get recent context (last 2 exchanges)
000164:     const recentContext = this.conversationHistory
000165:       .slice(-4)

000167:       .join('\n');
000168: 
000169:     const systemPrompt = `You're interviewing for ${this.config.jobRole}. Question ${this.questionsAsked}/${this.config.totalQuestions}.
000170: 
000171: Recent exchange:
000172: ${recentContext}
000173: 
000174: Evaluate answer (1-10) and respond as interviewer.
000175: 
000176: JSON format:
000177: {
000178:   "score": 7,
000179:   "action": "next_question|follow_up|correction",
000180:   "message": "Your response + next question if action is next_question"
000181: }
000182: 
000183: - next_question: Good answer, ask new question
000184: - follow_up: Ask for more detail/example

000186: 
000187:     try {
000188:       const messages = [
000189:         { role: 'system', content: systemPrompt },
000190:         { role: 'user', content: 'Evaluate and respond.' }
000191:       ];
000192: 
000193:       const response = await callOllama(messages, { 
000194:         temperature: 0.6,
000195:         max_tokens: 350
000196:       });
000197: 
000198:       const parsed = parseJSONResponse(response);
000199:

000202: 
000203:       // Determine if moving to next question

000207:

000212:         phase: 'questions',
000213:         questionNumber: this.questionsAsked,
000214:         actionType: parsed.action,
000215:         evaluation: { score: parsed.score }
000216:       });
000217:

000219:       const shouldEndQuestions = this.questionsAsked >= this.config.totalQuestions;
000220: 
000221:       return {

000223:         phase: shouldEndQuestions ? 'candidate_questions' : 'questions',
000224:         questionNumber: this.questionsAsked,

000226:         actionType: parsed.action,

000229:       };
000230:     } catch (error) {
000231:       console.error('Error processing answer:', error);

000233:     }
000234:   }
000235: 
000236:   /**
000237:    * Handle candidate's questions about the role/company
000238:    */
000239:   async answerCandidateQuestion(candidateQuestion) {
000240:     this.conversationHistory.push({

000246:

000144:     if (response.status === 401 || response.status === 403) {

000001: /**
000002:  * Audio Recorder Service
000003:  * Wraps MediaRecorder to capture microphone audio into a Blob (webm/opus)
000004:  * Provides simple start/stop API and basic duration tracking.
000005:  */
000006: 
000007: class AudioRecorderService {
000008:   constructor() {
000009:     this.mediaStream = null;
000010:     this.mediaRecorder = null;
000011:     this.chunks = [];
000012:     this.isRecording = false;
000013:     this.startTime = null;
000014:     this.mimeType = null;
000015:     this.pendingDataResolve = null;
000016:     this.onStart = null;
000017:     this.onStop = null;
000018:     this.onError = null;
000019:   }
000020: 
000021:   /**
000022:    * Start microphone recording
000023:    * @returns {Promise<boolean>} true if started
000024:    */
000025:   async start() {
000026:     if (this.isRecording) return false;
000027:     try {
000028:       // Request mic
000029:       this.mediaStream = await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({ audio: true });
000030: 
000031:       const mimeType = this.getSupportedMimeType();
000032:       this.mediaRecorder = new MediaRecorder(this.mediaStream, mimeType ? { mimeType } : undefined);
000033:       this.mimeType = this.mediaRecorder.mimeType || mimeType || null;
000034:       this.pendingDataResolve = null;
000035:       this.chunks = [];
000036: 
000037:       this.mediaRecorder.ondataavailable = (e) => {
000038:         if (e.data && e.data.size > 0) {
000039:           this.chunks.push(e.data);
000040:         }
000041:         if (this.pendingDataResolve) {
000042:           const resolve = this.pendingDataResolve;
000043:           this.pendingDataResolve = null;
000044:           resolve();
000045:         }
000046:       };
000047: 
000048:       this.mediaRecorder.onerror = (e) => {
000049:         console.error('MediaRecorder error:', e.error);
000050:         if (this.onError) this.onError(e.error);
000051:       };
000052: 
000053:       this.mediaRecorder.onstart = () => {
000054:         this.isRecording = true;
000055:         this.startTime = Date.now();
000056:         if (this.onStart) this.onStart();
000057:       };
000058: 
000059:       this.mediaRecorder.onstop = () => {
000060:         this.isRecording = false;
000061:         if (this.onStop) this.onStop();
000062:       };
000063: 
000064:       this.mediaRecorder.start(250); // collect small chunks
000065:       return true;
000066:     } catch (err) {
000067:       console.error('Failed to start recording:', err);
000068:       if (this.onError) this.onError(err);
000069:       return false;
000070:     }
000071:   }
000072: 
000073:   /**
000074:    * Stop recording and return a Blob of audio
000075:    * @returns {Promise<Blob>} recorded audio blob
000076:    */
000077:   async stop() {
000078:     if (!this.mediaRecorder || !this.isRecording) return null;
000079: 
000080:     const stopped = new Promise((resolve) => {
000081:       this.mediaRecorder.addEventListener('stop', () => resolve(true), { once: true });
000082:     });
000083: 
000084:     const dataFlushed = new Promise((resolve) => {
000085:       this.pendingDataResolve = resolve;
000086:     });
000087: 
000088:     try {
000089:       this.mediaRecorder.requestData?.();
000090:     } catch {}
000091: 
000092:     this.mediaRecorder.stop();
000093:     await stopped;
000094:     if (this.pendingDataResolve) {
000095:       await Promise.race([
000096:         dataFlushed,
000097:         new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 500))
000098:       ]);
000099:       this.pendingDataResolve = null;
000100:     }
000101: 
000102:     // Build blob
000103:     const mimeType = this.mimeType || this.mediaRecorder.mimeType || this.getSupportedMimeType() || 'audio/webm';
000104:     const blob = new Blob(this.chunks, { type: mimeType });
000105: 
000106:     // Cleanup
000107:     this.chunks = [];
000108:     this.mimeType = null;
000109:     if (this.mediaStream) {
000110:       this.mediaStream.getTracks().forEach(t => t.stop());
000111:       this.mediaStream = null;
000112:     }
000113:     this.mediaRecorder = null;
000114:     this.isRecording = false;
000115:     this.startTime = null;
000116: 
000117:     return blob;
000118:   }
000119: 
000120:   /**
000121:    * Abort and cleanup without returning audio
000122:    */
000123:   abort() {
000124:     try {
000125:       if (this.mediaRecorder && this.isRecording) {
000126:         this.mediaRecorder.stop();
000127:       }
000128:     } catch {}
000129:     if (this.mediaStream) {
000130:       this.mediaStream.getTracks().forEach(t => t.stop());
000131:       this.mediaStream = null;
000132:     }
000133:     this.mediaRecorder = null;
000134:     this.chunks = [];
000135:     this.isRecording = false;
000136:     this.startTime = null;
000137:     this.mimeType = null;
000138:     this.pendingDataResolve = null;
000139:   }
000140: 
000141:   /**
000142:    * Pick a supported mime type for MediaRecorder
000143:    */
000144:   getSupportedMimeType() {
000145:     const candidates = [
000146:       'audio/webm;codecs=opus',
000147:       'audio/webm',
000148:       'audio/ogg;codecs=opus',
000149:       'audio/ogg'
000150:     ];
000151:     for (const type of candidates) {
000152:       if (MediaRecorder.isTypeSupported(type)) return type;
000153:     }
000154:     return null;
000155:   }
000156: 
000157:   getDurationMs() {
000158:     return this.startTime ? Date.now() - this.startTime : 0;
000159:   }
000160: }
000161: 
000162: const audioRecorderService = new AudioRecorderService();
000163: export default audioRecorderService;
000164: 
```

000001: /**
000002:  * Interview Backend Sync Service
000003:  * 
000004:  * Bridges the AI Interviewer frontend flow with the backend database
000005:  * Handles syncing questions, answers, and evaluations with the backend
000006:  */
000007: 
000008: import { apiClient } from './apiClient.js';
000009: import { onValue, ref as dbRef } from 'firebase/database';
000010: import { realtimeDb } from '../config/firebase.js';
000011: 
000012: export class InterviewBackendSync {
000013:   constructor(interviewId) {
000014:     this.interviewId = interviewId;
000015:     this.questions = [];
000016:     this.currentQuestionIndex = -1;
000017:     this.initialized = false;
000018:     this.realtimeUnsubscribe = null;
000019:     this.lastRealtimeEventKey = '';
000020:   }
000021: 
000022:   /**
000023:    * Load interview from backend and initialize
000024:    */
000025:   async initialize() {
000026:     try {
000027:       const response = await apiClient.interviews.getById(this.interviewId);
000028:       
000029:       if (!response.success || !response.interview) {
000030:         throw new Error('Failed to load interview');
000031:       }
000032: 
000033:       this.interview = response.interview;
000034:       this.questions = response.interview.questions || [];
000035:       this.initialized = true;
000036: 
000037:       return {
000038:         interview: this.interview,
000039:         questions: this.questions,
000040:       };
000041:     } catch (error) {
000042:       console.error('Failed to initialize interview sync:', error);
000043:       throw error;
000044:     }
000045:   }
000046: 
000047:   /**
000048:    * Refresh interview state from backend.
000049:    */
000050:   async refreshInterview() {
000051:     const response = await apiClient.interviews.getById(this.interviewId);
000052:     if (!response.success || !response.interview) {
000053:       throw new Error('Failed to refresh interview');
000054:     }
000055: 
000056:     this.interview = response.interview;
000057:     this.questions = response.interview.questions || [];
000058:     this.initialized = true;
000059:     return this.interview;
000060:   }
000061: 
000062:   /**
000063:    * Subscribe to interview realtime events from Firebase RTDB.
000064:    */
000065:   subscribeToRealtime(onEvent) {
000066:     if (!realtimeDb || !this.interviewId) {
000067:       return () => {};
000068:     }
000069: 
000070:     this.destroyRealtimeSubscription();
000071: 
000072:     const lastEventRef = dbRef(realtimeDb, `sessions/${this.interviewId}/lastEvent`);
000073:     this.realtimeUnsubscribe = onValue(
000074:       lastEventRef,
000075:       async (snapshot) => {
000076:         const event = snapshot.val();
000077:         if (!event?.eventType) return;
000078: 
000079:         const eventKey = `${event.eventType}:${event.timestamp || ''}`;
000080:         if (eventKey === this.lastRealtimeEventKey) {
000081:           return;
000082:         }
000083:         this.lastRealtimeEventKey = eventKey;
000084: 
000085:         const eventsThatRequireRefresh = new Set([
000086:           'interview-started',
000087:           'interview-ended',
000088:           'question-asked',
000089:           'answer-submitted',
000090:           'pipeline-updated',
000091:         ]);
000092: 
000093:         if (eventsThatRequireRefresh.has(event.eventType)) {
000094:           try {
000095:             await this.refreshInterview();
000096:           } catch {
000097:             // Fail open: local interview can still proceed.
000098:           }
000099:         }
000100: 
000101:         if (typeof onEvent === 'function') {
000102:           onEvent(event);
000103:         }
000104:       },
000105:       () => {
000106:         // Keep fail-open behavior if realtime subscription fails.
000107:       },
000108:     );
000109: 
000110:     return () => {
000111:       this.destroyRealtimeSubscription();
000112:     };
000113:   }
000114: 
000115:   destroyRealtimeSubscription() {
000116:     if (typeof this.realtimeUnsubscribe === 'function') {
000117:       this.realtimeUnsubscribe();
000118:     }
000119:     this.realtimeUnsubscribe = null;
000120:     this.lastRealtimeEventKey = '';
000121:   }
000122: 
000123:   /**
000124:    * Get current question being asked
000125:    */
000126:   getCurrentQuestion() {
000127:     if (this.currentQuestionIndex >= 0 && this.currentQuestionIndex < this.questions.length) {
000128:       return this.questions[this.currentQuestionIndex];
000129:     }
000130:     return null;
000131:   }
000132: 
000133:   /**
000134:    * Get next question to ask
000135:    */
000136:   getNextQuestion() {
000137:     const nextIndex = this.currentQuestionIndex + 1;
000138:     if (nextIndex < this.questions.length) {
000139:       return {
000140:         question: this.questions[nextIndex],
000141:         index: nextIndex,

000150:   async markQuestionAsked(questionId) {
000151:     try {

000153:       
000154:       // Update local state
000155:       const questionIndex = this.questions.findIndex(q => q.id === questionId);
000156:       if (questionIndex >= 0) {
000157:         this.questions[questionIndex].askedAt = new Date();
000158:         this.currentQuestionIndex = questionIndex;
000159:       }
000160:       
000161:       return true;
000162:     } catch (error) {
000163:       console.error('Failed to mark question as asked:', error);
000164:       return false;

000166:   }
000167: 
000168:   /**
000169:    * Submit answer for a question
000170:    * Returns the evaluation result
000171:    */
000172:   async submitAnswer(questionId, answer, audioUrl = null) {
000173:     try {

000175:         this.interviewId,
000176:         questionId,
000177:         answer,
000178:         audioUrl
000179:       );
000180: 
000181:       if (!response.success) {
000182:         throw new Error('Failed to submit answer');
000183:       }
000184: 
000185:       // Update local question with answer and evaluation
000186:       const questionIndex = this.questions.findIndex(q => q.id === questionId);
000187:       if (questionIndex >= 0) {
000188:         this.questions[questionIndex] = {

000190:           ...response.question,

000193: 
000194:       return {

000199:       console.error('Failed to submit answer:', error);
000200:       throw error;
000201:     }
000202:   }

000204:   /**
000205:    * Start the interview on backend (if not already started)
000206:    */
000207:   async startInterview() {

000001: /**

000001: /**

000003:  * 
000004:  * Interfaces with the local faster-whisper Flask server for speech-to-text transcription.
000005:  * This bypasses OpenAI API calls and runs Whisper inference on the local GPU.
000006:  * 
000007:  * @module localWhisperService
000008:  */
000009: 
000010: const rawUrl = import.meta.env.VITE_LOCAL_WHISPER_URL?.trim();
000011: const LOCAL_WHISPER_URL = rawUrl ? rawUrl.replace(/\/$/, '') : null;
000012: const IS_WHISPER_ENABLED = Boolean(LOCAL_WHISPER_URL);
000013: 
000014: const getAudioExtension = (mimeType = '') => {
000015:   const normalized = mimeType.toLowerCase();
000016:   if (normalized.includes('webm')) return 'webm';
000017:   if (normalized.includes('ogg')) return 'ogg';
000018:   if (normalized.includes('m4a')) return 'm4a';
000019:   if (normalized.includes('mp4')) return 'mp4';
000020:   if (normalized.includes('wav')) return 'wav';
000021:   if (normalized.includes('mpeg') || normalized.includes('mp3')) return 'mp3';
000022:   return 'webm';
000023: };
000024: 
000025: const logWhisperDisabled = () => {
000026:   if (import.meta.env?.DEV) {
000027:     console.info(
000028:       'Local Whisper server disabled. Set VITE_LOCAL_WHISPER_URL to enable on-device transcription.',
000029:     );
000030:   }
000031: };
000032: 
000033: /**
000034:  * Check if the local Whisper server is running and ready
000035:  * @returns {Promise<boolean>} - True if server is healthy
000036:  */
000037: export async function checkLocalWhisperHealth() {
000038:   if (!IS_WHISPER_ENABLED) {
000039:     logWhisperDisabled();
000040:     return false;
000041:   }
000042: 
000043:   try {
000044:     const controller = new AbortController();
000045:     const timeoutId = setTimeout(() => controller.abort(), 10000); // 10 second timeout
000046:     
000047:     const response = await fetch(`${LOCAL_WHISPER_URL}/health`, {
000048:       method: 'GET',
000049:       signal: controller.signal
000050:     });
000051:     
000052:     clearTimeout(timeoutId);
000053:     
000054:     if (!response.ok) {
000055:       console.warn('Health check failed:', response.status);
000056:       return false;
000057:     }
000058:     
000059:     const data = await response.json();
000060:     console.log('✓ Whisper server healthy:', data);
000061:     return data.status === 'healthy' || data.status === 'ok';
000062:   } catch (error) {
000063:     console.warn('Local Whisper server not available:', error.message);
000064:     return false;
000065:   }
000066: }
000067: 
000068: /**
000069:  * Get available models on the local Whisper server
000070:  * @returns {Promise<Object>} - Model information
000071:  */
000072: export async function getLocalWhisperModels() {
000073:   if (!IS_WHISPER_ENABLED) {
000074:     throw new Error('Local Whisper server is not configured.');
000075:   }
000076: 
000077:   try {
000078:     const response = await fetch(`${LOCAL_WHISPER_URL}/models`);
000079:     if (!response.ok) throw new Error(`HTTP ${response.status}`);
000080:     return await response.json();
000081:   } catch (error) {
000082:     console.error('Failed to fetch local Whisper models:', error);
000083:     throw error;
000084:   }
000085: }
000086: 
000087: /**
000088:  * Transcribe audio using the local Whisper server
000089:  * @param {Blob} audioBlob - Audio data to transcribe (webm/wav/mp3)
000090:  * @param {Object} options - Transcription options
000091:  * @param {string} options.language - Language code (e.g., 'en', 'es') or 'auto'
000092:  * @param {boolean} options.translateToEnglish - Translate to English if true
000093:  * @returns {Promise<Object>} - Transcription result
000094:  */
000095: export async function transcribeWithLocalWhisper(audioBlob, options = {}) {
000096:   if (!IS_WHISPER_ENABLED) {
000097:     throw new Error('Local Whisper server is not configured.');
000098:   }
000099: 
000100:   const {
000101:     language = 'en',
000102:     translateToEnglish = false
000103:   } = options;
000104: 
000105:   try {
000106:     // Create FormData with audio file
000107:     const formData = new FormData();
000108:     const extension = getAudioExtension(audioBlob?.type || '');
000109:     formData.append('audio', audioBlob, `recording.${extension}`);
000110:     formData.append('language', language);
000111:     formData.append('task', translateToEnglish ? 'translate' : 'transcribe');
000112: 
000113:     // Send to local server
000114:     const response = await fetch(`${LOCAL_WHISPER_URL}/transcribe`, {
000115:       method: 'POST',
000116:       body: formData,
000117:       // Don't set Content-Type - browser sets it automatically with boundary
000118:     });
000119: 
000120:     if (!response.ok) {
000121:       const errorData = await response.json().catch(() => ({}));
000122:       throw new Error(errorData.error || `Server returned ${response.status}`);
000123:     }
000124: 
000125:     const result = await response.json();
000126:     
000127:     return {
000128:       text: result.text,
000129:       language: result.language,
000130:       confidence: result.confidence || null,
000131:       segments: result.segments || [],
000132:       duration: result.duration || null,
000133:       source: 'local-whisper'
000134:     };
000135:   } catch (error) {

000137:     throw error;
000138:   }
000139: }
000140: 
000141: /**

000146:  */
000147: export async function transcribeWithFallback(audioBlob, options = {}) {
000148:   if (!IS_WHISPER_ENABLED) {
000149:     throw new Error(

000151:     );
000152:   }
000153: 
000154:   console.log(`Attempting local Whisper transcription (${(audioBlob.size / 1024).toFixed(2)} KB audio)`);
000155:   console.log(`Whisper server URL: ${LOCAL_WHISPER_URL}`);
000156:   
000157:   try {

000161:

000173:     throw new Error(

000175:       `Troubleshooting:\n` +
000176:       `1. Ensure Whisper server is running: cd server && python whisper_server.py\n` +
000177:       `2. Check server logs for errors\n` +

000179:     );
000180:   }
000181: }
000182: 
000183: /**
000184:  * Get server statistics (for monitoring/debugging)

000186:  */
000187: export async function getLocalWhisperStats() {
000188:   try {
000189:     const [health, models] = await Promise.all([

000191:       getLocalWhisperModels().catch(() => null)
000192:     ]);
000193:     
000194:     return {

000204:       error: error.message,
000205:       timestamp: new Date().toISOString()
000206:     };
000207:   }
000208: }

000210: export default {

000040: /**

000045: const calculateAverages = (snapshots) => {

000048:       averageConfidence: 0,

000050:       totalSnapshots: 0,
000051:     };
000052:   }
000053: 
000054:   const totals = snapshots.reduce((acc, snapshot) => {
000055:     return {
000056:       confidence: acc.confidence + (snapshot.confidence || 0),
000057:       postureScore: acc.postureScore + (snapshot.postureScore || 0),
000058:       slouching: acc.slouching + (snapshot.slouching ? 1 : 0),
000059:       fidgeting: acc.fidgeting + (snapshot.fidgeting ? 1 : 0),
000060:       goodEyeContact: acc.goodEyeContact + (snapshot.eyeContact === 'good' ? 1 : 0),
000061:       goodPosture: acc.goodPosture + (snapshot.posture === 'good' ? 1 : 0),
000062:       centeredHead: acc.centeredHead + (snapshot.headPosition === 'centered' ? 1 : 0),
000063:     };
000064:   }, {
000065:     confidence: 0,
000066:     postureScore: 0,
000067:     slouching: 0,
000068:     fidgeting: 0,
000069:     goodEyeContact: 0,
000070:     goodPosture: 0,
000071:     centeredHead: 0,
000072:   });
000073: 
000074:   const count = snapshots.length;
000075: 
000076:   return {
000077:     averageConfidence: Math.round(totals.confidence / count),
000078:     averagePostureScore: Math.round(totals.postureScore / count),
000079:     slouchingPercentage: Math.round((totals.slouching / count) * 100),

000081:     eyeContactPercentage: Math.round((totals.goodEyeContact / count) * 100),
000082:     goodPosturePercentage: Math.round((totals.goodPosture / count) * 100),
000083:     centeredHeadPercentage: Math.round((totals.centeredHead / count) * 100),
000084:     totalSnapshots: count,
000085:     duration: snapshots[snapshots.length - 1]?.timestamp - snapshots[0]?.timestamp,
000086:   };
000087: };

000001: /**
000002:  * Speech Recognition Service
000003:  * Handles candidate voice input using Web Speech API
000004:  * Supports continuous recognition with pause detection
000005:  */
000006: 
000007: class SpeechRecognitionService {
000008:   constructor() {
000009:     // Check for browser support
000010:     const SpeechRecognition = window.SpeechRecognition || window.webkitSpeechRecognition;
000011:     
000012:     if (!SpeechRecognition) {
000013:       if (import.meta.env.DEV) {
000014:         console.info('Speech Recognition not supported in this browser');
000015:       }
000016:       this.supported = false;
000017:       return;
000018:     }
000019: 
000020:     this.supported = true;
000021:     this.recognition = new SpeechRecognition();
000022:     this.isListening = false;
000023:     this.isPaused = false;
000024:     this.finalTranscript = '';
000025:     this.interimTranscript = '';
000026:     this.silenceTimer = null;
000027:     this.silenceThreshold = 2000; // 2 seconds of silence
000028:     
000029:     // Configure recognition
000030:     this.recognition.continuous = true;
000031:     this.recognition.interimResults = true;
000032:     this.recognition.lang = 'en-US';
000033:     this.recognition.maxAlternatives = 1;
000034: 
000035:     // Event handlers (will be set by caller)
000036:     this.onResult = null;
000037:     this.onEnd = null;
000038:     this.onError = null;
000039:     this.onStart = null;
000040:     this.onSilenceDetected = null;
000041: 
000042:     // Setup event listeners
000043:     this.setupEventListeners();
000044:   }
000045: 
000046:   /**
000047:    * Setup recognition event listeners
000048:    */
000049:   setupEventListeners() {
000050:     if (!this.recognition) return;
000051: 
000052:     // Handle recognition results
000053:     this.recognition.onresult = (event) => {
000054:       let interim = '';
000055:       let final = '';
000056: 
000057:       for (let i = event.resultIndex; i < event.results.length; i++) {
000058:         const transcript = event.results[i][0].transcript;
000059:         
000060:         if (event.results[i].isFinal) {
000061:           final += transcript + ' ';
000062:         } else {
000063:           interim += transcript;
000064:         }
000065:       }
000066: 
000067:       // Update transcripts
000068:       if (final) {
000069:         this.finalTranscript += final;
000070:         this.resetSilenceTimer(); // Reset silence timer on new speech
000071:       }
000072:       
000073:       this.interimTranscript = interim;
000074: 
000075:       // Callback with results
000076:       if (this.onResult) {
000077:         this.onResult({
000078:           final: this.finalTranscript.trim(),
000079:           interim: this.interimTranscript.trim(),
000080:           isFinal: final.length > 0
000081:         });
000082:       }
000083:     };
000084: 
000085:     // Handle recognition end
000086:     this.recognition.onend = () => {

000101:     // Handle errors

000108:       }
000109: 
000110:       if (this.onError) {
000111:         this.onError(event.error);
000112:       }
000113:     };
000114: 
000115:     // Handle start
000116:     this.recognition.onstart = () => {
000117:       console.log('Recognition started');
000118:       this.isListening = true;
000119:       
000120:       if (this.onStart) {

000129:   /**

000131:    */
000132:   start() {
000133:     if (!this.supported) {

000135:       return false;
000136:     }
000137: 
000138:     if (this.isListening) {
000139:       console.log('Already listening');
000140:       return false;
000141:     }
000142: 
000143:     try {
000144:       // Reset transcripts
000145:       this.finalTranscript = '';
000146:       this.interimTranscript = '';
000147:       
000148:       this.recognition.start();
000149:       return true;

000151:       console.error('Failed to start recognition:', error);

000153:     }
000154:   }
000155: 
000156:   /**
000157:    * Stop listening
000158:    */
000159:   stop() {

000161:       return;

000163: 
000164:     try {
000165:       this.recognition.stop();
000166:       
000167:       // Clear silence timer

000001: /**
000002:  * Speech Service - Handles Text-to-Speech using Web Speech API
000003:  * Provides browser-based TTS for the AI interviewer's voice
000004:  */
000005: 
000006: class SpeechService {
000007:   constructor() {
000008:     this.synth = window.speechSynthesis;
000009:     this.currentUtterance = null;
000010:     this.isPaused = false;
000011:     this.availableVoices = [];
000012:     
000013:     // Load voices when available
000014:     this.loadVoices();
000015:     
000016:     // Some browsers load voices asynchronously
000017:     if (this.synth.onvoiceschanged !== undefined) {
000018:       this.synth.onvoiceschanged = () => this.loadVoices();
000019:     }
000020:   }
000021: 
000022:   /**
000023:    * Load available voices from the browser
000024:    */
000025:   loadVoices() {
000026:     this.availableVoices = this.synth.getVoices();
000027:     console.log('Available voices:', this.availableVoices.length);
000028:   }
000029: 
000030:   /**
000031:    * Get a suitable voice for the AI interviewer
000032:    * Prioritizes: English, female/neutral voices
000033:    */
000034:   getPreferredVoice() {
000035:     const voices = this.synth.getVoices();
000036:     
000037:     // Try to find a good English voice
000038:     const preferredVoices = [
000039:       // Google voices (high quality)
000040:       voices.find(v => v.name === 'Google UK English Female'),
000041:       voices.find(v => v.name === 'Google US English'),
000042:       // Microsoft voices
000043:       voices.find(v => v.name.includes('Microsoft Zira')),
000044:       voices.find(v => v.name.includes('Microsoft David')),
000045:       // macOS voices
000046:       voices.find(v => v.name === 'Samantha'),
000047:       voices.find(v => v.name === 'Alex'),
000048:       // Any English voice
000049:       voices.find(v => v.lang.startsWith('en-')),
000050:       // Fallback to first available
000051:       voices[0]
000052:     ];
000053: 
000054:     return preferredVoices.find(v => v !== undefined);
000055:   }
000056: 
000057:   /**
000058:    * Speak text using Web Speech API
000059:    * @param {string} text - The text to speak
000060:    * @param {Object} options - Speech options
000061:    * @returns {Promise} - Resolves when speech is complete
000062:    */
000063:   speak(text, options = {}) {
000064:     return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
000065:       if (!this.synth) {
000066:         reject(new Error('Speech synthesis not supported'));
000067:         return;
000068:       }
000069: 
000070:       // Cancel any ongoing speech
000071:       this.cancel();
000072: 
000073:       // Create utterance
000074:       const utterance = new SpeechSynthesisUtterance(text);
000075:       
000076:       // Set voice
000077:       const voice = this.getPreferredVoice();
000078:       if (voice) {
000079:         utterance.voice = voice;
000080:       }
000081: 
000082:       // Configure speech parameters
000083:       utterance.rate = options.rate || 1.0;      // Speed (0.1 to 10)
000084:       utterance.pitch = options.pitch || 1.0;    // Pitch (0 to 2)
000085:       utterance.volume = options.volume || 1.0;  // Volume (0 to 1)
000086:       utterance.lang = options.lang || 'en-US';
000087: 
000088:       // Event handlers
000089:       utterance.onstart = () => {
000090:         console.log('Speech started:', text.substring(0, 50));
000091:         if (options.onStart) options.onStart();
000092:       };
000093: 
000094:       utterance.onend = () => {
000095:         console.log('Speech ended');
000096:         this.currentUtterance = null;
000097:         if (options.onEnd) options.onEnd();
000098:         resolve();
000099:       };
000100: 
000101:       utterance.onerror = (event) => {
000102:         console.error('Speech error:', event.error);
000103:         this.currentUtterance = null;
000104:         if (options.onError) options.onError(event.error);
000105:         reject(new Error(`Speech error: ${event.error}`));
000106:       };
000107: 
000108:       utterance.onpause = () => {
000109:         this.isPaused = true;
000110:         if (options.onPause) options.onPause();
000111:       };
000112: 
000113:       utterance.onresume = () => {
000114:         this.isPaused = false;
000115:         if (options.onResume) options.onResume();
000116:       };
000117: 
000118:       // Store and speak
000119:       this.currentUtterance = utterance;
000120:       this.synth.speak(utterance);
000121:     });
000122:   }
000123: 
000124:   /**
000125:    * Pause current speech
000126:    */
000127:   pause() {
000128:     if (this.synth.speaking && !this.isPaused) {
000129:       this.synth.pause();
000130:       this.isPaused = true;
000131:     }
000132:   }
000133: 
000134:   /**
000135:    * Resume paused speech
000136:    */
000137:   resume() {
000138:     if (this.synth.speaking && this.isPaused) {
000139:       this.synth.resume();
000140:       this.isPaused = false;
000141:     }
000142:   }
000143: 
000144:   /**
000145:    * Cancel/stop current speech
000146:    */
000147:   cancel() {
000148:     if (this.synth.speaking || this.synth.pending) {
000149:       this.synth.cancel();
000150:       this.currentUtterance = null;
000151:       this.isPaused = false;
000152:     }
000153:   }
000154: 
000155:   /**
000156:    * Check if currently speaking
000157:    */
000158:   isSpeaking() {
000159:     return this.synth.speaking;
000160:   }
000161: 
000162:   /**
000163:    * Get all available voices
000164:    */
000165:   getVoices() {
000166:     return this.synth.getVoices();
000167:   }
000168: 
000169:   /**
000170:    * Check if speech synthesis is supported
000171:    */
000172:   static isSupported() {
000173:     return 'speechSynthesis' in window;
000174:   }
000175: }
000176: 
000177: // Export singleton instance
000178: const speechService = new SpeechService();
000179: export default speechService;
000180: 
```

000001: /**
000002:  * Name Generator Utility
000003:  * Generates random names for AI interviewers based on gender
000004:  */
000005: 
000006: const FEMALE_FIRST_NAMES = [
000007:   'Alexis', 'Amanda', 'Andrea', 'Ashley', 'Brittany', 'Brooke', 'Caitlin', 'Cassandra',
000008:   'Chloe', 'Christina', 'Claire', 'Diana', 'Emily', 'Emma', 'Grace', 'Hannah',
000009:   'Isabella', 'Jessica', 'Julia', 'Katherine', 'Lauren', 'Madison', 'Maya', 'Megan',
000010:   'Michelle', 'Nicole', 'Olivia', 'Rachel', 'Rebecca', 'Samantha', 'Sarah', 'Sophia',
000011:   'Stephanie', 'Taylor', 'Victoria', 'Zoe', 'Aria', 'Elena', 'Nina', 'Luna'
000012: ];
000013: 
000014: const MALE_FIRST_NAMES = [
000015:   'Alexander', 'Andrew', 'Benjamin', 'Brandon', 'Cameron', 'Christopher', 'Daniel',
000016:   'David', 'Ethan', 'James', 'Jason', 'Jonathan', 'Jordan', 'Joshua', 'Justin',
000017:   'Kevin', 'Kyle', 'Logan', 'Matthew', 'Michael', 'Nathan', 'Nicholas', 'Noah',
000018:   'Ryan', 'Samuel', 'Sean', 'Thomas', 'Tyler', 'William', 'Zachary', 'Marcus',
000019:   'Lucas', 'Oliver', 'Henry', 'Jack', 'Leo', 'Owen', 'Mason', 'Aiden'
000020: ];
000021: 
000022: const LAST_NAMES = [
000023:   'Anderson', 'Brown', 'Chen', 'Clark', 'Davis', 'Garcia', 'Harris', 'Jackson',
000024:   'Johnson', 'Jones', 'Kim', 'Lee', 'Lewis', 'Martinez', 'Miller', 'Moore',
000025:   'Patel', 'Rodriguez', 'Smith', 'Taylor', 'Thomas', 'Thompson', 'Walker', 'White',
000026:   'Williams', 'Wilson', 'Wong', 'Wright', 'Young', 'Zhang', 'Adams', 'Baker',
000027:   'Campbell', 'Carter', 'Cooper', 'Evans', 'Green', 'Hall', 'Hill', 'King',
000028:   'Mitchell', 'Murphy', 'Parker', 'Phillips', 'Roberts', 'Robinson', 'Scott', 'Stewart'
000029: ];
000030: 
000031: /**
000032:  * Generate a random name based on gender
000033:  * @param {string} gender - 'male' or 'female'
000034:  * @returns {string} - Full name (First Last)
000035:  */
000036: export function generateRandomName(gender = 'female') {
000037:   const isFemale = gender.toLowerCase() === 'female';
000038:   const firstNames = isFemale ? FEMALE_FIRST_NAMES : MALE_FIRST_NAMES;
000039:   
000040:   const randomFirstName = firstNames[Math.floor(Math.random() * firstNames.length)];
000041:   const randomLastName = LAST_NAMES[Math.floor(Math.random() * LAST_NAMES.length)];
000042:   
000043:   return `${randomFirstName} ${randomLastName}`;
000044: }
000045: 
000046: /**
000047:  * Generate multiple random names
000048:  * @param {string} gender - 'male' or 'female'
000049:  * @param {number} count - Number of names to generate
000050:  * @returns {Array<string>} - Array of full names
000051:  */
000052: export function generateRandomNames(gender = 'female', count = 5) {
000053:   const names = [];
000054:   const seen = new Set();
000055:   
000056:   while (names.length < count) {
000057:     const name = generateRandomName(gender);
000058:     if (!seen.has(name)) {
000059:       seen.add(name);
000060:       names.push(name);
000061:     }
000062:   }
000063:   
000064:   return names;
000065: }
000066: 
000067: /**
000068:  * Detect the gender of a name based on the first name
000069:  * @param {string} fullName - Full name (First Last)
000070:  * @returns {string|null} - 'male', 'female', or null if cannot determine
000071:  */
000072: export function detectNameGender(fullName) {
000073:   if (!fullName || typeof fullName !== 'string') {
000074:     return null;
000075:   }
000076:   
000077:   const firstName = fullName.trim().split(' ')[0];
000078:   
000079:   if (FEMALE_FIRST_NAMES.includes(firstName)) {
000080:     return 'female';
000081:   }
000082:   
000083:   if (MALE_FIRST_NAMES.includes(firstName)) {
000084:     return 'male';
000085:   }
000086:   
000087:   return null;
000088: }
000089: 
000090:

### 13.2.311 `src/utils/osDetection.js`
- Metadata: bytes=2276, lines=82, sha256=`842949befca32dacb695f983c8c4946d27de335708f750ea1bd8587b8a60c474`
```text
000001: /**
000002:  * Operating System Detection Utility
000003:  * Detects the user's operating system from the browser's user agent
000004:  */
000005: 
000006: /**
000007:  * Detect the operating system
000008:  * @returns {string} - 'windows', 'macos', 'linux', 'android', 'ios', or 'unknown'
000009:  */
000010: export function detectOS() {
000011:   if (typeof window === 'undefined') {
000012:     return 'unknown';
000013:   }
000014: 
000015:   const userAgent = window.navigator.userAgent.toLowerCase();
000016:   const platform = window.navigator.platform?.toLowerCase() || '';
000017: 
000018:   // Windows detection
000019:   if (userAgent.includes('win') || platform.includes('win')) {
000020:     return 'windows';
000021:   }
000022: 
000023:   // macOS detection
000024:   if (userAgent.includes('mac') || platform.includes('mac')) {
000025:     return 'macos';
000026:   }
000027: 
000028:   // iOS detection
000029:   if (userAgent.includes('iphone') || userAgent.includes('ipad') || userAgent.includes('ipod')) {
000030:     return 'ios';
000031:   }
000032: 
000033:   // Android detection
000034:   if (userAgent.includes('android')) {
000035:     return 'android';
000036:   }
000037: 
000038:   // Linux detection
000039:   if (userAgent.includes('linux') || platform.includes('linux')) {
000040:     return 'linux';
000041:   }
000042: 
000043:   return 'unknown';
000044: }
000045: 
000046: /**
000047:  * Check if the OS is Windows
000048:  * @returns {boolean}
000049:  */
000050: export function isWindows() {
000051:   return detectOS() === 'windows';
000052: }
000053: 
000054: /**
000055:  * Check if the OS is macOS
000056:  * @returns {boolean}
000057:  */
000058: export function isMacOS() {
000059:   return detectOS() === 'macos';
000060: }
000061: 
000062: /**
000063:  * Check if the OS is a mobile device
000064:  * @returns {boolean}
000065:  */
000066: export function isMobile() {
000067:   const os = detectOS();
000068:   return os === 'ios' || os === 'android';
000069: }
000070: 
000071: /**
000072:  * Detect if device is mobile or desktop
000073:  * @returns {string} - 'mobile' or 'desktop'
000074:  */
000075: export function detectDeviceType() {
000076:   if (typeof window === 'undefined') {
000077:     return 'desktop';
000078:   }
000079: 
000080:   // Check for mobile devices
000081:   const userAgent = window.navigator.userAgent.toLowerCase();
000082:   const isMobileDevice = /android|webos|iphone|ipad|ipod|blackberry|iemobile|opera mini/i.test(userAgent);
000083:   
000084:   // Also check screen width as additional indicator
000085:   const isSmallScreen = window.innerWidth <= 768;
000086:   
000087:   return (isMobileDevice || isSmallScreen) ? 'mobile' : 'desktop';
000088: }
000089: 
000090: /**
000091:  * Check if device is desktop
000092:  * @returns {boolean}
000093:  */
000094: export function isDesktop() {
000095:   return detectDeviceType() === 'desktop';
000096: }
000097: 
000098: 
```

000001: const SPECIAL_CHAR_REGEX = /[!@#$%^&*(),.?":{}|<>]/;

000004:   { key: 'length', label: 'At least 8 characters', test: (pwd = '') => (pwd || '').length >= 8 },
000005:   { key: 'lowercase', label: 'Lowercase letter', test: (pwd = '') => /[a-z]/.test(pwd || '') },

000007:   { key: 'number', label: 'Number', test: (pwd = '') => /\d/.test(pwd || '') },

000009: ];

000015:     return acc;
000016:   }, {});
000017: };
000018:

000020:   PASSWORD_REQUIREMENTS.every((requirement) => requirement.test(password || ''));
000021:

000023:   PASSWORD_REQUIREMENTS
000024:     .filter((requirement) => !requirement.test(password || ''))
000025:     .map((requirement) => requirement.label);

000015: const toTitleCase = (value) => {
000016:   const normalized = value.replace(/[_-]+/g, ' ').trim();
000017:   if (!normalized) return '';
000018:   return normalized
000019:     .split(/\s+/)
000020:     .map((word) => {
000021:       const lower = word.toLowerCase();
000022:       return lower ? `${lower[0].toUpperCase()}${lower.slice(1)}` : '';
000023:     })
000024:     .join(' ');
000025: };
000026:

000028:   if (!value || typeof value !== 'string') return '';
000029:   const trimmed = value.trim();
000030:   if (!trimmed) return '';
000031: 
000032:   const fieldLabels = candidateFieldLabels[field] || {};
000033:   const mapped = fieldLabels[trimmed.toLowerCase()];
000034:   if (mapped) return mapped;
000035: 
000036:   const isAllLower = trimmed === trimmed.toLowerCase();
000037:   const hasDelimiters = /[-_]/.test(trimmed);
000038: 
000039:   return isAllLower || hasDelimiters ? toTitleCase(trimmed) : trimmed;
000040: };

000143:   return colors[role?.toUpperCase()] || 'bg-gray-100 dark:bg-slate-700 text-gray-600 dark:text-slate-300';
000144: };
000145: 
000146: /**
000147:  * Filter navigation items based on role permissions
000148:  * Supports both flat items and nested items (groups with submenus)
000149:  * @param {Array} navItems - Navigation items array
000150:  * @param {string} role - User's organization role
000151:  * @returns {Array}
000152:  */
000153: export const filterNavByRole = (navItems, role) => {
000154:   if (!role || !Array.isArray(navItems)) return navItems;
000155:   
000156:   return navItems
000157:     .map(item => {
000158:       // If item has nested items (submenu), filter those too
000159:       if (item.items && Array.isArray(item.items)) {
000160:         const filteredSubItems = filterNavByRole(item.items, role);
000161:         // If group has no requiredPermission, check if any subitem is visible
000162:         if (!item.requiredPermission) {
000163:           // Only include group if it has visible subitems
000164:           return filteredSubItems.length > 0 ? { ...item, items: filteredSubItems } : null;
000165:         }
000166:         // If group has requiredPermission, check it first
000167:         if (hasPermission(role, item.requiredPermission)) {
000168:           return { ...item, items: filteredSubItems };
000169:         }
000170:         return null;
000171:       }
000172:       
000173:       // Regular item (no submenu)
000174:       if (item.requiredPermission) {
000175:         return hasPermission(role, item.requiredPermission) ? item : null;
000176:       }
000177:       // If no permission specified, show by default
000178:       return item;
000179:     })
000180:     .filter(item => item !== null); // Remove filtered out items
000181: };
000182: 
000183:
